tei:div.tei:p: ji ga rjo(/smo nga
(85)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ 9mi (85)0506 thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po pasgyu ka ra bza dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(22) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(25)0507 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 26rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 26'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ 26dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga 39rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba'i rtog pa chen po/ 41de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtog pa/ 571

rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 60las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gyi cho ga 66phyag na rdo rje'i rtog pa/ 69spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rtog pa/ 77nam mkha'i snying po'i rtog pa/ 83rdo rje khu tshur gyi rtog pa/ 87'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rtog pa/ 95rdo rje 'khor lo'i rtog pa/ 98nam mkha' mdzod kyi rtog pa/ 100byams pa'i rtog pa/ 101rig pa'i blon po chen po'i rtog pa/ 103rdo rje khro bo'i rtog pa/ 103tshogs kyi gtso bo'i rtog pa/ 104pho nya'i tshogs kyi rtog pa/ 104bran gyi rtog pa/ 105rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo rnams kyi rtog pa/ 105rdo rje khro mo rnams kyi rtog pa/ 106rdo rje tshogs ma mo'i rtog pa/ 106rdo rje pho nya mo'i rtog pa/ 107bran mo'i rtog pa/ 107phyi ma'i rgyud/ 108de kho na chen po zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ 108snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa'i rab tu bya ba/ 110phyag rgya bcing ba'i rab tu bya ba/ 1112

rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas pa zha lu pa ye shes rgya mtshos tshig don la legs par dpyad nas zhus/bsdur mchan/(140) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(163)0508 de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa zhes bya ba/ 164rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī/ garbha dang /bod kyi lotstsha ba bande dza ya rakṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus/ ā tsārya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(255) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(274)0509 mngon spyod kyi las/ 275rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī garbha dang /lotstsha ba brje dza ya rakṣi tas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(277) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(277)0510 de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa zhes bya ba/ 278rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun chen po de bend+ra de ba'i zhabs dang / bla ma paṇa chen skyes bu chen po mā ṇi ka shrī tshwa na'i zhal snga nas gus par mnyan 3

te chag lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong chos ṭwāṃ ༵༵la gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(400) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(431)0511 rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud/ 432kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po tsā na badzra dang / lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(442) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(446)0512 dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/ 447rdo rje sems dpa'i rtog pa/ 447de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtog pa/ 463'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa/ 464'gro ba 'dul ba'i rtogapa/ 473rin po che'i rigs kyi rtog pa/ 477khu tshur gyi rtog pa/ 479'jam dpal gyi rtog pa/ 484rdo rje 'khor lo'i rtog pa/ 486nam mkha' mdzod kyi rtog pa/ 488rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rtog pa/ 491rigs bsdus pa'i rtog pa/ 493phyi rol rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rtog pa/ 495shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul/ 501

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shad dmā ka ra bza dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(503) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(513)0513 dpal mchog dang po'i sngags kyi rtog pa'i dum bu zhes bya ba/ 514rtsa rgyud bstan pa/ 514de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po rdo rje gsang ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo/ 514rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje gsang ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 516de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 534rab tu dga' ba las byung ba rdo rje gsang ba rnam par rgyal ba'i dam tshig gi cho ga rgyas pa/ 536bde ba chen po padma'i rigs kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 538bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad kyi nor bu'i rigs kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 540rigs bsdus pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 542bde ba chen po'i dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje gsang ba la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 543dang po'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i phyag rgya thams cad kyi rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 546bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud/ 557las kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 559de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 563rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 564

padma'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 564nor bu'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 565phyi rol gyi phyag rgya'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 567rtog pa thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyag rgya'i rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 567rigs thams cad rtogs pa'i gsang ba thogs pa med cing gdon mi za ba'i de kho na nyid kyi bden pa myur du mchog gi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 568rgyud phyi ma bstan pa/ 570rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 570de kho na nyid sgrub pa'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 576de kho na nyid chen po'i gsang ba'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ 577rtog pa thams cad kyi las kyi phyag rgya bshad pa/ 578rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 585rdo rje slob dpon byin gyis brlab cing 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 585slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 596rtog pa thams cad kyi sgrub pa chen po don yod par 'grub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 599rtog pa thams cad sgrub pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud/ 602dang po'i snying po ma bsgrubs pa'i thams cad don yod pa thogs pa med las thams cad kyi rgyu skad cig la bsgrub pa/ 605phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 608de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi mchog sgrub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 608de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ 612

sgrub pa chen po cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 614rdo rje me dang nyi ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 621sgrub pa chen po cho ga'i rgyud/ 623chos thams cad sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 627phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa nyid de'i rgyud/ 628bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa rdo rje rin chen gyi rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 630'jig rten gsum 'byin pa'i rgyud/ 632sring mo bzhi'i rgyud/ cho 634klu'i dkyil 'khor/ 635sdug bsngal thams cad las 'don pa'i rgyud/ 636dkyil 'khor thams cad/ 637gsang ba ras bris kyi cho ga 640gsang ba chen po dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum dang dngos grub thams cad dgug pa dang / mchod pa chen po dang / bdag byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 640dga' ba chen po'i dpal rdo rje don yod pa'i dga' ba'i dam tshig rnal 'byor thams cad kyi dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal rang gi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsang ba/ 6gode bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga shin tu gsang ba/ 650mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga 665rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi cho ga 666mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi

cho ga mchog tu grub pa/ 668rtog pa thams cad kyi bsgrub pa'i cho ga 677dngos grub thams cad byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga mchog tu gsang ba/ 679shin tu gsang ba'i rnal 'byor thams cad kyi cho ga mchog tu gsang ba/ 681phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 687dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga 687phyag rgya thams cad kyi rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 691rdo rje khro bo rgyal po'i phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 700'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 709dbang bskur ba thams cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 711phyi'i phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 712rigs thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 713gsang ba'i bla ma dam pa'i dpal rang gi dam tshig gi bla na med pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i cho ga 714mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 717mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 723dam pa mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyud/ 730rtog pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyi mchog 732rgya gar gyi mkhan po pa'i ta mkhas pa chen po mant+ra kā la sha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba lha btsan po dge slong bla ma zhi ba'i 'od kyi snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(743) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(800)la phab/0514 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga 8
bsdur mchan/(818) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(821)

༄ga /thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/0tsho༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ra ha sro nā ma tant+ra rā dzā/ bod skad du/thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung lnga nyid kyis lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /mi rnams lus la nges par mthong ba dag /rang sems rab tu bsgoms 97par gyur na ni/ /dngos der bsgoms tshonapas nges par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /rang shes gsang ba dam pa ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med de/ /gnyis med gnyis kyi tshul can te/ /sangs rgyas rtag par rab tu 'dud/ / gang yang 0)bdag med las byung zhing / /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /sdug dang mi sdug rnam 5spangs pa/ /ci la'ang phyag ni mi 'tshal to/ /ma skyes pa ni yang dag bskyed96/ /skyes pa'i 'og tu rtag par ni/ /sangs rgyas skur ni bsgom 97)pa de/ /rang gi ye shes mchog phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor pa dang sems can kun/ /ma skyes pa ni 85—3

yang dag bskyed1 / /skyes pa'i 'og tu rtag par ni/ /nyon mongs bag chags kyis sun 'byin/ /lus can rnams ni 'khor gyur pa/ /sdug dang mi sdug rnam 'byed yin/ /sems gang de nyid sdug bsngal te/ /sems can rnams kyi 0lus 'byung ngo / /sems de yi ni rgyun nyid kyis/ge/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal gnon mepar 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mgon/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus gcig nerapu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba sgrol ba po/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i nyams dang yang dag ldan/ /rgyu yi de nyid mnyam sbyor bas/ /'bras bu'i de nyid rnams kyang ston/ /'bras bu'i de nyid yang dag zhugs/ /rgyu yi de nyid mi 'dod do/ /gang du 'dod pa skyes gyur pa/ /de nyid 'khor ba'i bag chags yin / /mkhas pa yi ni cho ga yis/ /bsgom (pepa ru ni yongs su brtagasadu/ /gang zhig slar yang gcig gyur pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnal 'byor byung / /sangs rgyas rjes dran la dmigs shing / /chos ni rjes su dmigs pa yi/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis dam pa nyid du 'gyur/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag ste/ /sangs rgyas skur ni rnam par bsgom6nye/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni bsgom gepar bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag ste/ /rdo rje chos ni rnam par bsgomatha/ /chos ni rjes dran rnal 'byor pa/ /chos kyi sprin 12las char rab 'bebs/ /mtshan ma ling ga zhes bshad de/ /phyag rgya'i nyu rimatshan ma rnam pa bzhi/ /'joms pas bha ga zhes bshad de / /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i dam pa yin/ /sems can kun gyi dngos kun gyi / /rang sems chos ni bsdus pa yin/ /chos bdag med pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /85—4

bsad ①na rang nyid 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang gi sems nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rtogs par bya ba sems nyid yin/ /rang gi sems nyid gsad ②bya ba/ /sems nyid kho na gsad ①par bya/ /sbyor ba nyid dang yang dag 'brel/ /gang yang srid pa 'byung ma yin/ /gang tshe sangs rgyas de tshe ni/ /sbyor lnga sangs rgyas bdag ces bsgom④/ /ting 'dzin ye shes las byung ba/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir mdor bsdus pas⑤/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor med par ⑥ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /phra mo'i dngos po ci bzhin (pemathong / /sdug pa'i dngos por de bzhin te/ /dngos dang dngos med khyad 3)par ni/ /bsgom ⑨pa kun tu brtags pa yin/ /dngos po bsgom ⑩pa'i dngos ma yin/ /bsgom (1par bya ba bsgom 8pa min8/ /dngos po bsgoms ④par gyur pa yis8/ /rang gi ⑩sems ni yongs su sbyangs7/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas yul ma yin/ /sems can yul du'ang mi 'gyur gyi8/ /rang sems rtogs pas sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rtogs pas min/ /gnyis med sbyor ba 'di la yang / /ting nge 7/)'dzin gyis rngo )ye shes brtags0/ /rgyu yi de nyid ji ltar mthong / /'bras bu'i de nyid de nyid yin/ /rgyu yi de nyid cung zad med/ /'bras bu'i de nyid de bzhin no / /de nyid de ni de bzhin shes/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pa kun spyod/ /rgyu yis rgyu ni dngos por min/ /'bras bu'i dngos por 'bras bus min/ /rgyu de 'bras bu'i dngos por rung / /rang gi sems ni so sor snang / /ye shes de ni rgyu dngos te/ /gsang de 'bras bu'i dngos po yin/ /gsang ba gnyis med spyod pa na yis/ /de yi na dngos pos mchog yin no/ /de nyid de nyid rtogs gyur pa/ /gsang de gsang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba de rig shes pa ste/ /85—5

mchog ni mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ /sdug pa'i ngo bor gang bshad pa/ /mi sdug pa yang de yi dngos/ /sdug dang mi sdug gzugs gang yin/ /mi mthong de ni de bzhin nya3)gshegs/ /rnam shes tsam ni med pa ru/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ci dzokyeltar ye shes mchog dag pa/ /de ltar dag pa de bzhin gshegs / /rnam par shes pa rnam pa bzhi/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi cho ga yis/ /gsang ba gnyis med sbyor (gyib yis/ /sku gsung thugs ni yang dag byung / /thugs ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ /dam tshig phyag rgya kun tu 'gro/ /chos kyi phyag rgya gsung gi ste/ /las kyi phyag rgya sku yi yin/ /rgya yis rgyas btab dngos po ni/ /gsang bdag gsang ba'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /rang rig pa yi ngo bo yis/ /ting 'dzin ye shes brtags pa yin/ /lus ngag sems su rnam brtags pa'i/ /bya ba rgyud du rnam brtags pa/ /gsang ba rnam pa gsum ④du bshad/ /rdo rje las can sna tshogs bzhin/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi bdag nyid ni/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bla med yin/ /phyag rgya bzhi po gsang ba de/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rgyalas grub byed / /'byung ba chen po bzhi po (6)yang / /phyag rgya bzhi zhes bshad pa yin/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi (amanyam sbyor ba/ /lha mo bzhi dang yang dag sbyor/ /sa ni spyan zhes bshad pa yin/ /chu ni mā ma tī (dezhes bshad/ /me ⑨dang rlung zhes grags pa ni/ /gos dkar mo dang sgrol rngum yin/ /dbang chen sa yi khams yin te/ /chu yi khams ni chu dkyil 'khor/ /me ni me yi khams yin te⑩/ /rlung ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dbang chen kha dog ser po ste/ /gru bzhi pa ste rgyas pa yin/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor skum po ste/ /dkar po'i mdog can zhi ba'i 8yin/ /me yi dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar/ /gru gsum dbang gi 8las rnams la'o/ /rlung gi 85—6

dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs0)/ /nag po'i gdug pa'i las rnams la/ /'byung ba che ②bdag las grub pa/ /las kyi dngos grub yon tan bzhi/ /las kyi dngos grub dngos grub mchog /'khor los sgyur (kyeb rnam pa bzhi/ /zhi ba la ni spyan gyi tshul/ /rgyas pa padma'i rdo rje can/ /dbang la rnam par snang mdzad gnas / /rdo rje khro bo mngon spyod la'oli/ /zhi ba dgongs ka bya ba yin/ /de bzhin rgyas pa snga ②dro la/ /gdug pa'i las rnams nyi ma'i gung / /dbang gi las ni mtshan phyed yibya/ /zhi la dkar po sbyar rishe)bar bya/ /ser por snang ba rgyas pa la/ /dbang gi las la (shedamar po ste/ /gdug pa nag po rab tu sbyar/ /ting 'dzin ye shes las byung ba/ /las kyi bsgrub 9pa dam pa yin/ /bcom ldan dag pa bsgom bya boste/ /sangs rgyas kun las mi g.yo gyur/ /bha ga'i dbus su gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje'i nyushedabyings ni de bzhin gshegs/ /lnga yi bdag gyur bdag nyid ni/ /bsgoms na g.yo ba med par 'gyuranyurte/ /snying la gnas pa'i lha mo che/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnal 'byor bskyed/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed hunyemadzad yum/ /rdo rje chadabyings kyi dbang mor 12bshad/ /'dod chags zhe tshesnang gti mug ste/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /rdo rje dbyings ni de bzhin gshegs/ /chags dang snang dang rmongs pa rnams/ /bsgoms nas khams gsum pa yi bdag /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gyur te/ /sangs rgyas bden pas 1 tshodug bcom mo /rang sems so sor rtogs pa yis/snye/ /gti mug sems ni de bzhin gshegs/ /rmongs pa nyid ni 'jig rten gyur/ /sems can kun la blta bar bya/ / zhe sdang 19sems ni de bzhin ༷ — stagashegs/ /phra mo'i ye shes yang dag bskyed31/ /sdang gyur 85—7

rdo rje nyid du gyur/ /sems can thams cad gzhig par bya/ /'dod chags sems ni de bzhin gshegs/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /chags gyur bzang po nyid gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya/ /byams pa'i sems ni de bzhin gshegs/ /nga rgyal yang dag bskyed nas ni/ /mdza' bor gyur cing kun nyid gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'khyud par ①bya/ /chags pa'i lta bas byams pa ste/ /thugs rje'i chos ni smra ba rdo dang / /kun la mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes bya ba'o②/ /rnal 'byor sbyin las rab dga' ste/ /tshul khrims ldan las dri med 'gyur/ / bzod pa las casani 'od byed pa/ /brtson las 'od 'phro can dang ldan/ /bsam gtan las ni sbyang 5dka' ba/ /shes rab kyis (7ni mngon gyur mthong / /thabs chen las ni ring du song / /stobs dang ldan las mi g.yo 'gyur/ /smon lam gyis ⑦ni legs blo ldan/ /ye shes ldan las chos kyi sprin/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /rang rig bdag nyid bcu gcig 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu rnams dang ske/ /stobs dang dbang ni rdzogs gyur cing / /sa bcu las ni 'das gyur pa / /mtshan ma brtan gyur de las ni/ /rdo rje'i (84chu ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi bcud len yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mtha' yas pa /gzung dang 'dzin pa spongs 9pa yin/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi bcud kyis ⑩len/ /rdo rje'i chu ni dag 'thungs pas/1/ /rdo rje slob dpon rnal 'byor pa/ /gdod 8nas dag par de tshe 'gyur/ /gdod nyu nas dag par gnas gyur pa/ /de nas byang chub sems su 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi bdag can 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam par grol ba'i ras kyis bogayogs/ /85—8

byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /yang dag bskyed gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying la 'dug /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i ma (17gyur dam tshig 'dzin byed pa/ /rdo rje dam tshig gis spyod na/ /rtag rin/tu dam tshig gnas par 'gyur(gyi/ /khams gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /bud med ces ④bshad ji snyed pa/ /cho ga bzhin du kun spyod (5)cing / /thugs kyi rdo rje smad mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sku la gnas/ /dam tshig phyag rgya ji snyed (65pa/ /rdo rje dam tshig gsum gyis ④bya/ /gsung gi rdo rje smad 98)mi bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /phyag rgya kun ni bud med bzang / /de rnams sten 9spyopa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyag rgya thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /bud med ces bya ji snyed ⑩pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba yin⑩ / —/de dag kun la nye bar sbyor8/ /gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ /ting 'dzin ye shes dam pa yin/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /nga rgyal ma yin hūṃ ma yin/ /rig hu pa ma yin sngags rig min/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya'ang mi bca'o0/ /mchod rten gyi ④ni las mi bya/ /glegs bam dag kyang bklag ⑩mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni mi bya zhing / /rdo rje mchog gsum phyag mi btsala'o sna / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /khyod kyis 3)srog chags gsad tsho/—rtepar bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /khyod kyis ( — )ma byin blang bya zhing / /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya/ /sbyin sreg 2lhayang na bsam gtan min/ /lus ngag yid ni mi phyed 32pa/ /gzhan min sems kyis 3bya ba ste/ /'di ni gsang ba'i ririmachog yin no/ /sngags rnams thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /rnal 'byor kun kyang rnam kun tu/ /de bas 'bad pa 85—9

thams cad kyis1)/ /sangs rgyas chos ni bsgom ②par bya/ /ma 'dres chos ni bcwa rin brgyad po/ /sangs rgyas chos zhes bshad pa yin/ /de rnams rtag tu bsgom pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sgrub byed yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /rtag tu thob par byas pa dang / /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu bsgrub/ /byang chub phyogs ni sum cu 54bdun/ /chos su yang dag bshad pa gang / /de rnams bsgoms ⑤pas dag pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' (ca'agro phan yin/ /'gro ba rnams la spro ba'i sems/ /brtan zhing snying po rab bsgoms pa/ /stong pa'i ⑦de nyid las byung ba/ /rdo rje ye shes zhes bya bshad/ /chos bdag med las yang dag byung / /gnyis med ye shes dam pa ste/ /chos nyid mchog gi ye shes ni/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes yang dag bshad/ /'di ni chos dbyings ye shes tedu/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin skyes/ /rdo rje ye shes rang bzhin sems/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes bya bar bshad/ /sems kyi spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /phra mo'i ye shes sogs sbyor ba / /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad ces byar bshad / /byams pa spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba spyod (spupar byed pa'i mchog /zag med brtan par gyur pa yi/ /thugs ni mi bskyod pa zhes bshad/ /thugs rje spro ba'i tshul gyis tsheni/ /sems can phan 'dogs mdzad pa po/ /thugs ni 'gro don yang dag ldan/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bshad do/ /dga' bas spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /theg chen mchog ni dri ma med/ /thugs ni 'od gsal dag pa ni/ /'od dpag med ces de bshad do/ /btang snyoms spro bar mdzad pa'i shugs/ /sems can thams cad rtogs mdzad pa/ /don yod bla med bya 85—10

ba ni/ /don yod grub par de bshad do/ /byang chub rang bzhin ye shes mchog /de 'dir rdo rje zhes bshad de0)/ /rdo rje ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ②de bshad do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pa/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bshad de/ /rdo rje'i rigs rnams kun gyi rgyal/ /rdo rje rgyal por de bshad do / /sangs rgyas thams cad chags byed pas(khu/ /mnyes par byed pa zhes bshad deli/ /bdud kyi sbyor ba chags pa che/ /rdo rje chags par de bshad do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed cing / /legs so zhes pa rab sogs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed pas/ /rdo rje legs par de bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa gang / /mkha' mnyam 5 rdo rje las byung ba/ /don yod rin chen chen po steyi/ /rdo rje rin chen de bshad do/ /ma rig bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs dag (pelas ni nges par byung / /thar pa'i snang ba gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje nyi mar de bshad do/ /rnam pa kun gyi dngos ye shes/ /thar pa'i lam 'jug thob mdzad gang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan tog chen po/ /rdo rje dbal du de bshad do/ /rdo rje bzhad 2pa rnal 'byor che/ /sangs rgyas kun 'byung rmad byung ba/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje bzhad par 9tshe de bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor che/ /sangs rgyas chos ni rtogs mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos dag pa/ /rdo rje chos su de bshad do/ /shes rab rnon po theg pa che/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges gcod mdzad/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa gcod tshepa po/ /rdo rje rnon por de bshad do/ /sangs rgyas rol mo'i 'khor lo ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nyinyabs/ /sems dpa' chen po theg pa che/ /rdo rje rgyu zhes de bshad do/ /shes rab ye shes rang bzhin 85—11

dag /gsung gi sgra ni rnam par spangasatshi/ /'jam pa'i gsung gi bdag nyid gyur / /rdo rje smra bar de bshad do/ /pha rol phyin pa kun gyi zhabs/ /chos rnams thams cad rtogs mdzad pa/ /sems can kun don sprul pa po/ /rdo rje las zhes bya bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran yang dag grub/ /theg pa dman pa rnam spangs shing / /byang chub sems la rab zhugs pa/ /rdo rje bsrung ④bar de bshad do/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed cing / /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam rinasreg la/ /nyon mongs zad pa nyer len pas/ /rdo rje ④gnod sbyin de bshad do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /bcing ba ru ni yang dag gyur/ /de nyid de nyid ye shes te/ /rdo rje khu tshur zhes bshad do/ /dam tshig phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /rdo rje bsdams 5las yang dag byung / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gyur pa/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes bshad do/ /nga rgyal med cing snang ba med/ /mtshan ma med cing zhen pa med/ /bdag med mnyam nyid ye shes ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rig zhes byar bshad/ /gsang ba'i mnyam par 'byor pa 'dir/ /ye shes pha rol phyin dge ba/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis yang dag byung / /rdo rje pha rol phyin pa'i 'od/ /byang chub sems ni rab bsgoms ༷ dpas pha rol sangs rgyas nyid son pa'i/ /pha rol phyin thob ye shes ni/ /rdo rje sems mar bshad pa yin / /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdo rje/ /chos bzhi gcig tu gyur pa nitshonas/ /rdo rje rin chen mar bshad do/ /gsang ba'i ye shes ye shes che/ /de nyid pha rol phyin dge ba/ /pha rol phyin pa che las byung ske/ /rdo rje chos mar shes par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dge ba ni/ /sbyor ba'i thabs su rab 'obastan pa/ /rdo rje las mar shes par bya/ /gang phyir de ni 85—12

rol ba dgi①/ /sgeg mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin dge bas / /brgyan /snyepa'i yan lag yid 'ong yin/ /glu ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /ched gdu brjod pa'i chos brjod pa'o/ /gar ma brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid ster ba'o/ /bdug sgo cig shes rab pha rol phyin/ /kun tu khyab par spros phyir ro/ /me tog bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /'dod pa'i 'dam gyis (shem gos pa'o/ /mar me smon lam pha rol phyin/ /phyogs kun snang bar byed pa yin/ /dri ni thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /dri ngan thur sel dge ba yin / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs chen po/ /dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yis 6gnas/ /thams cad 'dod pa'i thabs chen po/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bshad do/ /byang chub spyad ④pa spyod byed pa/ /rdo rje zhags pa zhes bshad do/ /theg pa 'di la brtan 'gyur 78rigang / /rdo rje lcags sgrog ces bshad do/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes shing / /gdod nas zhi ba mkha' dang mnyam/ /de lta'i tshig ni rab 'jug pas/ /rdo rje dril bu zhes bshad do/ /tshogs gnyis kyis 9ni sbyor ba yis / /sems can kun gyi don ston pa'i/ /sems ni rang bzhin gyis bo'od gsal / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par bshad/ /yang dag rdo rje rtogs pa ste/ /'dzin pa'i sbyor nyid lcags kyu yin/ /phra bar 11'bigs pa mda' zhes bya/ /dgyes pas legs so zhes bya ba/ /spras pas rin po che ru bshad/ /gzi brjid ces bya nyi ma yin/ /bsgreng nyanabs tog tu bshad pa ste/ /rnam par 'byed pas bzhad par bshad/ /'dod chags dag pa nya padma yin/ /nyon mongs dgra bcom ral gri ste/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor bas 'khor lo yin/ /gang gi brjod pas smra bar bshad/ /kun nyid sna tshogs rdo rje yin/ /gzhig skadaka'i sbyor ba 85—13

go cha yin/ /'jigs pa'i spyod pa'i 0)mche ba ste/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor nyid bcing ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gang bshad pa/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa yin / /gzhal yas khang ni ye shes te/ /sems kyi brtsegs pa bsgreng ②ba yin/ /phyi yi gru bzhi pa gang yin/ /tshad kyis ( dmanyam pa nyid gyur pa/ /byams pa la sogs sems gang yin/ /thig bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /chos kyi sbyor ba rjes dran nyid/ /gang de rdo rje thig tu bshad/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin/ /tshul khrims tshogs kyi dam pa ni/ /gang zhig rgyan du bshad pa yin/ /dad cinodabang la sogs sems gang yin/ / ra ba lngar ⑤ni yang dag byung / /rnam par thar pa bzhi po ni/ /sgo rnams su ni yang dag bshad / /yang dag spong ba ba'i po ni/ /rta babs rnams dang ka bar byung / /dran pa nyer gzhag 6chibazhi po ni/ /khyams (7)rnams bzhi por shes par bya /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi po ni/ /de ni sgo khyud rnam bzhi yin/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po ni/ /phreng ba me tog chun brgyan 58)pa/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad/ /sgrib pa gnyis las rnam grol zhing / /ting 'dzin ye shes kyis brtags pa/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par rnams/ /rnga yab ces ni yang dag bshad/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges gcod cing / /nyon mongs 'phrog pas dra ba ste/ /yang dag gcod cing spong ba nyid/ /sel ba'i spong ba la gnas pa/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba nyid/ /nyon mongs pa yi phyed 'phrog pa/ /dra ba phyed ces bya bar bshad/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin de/ /byang chub sems ni bla med yin/ /sems ni don kun skyed ⑨byed pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par bshad/ /shes rab ye shes rang bzhin dag /rdo 85—14

rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin skyes/ /thar pa'i snang ba gzi brjid che/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yin par bshad/ /tshon rtsi lngar ni yang dag bshad3sna/ /lta ba lnga yi me tog yin/ /ye shes lnga yi des sbyor nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga zhes yang dag bshad//nam mkha' bzhin du bdag med pa'i/ /rnam shes ye shes dam pa yin/ /ye shes de yi rgyan bshad pa/ /chags pa'i sems zhes bya bar bshad/ /chags bral las ni byang chub 'byung / /chags pa'i sems las gzhan yin no/ /de bas chags dang chags bral ba/ /byang chub sems zhes yang dag bshad/ /'jig rten chags dang bral bas 'dul/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub chags las byung ske/ /der ni thabs kyi sgom pa dag /dngos grub thams cad ster ba yin/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pa yis spyad/ /ji ltar ②gdul ①bya dag gyur pa/ /zhen pa kun tu mchod par 'gyur(4)/ /mtshan nyid gang zhig yang dag bshad/ /mtshan nyid des stini mtshon par 'gyur(6ri/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya yis/ /rgyas btab ye shes yin par bshad/ /phyag rgya bsgoms pas rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu phyag rgya'i 3)bdag can 'gyur/ /rgyas btab dngos po shes nas ni/ /bsgoms na phyag rgyas btab par 'gyur/ /mtshan dang mtshan nyid 'brel ⑧ba ni/ /shes nas rnal 'byor yang dag spyod/ /ji ltar mtshan nyid yang dag grub/ /de bzhin dag pa myur du 'grub79/ /g.yas pa'i cha yi mtshan mas ni⑩/ /shes rab can ni rab tu bstan/ /g.yon gyi mtshan ma ji ltar mthong / /de yis mthugs rje mtshon pa yin/ /phyag ni gnyis ku'i 8mnyam sbyor las/ /ting 'dzin gnyis su bshad pa yin/ /zhabs gnyis kyi ni mtshan ma yis/ /tshogs gnyis dag ni bstan pa yin/ /sor mo lnga yi 85—15

so / /khyod ni lus srul ①po mi sha za ba ma rungs pa drag shul gyi las byed pas na gtum pa ( ste/ sha za'i lus srel ba na ji ltar tshangs pa dang gtogs 'dod dang dbang phyug chen po yin tshangs pa zhes bya ba ni mi 'gyur ba'o/ /gtogs 'dod ces bya ba ni thar pa'o/ /dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang po ste/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po de ni dung yin pas 'dul nus so/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po lha chen po khros nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal ④te/ 'jigs su rung ba chen po'i gzugs khros pa chen po'i gad mos bgad ⑤nas 'jigs pa chen por byed pa 'bar ba chen po stong pa yi'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad mtha' med par ⑦gzugs sna tshogs su byas/ 'bar ba chen po'i grub pa/ mi mtshungs pa rdo rje dang ske/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang / 'khor lo dang / shaka duti dang / be con dang ske/ mi mtshungs tso)pa'i mtshon cha 'debs ⑩shing gtong ba ma mo yirnams kyi tshogs dang 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mdang bcas par kun bstan 0to/ /bdud dang bgegs byed pa dang mtha' dang mu med pa'i gzugs sna tshogs su sprul/ khro bo rab tu mi bzad pa ma rungs pa'i tshogs chen po dang lhan cig tu rab tu 'thab cing shin tu 'gyed pa/ gling bzhi pa'i tso'ajig rten gyi khams mtshan mo'i mun gnag 8tu byas/ 'bar ba chen po'i phung pos klongs te tsorab tu snang bar byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mdo rje 'chang ba chen po cung zad du tsomache ba'i thog ma gtsigs pa/ smin 517mtshams yi kyi khro gnyer gyi rlabs bskyod ⑥pa/mig g.yon pa cher bgrad de/ rdo rje'i lta ba du khro ba dang bcas pas zab mo'i tshig gis du snying po mchog 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal zhes bya 85—30

ba 'di gsungs so/ /rtsu/ de nas rghaṃ zhes bya ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun sgra des gang nas/ g.yos rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos g.yos ①so/ /'khrol rab tu 'khrol kun tu rab tu 'khrol lo/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha'i tshogs thams cad bcom ldan 'das rinabaskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bskyab tu gsol zhes nas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad gsungs so/ /gang 'di lta bu'i sngags kyi tshig smra ba ni khyod rab tu mi bgrungs so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes thubacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal ④nas/ yang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba 'di gsungs sol/ /oṃ sum bha ni sum bha ⑤rgyu/ groṇḍi groṇḍi 96ste// gros pa ya gro: me pa ya hūm̐/ā ⑧na ya ho bha ga bān stibadzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis lha chen po la sogs pa lha'i bdag po thams cad 'khor dang bcas par/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gang na ba der mgo rkang bzlog ste/ ri rab ri'i rtse mo'i dkyil 'khor chen por btsud nas brlams par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs g.yon pas mnan tom/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la legs so nye1zhes bya ba byin te phyag na rdo rje khyod kyis 'di 'dra bar sems can 'dul bar byed pa legs so legs so/ /de bas na thul la dbugs phyung nyanashig /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de dag gi don gyi phyir rdo rjes bcings pa 'di gsungs so/ /hūṃ nya badzra ḍi 'phyo ma nyadibha ba rakṣa sablon skoswā hā/de nas phyag na rdo rjes 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis lha chen po la sogs pa lha 1 de 85—31

dag thams cad shi)dran pa rnyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②de dag la 'di skad gsungs so/ /grogs po dag sems can chen po 'di'i bka' bzhin du byed ( tsho/par khas long shig(4) /de nas bcom ldan 'das la de dag thams cad mgrin gcig tu bdag cag mchid kyis 'tshal lo zhes gsol to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yang rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /hūṃ ṭakki ho/ de nas 'di brjod pa tsam gyis lha la sogs pa thams cad dbang du byas te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag byas (snyenas mchi ma blags te/ nga ro bton du nonas skyabs su dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das bskyab tsho7༄tu gsol/ da 8bdag cag khyod kyi bka' nyan na ci ltar bgyi ba bka' ri9)stsal du gsol zhes so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' bochen pos de rnams la gsungs pa/ grogs po dag byang chub kyi sems dang sdom pa gzung 11bar khas long 12shig /de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la nyusnyebasnyen bkur bgyid cing byang chub tu'ang khusems bskyed 8par 'tshal lo/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' mchen pos yang de rnams ji lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor du btsud 1 nas sdom pa 'dzin 1 du bcug ste/ byang chub sems ni brtan hunyebyas pa/ /sems can thams cad bde ba stsal )/ /phyag na rdo rje bdag chen ( nyedang / /'dod pa smad par mi bya'o/ /'di ni gsang ba pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gede dag sdom pa 'dzin du bcug chenas/ dam tshig byin pa ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya a rnyi ṣiñtsa mā bi 2 rirā ga ya tsho zhesarba kā mān ri gnyes phaṭa/ de nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'di ni bdud kyis smras pas na bdag cag mi nyan ri 3to/ /85—32

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas de dag la khyed cag gis 'di la ma brnyas shig ces gsungs pa dang / de dag gis gsol pa/ ji ltar 'dod chags dang bral ba ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bo zhes bcom ldan 'das nyid 1tshokyis bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs napa/ kye grogs po dag nga ①ni ji ltar 'dul ④bzhin du ⑤byed pa ste/ 'di nyid kyis phyi'ajig rten gyi khams 'di sun 'byin te/ ji ltar bde ba (bel mi chags pa dang / sdug bsngal la du'adod chags pa can ⑨ji lta bus 'jig rten 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i chos sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'chad par mdzad de/ de dag sbyang ba'i phyir 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun tu bzang po byang chub sems dpas ci nas kyang 0'dod chags dang bral bar ma byed cig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes yang gsungs pa/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mi 1ཿbi rā ga ya sarba 8kā māṃ tsos phaṭa/ de nas de dag gis ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bebaka' stsal pa bzhin no zhes gsol to/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes lag tu rdo rje byin te/ rdo rje'i 8dbang bskur ba 'di byin no/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba 7 ta thā ga ta badzra dha ro1 rtso tshobadzra pā ṇi tī/ ha ha ha ha/ de nas rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba byin pa ni hunye'adi lta ste/ dbang phyug chen po ni rdo rje rig sngags mchog go/ /mthu bo che ni rdo rje sgyu ma'o/ /tshangs pa ni rdo rje mi smra ba'o/ /sgra gzhon nu ni yirdo rje dril bu'o/ /dbang po ni rdo rje 'thab dwo )cha ste/ de dag la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum gyi dbang po thams cad rig pa'i blon po chen por dbang bskur ro/ /de nas bar snang la rgyu ba rnams rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni rdo rje 'khyil pa'o/ /zla ba ni rdo 85—33

rje 'od do/ /be con rtse mo ni rdo rje be con no/ /skya sleng hu)ni rdo rje skya sleng ②ste/de rnams ni rdo rje khro bor dbang bskur ro/ /de nas nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha rnams rdo rje (guming gis dbang bskur ba byin pa ni/ 'di lta ste chang gis myos pa ni rdo rjes zin (4pa'o/ /chang byed ni rdo rje phreng ba'o/ /rgyal ba ni rdo rje dbang ngo ske/ /rgyal ba skyes 5 pa ni rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba ste/ de dag la sogs pa ni tshogs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /de nas sa pa rnams rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ mdzod skyong ni rdo rje gru (7shing ngo / /rlung ni rdo rje rlung ngo / /me ni rdo rje me'o/ /ku be ra ni rdo rje 'jigs pa ste/ de dag la sogs pa ni rdo rje ri pho nyar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas sa'i (she'og na gnas pa'i lha'i 95dbang po thams cad rdo rje ming gis bodabang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ phag ni rdo rje kyo ba'o/ /gshin rje ni rdo rje nag po'o/ /sa'i spyi bo ni rdo rje rnam 'dren no/ /bā 11ru ṇa ni rdo rje klu 8ste/ de dag la sogs pa ni rdo rje bran du dbang bskur ro/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po rnams kyis nyu lha mo thams cad kyi lag tu rdo rje byin te/ rdo rje'i spudabang bskur nas rdo rje ming gi skadabang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa ni rdo rje khro ba ma'ochos / /nor can ni rdo rje gser ma'o/ /tshangs ma 0ni rdo rje zhi ma'o0/ /dug mo ni rdo rje gzhon nu ma'o/ /dbang mo 19ni rdo rje khu tshur te/ de dag la sogs pa ni rig sngags 2 kyi blon mo chen mor dbang bskur ru ro/ /de nas bar snang la rgyu ba'i ma rnams dbang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ bdud rtsi ma ni rdo rje bdud rtsi ma'o/ /'khrung 22ma ni rdo rje sdug gu ma'o/ /be dzo gecon 'chang ma ni rdo rje be con rtse mo'o / /skye 'phrog ma ni rdo rje rked chings teri rnyi/ de dag la sogs pa 85—34

ni rdo rje khro mor dbang bskur ro/ /de nas nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i ma rnams dbang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ gsod ma ni rdo rje gsod /rima'o/ /za ba mo ni rdo rje za ba mo'o②/ /gos ni rdo rje bgo ba mo'o ri/ /dga' mo ni rdo rje dbang mo ste / de dag la sogs pa ni rdo rje tshogs ma mor dbang bskur ro/ /de nas sa la rgyu ba'i ma rnams ④dbang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ zhi ba 5mo ni rdo rje pho nya mo'o⑨/ /rlung ma ni rdo rje mgyogs ma'o/ /me ni rdo rje 'bar ma'o ku be ra ⑧ni rdo rje thag thug ⑨ma ste/ de dag la sogs pa ni rdo rje pho nya mor dbang bskur ro/ /de nas sa 'og na gnas pa'i ma thams cad tshedabang bskur ba byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ phag mo ni rdo rje gdong ngo / /mgo lpags ma ni rdo rje nag mo'o / /sna chad ma ni rdo rje myags ma'o3lha/ /klu mo ni rdo rje chu srin ma ste/ de dag la sogs pa ni rdo rje bran mor dbang bskur ro/ /de nas phyag na bordo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen pos btsud pa de dag thams cad kyis 12sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bskyed nas rdo rje'i bodam tshig byin pa'o/ /oṃ ba li tod ba li tod badzra ā 8karṣa ⑩ya rghaṃ dza/ lha rnams dgug pa'o/ /oṃ badzra a gri 0pi ṭā 1 ya sa ma ya rdul/ bar snang la rgyu ba rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ badzra mā lā 17gra lo/ phreng ba 'chang ba rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ badzra brnya haṃ/ sa la rgyu ba rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ badzra pā tā la bhañdza bhañdza zhu hūṃ phaṭa/ 'og na gnas pa rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ he ru ka badzra sa ma ya sarba 0du/ ( ges ma ya mu pra bharnya tsakra /rgyu phaṭa/ ma mo tsho rirnams thams cad kyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag na rdo rjes phyag 'tshal lhanas 'di skad gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sems can thams cad 'dul ba lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ma rungs pa'i sems can gyi tshodakyil 'khor de 85—35

dag la yonyeji ltar bgyi ba bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/gang gis sems can de rnams sems can ②thams cad la phan pa byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i dam tshig 'di nyid la tshud cig /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i gdon ②'di dag la ji ltar nan tan gebagyi/ rims la sogs pa ji ltar bgyi/ dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan song gi rnams ji ltar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ dam tshig de nyid la nan tan byed du tshud cig⑤ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes yang gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das mi 'di (9rnams ji ltar nan tan ⑦bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen por btsud nas/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du tshud cig /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du btsud nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du tshud cig /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du btsud nas las kyi dkyil 'khor du tshud ⑤cig /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la yi rangs te / tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs te/ /grub pa thams cad byed pa'i mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po ⑨bshad par bya'o/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po tsodam pa ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 0tshul 'dra bar/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad thig gdab bo/ /de la srad bu bre tu ba'i cho ga ni 'di lta ste/gsar zhing legs par byas pa dang / /tshad ma bzang po 8srad bu yis/ /shes rab can gyis srad bre 8ba/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal dran zhing ngo / /de yi 85—36

dbung du hu)gdab pa ni/ /seng ldeng phur pa brten (gyipar ro/ /de las (bslad bu bre gsungs pa'isti/ /srad bu nyis ldab dubakyis byas te56// /bcu drug cha ru bgo bar bya/ /thams cad du ni rim gsum mchog /kho ra khor yug rigs (7)dag kyang ske/ /phur bu yis ni de bzhin no/ /de yi nang du bya ba ni/ /srad bu rim bdun ldan par te/ /tshon ser dri zhim ldan pa yis/ /thig rnams kyang ni gdab par bya/ /de yi (rmegadabus su gzhag ⑨pa ni/ /shin tu bkrabs pa'i nas phul bzhi'o/ /de yi steng du mgon po ste/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gzhag par bya/ /sangs rgyas thad 'khor mthams cad du/ /byang chub brgyad ni rim hu1bzhin par/ /bri 'am yang na mgazhag par bya/ /tshon sna lnga mchog rnams kyis so / /sangs rgyas spyan snga de ru ni/ /phyag na rdo rje de bzhin no/ /bri 'am gzhag par bya ba ni8/ /rdo rje rtsu zhes par 'dus so8/ /de yi zhabs ni g.yon pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po mnan 8par bya'o/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs kyis tsobatsir ba ni/ /nyon mongs ma yin lha mo'o/ /'dod drug hunyespyod pa'i lha rnams dgatso /srad bu rim bdun bar dag tu/ /bri 'am yang na gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje shugs kyis 'gongs /rtenas su/ /phyi rol byung nas de ru yang / /gling rnams bzhi yang bri bar bya/ /dbyibs dang cho ga ji bzhin du/ /grwa rdu )yi ri mo legs par dgod/ /gling rnams dbus ni ri mthams cad du/ /'jig rten ji bzhin bsogs par bya'odu rte/ /tshangs pa la sogs bzhi yi na rnams/ /de ru 'jig rten dbang po bring ste/ /kho ra khor yug ri dang nitsho snye/ /gling rnams kyi yang bar dag tu//phyi yi rdo rje'i burigs rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bri bar bya/ /sgo srung 2 bri bar bya ba du steyang / /rdo rje sgo bzhi de dag tu/ /rdo rje kyo ba zhags pa dang / /85—37

sgrog ①dang dril bu de bzhin no/ /kho ra khor yug ri yi ni/ /phyi rol dmyal ba ②brgyad rnams so/ /gnam dal dang ni nad dag dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang gdon drag rnams/ /bzhag gam yang na bri bar bya/ /chos min can ni gzhig phyir ro/ / de yi (7phyi rol du dgod pa/ /gtor ma sna tshogs mchog rnams so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 'byung ste/ de la thog ma nyid du slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal te ④'jug pa ni/ gtsang mas (༄gos gtsang ma bgos la/ se ral thag yigu dmar po thogs nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la de'i steng du dri zhim po'i me tog bzhag nas/snying po 'di brjod la zhugs shig /oṃ badzra pra tītstsha mi (༄ha ha ha ha hi/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (8)nas du ru ska'i ⑨bdug pa'am ci bdog pas gsol to/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma mdzub bomo gnyis kyo ba tang ⑩du byas la snying po ni hurte'adi brjod do/ /oṃ u ru gra gra huXbi ri ṇi bi ri ṇi/ badzra ma ya hi/ rnyi da ye swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na/ de las mtshan ma 'byung ba ni ba spu g.yo ba la sogs pa dang sa g.yo ba'am dri zhim po'am 'od zer mthong ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i spyi bor me tog gtor cig /de nas slob ma gzhug ste④/ de la ⑫thog ma nyid du bkrus nas slob ma gos gtsang ma bskon 7te gsum la skyabs su btang ba dang / bslab pa'i sdom pa 'dzin pa ⑩la so sor gnas par byas nas ⑫byang chub kyi sems skyed 3)cig /de nas gdong ras kyis g.yogs nas 0 mgo gtsug 2nyutor du byas te/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la chug cigatso /bcug nas me tog gtor te/ de nas gang la bab pa buni de'i lha'o/ /de nas gdong bcings pa bkrol nas rang gi rig pa'i lha ston la/ de la mchod cing 85—38

brgyad stong dus gsum du nyin bdun bzlas na/ de nas phyag na rdo rje ①slob dpon gyi gzugs su byas nas rmi lam du thams cad smra'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub ②pa'i cho ga gzhan 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bas zla ba gcig gi bar du de bzhin du dus gsum du khrus byas nas/ dus gsum du gos brjes dus gsum du ba lang ①gi phyi ④bas dkyil 'khor byas te/ rno lcags kyi mtshon chas der rdo rje bris la de la lta (pezhing / rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings te brgyad brgya bzlas na/ zla ba gcig gi mthar bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo /de nas rdo rje sgrub 965pa 'byung ste/ rdo rje ras sam rtsig (7pa'am shing leb la bris nas de la mchod pa byas te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung ⑧la lo gcig tshun cad ⑨rdo rje nam 'bar ba'i tsobar du zlos 0shig /'bar ba des na 8nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / lo bcu drug (/nyelon pa'i lus phyag na rdo rje dang mtshungs pa'i gzugs dang stobs dang mdog tu 'gyur 8te/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad dang ldan pa/ bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad 'thob 8par 'gyur ro/ /tshe yang lo stong phrag brgyar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ral gri sgrub ⑩pa 0'byung ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis tsoral gri bzung la lo gcig gi bar du 8bzlas na/ rig zhu)'dzin thams cad kyi bdag po rig pa 'dzin par du/'gyur ro/ /de nas 'khor lo sgrub du pa 'byung ste/ 'khor lo'i shurnyedakyil 'khor bris la lcags kyi 'khor lo thogs nas nam rdo rjer gyur cing slar yang 'khor lor gyur ④gyi bar du bzlas so//de nas de thogs pas na rig 'dzin thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur ro//de nas kyo ba tang bsgrub 42par 'dod pas phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar gser gyi kyo ba tang byas te 49lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung ( tshol/ grub pa rnam ②85wa 46

gsum du gyur gyi bar du bzlas te①/ dros pa tsam gyis thams cad kun dgug 2nus par 'gyur ro/ /dud pa byung ba tsam gyis thams cad dbang du byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /'bar bas ni thams cad dgug ①pa dang dbang du byas 3)shing rig 'dzin gyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha la sogs pa thams cad dgug 75pa 'byung ste/ lha chen po la sogs pa lha rnams gang yang rung ba'i cha lugs rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la/ rdo rje rgyu zhes bya ba'i (nyaphyag rgya bcings te bsdigs shing zla ba gcig gi mtha'i bar du (bebazlas na lha thams cad lhags te/ las thams cad byed pa'i g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /klu dbang du bya bar 'dod na klu'i mtshor lte ba man chad (nyechu'i nang du bcug la (7lo gcig tshun chad klu 7thams cad rang gi gzugs su ston cing las thams cad byed pa'i g.yog tu gyur pa'i nyunyebar du bzlas so/ /gnod sbyin dbang du bya bar 'dod pas gnod sbyin tshegang 1lhal gnas pa'i gnas der rdo rje rtsu zhes pa'i phyag rgya bcings la gnod sbyin de dag lhags te/ bka' ci stsal zhes 0smra ba'i bar du bzlas so/ /de phyin cad bka' thams cad 8byed pa'i g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma rnams thams cad dbang du bya bar 'dod pas ma'i tsoganas su song nas/ khro mo'i snying gar 'o tshordog pas mnan phonyel zla ba gcig lon gyi bar du bzlas na3)/ tshes nyi shu dgu la 'jigs su rung ba chen po'i sgra ( )'byin par byed de/ de nas shedabang du gyur nas bka' bzhin byed pa'i g.yog mor 'gyur te/ phrag pa la khyer nas mtho ris su khrid de/ slar yang khrid cing 'ongs sbyo —rtenas tshogs kyi bdag por bcug cing /de dag gis so mchod de/ sngon ma byung ba'i don thams cad dang / 'dod pa thams cad dang na chung thams cad 'gug go/ /'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor yang 85—47

ster te/ rnal 'byor gang gis nyu)khro bo'i (snye'ajig rten du yang 'gro zhing phyir yang 'ong ngo / /de la sus kyang cung zad kyang byed mi nus so/ /de nas dpal chen mo bsgrub (kyepar 'dod pa des phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar bzlas pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i sku las lha mo'i lus mthong gi bar du ste/ de las ma 'gul cig ④ces bsgo'o⑤/ /de phyin cad don thams cad ster bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas pa'ang (bester ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas mtsho dbyangs ma dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ des 9)phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar yi ge'i (shephreng bar byas la phreng ba'i yi ge bkod cing mthar phyin gyi (khedībar du bklags 7te/ nyin re zhing dus gsum du las de /rtabyas la de nas brgyad nyu2stong bzlas na/ zla ba gcig lon pa dang mtsho dbyangs ma mthong ngo ske/ /de phyin cad tu thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi bogatsug lag thams cad rigeshes nyen can 7du bya ba thams cad dang / bzo thams cad kyang ma bslabs par de ltar 'o tshorab tu shes so/ /de nas lig bu mig dang gur gum dang /ldong ros dang / ba bla rnams la bsgrub 32pa 'byung ste/ lig bu mig blangs la 'jom pa'i steng du bzhag nas/ lag pas mnan te 19grub pa rnam gsum byung gi bar du bzlas so/ /gcig gis ni mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pas ni gzugs mang por 'gyur ro/ /gsum pas ni nam ci )gnas gong mar 'dzeg pa na 1nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gur gum la sogs pa bzung ste/ 'jom zhu pa'i bu gar bcug la/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas mnan nas nam 'bar gyi bar du bzlas so/ /de nas thig le byas nas zhu 'dod pa thams cad kyi bdag po dang rig 'dzin dang thams cad du 'gro ba dang tshe lo stong gethub par 'gyur ro/ /85—48

de nas sā ①la bhardzi ②ka sgrub ①pa 'byung ste/ gnas gang la sā la bhardzi snika ri mo bris pa'am/ gzugs su byas pa de'i 'jom pa la sor mo bzhag ste zla ba gcig pasnyetu zlos shig /de nas zla ba gcig gi mthar mtshan thog thag zlos shig /de nas nang par rang gi yigazugs su bstan nas 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa'i chung mar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin mo bsgrub ⑦par 'dod pas/ gnod sbyin mo gang na 'dug pa'i gnas der 'dug la/ rang gi gzugs su 'ongs kyi bar du bzlas na/ de la 'dod pa thams cad ster ba'i bran mor 'gyur ro/ /de nas sha za mo bsgrub ⑧par 'dod pas phyag dar phung po mes btang ste/ lag pa g.yon pas rang gi mtshan ma 6)de bzung la/ g.yas pas gzegs ⑩ma bsregs tshipa ni phyag dar gyi phung po de las ci tsam na pho sha za mo gdong mdangs tsogazugs mi sdug pa 'ongs te rang gi gzugs su gnas so/ /de yang de bzhin du bran mor 'gyur ro/ /de nas ci bgyi ba bsgrub ④par 'dod pas nyin zhag gcig smyung ba 35byas la/ tshes nyi shu dgu la brgyad stong bzlas te/ de nas zla ba gcig slong tshemo la za zhing grangs med par bzlas te/ zla ba gcig zhu tsholon pa dang / nub gsum smyung ba byas tunyenas mtshan thog thag bzlas (sheso/ /de nas nang par ci bgyi 'ongs na bu des mi 'jigs par bya ste ⑰/ de nas de rangs menas 'grub bo//de phyin cad 'dod pa thams cad 'bul ba'i g.yog tu 'gyur te/ mtho ris kyi lha mo yang ⑥ 'gugs shing 'bul lo'u/ /de yang skyel cing bslar yang 'gugs so phyal/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi thams cad kyang smra'o/ /gzhan gyi nor thams cad kyang phrogs nas 'bul lo/ /de nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs bya bar 'dod pa dngos grub med pa gang yin pa des/ zla ba drug gi bar 85wa 49

du nyin zhag bcu bcu ①zhing spyad pa snga ma brjes la/ slong ②mo'i kha zas la sogs pa lanas rlung bza' ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas mjug ⑤tu mtshan thal byung bzlas na nang par sangs rgyas pa'ang (misbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas nyin re zhing bcwa ༅brgyad kyi bar du sngon gyi spyad pa rnams byas la de'i mjug (3)tu mtshan thal byung bzlas na nang par las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba ni hūṃ zhes thang cig brjod pas kyang ngo / /de nas ro langs bsgrub (nyepa 'byung ste/ ma rmas khyam nyams pa'i mi ro blangs la legs par bkrus nas byug pas legs par byugs te/me tog gi phreng ba nyu stabatags nas/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan /nyal dbugs byung hurtegi bar du bzlas na de ldang ste langs pa dang / de zhon nas mthams cad du 'gro zhing tshe yang lo stong phrag brgyar tshe'agyur ro/ /de nas ro langs kyi grub pa mchog sgrub 8pa 'byung stetshe/ ma mas hu tshom nyams pa'i mi ro blangs nas/ de bzhin du rab tu brgyan la pho zhon te/ langs shing yang 'gyel gyi /khebar du bzlas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur 'gyur ro/ /de phrag pa la khyer na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad srel ba'i rig 'dzin 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam pu 3 thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyis ni/'gro ba dang tshe yang bskal ris2par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de nas ma bsgrubs ri rtekyang dkyil 'khor mthong ba nyid kyis las su 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ thang cig brjod pas tsoni bdag dang gzhan dang grong dang / grong khyer dang / rgyal po la sogs pa bsrung 2bar 'gyur ro dzī/ /mtshams bcad tsho tshopa la sogs pa ni brtan par lta bas mtshams bcad ( snyen/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mi 'da' ( )na gzhan lta ci smos/ sa'i dkyil 'khor dang nam mkha' dang phyogs bcing ru sta85—50

ba'ang ①lta ba des so/ /dbab pa ni reg pa dang ma reg pas ral gri dang / me long dang / snod dang / mthe ②bo dang / shing ljon pa (kyidang / bris pa dang /cha lugs dang / gzhu dang / mda' dang / rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje ④dbab pa'i phyag rgya gos kyis ⑤g.yogs la bcings te/ gu ①gul gyi bdug tsorapas dbab bo/ /gdon zhi bar bya ba ni hūṃ zhes pas so/ / rdo rje bya/ zhes pa'i phyag rgyas ni sems can thams cad 'phungs ⑨par byed do/ /rdo rje lcags ②sgrog gi phyag rgyas ni byad ma'i gdon las thar bar byed do/ /he ru ka rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan pas ni byad tsoms bsad pa las 7slar gso bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gzung bas 8spa la bzung rtsonyeste bslang bas skoni/ dug gnon ⑩pa dang / dug bslang ⑩ba dang / dug zhi bar bya ba dang / dug sba 8ba dang / dug gzhig par bya ba dang / dug gis 8shi ba las gso du bar bya ste/ rdo rje hūm̐ zhes pa gcig gis so/ /gter dbyung 2skyeb ni/ zangs kyi ril ba chus bkang la/ rdo rje rgyu zhes pa'i mdzub tsomo dang gu gul gyis bdug pa 3byas te bzlas na/ gal te gter yod na ni chu de bulud do/ /de ste med na ni 'khyil lo/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i hūṃ zhes pa bubazlas te blang ngo / /snang ba dgug pa ni/ dong buka'i ljon pa'i yam 0shing gis 6me bus te/ zho dang /sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis rā du pedza ko sum̐ )shā hu ta ku'i sume tog la bskus nas stong phrag brgyad bsregs ben snang ba thob bo/ /'og gi gnas su ni dusterdo rje 'og gi phyag rgyas 'khrul 'khor thams cad bcom nas rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa bzlas te zhugs na de la sus kyang gtse bar mi nus soninye/ /gtogs 'dod kyi 'khor los kyang ci sreyang byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar rdo rje'am/ nor bu marga 85—51

ti'am / padma rā ga 'am/ mu tig gam/ gser ram/ dbyig gam/ gzhan ci yang rung ba 'am/ skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la lo gcig gi bar du dus gsum du brgya ①brgyar bzlas nas de nas lo gcig lon na brgya 'gyur du 'gyur ro/ /de snyed du brgyar bzlas na ②de snyed ②kyi brgyar 'gyur ro/ /de nas stong du bzlas na yang stong 'gyur ④du 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod dgug pa ni stong phrag brgyar bzlas so/ /dgug pa ni rdo rje kyo ba tang gi phyag rgyas zla ba bzhis khugs so/ /dbang du bya ba ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi ⑤phyag rgyas so/ /sems can thams cad gtan 'pho ba ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ stong phrag brgyar bzlas na sems can thams cad yid kyis dmigs pa bzhin gtan 'pho'o/ /chu gnon (7pa ni rdo rje'i 3)phyag rgya bcings la chu'i steng du 'gror rung ba'i bar du bzlas so(8)/ /me gnon ⑨pa ni thang cig bzlas pas 7so/ /lo shetetog bsrung nyugeb ni rdo rje lta bas te⑩/ de la srog chags rnams gang gis kyang gnod par mi 'gyur zhing byi tsob la sogs pa yang 'da' bar mi byed do/ / rdeg pa spo ba 8ni khro bo'i lta bas te/ gang du bltas pa der 'pho'o / /bza' ba dang btung ba dang nyu9thams cad spo pho ba ni 'bar ba'i lta bas ni 'osherang gi snod du 'pho'o/ /sdig pa dang sbrul thams cad med par bya ba ni thang cig brjod pas so/ /gcan srin thams cad la thang cig bzlas pas med par 'gyur ro/ /rkun po thams cad 'pham 19pa ni rdo rje khu tshur bcings rgo )pas so /dmag las sgrol ba ni rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas so/ /gzhu dang mda' dang mdung dang rgyal mtshan mnan nas 'gul gyi bar du bzlas te/ de thogs na dmag thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhal che la ni thang cig 5 —rtebarjod 85—52

pas rtsod pa'i lan thebs par 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba thams cad ni til gyi sbyin sreg tshigis so/ /rgyas pa thams cad ni yungs kur 9bgyi sbyin sreg ②gis so/ /gtan 'pho ba thams cad ni tsher ma'i sbyin sreg snogis so/ / gso ba thams cad ni drur ba'i lo ma'i sbyin sreg gis so/ /cizhena'atshe ba dang gnam dal dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad gzhil ba ni til dang 'bras kyi sbyin sreg (6)gis so/ /gzhom pa thams cad ni rgyu zhes pas so/ /rgod (me)du gzhug pa dang myos par bya ba thams cad la 2phaṭa ces bya bas (9༄so/ /thams cad gnyid log tu gzhug pa ni bskums hu )la mig btsums te brgya bzlas pas thams cad gnyid log 7par byas pa yin no/ /sems can thams cad rgyas gdab 8pa ni rdo rje khro bo'i lta bas bltas na rgyas btab par 'gyur te/ nyin bdun las lhag par mi gson no/ /ngag 'phrog sa pa ni rang gi lce sos bzung nas rtsu zhes bya ba'i skebar du sbyor ba bya'o④ / /snying drang ba ni rdo rje sor mo'i phyag rgyas dpung pa bsnol te/ rang gi mchan khung du glong zhing snying po bzlas na nub bdun tshun chad ⑩'pho bar 'gyur ro⑩la/ /snying bcad pa ni rdo rje blangs te gcad nyushepar bya'o/ /snying dbye ba ni rdo rje lcags phur pho)gyis gdab py-i )ste ming nas smos shing gzugs so/ /snying spo ba ni lag pa gnyis kyis 3)rdo rje blangs te mtshan bdun du rab tu sbyor ba byas pas 'pho bar sdo ༄'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya 'di rnams las thar bar bya ba bshad de/ des rgyas ni 'debs pa la ni khu tshur dam pos so/ /ngag 'phrog pa la ni rdo rje ngag gi stobazlas pas so/ /snying 'dren pa la ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya snying gar dgrol lo/ /bcad pa la ni rdo rje hūm̐ zhes pa bzlas nas 'o mas khrus shig /phye ba la ni phur 22bu phyung nas rdo rje dris skus shig /snying spo ba (snyul ni rdo rje snying 85—53

pos thar bar bya'o①/ /de bzhin du byad ma'i phyag rgya yang spo bar bya'o②/ /snying bsgrub (kyepar 'dod na bud ④med kyi snying gar lta zhing lan cig ⑤bzlas na de'i snying ga nas sgra thos par 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'i snying gar yang de bzhin du byas te (nyasnying ga thams cad du yang de ltar ro/ /de nas pha rol gyi sems shes pa bsgrub par 'dod pas ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa brgyar bzlas na pha rol gyi sems shes so/ /sngon gyi gnas shes par bya ba ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa bzlas pas so/ /rmi lam mthong bar 'dod pas ni rdo rje rghaṃ zhes pa lan gnyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas shing bdug (2)pa sa ka pi tsas 6)bdugs te gnyid log na/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi shes pa ston to/ /tshig bsgrub ⑩par 'dod pas rdo rje tshig gis ri1lestong phrag brgya bzlas na/ rdo rje tshig gis rang gi lces smras pa/ thams cad bden par 'gyur te ci bslabs ④pa de stsol to/ /cho 'phrul ston pa ni tso bzlas pa'i rdo rje'i 8tshig gis brgyad brgya 8bzlas na rang gi lus la cho 'phrul du 'gyur ba ⑩ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje 'dzin dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi hunyegazugs brnyan gyi tshul du ston to/ /rang gi gzugs ci dga' bar sgyur hunyebar byed 'dod pas rdo rje tshig gis yirdo rje du )bzlas pa 2nyestong phrag brgya bzlas na/ gzugs gang dang gang 'dod pa de dang bdag sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su yang 0byed par 'gyur ro/ /mi snang bar 'dod pas rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje bzung 2gel rdo rje bzung nunyebs mi snang bar gyur pa ( nyede srid kyi bar du bzlas so/ /btang bas ni budagrol 0lo/ /khri'u la 'dug nas rdo rje lag tu shu2blangs te nam 'phar gyi 37bar du bzlas so/ /gdon gyis 85—54

'dzin du gzhug ①na rdo rje ②rgyu zhes pas so/ / gdon gar byed du 'jug pa ni hi zhes pas so/ /③gdon bskyod pa ④ni hag ces pas so/ /gdon gzhom pa ni phaṭa ces pas so/ /gcer bar bya ba ni mi'i skra'i skud pas rang gi shedapung pa bcings na gcer bar 'gyur te gos brje yibar 'gyur ro/ /sdang (7bar bya ba ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya dral (shebs so/ /bskrad ⑨pa ni rdo rje khu tshur gyis 'phang ngo / /dgos pa bskyed pa ni 0mtshan thog thag sha chen po rang gi khrag gis bskus te sreg yigo/ /gzhan gyi hunyebud med dgug pa ni rdo rje bzung nas snying po bzlas shing dgug gam/ yang na thams cad du khyab pa hūṃ zhes pas thams cad bya'o/ /bud med thams cad dang chadaga' bar spyod pa ni rang gi rtags rdo rje bcings pas bzung thal nyin bdun dus gsum du langs kyi bar du bzlas so8/ /de nas mjug tshetu nam phyed kyi ⑩bar du bzlas 3/na rtag hu7tu ldang la mi snyoms zhing bu bcud mang la rtags shugs drag por 'gyur ro/ /bu mo spyad 21 pa ni rdo rje bzung dunas thams cad du khyab par rtsu zhes bya ba byas nas spyod do/ /bud med thams cad dbang du bya ba ni rdo rje rtsu zhes pa'i phyag rgya bcings la stong phrag brgya bzlas na bud med thams cad mgu bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar spyan ras gzigs dbang po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la stong phrag brgya 0bzlas na bud med thams cad mgu bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad dbang du bya bar 'dod na rdo rje khu tshur gyi bcings pas rdo rje bzung 30la nam 'gul gyi bar du bzlas so/ /snang ba la dbang du bya bar 'dod na rdo rje blangs te rang gi spyi bor bzhag la rdo rje spyi bor tsobartan par gyur gyi bar du bzlas so/ /de nas snang ba'i mdun du 'dug na des snang thubar rang gi dbang bskur ba yang 85—55

465 to/ /nor 17dgug pa ni rin po che'i (gugatso bo'i phye mas sbyin sreg byas pas (gyisol/ /char dbab pa ni rdo rje hūm̐ zhes pa stong bzlas pas (gso/ / char gcad ⑤pa ni rdo rje (6 rgyu zhes pas so57sku/ /ser ba gcad (nyepa ni rdo rje gsor lho)ba'i phyag rgyas nyu )so/ /gdon dgag pa yang phyag rgya de nyid kyis so/ /sprin dgag pa ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba brgyar /lhabazlas pas so/ / bsal ba la ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa lan brgyar bzlas so/ //lhardo rje dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag nas me tog dang bdug pas mchod de/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas mnan tenyusnye/ rdo rje langs kyi bar du bzlas so/ /de thogs nas sa tshebaskor na ci 'dod pa bzhin du sgyu ma'i ⑫las rnams ston te15/ rdo rje nyu tshobaskor bas dus ma yin par shing la 'bras bu dang me tog mthong ngo / /nam mkha' la me tog gi phreng ba chags par bya ba ni dbugs bsdams la rdo rje khu tshur bcings te gtor na chags tunyeso/ /cha lugs bzhad par bya ba ni rdo rje'i phyag rgyas so/ /gar byed par bya na 8rdo rje 'dzin mas so/ /smra bar bya 2 stan rtsu zhes pas so/ /rgyug par bya na shurnyerdo rje dgug pa'i phyag rgyas so/ /smin ma 'gul bar bya na ( rterdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin pas rdo rje thogs la rang gi smin mtshams tsho snyesu bsgul bas so/ /sa thugayo bar bya na rkang pa g.yon pa brdabs pas 25so/ /khyim bskul ba ni rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgyas so/ /khang pa dgug na na rdo rje khros pa'i kyo ba tang gi phyag rgya na bcings pas so/ /sprin med par char pa na dbab pa ni rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas (so/ /skad cig tu sprin 'du zhing ston pa ni rdo rje bskor bas so/ /zla ba dang nyi ma dbab cing bstan pa ni rdo rje brdabs ra pas so/ /nyi ma dang zla ba mang po bstan dgan rdo rje bzhin da nam mkha' la gtor bas so/ /dmag rnam bzhi bstan na rdo rje bskor bas so/ /85—56

mtshan mo nyin bar du bya na rdo rje 'bar ba bskor bas so/ /nyin mo 17mtshan mor bya na mig btsums /gul rdo rje bskor bas so/ /thams cad nas rdo rje bstan nas (0brgya bzlas te rdo rje bskor bas so/ /thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa' bstan na stong bzlas te rdo rje ④bskor bas so/ /phyag na rdo rje thams cad pa (snyel bstan na stong phrag brgya bzlas te bskor bas so thams cad nas sangs rgyas bstan na rdo rje la bye ba bzlas pas 56)so/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje rtsu zhes bya ba'i rtog pa chen po tso)rdzogs so na~X// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad gsungs so/ /ngas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ gang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir brtson par 'gyur ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (9༄snying po 'di sbyin no/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas tsog tsog por 'dug ste mnos pa/ rdzu (bobadzra bid hu swā hā/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi 12stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di /lharab tu g.yos so/ /sems can thams cad kyang rab tu g.yos nas phyag 'tshal zhing dbang du gyur torsha/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 15chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ rdo rje rig pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du dkyil 'khor thams cad brtags te/ de'i 85—57

dbus su nas phul bzhi la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs te/ de'i spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje yid kyis kyang tsog tsog por ①bzhag go/ /de nas de bzhin du gzhug go/ /zhugs nas 'di skad du khyod deng nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid do/ /de ste dang na de bshad do zhes bsgos (kyeshig /des smras pa gsungs shig ces pa dang / de nas khyod deng phan cad de bzhin gshegs par gyur to zhes smos shig② /des smras pa/ ci'i phyir dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i phyir ro zhes des smos ④shig /gang dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs (nyepa de de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du blta ste/des sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang tshe 'di nyid dam/ pha rol la 'thob ⑥par 'gyur ⑦zhes smras nas phyag rgya slobs shig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes 2bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris nas bcug la rdo rje'i sgrub yi)pa bslab ⑩bo/ /lag pa gnyis kyis 0rdo rje bzung nas 8rang gi phyag rgya bsgom monyusnye/ /rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di ci yin snying po sgom ④pa ste/ rdo rje tshig gis bzlas na des de bzhin gshegs pa'ang tshe 'di'am gzhan la thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i chadakyil 'khor ro/ /thams cad dam tshig chen po'i tshul du byas la 'di smros 8shig /dad brtan phyag na rdo rje la/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs de bzhin no/ /sems can thams cad mgu ba ru/ /khyod kyis ⑩de ltar brtag par bya/ /deng nas khyod kyis de ltar 8ma byas na sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /yang dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris la slob ma hu'ebacug nas las rnam zhu )bzhi'ang bslab bo/ /lus thams cad kyis gtugs rdu2te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ⑫ /85—58

de nas langs te yan lag lngas phyag byas nas ①rig pa thams cad ni bshags na)so / /de nas langs la ①thal mo sbyar te pus ④mo gnyis sa la gtugs nas bsod nams thams cad kyi rjes su yi ⑤rang ngo / /de nas langs te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (neral rdo rje 'dzin ma'i laphyag rgya bcings nas phyag 'tshal ༅te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig gis pobadzra bid brjod cig /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang phyag na rdo rje la phyag bya ba dang bkur ste pyadang mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas phyag na 7rdo rje 8rig pa bsgrub hu pa 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor mthong bas 577ras la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bris la/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs tunyedabang po g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur rgyan thams cad kyis hu9brgyan par 1 tshobya'o / /de nas gso sbyong /nyecan hu)dus gsum du khrus byed pa/ dus gsum du bkrus pa'i gos gyon la stong phrag brgyar bzlas so/ /de'i mjug du )tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur bcings nas mtshan thal byung bzlas na/ nang par du du —2de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshegs te zhal ston to/ /mchog ci 'dod pa stsol te sangs rgyas pa'i bar du yang stsol to/ /de nas yang cho ga gzhan nanate / ras la bcom ldan 'das shustede bzhin gshegs pa padma'i du stesteng du bzlugs par byas la/ de'i spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje thal mo sbyar te tsog tsog tsho snyepor 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la blta bar bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas phyogs su 37phyag na rdo rje ya gcig zu tshogis zhunyerdo rje gsor g.yon pa na padmo'o(6/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su rdo rje khu tshur te/ khu si )tshur gnyis kyis ( skyerdo rje bsnams da 85—59

par byas la/ de nas tshes gcig nas brtsams te zla ba gcig de bzhin ②bzlas la/ zla ba tshangs (minas mtshan thal byung rdo bzlas na/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa byon nas mchog ci 'dod pa stsol to/ /yang cho ga gzhan ni ras la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bris la/ de'i spyan sngar zla ba drug de bzhin du bzlas pa'i mjug (gel nyin mtshan gsum du smyung ba bya ste(ge/ phyag na rdo rje byon nas phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid byin gyi bar du bzlas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ mjug ⑥cu de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /nam mkha' la bltas te (7stong phrag brgya bzlas na (8༄nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong ngo / /des de la phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nyin gcig (9)bzhin stsol to/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar stong phrag brgya bzlas na mchog thob 7bo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i hunyespyan sngar stong phrag brgya bzlas na phyag na rdo rjes 'dod pa thams cad stsol bar 'gyur rom//'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i spyan sngar stong phrag brgya 3)bzlas na/spyan ras gzigs 1 dbang pos lag nas bzung ste/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 15khrid cing slar yang khrid de 'ong ngo / /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i skortog pa chen po'i rgyal po las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtog pa rdzogs sog1 // //de nas bcom ldan 'das la 13phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' /lte chen pos ciyang 'di skad tsho chagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal sa po 'dir snying po gang 85—60

brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje'i ri ltar mi g.yo ba'ang 1bskyod cing 'dren na sems can gzhan lta ci smos/ gang dran pa tsam gyis kyang 'jigs ②pa thams cad las du rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gang brjod pa tsam gyis kyang mtshams med pa thams cad lhag ma ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ba dang / thams cad la srung (4)bar 'gyur ba dang / phyag na rdo rjes kyang 'dod pa thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ba dang / mchog stsol ba dang / don thams cad sgrub (depa dang / dgos (65pa thams cad byed cing rtag par phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur ba dang / gang bslabs pa tsam gyis grub 97)pa thams cad mngon par 'gyur bar stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//phyag na rdo rje khyod kyis legs par smros shig /ngas kyang bzung ngo / /de nas phyag na rdo rjes 9zhesardo rje snyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor te/ rang gi snying gar bstod rdorsha)pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /ṭakki hūm̐ dza/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi nya )khams thams cad rab tu g.yos so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad g.yos/ rab tu g.yos11/'phar rab tu 'phar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rab tu bskyod par gyur to//nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ma rung bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying por gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis brtan par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i grub pa yang sra 32bar gyur to/ /bdud dang mi bgrungs pa'i phyogs thams cad kyang brlag par byas so/ /gdon thams cad bcos bsad 1 bcom 85—61

ste 'dar pad pad nas/ bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su dong nas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag skyobs/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag cag 7skyobs shig pa ②dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje 'di nyid la skyabs su deng (kyeshig dang ④/ 'di nyid khyed la skyob par byed do/ /phyag na rdo rje'i snying ga nas kun tu 'bar bas ⑤bskor bsti/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'dzum zhing khro ba / phyag gnyis kyis me tog gi gzhu 'gengs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis ⑦rdo rje rghaṃ zhes pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dod pa'i khro bo phyung ⑧nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can kun 'dod pa'i khro bos sbyangs nasal/ phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar 'dug ste ⑩bka' nod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / nga ji lta ba de bzhin du khyod kyis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyis shig ces so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ⑪gsungs so/ /lag na rdo rje de bas na khyod snying po gang gis sems can 'di dag thams cad brgyal ba dang / bcos pa dang / bcom pa kun 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan dag kyang rdo rje'i lus thob par 'gyur ba de smros hu3shig /oṃ rgyu / rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya 'dis bdag nyid go bgos na/ rdo rje'i lus dang /rdo rje'i tshe thob cing srung hunyebar yang 'gyur te/ nam 'tsho'i ④bar du thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpas 8rdo rje 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor che/ /gru bzhi pa ste 8sgo bzhi pa'o/ /rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa ste/ bcu drug cha dang ldan par ro/ /rdo rje'i ra 85—62

bas mdzes pa ste/ /grwa ①dang sgo ②yi zur dag dang / /de bzhin rta babs mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen ldan par bya/ /ba dan phreng ba dril bus brgyan la/ /dang por ④ phyi yi ⑤dkyil 'khor 'di/ /snying po bzlas shing bri bar bya / /de yi nang gi yi'akhor lo yang / /rdo rje srad bu mnyam ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje'i ka ba brgyad ldan zhing / /rdo rje'i ka ba bdun ⑦gnas su/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi tshul du ste/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bzhag pa'o/ /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /phyag na rdo rje gzhug ⑧par bya/ /sangs rgyas rin chen thams cad dag /dbu rgyan (9)du ni brgyan thogs pa/ /cung zad tsam du bzhad pa'i zhal / /rdo rje snyems par mdzad pa ste/ /me tog mda' gzhu ⑩'chang ba pohu'i/ /de las gzhan pa phyag bzhi pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs nyid de/ /khro gnyer bzhad pa'i zhal ngo can/ /gnyis kyis me tog gzhu 'gengs shing / /gnyis kyis 0rdo rje rtsu mdzad pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi 3/g.yas phyogs su/ /rdo rje dga' ba bri bar bya/ /snying gar rdo rje brtan 'dzin cing / /'khyud pa lta bu'i sbyor bas so / /phyag na rdo rje'i rgyab tu ni/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'chang ba ste/ /sems dpa' rdo rje dpal can te/ /rin chen char pa rab tu 'bebs/ /rdo rje can gyis ④g.yon bris pa/ /rdo rje snyems pa 8dmar po ste/ /gnyis kyis rdo rje snyems pa ⑩'dzin/ /sgeg pas mchod cing 'dud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor grwa pho tshoyi gnas rnams su/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bri bar bya/ /dpyid kyi rdo rje rdo rje'i sprin/ /ston ga'i rdo rje kha ba mo/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor grwa dag tu/ /'dod pa'i gzugs la sogs pa bri/ / sgo yi 8dpung rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje hu)'dod pa'i kyo ba sogs/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po der/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid rdo rje 85—63

snying po'i phyag rgya bcings la zhugs la 'di skad du smos shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun la bde ba stsol/ /sems can kun gyi phar gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag deng 'grub/ /ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ༅/ de nas de skad smras 2pa dang 'bab par 'gyur te/ de ltar babs 2pa tsam gyis (0phyag na rdo rje'i gzugs mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das mthong bar bstan pas grub pa thams cad kyang stsol te/ la la ni rdo rje 'dzin la la ni 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur (gerol/ /de nas slob ma gzhug ste/ snying po'i phyag rgya bcings la/ des phreng ba bzung tshoganas gos dmar pos yan lag bcings la/ ras dmar pos mig gnyis bkab ste bcug nas 'di skad ces smos shig /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mi mkhas pa su la yang gsang ba 'di dag mi bsnyad ⑦par byos shig /'byung po'i gdon dang phra du men ma la sogs pa'i gdon gyis bsad 795par gyur ta re/ shi nas kyang dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ro zhes bsgo nas gdong khol ny-i dīcig /de nas 'di skad ces smos shig /gang dbus na ba 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje ste/ 'di ni dang po'i sems dpa' 'dod pa'i bdag po ma'adod pa'i dbang po kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa'o1ge/ /gang mdun na ba 'di ni bcom ldan 'das 'di'i thugs yin te/ 'dod pa'i khro bo'o/ /gang g.yas na ba 'di ni sems can thams cad kyi reg pa'i bde ba ste/ rdo rje dga' ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /gang rgyab na ba 'di ni bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid che ba'i rgyal mtshan te/ sems dpa' nya thams cad kyi byams pa slong ba dang nor sbyin pa'o/ /gang g.yon phyogs na ba 'di ni bdag nyid che ba'i bdud de/ sems can thams cad chags par byed pa'o/ /gang grwa'i bzhi 85—64

po 'di rnams ni dus kyi mchod pa/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang dri'i lha'o/ /gang phyi'i grwa'i (2gnas na ba de dag ni gzugs la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan no/ /gang sgo srung (mide dag ni mig dang / 'dod chags pa dang mdza' ②ba ste/ kyo ba tang ba chodadang / zhags pa dang / sgrog dang /'bebs pa dag ni rgol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa thams cad kyi bdag po la smod par ma byed cig /gang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sems can thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir 'dod chags dang bral ba 'chad de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mu stegs can gyi 957rnams 'dod chags bral ba'i chos des thar pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams chags pa rnams ni/ sems can thams cad la chags pas na thar nga/ ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag gi chung mas kyang sems can sdud par byed de / 'dod chags ni byang chub tu bstan pa'o zhes so/ /de nas snying po byin cig /ṭakki rtsu dzaḥ(6sku/ 'di bsgrubs 97)na bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i (8dimachog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das grub pas na 'dod pa'i khro bo grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snying po 'di bdag nyid che ba ste/ṭakki zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'o/ /tsū zhes pa ni khro bo'o/ /de gnyis (gedagug pa'i phyir dzaḥ0zhes bya ba ni 'di khyod kyis bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po shes par slobs shig /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje'i thugs bslabs nas lag pa gnyis su rdo rje sbyin pa'i snying po ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra dha zhumar badzra pra tai dhā 12ra ya sid rgya 91snyeṭakki tsū dzaḥyi/ de nas phreng ba phyag na rdo rje la phul bas de'i mgo la bskon no/ /de nas rdo rje ming gi tshedabang sbyin pa snying 85—65

po 'dis so/ /oṃ badzra a gi ṣiñtsa sarba kā me shwa red twe i dam badzra nā ma nā mā dhiṣṭha te dri ḍho ①su bha ba oṃ ṭakki rgyu dzaḥl/ de nas der 'dug ste phyag rgya chen po bcings nas rdo rje tshig gis brgyad stong bzlas na de nas sa g.yo ste/ grub pa thams cad lan cig dubazlas pas 'grub bo/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la brgya bzlas na de'i thugs dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de phyin cad ④sems can thams cad kyi snying ⑤shes pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi snying la dbang byed do/ /thams cad kyi snying du sdug par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad kyi brtan 56)par chags so/ /snying thams cad las tshig (pethos par 'gyur ro/ /gyur pa dang 'gyur ba dang (she/ da ⑦ltar gyi tshig bden par 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi snying las kyang cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi mthong zhing gzhan la yang ston to/ /de'i snying las rdo rje 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na sems can thams cad kyis mi sod skopa dang / mi tshugs pa dang / mi gcod pa dang / mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i lus su 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa bya ste/ rdo rje'i thugs bstod pa'i glus bstod nyunyedo/ /de 8phyin cad grub pa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur te/ 'dod pa thams cad dang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad kyis 'dra bar mchod nas/ ji snyed pa'i zas dang ro dang spyad pa thams cad kyis nyunyetshim par byas nas 'byung ngo / /rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa'o// //de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'dod pa khro bo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya ji 85—66

lta ba bzhin bris te zhugs nas mchod pa'i lha rnams kyis gar gyi mchod pas snyim pa ma stongs ①par byas te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ②phyag rgya chen po bcings la/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rdo rje'i glu'i rdo rje'i bzlas pas 'bum bzlas so/ /de nas rdo rje de rtsi nibar 'gyur ro/ /de nas slar yang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de ltar mtshan gcig thal byung du bzlas na nang par rdo rje 'dzin tam/ rdo rje khro bo stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bdag po lha'i gzugs dang / mdog dang rgyan dang spyan gsum pa la phyag bzhi pa rdo rje 'dod pa'i mdangs dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi tsher 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor te/dkyil 'khor chen po'i srad bus thig btab ste④/ de nas lha mo rnams bris la de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag nas 'di skad smos shig /ho badzra satwa su ra ta st+waṃ/ de'i spyan sngar rdo rje gzhu 'gengs pa'i gzhu bris te/de'i phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /badzra a rgyu/ g.yas su rdo rje dga' mgu 'khyud par bya'o / /de'i phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /badzra ki ⑤li rtsu/ rgyab tu yichu srin rgyal mtshan 'chang ba byams ma'i rdo rje bri de'i phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /badzra a gri ho/g.yon du rdo rje snyems ma bris te/ rdo rje g.yon du sbyor bar bya/ de'i phyag rgya ni ri ri'adi'o / /badzra garbe (8༄ha ni/ de nas grwa dang sgor yang rang gi lha mo bri/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon nyid shin tu chas phyo)la rdo rje lag tu thogs bud med kyang brgyan 0te/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs 0la/ dpung pa gnyis kyis 'khyud de zhugs la 'di skad brjod do/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ su ra ta ho ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥhunye / de nas brjod pa tsam gyis bcom ldan 'das ston par mdzad de/ phyag 85—67
