rgya thams cad 'grub pa dang dam tshig thams cad 'grub pa ①yang stsol to/ /de nas slob ma yang (kyede bzhin du snying po'i rdo rje de nyid kyis chabatsud nas 'di zhes smros shig /khyod kyis ④dam tshig 'di las ma 'da' shig /mi bde ba ma spangs par myur du shi zhing ngu 'bod chen por skye bar 'gyur 2ta re/ de nas dam tshig brjod de/nye/ bdag che kun gyi phyag rgya ni/ /'dod pa bsam las yang dag 'byung / /de bas khyod kyis sdig med pa'i/ /'dod dang bsam pa ma btang 57)shig /'di ni dam tshig bsrung rdunyeba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ṭakki rtsu phaṭa/'dis rdo rje'i chu blud do/ /gang dngos po gzhan thams cad kyi phyir yang mnas bsgag (9)ste/ de dag la yang rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin pas blud do/ /gang gis 'di las 'das na/ zla ba phyed kyis snying 'gas so zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dam tshig chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings pa bslab ⑩bo//de nas de bzhin du 'byung ngo / /shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris nas nyid kyi sku'am mtshan ma gzhag go/ /der btsud nas las rnam bzhi bslab par bya'o/ /de la dang po nyid du 'dod pa thams cad stsol bar gyur te/ phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya chen po bcings nas rdo rje 'dzin phyag bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i skur bdag nyid mthong ba de srid kyi bar du bzlas so/ /de phyin cad nyusto'adod pa thams cad nus par 'gyur rol/ /de nas khro bo'i las bslab ste/ rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya bcings /nyal bzlas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thang cig bzlas te/ rghaṃ zhes pas bsdigs na de bzhin gshegs pa yang 'gyel bar 'gyur ro/ /de phyin cad 12'gro 85—68

ba gnas pa thams cad kyang 'gyel nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i 91cilas 'byung ste/ sems can thams cad 'dod pa dang khro bo gnyis kyis 'dul bar 'dod na/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byas te / rdo rje thugs kyi phyag rgya bdag gi snying gar bcings la phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar rdo rje 'dzin thob pa de srid du bzlas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las byed par tshon 'dod pas phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar byang chub tu du sems bskyed la sbyin pa sbyin/cho/ tshul khrims bsrung 'a / bzod pa bsgom(6)/ brtson 'grus brtsam(shwa/ bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug(kye /shes rab yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ ci 'dod ci nus kyis (95bya zhing rtag tu bzlas pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur ri mthong gi bar du bya'o/ /de nas sa bcu po 'thob ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i las byed pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas sgrub pa 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs pa37/ /dam tshig shes pa ma yin dang / /slob ma ma yin gzhan rnams la/ /mi zad snying po 'di mi sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bas sgrub nyu2pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar stong phrag nyusnyebargya bzlas na sngar bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ras la bris te/ras kyi dbus su ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bri/ de'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje phyag bzhi pa'i thugs ka nas thugs nyu0'byung ba de bzhin du bri lha/g.yon du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po phyag bzhi pa ste/ gnyis na ni padmo'i ting nge 'dzin 'chang / gnyis kyis ni me tog gi gzhu 'gengs 4pa/ kha dog 1785—69

dmar po bri/ spyan sngar de bzhin du rdo rje 'dod pa'i khro bo bri'o/ /steng du nam mkha'i snying po bri/ grwar mchod pa'i lha rang gi mchod pas bkram ①pa dang mgo bor ro/ /de nas ras la bris pa'i spyan sngar zla ba bzhin dus bzhir ②stong bzlas shing bsgrubs ②na de nas ⑤zla ba tshang ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa'ang stsol ⑤bar 'gyur ro0/ /ras la bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bris la sems dpa' chen po dang / lha mo yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /de'i spyan sngar zla ba gcig tu grangs med par bzlas shing 'dod pa thams cad zos la bsgrubs te/de nas zla ba gcig lon pa dang phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya chen po ⑦bcings la mtshan thal byung bzlas na nang par rdo rje 'dzin du'athob bo/ /ras la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin du bris la/ de'i spyan sngar zla ba phyed kyi bar du rtag par bzlas pa ni ༅mi nyal mi mnal bar bzlas te/ de nas zla ba phyed lon pa dang mtshan mo yang thal byung du bzlas na nang par phyag na rdo rje dang mtshungs pa dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod chen po dang 8/ bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad kyang 'thob cing thams cad du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ras la bcom ldan 'das khro bo de bzhin du bris la/ de'i spyan sngar rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ stong phrag brgya bzlas na des 'grub par 'gyur te/ bsgo ba bzhin belas thams cad byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du'ang khyer zhing slar yang khyer te 'ong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad khyer te 'ongs nas de la sbyin no/ /des kyang longs spyod ⑫par nus na/ lha'i bu mo thams cad lta ci smos 8brgya byin yang stsol to/ /phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du bsgo bas stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /85—70

sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste dbang du byed do/ /phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar rdo rje thugs kyi phyag rgya bcings nas stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nyid kyis 1)dpal gyi lha mo khrid de byon nas sgrub pa po'i mdun du 'dor ro/ /de nas sgrub pa pos bcom ldan 'das khyod nyid bdag gis ( grub par 'tshal gyi/ 'di ci 'tshal zhes smros shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes te ci 'dod pa'i mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro / /grub pa thams cad kyang 'grub bo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang po'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas (gyin spyan ras gzigs dbang pos mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na dbang stsol bar 'gyur te/4)/bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/ /rdo rje bzhag ste de'i mdun du 'bum bzlas na de nas las thams cad yid bzhin du grub par byed do//phyag rgya chen po bcings nas 'bum bzlas na phyag na rdo rje 'dzin gyis mchog stsol to / /dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas (ldenon rdo rje 'dzin mngon du mthong zhing phyag rgya'i las kun grub pa yang stsol bar 'gyur ro97/ /rdo rje lag tu thogs nas 'bum bzlas na rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje bzung ba tsam gyis 97mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo thogs te 'bum bzlas na 'khor lo'i rig 8pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /kyo ba tang thogs te 'bum bzlas na/ kyo ba tang (9)des thams cad 'gugs nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa thogs te 'bum bzlas na/zhags pa des thams cad drang nus par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje ⑩bcings pa bsdams te 'bum bzlas na/ sems can thams cad bcing 17nus par 'gyur ronyuge/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na gnas 85—71

pa dang 'gro ba thams cad dbab nus par 'gyur ro/ /0)rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na/ rtsu zhes bya ba gcig gis (5)gnas pa dang ske/ 'gro ba thams cad skad cig ( ragis ltung bar byed nus par 'gyur rol/ /lha chen po rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na/ zla ba gcig tshun cad ⑤kyis der 'ongs te dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mthu bo che rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te 'bum bzlas na 'khor lo thob ste/ 'khor lo de thogs na kha'agrub par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa mnan te 'bum bzlas na tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te 'bum bzlas na rdo rje sbyin par 'gyur te/ rdo rje bskor bas tshar gcad (7)pa dang / dbab pa dang thang cig dunaragis ni gnam lcags dang ser ba 'bebs so/ /sa nad gzhon nu mnan te 'bum bzlas na/ gzhon nu ma thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad kyang byed par 'gyur ro / /nyi ma la bltas te 'bum bzlas na/ bdud rtsi rna cha sbyin par 'gyur te(7/des na lha'i lo stong 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba la 'bar ba'i lta bas mgu bar bltas te stong phrag brgya bzlas na zla ba 9gnyis su mthong ste/ de phyin cad 17zla ba dang nyu2mtshungs pa'i 'od dang mdangs su 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi mig tu mdzes shing sems can thams cad kyi snying du sdug par 'gyur ro/ /gza' 51 chen po'i gzugs la bltas te 'bum bzlas na de nas be con thob ste(1ri/be con des ni 'thabs na dgra las rgyal te nor thams cad 'thob bo/ /skya lkesleng gi gnas su song ste 'bum bzlas na skya sleng las kun byed do/ /rgyan gyis myos pa mnan te 'bum bzlas na/ chang gi snod thams cad nam 'tsho'i bar du 85—72

mi zad 0)par 'gyur ro/ /ma dhu ((ka ra la bltas te stong phrag brgya bzlas na/dbang bskur ba thob par 'gyur (gyiro/ /rgyal ba ④la bltas te 'bum bzlas na 'thab mo dang rtsod pa'i g.yul thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba thob pa mnan te 'bum bzlas na thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /mdzod skyong rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te 'bum bzlas na bza' ba dang btung ba mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba thams cad kyis kyang 'di la zad par mi nus so/ /rlung mngon du byas te stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ rlung gis de dang mthun 5)par 'dod pa thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /me la bltas te 'bum bzlas na me'i dbus su 'dug pa dang / nyal ba dang 'gro na yang mi 'tshig ste(6)/ me'i gzir gyur cing nyin gcig kyang gser srang re re sbyin no/ /ngal bso 7po mnan te 'bum bzlas na gnod sbyin thams cad kyi bdag por gyur nas nor thams cad kyang sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /phag mo mngon du byas te stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ sa la 'dug pa'i gter 'byin (8)no/ /gshin rje mnan te 'bum bzlas na mi 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnam 'dren pa'i cha lugs tshotshotshol bltas te stong phrag brgya tshibazlas na/ de las thams cad pa'i g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /klu ba 11ru ṇa nyusnyemanan te 'bum bzlas na/ klu thams cad las kun byed pa'i g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /mi'i hu gnas su song nas stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ mi thams cad g.yog byed cing gdon sathams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /sa la 'dug ste 'bum bzlas na sa'i dbang por 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la bltas te 'bum bzlas na/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i sems can thams cad bskyel ba dang /dbang byed par 'gyur zhing nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'i 'og mngon 85—73

du byas te stong phrag brgya ①bzlas na/ sa'i 'og na 'khod pa kun la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rin po che thogs te 'bum bzlas na stong phrag brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gser gyi dong tse risal sogs pa yang de bzhin no/ /skyes pa bzung ste 'bum bzlas na/ stong phrag brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med bzung ste stong phrag brgya bzlas na stong phrag brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rta (mil zhon te 'bum bzlas na 'bum du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /glang po bul zhon te 'bum bzlas na 'bum du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /ba lang la sogs pa phyugs kyi rwa gnyis bzung ste (snye'abum bzlas na/ stong phrag brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gos dang rgyan gyis chas (67la stong phrag brgyar bzlas na stong phrag brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal mo la bltas te 'bum bzlas na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mtsho dbyangs ma la bltas te 'bum bzlas na tshig rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bslangs (7tshon ci bslangs pa de kun ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gtsug lag thams cad dang / rnam par shes pa thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /grub byed ma bzung nas 'bum bzlas na/ 'das pa dang / da 9)ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa kun kyang ston cing ched du ma bslangs par nor sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /sā 9la bhardzi ka mnan nas 'bum bzlas na nyin re zhing 7yang gser gyi dong tse /spebargyad brgyad ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gos kyi sgrog ma nyunyal mnan te 'bum bzlas na mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang gi snod mnan te 'bum bzlas na de dang de mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin gyi cha lugs mnan te 'bum bzlas na / gnod sbyin nyu2gyis ci dang ci 'dod pa kun sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /srin po mnan te 'bum bzlas na de de'i g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /'byung po mnan te 85—74

'bum bzlas na/ 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /sha za'i cha lugs bris pa mnan te 'bum bzlas na de de'i g.yog byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin ma la sogs pa yang bsgrub 0)bo/ /ri la 'dzegs te 'bum bzlas na (snyeri thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phyugs kyi lhas su 'dug ste ri 'bum bzlas na phyugs thams cad la dbang du 'gyur ro(ge/ /shing ljon gyi drung du 'bum bzlas na/ shing ljon pa'i lha rnams mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /zhing la 'dug ste ⑤'bum bzlas na/ bza' ba (kha'abum du 'phel bar rtso)'gyur ro/ /tshong pa dang bcas pa'i grong du 'bum bzlas na nor thams cad ma bslangs 8par thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas byin can du 'bum bzlas na thams cad la 89skudabang du 'gyur ro/ /grong du 'bum bzlas na zla ba gcig tshun cad hu )kyis grong de 'thob ⑩bo/ /gtsug lag khang du 'bum bzlas na/ gtsug lag khang na gnas pas nor thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i rten nyugedu 'bum bzlas na lhas nor thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /khang pa stong par 'bum bzlas na sha za thams cad de'i g.yog tu 'gyur tenyusnye/ dgos pa thams cad sbyor bar 'gyur ro//snang 8ba'i gnas su 'bum bzlas na snang ba dbang du 'gyur ro/ /skyed mamos tshal du 'bum bzlas na/ skyed tshamos tshal gyi me tog dang 'bras bu thams cad rtag tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshor 'bum bzlas na mtsho de'i lha la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /gter gyi gnas su 'bum bzlas na gter rang 1 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dgod cing 'bum bzlas na rtag tu dga' bar 'gyur te/ bgad 1 pa tsam gyis las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /khros pas 'bum bzlas na thams cad gtan 'pho bar nus par 'gyur ro/ /cang mi zer bar 'bum bzlas 85—75

na sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lkugs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis gyo'abum bzlas na tshig thams cad kyi dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bud med kyi 'jom kun par rtags btsugs te/ 'bum bzlas na 'dod pa thams cad kyi bdag po dang nam mkha' la 'gro ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / 'jom pa la mdzub (0mo btsugs te 'bum bzlas na de byas pas gnas pa dang 'gro ba thams cad 'dren cing 'gugs pa dang ④/ gtong ba dang 'gyel ba dang slong bar 'gyur ro/ /'jom 95)pa lta zhing 'bum bzlas na/ bud med thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro//'jom par lig bu mig bcug ste 'bum bzlas na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jom par gur gum bskus (6)te 'bum bzlas na/ des bskus rtsonapas 'dod pa'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /'jom par ba bla bcug (8)ste 'bum bzlas na nam mkha' la 'gro ba (9nye'agrub par 'gyur ro/ /'jom par ldong ros bcug ste 'bum bzlas na rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /ral gri thogs te 'bum bzlas na ral gri can gyi rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo thogs te 'bum bzlas na/ 'khor lo can gyi rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /kyo ba tang thogs te 'bum bzlas na kyo ba tang des thams cad 'gugs nus par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje gsor nas stong phrag brgya bzlas na rdo rje rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje lag gis 0bzung nas 'bum bzlas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la lag gis bzung ste 'bum bzlas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byed pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran zhing 'bum bzlas na/ sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal zhing 85—76

'bum bzlas na phyag na rdo rjes kyang de mchod na gzhan gyis 1༄lta ci smos/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs las bzung (0ste 'bum bzlas na ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /rdo rje snying po bzung nas 'bum bzlas na nor thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs tsho ril rdo rje khu tshur gyi spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na khu tshur bsdams (༄)pa tsam gyis 95)las kun byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu la lta (6)zhing 'bum bzlas na nam mkha' la yi ge snang ste/thams cad smra ba dang spobs pa thogs pa sgoramed pa zhurathob par 'gyur ro/ /sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 99)ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la bskor zhing bo'abum bzlas na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur rol/ /nam mkha'i mdzod la bltas nyunyute 'bum bzlas na nam mkha' la 32rgyu ba thams cad dang / don thams cad dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad kyi bar du ston to/ /byams pa'i zhabs la bzung ste 'bum bzlas na/ mtho ris kyi 'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas 'bum bzlas na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po slob dpon dang / yid kyis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor chen por brtags te zhugs nas 'bum bzlas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar phyag rgya chen po bcings la dkyil 'khor chen por 'dug stenyan/ rdo rje'i bzlas pas stong phrag brgya rdo rje tshig gis bzlas na/ dngos grub thams cad dang ske/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / bshes gnyen ngathams cad dang ske/ las thams cad kyang nus par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i bdag po dang /85—77

dbang phyug dang / byed pa po dang / 'byin pa dang / mi zad 0)mi nyams pa dang ske/ 'dod pa thams cad nyams su myong zhing bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad rnyed (micing 'thob ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang /bde ba 'grub pa'i sbyin par 'gyur ba dang / de rang gi gnyen dang / bshes gnyen thobadang / grogs thams cad kyis kyang mthong ngo / / de dag ④la yang 'grub par byed do/ /bsams gepa tsam gyis yisgyu ma thams cad ston te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs kyang ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi cho 'phrul yang ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yang ston to/ /skad cig gis 1)gzugs sna tshogs su ston par 'gyur te/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi tshe dang / stobs dang / gzugs dang / na tshod dang —/ shes pa ci tsam pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 'dug ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas/ khro bo'i tshig gis (zhedabacom ldan 'das la lta 7zhing don gyis 'bum bzlas na/ des rdo rje khro bo lta bur bdag gi lus 'gyur ro/ /rghaṃ zhes pas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang cha'adzin pa dang / khams gsum gyi dbang po dang / spyan gsum pa'i khro bo chen por gyur nas ma lus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong zhing mchod pa dang sems can thams cad grub pa gsol te/ de ltar mi zad mi nyams par 'gyur ro zhes 37bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las phyag na rdo rje'i rtog pa'o// //85—78

de nas bcom ldan 'das la (1)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nadabang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di stsal to/ /gang brjod pa tsam gyis ni༄de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du grub pa dang / 'jigs 4pa dang ske/ gnam dal dang / 'tshe ba dang / nad thams cad 'jig par 'gyur rol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 5'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' la legs so zhes bya ba byin te legs so legs so/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi (cadabang po khyod kyis 5medasmros shig /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ / ā ro lika(8da /de nas 'di brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lhan cig tu 'dus te/ ri rab ri'i rtse mor bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der dong nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te zhugs so/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rang gi snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas yang dag rab khabashad pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal tshul bzhin du/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de dbus srad bu mnyam pa ru/ /grwa bzhi tshepar ni gdab pa ru/ /gnyis pa'i grwa ni sgor 11bstan te/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi tshul du ste/ /dbus su thig ni bzhi yang bri/ /tshon rtsi dmar po dag gis sna ni/ /85—79

padma 'dab 1)brgyad bri bar bya/ / de yi 92)snying po'i gdabus su ni/ /'jig rten mgon po gzhug risapar bya/ /'dab (snyem kun gyi steng rnams su/ /sangs rgyas cha lugs bri bar bya/ /padma che mchog phyag rgya yis/ /der ni slob dpon bzhugs zhiXnas kyang / /dkyil 'khor gnas su 'jug tsotshonas ni/ /rnal 'byor snyoms par 'jug par bya/ /ji ltar padma tsho0chu rnams dang / /nyes pa'i bag chags mang po yis / /chags par mi 'gyur de bzhin 'dir/ /'gro ba chags pas dag par gyur pa yin/ /'di lan cig tho)brjod nas bsgom ste/ de nas mdzub (7mo gnyis kyi kyo ba tang gis kun drangs la padmo chen po de spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i spyan sngar dgrol /stolo/ /de la pad mo chen po'i kyo ba tang 8ni 'di'o/ /oṃ ma hā padma hūm̐ dza hrīḥ51snye/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs tsokyi skodabang po nyid byon te/ slob dpon la zhal ston par mdzad nas yang na 'od zer yang 'gyed do/ /de nas phyag rgya de nyid kyis 7slob ma gzhug go/ /dkar pos g.yogs la gos dkar po bgos zhu snal/ thod dkar pos mgo la gtsug tor byas nas bcug ste3she/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di zhu)brjod nas don kyang bstan par bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon par 3 )pad mo byin/ g.yas par sngags kyi nor bu bskur la 'di skad smos shig /sangs rgyas thams cad pad mo che / /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /rtag pa ༷ lharu ni brtag so par bya/ /khyod ni ni deng nas spyan ras gzigs/ /de nas phyag rgya tsho gyichen po bcing ba dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa bslab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po pad mo zhes bya'o/ /de nas pad mo'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste / pad mo'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris la/ dbus kyi snying po la 'dug 85—80

nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la padma 'dab tshom kha 'byed pa'i tshul gyis blta nazhing stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ 'phags pa kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po thob bo/ /pad mo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste / dkyil 'khor de bzhin du byas la de'i dbus su pad mo stong bzhag ste/ de nas pad mo re re zhing bzang po (45thang res bcom ldan 'das la pad mo stong 'bul lo/ /de nas slob ma bcug ste dam tshig brjod do/ /slob min 5bu min ma yin te/ /dam tshig can la dam tshig bstanayi / /'dod pa'i 'dod chags thams cad ni/ /dag pa nyid de 47༄padma bzhin / /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin bris la mchod pa rnam pa 87bzhis mchod do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yid kyis te/ /phyag na rdo rje'i tshig gis so/ /lus kyis 'jig rten mgon po ste/ /nam mkha'i snying po las kyis so/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs kyi tho dbang pos sgrub 7pa'i cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /ras la bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs kyi nyunyedabang po ri rab ri'i rtse mo na/rang gi ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs nyurtashing nyu de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad mtha' kun tu bzhugs ④par bri/ de nas zla ba yar gyi tshes zhag gcig /tshogenas brtsams nas rtag tu thams cad dag 7pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tsho/ tshorgyun du bzlas te/ nam spyan ras gzigs kyi hunyedabang po'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku byung nas sgrub pa po'i pad mo'i /rtedabus su bzhugs rte )te/ yang de las gzhan pa'i sku byung nas sgrub pa po'i dbang bskur ba'i gnas su brtan par 'gyur gyi bar du bzlas so/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi skur kun gyur te/ skad cig gcig gis 51bde ba 85—81

can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro zhing ldog go/ /sems can thams cad kyang mthong ste/ tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub ①pa 'byung ste/'bum bzlas na sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /nyis 'bum bzlas na mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i (misdig pa thams cad ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro(khu/ /sum 'bum bzlas na bsod nams thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas dngos grub thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / bshes gnyen ④thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcings te ⑤stong phrag brgya bzlas pa'i mjug (6)tu mtshan thal byung bzlas na/ de'i nang par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byon nas de'i snying gar zhugs te/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'thob (spyibo/ /yang na khar zhugs na spyan ras gzigs dbang po 'thob (8)bo/ /de nas ma bsgrubs kyang las su 'gyur ba ni dang po brjod pas bdag srung (9dngo / /gnyis brjod pas ni gzhan dang grong dang grong khyer srung ⑩ngo ske/ /gsum pa brjod pas ni las thams cad byed do/ /dbab pa ni tsan dan gyi bdug tshospepas so/ /gdon thams cad zhi bar bya ba ni trī 8zhes bya bas so/ /sems can thams cad dbang du bya ba ni rdo rje me tog bzlas te byin no/ /sems can thams cad gnon pas 32ni sa ser pos so/ /bud med dbang du bya ba ni su ma na'i tsheme tog la bsngags 8pas so/ /chom rkun gnon 9/9pa ni yungs kur nyurtegyi sbyin sreg 13gis so/ /ri dgas thortedang bya gnon sbyo )pa ni yungs kur zhunagator bas so / /sgyu ma gnon 'i pa ni rma bya'i chang 2bus so/ /mi lam mthong bar tsunyebya ba ni dus gsum du bzlas pas so/ /rmi lam ngan pa gzhil ba ni til gyi sbyin sreg ( snye85wa 82

gis so/ /sems can thams cad dbang du bya ba ni khyim bya'i sgro'i sbyin sreg ti gis so/ /bu mo thor bu dbang du bya ba ni bu mo'i skra'i sbyin sreg (gegis so/ /yugs sa mo dbang du bya ba ni bud med kyi me tog gi sbyin sreg (8)gis so/ /bud med thams cad dbang du bya ba ni bud med kyi dbang po'i sbyin sreg zhi)gis so/ /'dod pa thams cad dbang du bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang po la mchod pa byas nas(lde/ nub gsum rangs 567par bzlas na/ de nas 'dod pa thams cad rtag tu 'thob (7)par 'gyur ro/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang po'i spyan sngar (8)nyin re zhing dus gsum du lan gsum 9)bzlas na/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba gsum gyis re ba ci 'dod pa'i mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar zla ba gsum gyi bar du nyin mtshan gsum 9bzlas na/ de bzhin gshegs pas mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rtog pa'o// // de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems 11dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal por rang gi snying po 'bul gyis12/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes su gsol/'dis sems can thams cad dbang bskur ba thob pa la sogs pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' la skyes bu chen po smos shig 85—83

ces bka' stsal to0)/ /de nas 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' ②chen pos rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ / traṃ bā bā chaṭa ṭa ha ha/ de nas 'di brjod pas nam mkha' la dbang bskur ba thams cad la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang ④/ gos dang / gser dang / nor rin po che'i dbyig la sogs pa thams cad kyi char bab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku kun du rgyan 9gethams cad kyis brgyan ༅te bzhugs so/ /de nas nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems dpas dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin te/ /rdo rje rin chen mnyam ldan zhing / /grwa (7brgyad shin tu mnyam par bya/ /rin chen kun dang ldan par bya/ /der slob dpon zhugs te rdo rje rin po che'i phyag rgya dbang bskur ba'i gnas su (nyebazhag la zhugs nas 'di zhes brjod do/ /re ba thams cad grub pa yi/ /nam mkha' grub pa mchog yin te/ /grub shig grub shig ⑨sems chen po/ /bcom ldan thams cad grub par ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' 0byin gyis rlob nyunyepar mdzad do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su nam mkha'i snying po'i cha lugs bzhag la de'i thad 'khor kun du phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa brgyad gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rdo rje khu tshur gyis gzhug tsogo/ /bcug nas 'di skad ces brjod do/ /sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /don zhes 9/snyebastan pa gang yin debo/ /byang chub sems ni brtan mapa yin/ /de nas sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi bslab bo/ /de la dbang bskur ba sbyin pa dang / nor sbyin pa dang zas sbyin pa dang chos sbyin pa'o / /de la dbang bskur ba sbyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la'o/ /85—84

nor sbyin pa ni sems can thams cad la'o/ /zas sbyin pa ni byol song thams cad la'o/ /chos sbyin pa ni sems can mi snang ba thams cad la'o/ /de nas snying po byin la rin po che thams cad kyis 3)byin gyis brlabs du pa'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te 'di zhes brjod do/ /oṃ badzra ratna bhi ṣe rdo kā bhi ri ri ṣiñtsa sarpā dhi pa ti 'a)rgyu bā bā ṭa ṭa ha ha/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i khu tshur gyis phyag rgya bslab (6)stel/ sngags ni 'di'o/ /hūm̐ bā ṭa (2ha/ de nas rdo rje rin po che'i phyag ④rgya bcings te sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ bā tshe'i ṭa nyu)mu baṃ/ de nas mchod pa rnam bzhi bya ste 'byung ngo / /dbang thams cad bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas rdo rje rin po che'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ rdo rje rin po che dbus su bris la / lag tu nor bu thogs nas rdo rje rin po che langs kyi bar du bzlas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byon te dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /dbang bskur ba des na thams cad kyi dbang por 'gyur ro/ / rin po che'i nyugedakyil 'khor ro//de nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor te/ nam mkha'i snying po'i cha lugs bris la/spyan sngar nor dang / gser dang / mu tig dang / nor bu rin po che la sogs pa gang yang rung ba bzhag la/ de nas de btsud rto de thams cad bstan nasal/ dam tshig 'di sbyin no/ /sangs rgyas la sogs sems dpa' dag /gal te nyin re mchod stongs 51rin/ /khyod kyis 12nor dang don bsags pa/ /tshe rabs kun du 'jig tshapar 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni mna'i 3 tshosnying po'o/ /oṃ bā bā ṭa ṭa ya swā hā/ de nas chus dbang bskur ro/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor bris la de bzhin gshegs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bya ste/ de'i dbus su bzhag nas der btsud de/ de nas las rnam pa lnga 85—85

bslab 3)pa ni 'di lta ste/ dbang sbyin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa ②bya'o/ /de nas nor sbyin pa ni dge sbyong dang bram ze la sogs pa la ci nus kyis (she sbyin no/ /de nas zas sbyin pa ni byol song rnams la sbyin no/ /de nas mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni gyod khrid thams cad la sbyin no/ /de nas chos sbyin pa ni mi snang ba'i sems can rnams la sbyin no/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bsgrub ④pa 'byung ste ras la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan (5)pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ⑥ba bris te/ de'i g.yas phyogs su 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po bcom ldan 'das la dbang bskur ba'i phreng bas dbang bskur ba'o/ /g.yon phyogs su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas ras la bris pa de'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas pa'i mjug ⑦tu nyi ma shar ba nas brtsams te / phyi (8༄de nyin gyi nyi ma shar gyi bar du bzlas na de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying po ras la bris pa de las byung nas sgrub pa po de la rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur yo)ro/ /dbang bskur ba de nas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma bsgrubs par yang las su 'gyur ba ni 'bum bzlas na don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na/ gter chen po rnyed dom/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na/ spyan ras gzigs dbang pos phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na rgyal srid 'thob hu)bo/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi spyan sngar 'bum bzlas na/ nam mkha' la khu tshur bcings kyi pas gser gyi dong tse 32'byung ngo / /'jam dpal gzhon nu 85—86

la bltas te 'bum bzlas na chos kyi nor dang gzungs thob bo/ /des nor yang skye bar byed do/ /rdo rje 'khor lo srin lag gi sor mos mnan te 'bum bzlas na 'khor lo bskor ①bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i mdzod kun nas 'khyud de 'bum bzlas pas nam mkha' las nor thams cad dang / zas thams cad kyi yo byad zad mi shes par 'gyur ro/ /byams pa la bltas te 'bum bzlas na/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa byang chub ②sems dpa' dga' ldan gnam ①gyi dbang mchog byin nas slar yang 'ong ngo / /de phyin cad ④'dod pa thams cad kyi nor gyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las nam mkha'i snying po'i rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyis (snyebyang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa'i 'khor thams cad bskyod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po dbul bar bgyi ste/ bdag gis bskal pa stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la rdo rje'i ri rab de bzhin gshegs pa las blangs te/des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra mo snyed 6)kyi sems can rnams 'grub pa thams cad grub par byas te/ de'i bskyed pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs kyi bar du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje khu tshur byang chub sems dpa' mechen po la legs so zhes bya ba byin te legs so legs so/ /rdo rje khu tshur khyod kyis smos ⑧shig /rdo nas rdo rje khu tshur gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu g.yos par byas nas rang gi snying po 85—87

'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ru ṭu ru ṭu rdu ma ṭa6)/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin dang / 'khor thams cad dang bcas nas/ ri rab ri'i rtse mor bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags te/lag pa gnyis kyis rang gi khu tshur gyi phyag rgya bcings nas②/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub la dmigs shing / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur gyi zhudakyil 'khor chen por gyur nas bkod do/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyag rgyas btab nas dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs sol/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /rdo rje'i (shedakyil 'khor 'dra ba ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur zhes gsungs so/ /de yi ⑤dbus su sems chen po/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur rdo rjer bcas/ /lag pa gnyis ni btsir ༅bar bya/ /de yi ngos ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas gzugs rnams gzhag par bya/ /de dag gi ni grwa kun du/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun bri'o/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyis tsa)rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyi dam 2tshig gi ①phyag rgya bcings te / zhugs la 'di brjod do'i/ /hūṃ dakṣi ṇi tsom ra na 8phaṭa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur slob dpon la grub par 'gyur te/ de la phyag rgya yang brtan par 'gyur zhing sus kyang dbye bar mi nus so/ /de nas snying po 'dis bdag gi snying gar dgrol lo/ /oṃ badzra muṣṭi mutha/ de nas slob ma gzhug pa ④ste rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdo rje dang bcas pa phreng ba dang bcas par bya ste/ de bzhin du ras dmar pos mig gnyis bkab ste/ de nas 'di zhes brjod do/ /deng khyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ⑩phyag rgyas btab 85—88

pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya dang / rdo rje 'dzin gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgyas kyang btab bo/ /khyod chos dang rdo rje las gang 'dod/ des smras pa gnyis ma'o zhe na/ de nas 3)rdo rje slob dpon gyis (kyerdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i cha lugs blangs nas phreng ba de'i mgo la bzhag ste/ dgrol ba'i snying po de nyid kyis phyag rgya snying gar dgrol lo/ /de nas lag tu sbyin pa ni lag pa g.yon par rdo rje'o/ /g.yas par de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de ste de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes zer na de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid sbyin no/ /de ste rdo rje'o zhes zer na de'i lag pa chagayon par rdo rje byin la 'di skad bsgo shig④ /'di gnyis ni khyod kyi (5)grub par dmigs la rtag tu mchod pa gyis ⑥shig /de nas gdong g.yogs pa bkrol 0ril dkyil 'khor ston la ⑧'di zhes ⑨smras shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje rnams/ /bsdus pa khu tshur zhes bya ste/ /bcings na rdo rje khu tshur bshad/ /de nas snying po byin la phyag rgya bcings pa slobs ⑩shig /dam tshig gi khu tshur zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag bri/ /de yi dbus su ci rigs par/ /sangs rgyas sku lus gzhag par bya/ /thams cad rgyan gyis hunyebargyan 8pa yi/ /rdo rje khu tshur kun 'dzin pa'o/ /de yi ngos ni thams cad du/ / phyag rgya bzhi ni bri bar bya/ /zla ba'i tsodakyil 'khor dbus rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen yang de bzhin/ /de bzhin rdo rje pad mo'i dbus/ /rdo rje rgya gram bri bar bya/ /grwa yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /mchod pa rnam bzhi bri bar bya/ /de nas btsud nas phyag rgya kun / /bcing ba yang skoni bslab par bya/ /sgrub hunyepa gsang ba dag dang ni/ /85—89

bskul ②ba gsang chab bslab par bya/ /'di rnams thams cad kun bris nas/ /sgrubs ②shig ces ni brjod par bya/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ de bzhin du mtshan ma bzhag nas 'di zhes brjod do/ /ci ste dkyil 'khor ma mthong na/ /phyag rgya shes par bstan na ④ni//rdo rje rin chen rgyal ba dang / /sna tshogs pas khyod gsod ⑤par 'gyur/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur gyi spyan sngar phyag rgya'i las bslab bo/ /de la phyag rgya bcings pa ni 'di'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba kun byas la / /sor mo thams cad dgug bya ste/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje khu tshur phyag rgya bcing / /de nas lag pa'i phyag rgya bcing ngo / /de lta bur mi ldan na 'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog bsgrub ⑥pas ni dam tshig chen po yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snying po thang cig bzlas pas phyag rgya thams cad bcing bar bya ste/thams cad kyi ni ma yin no/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur gyi sgrub ⑦pa 'byung ste/ 'o ma 'thung byazhing rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi phyag (khenargya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na/ sngar bsnyen pa 0byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ras la bri bar bya ste/ ras la bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa rdo rje khu tshur rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 7pa bris la phyag gnyis kyis 8rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i dar gyis hunyebacings la/ de'i thad 'khor thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang phyag gnyis ka de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje khu tshur du bcing bar ④bya'o/ /byang chub 85—90

sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin du snyoms par zhugs par bya'ol/ /de nas de'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur bcings la stong phrag brgya bzlas pa'i mjug ༅tu zhag bdun sgyungs ②nas bdag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur bsgoms dul/ mtshan thal byung du bzlas so/ /de nas nam phyed nas bdud kyi las sna tshogs snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'di brjod cig④ /oṃ badzra muṣṭi (9ha na ha na sarba mā ra ṇa yiphaṭa/ de nas nang par gyi dus na bcom ldan 'das thams cad byon te lus kun tu 'jug go / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /yang ras kyi cho ga 'byung ste/ ras la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bris te/ de'i g.yas (7༄su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sku mdog sngo bsangs utpa la sngon po lta bu rdo rje khu tshur gyi (kyephyag rgya stigayon pa'i khu tshur gyis rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa ste/ de'i g.yas su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje'i dam tshig gi khu tshur can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gzhon nu ma dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 0rdo rje dam du 'tshir hunyeb mdog dmar por 7bya'o/ /de'i thad du rdo rje'i gsal phur ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan hunyepa/ spyan gsum pa lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje gsal phur 8thogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po thor tshugs kyi dbu rgyan can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ padma 8dang mchog tsosbyin gyi phyag tu byas la/de'i g.yon du pad mo chen po'i rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i sde zhes bya ba'o / /de'i g.yon du rdo rje'i dpal mo dang rdo rje 7pho nya ma'om/ /rdo rje nyu)85—91

dpal mo ni gser gyi sku mdog go/ /dpal gyi gzugs 'chang ba phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo ni ①mdog sngon mo la rdo rje 'khar ②ba 'chang ba'o /de nas zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas stong phrag brgya ②bzlas na/ gzugs kyi ras de las phaṭa ces bya ba thos na④/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur te / de phyin cad ⑤nam mkha'i dkyil na spyod cing 'dod na ⑥mi snang bar yang ⑦'gyurani / dpag tshad stong du phar yang 'gro zhing gyen du yang 'gro'o⑨/ /ci 'dod pa'i gzugs su 'gyur ro⑩/ /kun tu 'khyil pas 'khyil pa'i skra can lo bcu drug lon pa'i lus su gyur nas/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la ci 'dod pa bzhin longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings pas sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa dang / chad pas gcad 7pa la sogs pa thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs bzang po bskal par gnas shing /rga 8ba dang shi bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /yang cho ga gzhan te ras la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bris la/ de'i g.yas phyogs su phyag na rdo rje rgyan thams cad kyis 3nyebargyan pa 0sku mdog utpa la sngon po'i kha dog phyag na rdo rje dang bcas pas rdo rje khu tshur bcings te sbyar la bcom ldan 'das la 'dud par bya/de'i g.yon phyogs su bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig gi khu tshur rgyan thams cad kyis hunyebargyan pa yid tsam 'dud 6nyapas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba/lag pa g.yas pa na a mra'i 'bras bu 'bul ba/ g.yon pa na rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje 'dzin to/ /de nas ras la bris pa'i spyan sngar zhag gsum sgyungs thal/gu gul gyi ril bu sran ma tsam du ru ska'i hunye'abru mar la bsnyugs pa ⑩brgyad stong du 85—92

ba med pa'i mdag ma la bsreg tshigo/ /de nas gzugs de 'gul te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od zer 'byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur gyis ②mchog stsol ba ni rgyal po'am/ 'khor lo bskor ba'am/ lha ma yin pa dbang ba'am/ sa brjod pa'am/ sa'i 'og brjod ①pa'am/ khams brjod pa'am / 'dod pa'i khams mi snang ba'am/ nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /yang bsgrub ④pa gzhan gyi cho ga ste/ ras la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khu tshur rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bris la/ de bzhin du rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis ⑤do rje khu tshur bcings pa utpa la sngon po'i mdog tu byas la de'i spyan sngar dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur bcings te/ stong phrag brgya bzlas pa'i mjug nyin mtshan gsum thal byung bzlas na/ nam phyed nas bcom ldan 'das nyid byon te mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /ras sam shing leb bam/ rtsig 6)ngos la bcom ldan 'das ma cigerdo rje khu tshur de bzhin du rdo rje dang a mra'i 'bras bu thogs par byas te/ de'i spyan sngar stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ phyag rgya thams cad bcings pa tsam gyis las thams cad gdon mi za bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma bsgrubs (depa'i las rnams 'byung ste/ rdo rje dam tshig gi khu tshur bcings nas 'bum bzlas na/ khu tshur bcings pas nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bcings na/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzugs 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni 'bum bzlas pas so/ /lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur bcings te stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ khu tshur bcings pa des mi snang bar 'gyur te/ phral na snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje bcings pa'i skyukhu tshur byas la 'bum bzlas na/ khu tshur bcangs ⑩pas bcing ba dang /85—93

rengs par bya ba dang / gnyid log par bya ba thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la rdo rje khu tshur bcangs ①te 'bum bzlas na/ rdo rje khu tshur byabs ②pa tsam gyis nam mkha' la nor dang / gser dang / mu tig dang / rgyan dang ske/ rin po che dang / gos dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / me dang ske/ chu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / myu gu dang / yi ge dang /'thab cha dang / ston skyobs dang / mtshon cha dang / glegs bam dang /rtog pa dang / mdo sde dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku la sogs pa dngos po gnas pa dang ske/ 'gro ba ci 'dod pa dgug par byed do/ /g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur bcangs dul 'bum bzlas na/ rdo rje khu tshur bstan pas duganas pa dang /'gro ba thams cad dgug pa dang / 'dren pa dang 'gyel bar nus par 'gyur rol/ /khu tshur sgyur ⑤bas thams cad gtan sti'apho nus par 'gyur ro/ /g.yas pas rdo rje khu tshur bcings la stong phrag brgya bzlas na/ rdo rje khu tshur byabs ⑦pas thams cad las nor dang / gser dang / rgyan dang / gos dang /mtshon cha dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa dngos po thams cad 'gugs sodu/ /gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya las dam pa thams cad kyang 'gugs sodhi/ /bud med kyi nu ma dang / mngal phyogs dang / mig dang / sna dang / mchu dang / rna ba dang / mgo dang /brla dang / ska rags dang / gsang spu la sogs pa dngos po thams cad kyang 'gugs so/ /bkrol 7na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin zhag gcig smyungs skyel lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs 8te stong phrag brgya bzlas na0/ de phyin cad ④khu tshur bcangs 8pas las thams cad byed do/ /de la las rnams ni dgug pa 85—94

dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / rengs par bya ba dang / rmugs par bya ba dang / rgyas gdab pa dang / gnyid log pa dang ske/ bslang ba dang / drang ba dang / bskyel ①ba dang / brdabs pa dang /bskrad ②pa dang / dbye ba dang / go bzlog pa dang / gtan 'pho ba dang /gso ba dang / sgyu ma thams cad bstan pa dang / dus tshigs bsgyur ba dang /sa la sogs pa g.yo ba dang ②/ thams cad la dbab pa dang / dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / gar byed pa dang / glu len pa dang / sngon ma byung ba'i sbyor ba dang / so sor lung ston pa dang / 'khrul 'khor thams cad gzhom pa dang —/ sgo thams cad dbye ba dang / gdon thams cad 'jug pa dang / dug thams cad bslang ba dang ④/ ma rungs par bya ba dang / thams cad spo ba dang lge/ thams cad kyi phyag rgya gzhom pa dang / thams cad 'gegs ⑥pa dang /gas ⑦pa sbyar ba dang / sbrul bskrad pa dang / gzung ⑧ba dang / gtang yorab dang ske/ ser ba dang / char dbab pa dang / glog ⑩dbyung ba dang / thams cad slar gcad 7pa dang / sngan /nyachad med pa'i gos dang / rgyan dang /rin po che dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang ske/ bya dang ri dgas tsodagug pa dang / gtong ba dang / gzugs mang po ston pa dang / mi snang ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba bstan ④pa la sogs pa 'dod pa bzhin las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje khu tshur gyi rtog pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa byang chub 85—95

sems dpas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ①kyang rang gi snying po 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa 'dir stsal bar bgyi ste/ gang brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzod brjod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nubasmros shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas smras pa/ a ra pa tsa na/ de nas 'di brjod ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid las yi ge mnyam pa nyid sems can thams cad kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i grub pa thob par 'gyur ba bshad do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'byung ①ste/ 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yar gyi ngo tshes bcu bzhi'am bco (gelnga la bris te/ de'i dbus kyi lte bar 'jam dpal bzhugs par bya'o/ /rdo rje ral gri dang glegs bam thogs par byas la/ de'i thad 'khor thams cad du yi ge a ra pa tsa na la sogs pa'i phreng ba bri bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje ral gri dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la zhugs te/ nispyi pas ⑤gra zhes bya ba'i yi ge 'di lnga gyebarjod do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis slob dpon la thogs pa med pa'i spobs ⑦pa yang stsol te/ de phyin cad (0bcom ldan 'das kyis nam mkha' la yi ger bris te thams cad gsung ngo / /de bzhin du slob ma bcug ste④/ 'di zhes smos shig /deng khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos thob par 'gyur gyisapho )/ /snying po 'di khyod kyis su la yang ma smra shiganyunya /de la gsang ba'i yi 8ge 'di rnams sol/ /a ra pa tsa na zhes bya ba ste/ 'dod pa thams cad thob bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ a zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'o3ge/ /ra zhes bya ba ni chags pa'o/ /pa 85—96

zhes bya ba ni don dam pa'o/ /tsa zhes bya ba ni spyod pa'o/ /na zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin med pa'o/ /de ltar 'dod pa dang / chags pa dang / don dam pa dang ske/ spyod pa dang / rang bzhin med pa nyid kyi snying po 'di bsgoms te bsgrubs na / 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni 'dod pa thams cad kyi snod yin te de bas na snying po 'dis ①de bzhin gshegs pa dang /rdo rje 'dzin kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing ba ②bslab bo / /spros pa med pa'i mchog ces bya'o/ /de nas ral gri'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ de bzhin du rdo rje dkyil 'khor bris la de'i dbus su ral gri bzhag ste / mdun du snying po 'di bsgrubs na/ des 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa bsgrubs par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje ral gri'i dkyil 'khor ro/ — /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ni dkyil 'khor chen po (getshul bzhin du bris la zhugs nas 'di zhes brjod do/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tsā bya/ ārya ⑤ nutpanda tāta(6)/ a zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi sgo ste/ thog ma nas ma (7)skyes pa'i phyir ro zhes nang par langs nas nyin re lan re brjod na/ mtshams med pa thams cad kyis mi gos sol/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas mchod pa rnam pa ⑧bzhis mchod pa ni 'dri nyu)ba dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /sgom ⑩pas so/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bsgrub par pho/'dod pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ras la bris nas/ yi ge phreng ba thams cad brjod de 'di skad du chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyi bsgrub pho pa'o zhes kyang brjod nas yi ge 'di 'bum bzlas na/ spobs pa mi zad par 'jam dpal dang mtshungs 85—97

pa dang / nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma bsgrubs kyang las su 'gyur ba ni/ lan gcig ①bzlas pas sdug bsngal thams cad las grol lo/ /gnyis bzlas pas mtshams mede pa thams cad lhag ma ma lus par zad par ②'gyur ro/ /gsum bzlas pas ting nge 'dzin mngon du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi bzlas pas dran pa dang ldan par 'armer ro/ /lnga bzlas pas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la/ yi ge phreng ba g.yas phyogs nas a zhes bya ba'i drung du na zhes bya ba phyin gyi bar du bri'o/ /de nas bskor zhing yi ge 'bum bzlas te/ yi ge re re 'bum rdzogs na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dang /'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje cig char 'grub ste/ nyin re zhing mthong bar bstan nas/ chos bshad de slar gshegs so/ /tshe 'di nyid las sangs rgyas pa man chad kyang stsol to/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rtog pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan /das la rdo rje 'khor lo byang chub sems dpas ②'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ④kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir snying po 'di stsal bar bgyi ste / gang brjod pa tsam gyis phyedakyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥rdo rje 'khor lo byang chub sems dpa' la bskul lo / /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo byang chub sems dpas ⑦bcom ldan 'das la rang gi snying po phul ba/ oṃ badzra tsakra hūṃ/ de nas 'di brjod pa tsam gyis ⑧de 85—98

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor de nyid du zhugs so/ /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo byang chub sems dpas dkyil 'khor 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bzhin bris la/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bdag che ba/ /rang gi lag na phyag rgya thogs/ /de yi dbus su gzhag par bya/ /de yi thad 'khor thams cad du/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams bri/ /de yang sems can chen po rnams/ /de dag nyid ni legs par bri//de nas blo ldan thog ma ru/ /rdo rje 'khor los 'jug par bya/ /zhugs nas snying po 'di bzlas so/ /dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ.a/ zhes brjod na/ des bcom ldan 'das dgyes te/ grub pa thams cad du stsol to/ /de bzhin du slob ma bcug nas de nyid du bsgrub par bya'o/ /rdo rje ②'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na / de bzhin gshegs pa'am rdo rje 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje 'khor lo zhes bya'o①/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i dbus su rdo rje bri ④ste/ de bzhin du bzlas na rdo rje 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin du bris nas mtshan ma bzhag ste 'di zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje 'khor lo 'jug pa yis / /mthong dang de bzhin bsgrubs rgyan ni/ /rtog pa thams cad 'grub par rodu / /de bas brtags dzinate bsgrub par bya/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor bris pa de nyid du/ /phyag rgya shes pa bsgrub lapa'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus brtan ⑨pas thams cad kyi/ /bla med pas ni bslab 7par bya/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa tsam gyis ma bsgrubs nyunyepar las thams cad 8byed de0/ ji ltar dga' ba'i cho ga'am rtog pa las bshad pa sgrubs ④shig /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal 85wa 99

po las rdo rje 'khor lo'i rtog pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la nam mkha'i mdzod ①byang chub sems dpas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir ②rang gi snying po stsal bar bgyi ste/ snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mchod pa thams cad kyi gnas su 'gyur (kyeba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lismyos shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyis gsungs pa/ oṃ ga ga na si bha ba badzra bā tsa eho/ de nas de'i dus na ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦dkyil 'khor thams cad la nam mkha' las mchod pa kun 'byung bar byas so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ rdo rje 'khor lo bzhin du bri/ /de yi dbus su nor chen te/ /nam mkha' dang por bzhugs par bya/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bskor ba'o⑧/ /dang por slob dpon 'jug pa ni/ /mchod pa kun mchog phyag rgyas so/ /dkyil 'khor de ru zhugs (penas ni/ /rdo rje thams cad brjod par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'grub ste / de bzhin du slob ma yang bcug nas rdo rje thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po 'di brjod la phyag rgya yang slobs shig /mchod pa thams cad ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor te/ yid kyis ⑩dkyil 'khor bris la der zhugs shiganyurje /zhugs nas 'di skad rjod lhonyecig /'di dag thams cad ni nam mkha' nyid de bden pa gang gis nam mkha' nyusnyegazugs med pa las gzugs 'byung ba des na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang /yid la 'dod pa'i grub pa thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ④bar gyur cig ces 85—100

byas nas 'dug ste/ rdo rje kun gyi phyag rgya bcings nas 'bum bzlas na/ de nas nam mkha' las mchod pa'i rnam pa thams cad dang / don thams cad dang ske/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas btsud ①de 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig go zhes rjod ②cig /'byung ba kun las nam mkha' ni/ /'byung ba chen po lnga pa'o / /nam mkha' la ni 'dod pa 'byung / /'dod pa'i mchod pa grub gyur cig /ces smras nas(sne// 'dis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cig ces bsgo shig④ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /slob ma nam mkha' la yid kyis dkyil 'khor 'drir (gebacug la/ der slob ma yid kyis mchod pa yang slobs shig /yid kyis 'di skad rjod (pecig /nam mkha'i mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod do zhes nyin re zhing byas na 'grub bo / /'jig rten gsum las rnam par (gergyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las nam mkha' mdzod kyi rtog pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'phags pa byams pa byang chub sems dpas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po stsal tsho ribar bgyi ste/ gang brjod pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad byams pa'i sems skye bar ⑨'gyur ba'o shwe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu smos shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byams pa byang chub sems dpas 11rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ mi rsha tri dṛ 512nye tsi te botiṣṭha ho/ /de nas 'di 85—101

brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te bzhugs so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bris pa der byams pa bzhag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang byang chub sems dpa' bzhi bya ①ste/ go cha brtan ②pa'i phyag rgyas ②zhugs la 'di zhes brjod do/ /badzra dṛ ④nye ⑤tiṣṭha/ de nas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas slob ma de bzhin du dkyil 'khor chen po thams cad du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis btsud do/ /btsud nas byams pa chen po'i phyag rgya bslab ste / de nas go chas bskon no/ /brtan ⑥pa chen po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor rol/ /de nas byams pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ byams pas zhugs la byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgrubs shig /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor du bcug la 'di zhes brjod do/ /rangs sam yang na khros kyang rung / /mdza' dang (7snang ba de bzhin te/ /'gro las gal te rgyal 'dod na/ /byams pa chen po bsgom (kyepar gyis/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas dkyil ⑨'khor du btsud la 'di bslab ⑩bo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad dge bar gyur cig /'byung po thams cad la ⑩byams pa dang ske/ byol song thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin no/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro / /byams pa bsgoms pas grub pa thams cad ci 'dod pa'i sgrub pas bsgrub 'bo/ /las rnams kyang yid kyis ci dad 0pa'i cho ga dang byams pas sgrubs skoshig /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las byams pa'i rtog pa'o// //85—102

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la rdo rje rig pa'i dam pa (3)la sogs pas mgo bos ②phyag 'tshal ①te/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po phul ba/ oṃ drilnga/ oṃ bhinda badzra shu 5)la/oṃ sbyin dha (7rgyu tsakra phaṭa/ oṃ snar bhu ⑦ba swaḥ6)swā hā/ oṃ ha na bhinda (9 badzra hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ la la la la a bhi ṣa magha 4gleṭan/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor zlum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwa'i 572srad bu'i dbus su dbang phyug chen po bri/ der gzhan dag kyang rim gyis thams cad du 32bri ba'am/bzhag pa'am mthar ni tshon ④gyi thig le yang gzhag go/ /de nas thog mar slob dpon gyis gsal phur gsum pa'i rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings la 'dug go/ /g.yon logs nas rdo rje'i slob ma yang bcug ste/ de nas phyag rgya yang bslab bo//de phyin cad 8thams cad 'grub cing 'jig rten thams cad kyi rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rig pa'i blon po chen po'i rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'khyil pa la sogs pa rdo rje khro bos 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po phul ba/ oṃ a mṛ 4ta kuṇḍa ⑩li kha kha kha kha kro dha dzā /tshoste' mā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā thā hu)ba sbo ṭa ya rgyu phaṭa / oṃ tsu )kā la daṇḍa beha na ha na rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la pra shā gra ā ku 5rnyes phaṭa/de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bris la de'i rnalhadabus su rdo rje gzhag go/ /phyogs bzhir ni khro bo rnams de bzhin du bar bcad du khudu byas la 'god ( shedo/ /de nas slob dpon bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgyar 85—103

zhugs hu)nas phyag rgya bcing dun ba bslab bo/ /de nas thams cad dgug pa dang /dbang du bya ba dang / gtan 'pho ba dang srung ba 'grub bo / /rdo rje khro bo'i rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje srin po la sogs pa tshogs kyi gtso bos snying po 'di rnams phul lo / /oṃ ma hā bā lā ka ma hā ga ṇa dugede bi ba pi ba ru hrīḥgeran sarba duṣṭa (6)na nā phaṭa / oṃ mā rtsoda' dha ra tsa la tsa la ya hūm̐/ oṃ dha nur dha ra ba shī (8༄ku ru sarba sad (9༄tā skyon swā hā/ oṃ dza ya bi dza hu ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/gzhu lta bur dkyil 'khor bris la der rdo rje gzhag go/ /g.yas su'ang gnyis g.yon du'ang gnyis so/ /de nas rdo rje srin po'i 8phyag rgyas btsud de/ de nas phyag rgya bslabs 32nas cho ga bslab bopa ni/ gang dge ba dang drin gzo dang / / lha yi tso'akhor mthong ma gtogs paratshe/ /gzhan rnams de dag thams cad kunal/ /mi dge ba rnams gtan 'phor bya/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las tshogs kyi gtso bo'i 1 rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje gtun shing la sogs pa'i pho nyas rang gi snying po smras pa/ oṃ lī ga lī hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā pa ta rghaṃ/ oṃ badzra dzā lā 43ya swā hā/ oṃ bi ka ṭa smyo/—69 ra ba de cinyi me sarban 214 phaṭa/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba ni shing rta dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor bris te/ dbus su rdo rje gzhag nas rdo rje gtun shing gi gephyag rgyas bcug la las 'di bslab bo/ /mi dge ba'i sems can thams cad 'thung 42shig /phrogs shig /sregs nasteshig /zo shigs /de nas 85wa 104

phyag rgya bcing 3)ba bslab bo/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las pho nya'i tshogs kyi rtog pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la rdo rje kyo ba tang la sogs pa bran rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par (na rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo//oṃ bā rā ha rda thoska ṭa tshoXbi ga to dha ra sarban kha na kha na rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ sarba mā ra da ḍa ④rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ gi (bka tai ka rda sbyi 56༄ nyin dha (7rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ma ṇi ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'di'o/ /gru (8)gsum par bris la mngon sum (9)pa'i phyag rgyas zhugs nas gar gyi phyag rgya bcing ba bslab ste/ gar gyi mchod pas ni dbus kyi rdo rje la mchod do/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las bran gyi rtog pa'o// //de nas ma mthams cad kyis ku co'i sgra bton tem/ gar gyi nyu mchod pa chen pos bcom ldan 'das la mchod nas rang rang gi snying po phul lo/ /de nas rdo rje'i blon mo cho12chen mo dag gis smras pa/ oṃ badzra gro dha ra li rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsakra tshin dha tso phaṭa/ oṃ shān ti hūm̐/ oṃ badzra musbyi ha na shin dha ha man rtsu phaṭa/oṃ ku mā tsor ha bi ṣa 1)lha ṇa ti ke 18ra ṇa ra ṇa /6tsa lā 3 )ya sarba dugle 1na rgyu phaṭa/de nas de dag gi 32dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa de'i sgor 'khor lo ( /la sogs pa 2 )bri'o / /de'i dbus su rdo rje khro mo'i me lag na rdo rje'i gsal phur 25can bzhag go / /dam tshig gi cho ga ni de bzhin no/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par 85—105

rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo rnams kyi rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje khro mo rnams kyis stirang gi snying po smras pa/ oṃ a mṛ ②te hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ sau mya kro dhe rtsu phaṭaḥdu/ oṃ daṇḍa rgyas ri ṇa ( ha na rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi ⑥ga li hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor zur brgyad pa bris te/ de'i dbus su rdo rje gzhag go/ /cha bzhir bgos pa rnams la bzhi po rim gyis gzhag go/ /'jug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga ni de nyid do/ /'di ni khro mo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las/ rdo rje khro mo rnams kyi rtog pa'o// //de nas tshogs ma mo rnams kyis ⑦smras pa/ oṃ kharga mā ri ṇi ni// oṃ a sha si ba dhe hi ra ma ho/ oṃ pā sha sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ra stim ṇi ra ti pri 0ye ho/de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor ni zlum po ste0/ sgo 8bzhi pa dbus su se ral srad bu byas te thig bzhi btab la rim pa bzhir bri'o/ /gzhan yang phyi'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin du skum por thig bzhi rim du btab la de'i dbus su gnod sbyin gyi gdong bri'o/ /ngos bzhir ni rim gyis te/ shar phyogs nas bri ba'am gzhag par bya'o/ /sgo bzhir rdo rje'i mngag gzhug ⑩ma bri ba'am ④gzhag par bya'o/ /de'i snying po ni 'di'o/ /gi tsi ri ṭi mabhyo bhyo/ /de ltar rig pa'i blon mo chen mo la sogs pa thams cad du gyis shig /'di thang cig bzlas pas thams cad khugs so/ /de nas gdong g.yogs nas lag pa tsoganyis kyis rkang pa'i mthe bong ⑫85wa 106

bzung ste/ phyag 'tshal nas skyil mo krung gi 6)gar byed cing zhugs la dbab bo/ /bcangs ②nas dam tshig byin cig /sarba mā ra khā da pi ba de hi ba ra sa ma ya ho//de nas de bzhin du dam tshig sbyin no/ /glu gar dang / sil snyan dang / zas dang skom gyis thams cad tshim par byas la dril bus phab pa ste/ de nas dngos grub thams cad dang bde ba thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rnyed dunas/ rnal 'byor dang nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa yang thob bo zhes smos shig /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal ④po las rdo rje'i (9tshogs ma mo'i rtog pa'o// //de nas rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyis smras pa/ oṃ :sti/ oṃ ka li ma rā ni⑦/badzra rākṣa dusi ha na sarba na ṭī ma/ oṃ bu tha ṇi tha/ oṃ ma hā ka ra bā gne po)/ phaṭa/dkyil 'khor grwa lnga ⑩par bris te/ rdo rje ni blagrwa'i (gyedabus su gzhag go/ /bzhir 0ni rdo rje 8lo nya mo bzhag ste de cho ga de 8bzhin du bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje pho nya mo'i rtog pa'o // //de nas rdo rje bran mo rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/ oṃ bā rā nyi 7badzra mu khi nyunyedri tai ta rā pa ta la sa ma nyusteya ma nu sma ra ā bi sha zhu )rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kā li kā pā li mā la dhā ri tsā 0ka ṭa ka ṭa ma ṭa ma ṭa bhi mā ra 3)ya sarba mā ra ṇi 0rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pu ta ni u tsusma ru dā khā da busarban ( nyesho ṣa ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ka ra mu khi 69ha ra ha ra hūm̐/dkyil 'khor gru zhu)bzhi la sgo bzhir ( 3bris nas/ de'i dbus su rdo rje bris te de 85—107

bzhin gar gyis mchod do/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las bran mo'i rtog pa ste rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs so0ste// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod yin no/ /de bas na rtog pa'i rgyal po 'dir don yod cing myur du grub par bya ba'i phyir gang gis sems can thams cad dngos grub dam pa bde blag tu thob par 'gyur ba'i phyi ma'i rgyud shod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can 'di rnams ni brtson 'grus kyis 'dul te/ dad pa dang mi ldan pa sdig pa byed pa/brdzun smra ba le lo can dka' ba spyad pa mi bzod pa/ 'dod chags dang bral bas 'dul ba/ rtag tu chags pa de dag gi don gyi phyir gang gis sems can de dag bya ba thams cad byed bzhin pa dang / brtson 'grus med pa dang dka' ba spyad pa yang med par bde blag tu tshe 'di nyid la myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba de de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs ( kyis shod cig /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi 'di dag ni yul la mngon par dga' zhing bdag gi grogs po dang / pha dang /ma dang / bu dang / chung ma rnams mthong 'dod cing de yang sred pas 'khol ba ste/ phyogs nas phyogs su yang 'gro mi nus na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang rig 'dzin gyi gnas su lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag na rdo rjes phyag 'tshal (kyete/ phyi ma'i rgyud bshad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga las libyung / phyag na rdo rje ga las skyes/ /rdo rje yang ni ga las byung / /phyag rgya snying po (5)rig pa dang / /sngags rnams 85—108

khyad par ci lho)zhig yod/ /gsang ba sgrub pa ji lta bu/ /phyag rgya bcing rdo ba ji lta bu / /de rnams kyi ni de nyid gang / /byin gyis brlabs (bsogs ji lta bu/ /sgrub 0pa rnams kyang ji ltar mthong / /dngos grub 'dod pa ji lta bu/ /ras la ri mo ji ltar bri/ /sku gzugs tshad ni ji tsam zhig /ji ltar bzlas pa bya bar (5gsungs / /ci 'dra ba (6)ni mchod par bgyi/ /bsod nams med pas ji ltar 'grub / /ji ltar grub pa myur bar 'gyur/ /slob dpon du yang ji ltar 'gyur/ /las rnams bsgrub pa ji ltar (me)bya/ /de dag gi ni de nyid gang / /thams cad bdag la bshad pa'i rigs/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba bstan te/sems dpa' thog ma tha ma med/ /nam mkha' skye ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /kun du bzang po thams cad bdag /'dod pa 'gro ba bdag po yin/ /sems can kun sems gang yin pa/ /brtan pas sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /mnyam par gzhag pas ting nge 'dzin/ /nges par rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /de la smras pa sems gzugs med pa la ji ltar na sra ba'i rdo rjer 'gyur/ smras pa/ ji ltar rnam par shes pa la sems can skye ba na sha dang / rus pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba bzhin te/ sdug pa dang / chags pa dang / bde ba dang / rnam par shes pa gzugs med pa rnams 'dus pa las sems can skye ba dang / ji ltar klu rnams khros pas sems kyi ting nge 'dzin nges pas nam mkha' la gnam lcags 'byung ba'am / glog dang bcas te 58)'byung ba de bzhin du nges pa 57dag las rdo rje nyid du 'gyur te/ sems dpar byin rlabs tshesbyor ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpar yang 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan rdo rje de nyid ni/ /bsgoms pas sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /de la sems dpar 17byin gyis rlob pa'i sbyor ba gang zhe 85wa 109

na / sems dpa' kun gyi bdag che na①/ /bdag nyid la yang gnas so zhes/ /byin gyis brlabs nas sems dpa' bdag /yin zhes nga rgyal bsgom par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sems dpa' ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'am rgyal ba yin/ /rang sems so sor brtags pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub de nyid yin/ /de nyid phyag na rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis so/ /'jig rten dbang po nam mkha' ②snying / /de ltar gzhan yang de nyid do/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyang de nyid de/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang ba'i rigs/ /de nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs / /de nyid nor bu'i rigs yin te/ /khams gsum de nyid yin zhes gsungs / /'jig rten gsum po'ang de nyid do/ /de nyid byed dang 'byin pa po rka/ /sems can kun gyi mes po ste/ /de nyid sems can gnas yin te/ /'byung ba che rnams de nyid do/ /de nyid 'gro ba'i mgon po ste/ /gnas pa dang ni 'gro ba yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de kho na chen po zhes bya ba'i rab ④cu byed pa dang 55)po'o// //de nas snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa'i khyad par gyi bar du bya ba ste/ snying po'i khyad par ni gsang ba dang ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /de la sems can gyi don gyi phyir gsang ba brjod pa dang / smra ba ni snying po brjod pa ste / snying po brjod pas ni yisnying gis bsam pa'i grub pa thob ces bya ba ni snying po'i khyad par ro/ /de nas phyag rgya'i khyad par ni/ /rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs rnams kyi/ /gzugs brnyan sbyor ba 'di dag ni/ /phyag rgya kun gyi khyad par 85—110

te① / /'byung ba yang ni de yis bstan/ /ji ltar jo bo'i rgya mthong na/ /bran rnams 'gal bar mi byed pa/ /de bzhin rgyal ba nyid rnams kyang / /phyag rgya 'da' bar yong mi mdzad/ /rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /ji ltar gnas dang mthun ②byas la/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar ldan pa yi/ /sems dpa' chen por bdag nyid bsgyur/ /de ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /sor bsnol brtan (gyipa dam tshig ste/ /sems kyi shes rab ldan pa las / /gnyis phye las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /de dag dam tshig rtsa ba ste/ /rtsa byung bcing ba rgyu yi mchog /gang gis thams cad lus brtan 'gyur/ /de phyir phyag rgya brjod pa yin/ /gang gis thams cad rgyas btab pa/ /chud mi za zhing rab sbas te④/ /mnga' bdag gzugs brnyan (she'achang bas na/ /sgrub pa po rnams myur du 'grub/ /gang dag mthong na sangs rgyas dang / /sems dpa' la sogs mthong bar 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams pas gzir bas na/ /'da' bar mi 'gyur 'grub (6rapar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya'i khyad par de 9)yin te/ don dam pa'i de kho na nyid kyang phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /de la sngags kyi khyad par ni 'di yin te/ ngag tsam spros pa med pa ste/ /sangs rgyas bka' yis grub pa nyid/ /chos kyi tshig gis dubaskul ba ste/ /de dag sngags zhes ⑨bya ba yin/ /de la rig pa'i khyad par ni 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa ni med par byed/ /rig pa de bzhin chud par byed / /don rnams rtogs par gyur pas na/ /rig pa zhes ni de phyir bya/snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa'i rab tu bya ba gnyis pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya bcing ba'i tsherab tu bya ba bshad do zhes bcom ldan 'das bla 85—111

na med pa'i phyag rgya thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la phyag rgya chen po ni de nyid bskul ba'i snying pos bcing ngo / /dam tshig dang las kyi hunyephyag rgya ni rdo rje bcing ba dang brdab pa la sogs pa byas nas bcing ngo / /dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid bskul ba'i snying pos phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa phyag rgya thams cad bcing ngo / /de yang ma chags pa dang slob ma ma yin pa dang /snod ma yin pa dang / dad pa med pa la mi sbyin no/ /yun du sbyangs na de dag kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de la de kho na nyid bskul ba'i snying po 'di'o/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ/ de la dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid bskul ba'i snying po ni 'di yin no / /sa ma ya ho su ra ta yin sdi/ rdo rje khro bos phyag rgya thams cad rang gis (babacing ngam/ gzhan 'ching 94༄du gzhug na ni rtsu zhes bya ba thang 75)cig tsam gyis sol/ /de nas rdo rje bcing ba la sogs pa bcing ba 'byung ste/ badzra ban dha zhes brjod la rdo rje bcing ba snying gar 56chings shig /de nas snying po 'dis sor mo thams cad brdab par bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ban dha ṭā btsor/ 'dis ni phyag rgya thams cad dgug cing dbang du byed do/ /de nas rdo rje ye shes dbab pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ngo / /badzra ā 8be sha zhes brjod la/ snying po 'dis rdo rje dbab pa bskyed par bya'o/ /aḥ9 thams cad dbab pa'i snying po 'di ni gdon mi za ba'o/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba ni badzra muṣṭi zhes brjod 1 )la bcing ngo / /de ste de ltar ma byas na nyu1yang sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes brjod 1gel phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa rigs thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'ol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang / sems kyi phyag rgya thams cad kyi snying po don yod pa 'da' 512bar bya ba ma yin pa ste/ stong 85—112

bzlas pas phyag rgya bcing 51)ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya lan cig (pebazlas na/ grub pa thams cad la gces ((par 'gyur ro//de nas phyag rgya bcing ba 'byung ste/ thal mo sbyar la sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba ni rdo rje'i thal mo'o/ /de nyid sor mo'i ④bar rnams su shin tu bsdams pa ni rdo rje bcing ba'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo gnyis nang du bcug ste/ mthe'u chung dang srin lag gi bar du rab tu bcug (snyel btsum pa 'di ni rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo gnyis gshibs stil nang du bcug tsho la de bzhin du mthe'u chung dang srin lag gi bar du btsugs zhu)te/ mdzub nyu)mo shin tu bkug pa ni rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gnyis su byas pa ni las kyi phyag rgya gzhan du 'gyur te/ dam tshig chen po de kho na nyid lan cig 'ibarjod la snying ga'amanyu7/ nam mkha' la so sor bcing ngo / /ngag gi phyag rgya yang badzra dzi hwa 3 zhes brjod la phyag rgya bcing 51lhango / /lta ba'i phyag rgya ni snying po'i don gyis bcing ngo / /skoso'i phyag rgya dang mchu'i phyag rgya dang mig bsgul ba'i phyag rgya dang / snying dang lus g.yo ba'i phyag rgya ni sa ma ya tshe: zhes brjod na bcing ba grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ zhes pa'i rilaphyag rgya bcing ba 'byung ste/ rdo rje hu 7khro bo'i mdzub nyunyeme ni rdo rje khu tshur du byas la mdzub mo brkyang 19na rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba yin no/ /rdo rje khro bo'i mdzub tsho )mo gnyis/ /lag ngar bsnol 37te bcings nas kyang / /mthe'u ri gechung lcags kyu sbrel byas la/ /rtsu zhes pas 0ni bsdigs ༷ stepar bya/ /de nyid g.yas pa kyo du geb tang du byas pa ni/ rdo rje khro bo'i du 9kyo zhu tshob tang ngo / /de la 'di ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag mthil dag ri shetu rdo rje bcing / mthe bo gshibs tsho —6pas bkab pa yis dī/ /khu tshur 85wa 113

byas pa dam tshig gi/ /phyag rgya rdo rje khro bo ste/ /ti rin ①te ri zhes bya'o/ /rgyu ni ngag gi phyag rgya'o/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni thams cad gsod ②pa'i khro bo'o/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi ②bcing ba ni rdo rje bcing ba sa ④la brkyang ste bzhag pa 'dis rdo rje'i sa gzhir (snye'agyur te/ de la sus kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje 'dod pa'i khro bo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba bcings la mdzub yimo rdo rje ltar byas pa ni thams cad la dbang byed pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig rdo rje bcings la mdzub (7mo gnyis mnyam par gshibs ⑧pas snying gar gtugs ⑨shig /gal te de las 'da' bar byas na snying gas te 'chi'o/ /rdo rje'i ⑩phyag rgya gnyis bcings la/ /mdzub 3lhamo kyo ba tang du bcing / /dkri zhing phyir dkri byas pa ni/ /lha rnams dgug pa'i mchog yin no/ /rdo rje bcing ba tsobartan byas la/ /mdzub nyi mo bkug pa shin tu btsir/ /mthe bo tsoganyis ka gshibs pa yis / /dbus su btsir ba bar 8snang gi/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs tsol/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ka sbrel nas su/ /mdzub 7mo yi ni rgyab sbyar te/ /bzlog pa nam mkhar (12rgyu rnams kyi'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba brtan byas nas/ /khu tshur gyis ni sa mnan pa/ /'di ni sa pa'i dam tshig steskye/ /thams cad byed pa ru )'da' bar dka'/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings (nyate/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mos mdzub ri 42mo btsir/ /mthe'u zhunyechung sor mo mnyam brdab pa/ /'di ni 'og ma rnams dgug pa'o/ /mdzub 3stemo gnyis ka brtan po 'aru/ /rdo rje bcings pa gyusprel bar bya/ /gung mo mthe bo tsho nardo rjer bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'joms pa'o / /rdo rje dkri ( snyeb dang / rdo rje btsir ba dang / rdo rje ( —)phreng ba dang /rdo rje sa dang / rdo rje sa'i 'og dang / rdo rje he ru /'ozhu )/ /de la rdo rje shugs 85wa 114

kyi phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni byed pa na/ /srad bu'am yang na ri mo la/ /'jug pa dang ni 'byung ba na①/ /bsgrub ②pas yid kyis bteg (minas so / /de la ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i snying po ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra be ④ga hūm̐/ 'dis ni dam tshig ma ⑤nyams par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du dam tshig nyams pas 97grub pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /dpung pa gnyis rdo rje bcings te/ rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis su byas la pus ⑦mo btsugs (8)te mgo bo sa la btsugs te phyag bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje la ni ⑨de nyid kyis bodad pa'i stobs kyis gnas par byas la/ 'dzum zhing bskyod ༅pa dang / smin nyunye ma 'gyed 〉snyepa dang bcas pa'i mig gis phyag btsal rshalo / /gzhan rnams la ni pus tshemo btsugs pa'o/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba ni 'di yin te/ lag pa gnyis kyi rgyab sbyar nas mthe bo 7mthe'u chung sbrel bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya 'di sangs rgyas thams cad dbang du byed/ pra tītstsha nyurtebadzra/ snying po 'dis me tog gtor ro/ /rdo rje kyo ba tang gi phyag rgya ni rdo rje 'dzin ma'i mdzub nyunyemo gnyis yikyo ba tang gi tshul du bya'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa dang / sems can thams cad dgug hu rtepa'i dam tshig 'da' bar mi bya ba ste/ dam tshig lcags kyu yin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rtog pa'i phyag rgya bcing ba 'byung ste/rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis bcings sa1nas/ /g.yas pas bsdam zhu par bya ba ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i mdzub tsa)mo g.yon/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog bsam pa'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /mthe bo dgeganyis ku'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub bumo gnyis ka dgug par bya/ /rdo rje thal mo 85—115

'od dkyil 'khor/ /gung mo gnyis ka kha 'byed pa/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i phyag rgya ste༅/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgug pa dang / gzhug lapa dang / dbang du bya ba las/ 'da' bar mi 'gyur zhing / 'di mthong bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mthong bar 'gyur ro(5)/ /de nas badzra bid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste/ sems ni rnam dag shes bya ba/ /brtan pas sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /mnyam par gzhag pas ting nge 'dzin/ /nges pas rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo'i ④bdag nyid de / /sems nyid sangs rgyas nyid yin no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas/de ske/ /nges par sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po bcings nas de bsgom (6)mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rang gi sems so sor brtags pa la sogs pas 97sangs rgyas su yongs su sbyar bar po)byas nas/ji ltar tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur porate/ de ltar byin gyis rlob par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'ikhu tshur ni las kyi phyag rgya'o / /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya chen po ni hu)'di yin no/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /phyag na rdo rje nyu2bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'gying ba rab byed 1nyecing / /'gying dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor/ /'di yis kun 'gro skad cig gis/ /'od dang gyen du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa kun dbang thams cad pa/ /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba bcings nas kyang / /gung mo nang bcug snying gar bzhag / mthe bo nyu mthe'u chung kha phye 1snyemanyam/ /rdo rje chen po de ltar bcing / /sems dpa' kun gyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /'di ni snying gar bcings pa yis/ /phyag rgya 85—116

kun gyi dngos grub pa/ /dam pa dag kyang thob par 'gyur/ /de la ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /phyag na rdo rje bdag gi lus/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byas la/ /'gying bcas rdo rje gsor byas na/ /'gying zhing gyen du ston tshul gyis/ /snying gar bzung na 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni 'di yin no/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /g.yas ①pa gzhu 'dren sbyor ba dang / /mda' 'phen pa yi tshul gyis su/ /kun la bsnun na chags par bya(gyi/ / de nas (sne/bcom ldan 'das dbang bskur ba'i phreng ba'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i phyag rgya gtsug tor 54du gzhag go/ /de nas phab ste gung mo rdo rjer byas te/de las bskor te (degung mo nor bur byas la/ g.yas phyogs su gzhag go/ /ltag 96rapar gung mo'i rdo rje'i padmo gzhag go/ /de las bskor te 35gung mo dang mthe'u chung gyes par byas la g.yon du gzhag go/ /de nas mdzub 90mo gnyis mdud (9༄pa byas te phreng ba bcing ba'i tshul du ltag par mdud 57pa byas la/ sor mo thams cad mthe'u chung nas mthar gyis 'jig pa'i tshul gyis dgrol ba ni cod pan gyi tshul bzhin dgrol lo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems dpa' bsgrub 11par 'dod pas lha mo'i dkyil 'khor byas te/ de nas nyin gcig cing 12bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs 1 nas/ji lta bu'i dus su ci nus pas ci 'dod pa bde bar byas la/ phyag rgya chen po'i tshul gyi 0glu dbyangs kyis 51gerdo rje'i tshig tu rdo rje sems dpa' bzlas te snying po 'di ci 'dod pas bzlas so/ /oṃ ma hā su kha 19badzra satwa dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥhu su ra ta 85wa 117
