stim/ de ltar zla ba 6)gcig bzlas te bsgrub ②bo/ /zla ba gcig dulon pa'i mjug tu tshes bco lilnga la ngal na phyag rgya bkrol la⑤/ rdo rje'i thal mo brkyang nas lus thams cad kyis ༅phyag bya'o/ /cung zad gnas nas ji ltar ngal bar mi 'gyur bar byas te/ de ltar mtshan rangs par bzlas na/ de'i nang par bcom ldan 'das zla ba'i kha dog zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa'i 'od can byon te/ sgrub pa po la ⑦'khyud (nyenas de'i lus kun tu zhugs so/ /de nas sgrub pa po yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'i 'od can dang / zla ba'i 'od can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng ⑨ba la sogs pa dang / lha'i rgyan thams cad kyis 7brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi lus dang / ngag dang / sems rdo rje thams cad dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi rigs dang / gnyen dang ske/ grogs po dang / gnyen bshes la sogs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis gzugs bzang po mthong na yang 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro⑩/ /lta bar byed do/ /mchod par byed do/ /sten par byed do/ /don thams cad byed do/ /de yang rang gi khyim de nyid na gnas /tsho bzhin du lha'i 0cho 'phrul byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs par yang gyur nas rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul thams cad byed do/ /rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis kyang 'dul bar byed do/ /sems can de dag gis kyang mthong ngo / /ma btul ba rnams kyang 'dul lo/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs su 'gyur ba dang / thams cad du 'gro ba dang /phyir 'ong ba dang / gyen du 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byas nas phyir 'ong ba'i bar du'o/ /don thams cad la longs spyod pa dang / 'dod pa thams 85—118

cad la dbang ba dang / 'dod pa thams cad spyod pa'i ①tshe/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje 'dod pa khro (gebo'i phyag rgya bcing ba ①ni rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis (4ribacangs gepa las/ mda' 'phen pa'i tshul gyis me tog gi gzhu 'dren pa ni thams cad dga' bar byed pa yin no/ /rdo rje'i yikhu tshur gnyis kyis snying gar rdo rje rgyu zhes pa ste/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis shi'aphen pas rdo rje 'phangs pas ni thams cad gtan 'pho'o/ /de nas 'di ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs (kyete/ /de ltar kyo ⑨ba mthe'u chung mdzub/ /mdud ⑩nas mthe bo yigashibs pa yis/ /bsdams te snying gar gzhag par bya/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa nges par dgug pa dang gzhug 12pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang 'dren par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyis 'khyud pa ni nyusnyerdo rje dga' ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'byung ste/ rdo rje bcing ba bsdam 8byas nas/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mtheb (7mo mtshan du/ /mthe bo'i rtags ni btsud nas su/ /de bskyod bar du bsdam par bya / /'dis ni bud med thams cad dga' bar byed do/ /rdo rje'i 'ikhu tshur gnyis kyis rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /rdo rje'i phonyergyal mtshan no/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'byung ste/ rdo rje bcing ba bsdam 8byas nas/ /mdzub /tsho mo gnyis ni dgug par bya/ /srin lag gshibs la mthe'u chung bskyedan )/ /de ltar mthe bo zhu /gnyis kyang bskyed snye/ /'di bstan 33pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang byams pa bstan par mdzad na gzhan lta ci smos/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis snyems par byed pa ni rdo rje snyems pa'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'byung 85—119

ste / rdo rje bcing ba ②kun byas nas/ /rtsib logs gnyis su bskor nas su/ /'dzin (kyepas bskyod pas 'dud ②pa ste/ /khro bo thams cad mgu bar byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog bcas dang / /rdo rje gar gyi rab sbyor bas/ /mdor na me tog la sogs pa'i/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa myur du 'grub/ /rtog pa gzhan gyi gsang ba'i mchod pa dang yang sbyar ci)ro/ /de nas rdo rje gar 'byung (geste/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /'dzum pas mtha' nas brtsams te dgrol/ /glog bzhin bsgyur te bskor zhing dgrol/ /'gram pa dang ni gtsug tor bzhag /rdo rje gar zhes bya ba ste/ /bdag che'i mchod pa thams cad do/ /mchod pa 'di ni gsol bas na/ /dngos med nyid kyang myur du 'grub/ /de nas rdo rje gzugs la sogs pa'i phyag ༷7rgya bcing ba ni rdo rje bcing ba brkyang la mthil du blta'o / /rdo rje bcings pas g.yon pa'i mdzub ༅mo ni pi bang ⑤gi shing ngo / /g.yas pa bkug pas ni len te(pe/ brkyang ba'i lag mthil mgyis rang gi snying gar byug go/ /me tog gi thal mo'i tshul gyis 7rdo rje ro btung bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis bcangs (8te/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung ni g.yas pa'i kyo ba tang gis bzung /lhango / /kyo ba tang de g.yas pas sems dpa'i dam tshig thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyang dgug bogo/ /rdo rje bcings la mthe bong mdud 5pa ni zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub nya9mo sbrel ba ni thams cad bcing ngo / /rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgyas ni thams cad 'bebs par byed do/ /de nas go nyu tshocha'i phyag rgya 'byung ste/ khu tshur bcings pa nyusheganyis kyis snying skragar mdud pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /spos nas yang ltag du )par yang de bzhin no/ /spos nas snying gar yang de bzhin no/ /yang bar du 85—120

yang mdud ①do/ /yang spos nas snying ga ②dang ltag sapar yang de bzhin no/ /mgo la yang de bzhin du dbang bskur ba'i gnas su'o/ /phreng ba bcing ba'i mdud ④pa'i tshul gyis (snyemathe'u chung la sogs pa'i sor mo thams cad dgrol ba'i cod pan gyi ༅tshul du bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ padmo zums (7)pa'i thal mo sbyar/ /pad mo chen por grags pa ste/ /mthe'u chung mthe bo (sheganyis 'gyed pa/ /sdig pa rnams ni sel ba'o / /de nyid mdzub 9)mo kyo ba tang du byas pa ni thams cad dgug bopa'o/ /de nas padmo 'byung ste/ rdo rje bcings pa'i mdzub lcamamo gnyis bkug la mthe bo 12mnyam pa'i steng du gung mo gnyis bzhag go/ /de gnyis su byas nas g.yon pa la g.yas pas pad mo 'byed par bya'o/ /de nas pad mo dag gi phyag rgya ni hrīḥhu /ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni pad mo 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri ma (1 tsho sbyong bar 8gsungs pa nyid do/ /de nas nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni nor bu'i khu tshur gnyis gas ri dbang bskur ba'i phreng ba bcing ngo / /de nas rdo rje rin po che'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje nyu bcing ba kun byas nas/ / mdzub mo mnyam 12nas mtheb dang sbyar/ /de dag ngos su sprad hu)pa steso )/ /dbang bskur gnas su dbang sbyin no/ /de nyid kha yar bstan la snying gar bzhag pa ni nor bu'i khu tshur zhes bshad de( lha / don thams cad 'phrog zhu pa'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo'i rdo rjes mdzub 3mo mnyam pa mnan te/ rgyab bskum pa ni rdo rje'i nor bu'o/ /༷bu / chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya thams cad nam mkhar bsgom 'upa'o / /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni de ltar sngar bshad pa nyid do//blo / ngag gi phyag rgya'o/ /byams pa'i bcing ba ni bcing ba'i nang na mchog ste/85—121

ye shes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /mdun du ni rdo rje chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas su ni rdo rje rin po che'i phyag rgya bstan pa nyid do/ /rgyab tu ni rdo rje bcing ba snying gar bkan ①nas mthe bo sbyar te/ mdzub (kyemo gnyis dgug par bya'o/ /rdo rje padma mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i mthe bo chadang mthe'u chung gnyis snying gar brkyang ba ni rdo rje ste/ rdo rje thams cad do④/ /rigs thams cad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ grub pa thams cad 455 ba phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du bri'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni rdo rje khu tshur mdzub ⑤mo'i rtse yimo bkug (7)pa 'di ni ral gri'o/ / snying po nini glegs bam mo/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o / /g.yon pa'i glegs bam bcangs ⑨pa'i mthe'u chung ni g.yas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pas gzung (7ngo / /ā/ chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /chos 'o)thams cad la yi ge med ces bya ba ni ye shes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ rdo rje'i 512khu tshur gnyis bcangs phonyate/ /mthe'u chung mdzub ④mo'i rdo rje'i 8bcing / /rdo rje 'khor lo zhes bshad de⑩/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub pa'olho / /'di mthong bas 1snyedakyil 'khor thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dbus su kha bzhag ste bzlas na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur zhing de bzhin du sgrub tshipar 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ/ chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni rdo rje nor bu'i phyag rgya las mthe'u chung dang srin lag mnyam pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng lho )ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni ṭwāṃ/ 'phags pa byams pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni rdo rje rimago cha'i phyag rgya'o/ /ngag gi phyag rgya ni oṃ/ de nas rtog pa thams cad spyi'i phyag rgya shes pa 'byung ste/ de la lus kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur 85—122

ba ni 'di lta ste/ 'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / rkang pa bsnyams sko11te brkyang ba dang / lag pa bsgreng (kyeb ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /mchog bsgrub pa la rdo rje dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /langs nas ①g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur bcangs ④nas g.yas pa bkug pas drangs pa ⑤ni rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ste/thams cad 'dren pa'i phyag rgya yin no/ /langs la pus mo bskyed 47de bkug nas lag pa stiganyis bsdams te gyen du brkyang ba ni thams cad gtan 'pho ba'i ral gri'o/ /dpung pa gnyis kyis (8rang gi snying gar 'khyud 6nyepa ni go cha ste mi phyed pa'o/ /de nas rang gi phyag rgya bcing ba ni a ho haṃ hūṃ/ dbab pa dang /dbang du bya ba dang / bsrung 7ba dang / gtan 'pho ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas lta ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba ni/ /myur 'gyur rdo rje'i lta ba ste/ /bgrad de btsums 17pa 'dren pa yin/ /khro bo'i lta ba khro gnyer tenyunye/ /brtan par lta ba mi g.yo ba'o / /de nas 'di dag gi las 'byung ba ni rdo rje'i lta bas skye 'gro thams cad mgu bar bya'o/ /bgrad pa'i lta bas ni thams cad dgug pa dang / rims dang ske/ gdon dang / dug dang / byad ma la sogs pa dang / nad thams cad sel to/ /khro bo'i lta bas ni thams cad gtan tuge'apho'o/ /brtan par lta bas ni thams cad bsrung 8ngo / /de la snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa8/ dīpta dṛṣṭi ⑩e ku sha nyunyedza/ oṃ kro dha dṛṣṭi phaṭa/ dzrabha dṛṣṭi nyugelha/so'i phyag rgya 'byung ste/ so bca' bas ni gtan 'pho'o/ /mur bas ni dbang du byed do/ /snying po bzlas shing khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin bzlas te phyag rgya'i las byed do/ /g.yas nas gcu ྅)ba ni dgug 4 )pa'o/ /g.yon nas gcu ( nyeb ni dbang du byed pa'o/ /ma mchu sos mnan pas ni gtan 'pho'o(nya/ /mchu gnyis 85—123

ka bsdams pas ni bsrung 0)ngo / /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rjes su dran pa dang / rdo rje khro bo rjes su dran pa dang / rdo rje rjes su dran pa ②ni thams cad sgrub pa ste mchu'i phyag rgya'o/ /mig g.yas pa bskyod 0pas dbang du byed do/ /mig g.yon pa bskyod pas rjes su chags so/ /gnyis ka btsums ④ pas ni gtan 'pho'o/ /gnyis ka bgrad pas ni srung ⑤ngo / /thams cad kyi snying po bzlas te gyen du bltas 96)na nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /thur lnga)du bltas na sa'i dbang por 'gyur ro/ /g.yas nas bskor ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod do/ /g.yon nas bskor bas (8)ni phyag na rdo rje la mchod de/ thams cad kyi 3)snying po stong bzlas nas bsgrub 7bo/ /de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba 'byung ste/ de la 'jig rten pa'i phyag rgya rnams ni 'jig rten pa'i khu tshur las 'byung ste/ rdo rje khu tshur ni rdo rje bcing ba shilas/ g.yon pa'i mthe bo nang du bcug nas mthe'u chung dang srin lag gi bar du btsir la bsdam par bya 51 ste/ de nyid la phyag rgya'i snying po 'di 'bum bzlas te bsgrub 32bo/ /oṃ badzra mu drwa liju/ rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis su byas te/g.yas pas mtshan ma ji ltar byas pa bzhin du gzung mngo / /ma rnams thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni 'di bzhin du rdo rje'i khu tshur las g.yon pa rdo rje'i khro bo'i mdzub mo bsgreng 8ba ste/ dur khrod dam tshogs kyi gnas su rdo rje khro bo'i mdzub 3 tshomos mi khrag thigs pa gsum khar blangs te myangs nas mi ro ma smas phonyeshing ma nyams pa rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te brgya bzlas na nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / byad ma thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro//tshogs de dag thams cad kyi dbang por 'gyur tenyurte/ thag 'jug pa dang /85—124

phan 'dogs nus par 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i bde ba'i mchog thams cad dang ske/ rtog pa thams cad dang / las thams cad dang / phyag rgya thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo'i khu tshur sgrub ①pa'i snying po ni 'di yin no / /oṃ badzra ā ②ra li/ phyag rgya bcing ba'i rab tu bya ba'o(kye/ /de nas de'i rjes la phyag rgya thams cad kyi gsang ba'i sgrub ④pa'i skabs bshad par bya ste zhes/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya gsang ba sgrub (epa ni dkyil 'khor bri ste der ⑦'di skad brjod 3)do/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya btsun mo 'di/ /rtag tu bdag la stsal ⑨bar 465/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub 0phyir/ /grub pa 37mchog ni bsgrub nyunyepar bgyi/ /phyag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor nas 'di zhes brjod dol/ /su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ nyu2ho/ badzra satwa ā tsobya sid dha nan/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnams kyi gsang ba'i phyag rgya sgrub 0pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /rtag tu bdag la grub pa 465/ /de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje rigs kyi gsang ba sgrub 7pa ni phyag na rdo rje khro bo ni thams cad byed pa yin no zhes de skad brjod la bsgrub par bya'o/ /ma rnams kyi gsang ba'i phyag rgya sgrub rtso tshopa ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas bhyo bhyo zhes rjod 1gecig /gsang ba sgrub (16pa'i rab tu bya ba'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i de kho na 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya'i de kho na ni sems las sangs rgyas kyi chos 'byung ngo / /yang dag par na 'di dag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i thugs la gnas pa yin no / /bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yin pas 3 stabadag gi chung ma yin no zhes sngar bsgoms la phyag rgya bsgrub 31bo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i de kho na ni/rab dga' bcing gi ba kun gyi mchog /de las phyag rgya rnams su byas/ /'dod 85—125

pa rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /grub brtan myur du stsol bar mdzad/ /de nas gzhan dag ni/ bcom ldan rtag pa 'dod pa ste/ /de nyid ①de bzhin gshegs pa'o / /de las thams cad bdag nyid gzugs/ /bdag kyang phyag rgya grub par ②shog /de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i (kyirigs kyi phyag rgya'i ④de kho na ni ⑤phyag na rdo rjes (6)lha thams cad dbang du byas nas rdo rjer byas te/ de dag gi phyag rgya yang rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyid do/ /de nas ma rnams kyi phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid ni/ ma rungs thams cad za ba'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun gyis byas pa ste/ /phyag rgya 'bebs pas de yi phyir/ /bsgoms nas kyang ni bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de kho na rab tu sbyor bas thog mar bsgoms ⑦nas bsgrub bo/ /phyag rgya'i de kho na'i rab tu bya ba'o(de/ /de nas rtog pa thams cad kyi 'byin gyis brlab 7pa mal sogs pa'i las bshad do ⑩zhes tsonas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa/ nyin re dang po dus bzhin du/ / rdo rje tsoche mchog phyag rgya yis / /snying ga smin mtshams lkog ma gtsugatso /bdag nyid byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de la tshebyin gyis nyu tshobarlab pa'i snying po ni 'di yin no/ /badzra satwa / badzra ratna/ badzra dharma/ badzra kurma/ de la 'di ni rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur ba'i snying po yin no/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sgyi 0kṣañtsayo/ snying po 'dis rdo rje rin po che'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bzhag ste/ mdzub ⑦ mo gnyis kyis phreng ba'i tshul du bcings la/ ltag par mdud ( nyepa'i tshul du 'byas nas ( nyebaskor te/ mthe'u chung nas brtsams te bkrol bubs sor mo thams cad bkrol te dar dpyangs du nyepa ltar bya'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes bskyod pa ni rdo rje bcing ba cibakan te pang tsunapar bzhag nas bsgom ( nyepa'i snying po 'dis rang gi 85wa 126

snying gar rdo rje bsam mo/ /oṃ badzra ādma kuḥcha/ rdo rje'i bzlas pas geci 'dod par ①bzlas so/ /de nas rdo rje'i byamachod pa'i rab tu bya ba ni/ rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis bcangs (gyenas/ /rdo rje 'gying ba legs par bya/ /rdo rje phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /rdo rje gar kyang spyi bo nas/ /der bstod pa'i rdo rje'i glu blang zhing mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen bla med de//rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pas/ /rdo rje las ni mdzad par gsol/ /dga' ba dang ske/ dbang bskur ba dang / glu dang mchod pa 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyang rnyed par mi dka' 56)na grub pa gzhan lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ltar sems dpa'i bde ba 'di dang mtshungs pa med do/ /de nas phyag na tso)rdo rje sa'i byin gyis brlab (8)pa la sogs pa 'byung ste/ nyin re dang por dus bzhin du/ /rdo rje'i byin gyis brlab tshul gyis/ /bdag gis bdag nyid byin brlabs nas/ /sems dpar byin rlabs porarnal 'byor ldan/ /rdo rje dang bcas rdo rje bcing / /rdo rje 'bebs la sogs tshul gyis/ /rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje bcas/ /gnyis byas phyag rgya'i mchog gis su/ /bdag nyid byin gyis brlab par bya/ /'dod pa bdag nyid ces 7kyang bsgomanyunye/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 8gsang ba'i snying po bzlas par bya'o/ /de la gsang ba'i snying po 'di rdo rje'i glus ci 'dod par nyugebazlas so/ /ṭakki 8dzaḥ/7༄ho/ de nas bsgrub 7pa gzhan yang 0rdo rje bcing bas rtags bzung ste 'bum bzlas na/ 'dod pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug dang / 'dod pa'i gzugs dang 'dod pa'i tshe dang /'dod pa'i bdag po dang / kun du 'gro ba thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur nyusnyeba'i rab tu bya ba 'byung ba ni de bzhin 85—127

gshegs 1༄pa thams cad kyi phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba ji lta ba bzhin du snying po 'dis sbyin no/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna (mirnyi ṣe ka a/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pa ni ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad nyid yin pa de bzhin du bdag kyang thams cad nyid do zhes nas snying po 'dis thams cad dgug pa dang /gzhug tsho pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas te bsgom (4)mo/ /de la snying po ni 'di'o/ /oṃ satwa dzaḥ(ges baṃ hoḥ(6)/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gsang ba'i mchod pa bya ba ni byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa thams cad byed de/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs (3ril/ /rdo rje gar dang sbyar nas su/ /me tog la sogs dbul ba ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa phyag rgyas dbul/ /gzhu 'dren pa yi tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje mda' ni 'phen par bya/ /kun nas 'khyud dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng (9/ /gnyis snyems 'dzin pas 'dud 9shedapa'o/ /rdo rje'i bstod pa 'dis rdo rje'i glu blang zhing mchod do/ /gzugs la sogs pa 'dod pa dag gi bde ba dang / /shin tu yid bde bcom ldan rab dga' khyod la 'dud/ /khyod kyis bdag la deng 7du dga' ba de kun mchod la/ /mchog gi bdag nyid grub pa'ang myur du tshul bzhin stsol/ /bstod pa'i snying po 'dis thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la nyin rer 31lan re bstod na bcom ldan 'das las thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon de rang gi lce las kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang nyan/ da ltar gyi thams cad dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang / rtog pa thams cad dang / tshig gi rgyud thams cad kyang smra bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i glu sngon ma byung ba yang lho len to/ /rdo 85—128

rje'i glus 'bum bzlas na rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lan cig 1byin gyis brlabs la de nas phyis sgrubs shig /de nas nyin gcig bzhin byin gyis brlab ②pa la sogs pa nyin rer pu )lan re byas na grub pa thams cad dang /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang dbang bskur ba la sogs pa dang / shes pa thams cad dang / las thams cad 'grub bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa dang / sems dpa' rnams der lhags nas phra mo la sogs pa ston te tshig smra'o/ /byams par byed do(3/ /mchod do/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim gro thams cad kyis (5)mchod do/ /sems can thams cad la tshar gcad ne pa dang / phan 'dogs nus par 'gyur rol/ /'jig pa med pa dang / zad pa med pa dang / 'god pa med pa dang /'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / sdug bsngal thams cad kyang sel to/ /cho 'phrul thams cad ston to/ /bdag nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa sems dpa'i gzugs man cad ri7)dang / bdag gi lus thams cad dang ske/ nam mkha' dang / sa dang / shing dang / ri dang / chu rnams las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad ston par byed do/ /'od zer ston pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad ston to/ /rang yang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la sogs pa dang / thams cad kyi gzugs su 'gyur rol/ /mig gis (8)'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi shes pa thams cad yi ge rnams las mthong ngo / /thams cad las thos shing rang gi lces smra'o/ /sngon ma byung ba'i rtog pa dang / mdo sde thams cad 'chad do/ /ston skyob 59 thams 85—129

cad dang / sil snyan dang / 'phong dang / mtshon 'debs pa dang / shes nyen nyunyedang / bzo (kyedang sgyu rtsal thams cad lhun gyis grub par shes par ④'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig chubazhin du gzugs chen po dang / mdog dang /stobs dang / dpa' ba (gedang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / dngos grub thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems dang /spyod pa dang / sgra skad dang / tshig shes shing mthong ngo / /nyin gcig ⑥bzhin thams cad mngon par shes par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang ske/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa dngos grub thams cad ma bsgrubs ⑦par tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ro/ /byin gyis ⑧brlabs la sogs pa'i rab tu bya ba'ol/ /de la sgrub lhorapa'i rab tu bya ba 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgrub ⑩pa ni mdun du bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi sku rjes su dran pa bsgom hunyazhing snying po dang /phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa rnams bsgrub hu bo/ /phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa ni sems dpar lho byin gyis brlab ④pa'i rnal 'byor ram/ 'dod par sgom tsopa'am / /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'am/ bdag gi snying gar rdo rje bsgom 8pa'am/ bdag gi mdun du sangs rgyas rjes su dran par byed bzhin du snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa rnams bsgrub 1 7bo/ /sems dpa' chen po thams cad ni bdag nyid kyis rang gi sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'am/snying gar rdo rje chen po bsgom (2zhing snying po dang ⑪/ phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /phyi'i rdo rje'i rigs bsgrub nu )pa ni khro bo'i tshul gyis ༷ 7snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa rnams bsgrub zhu bo/ /rdo rje ma rnams sgrub du snyepa ni sems can thams cad za ba'i rjes su dran pa'am bdag nyid 85—130

rdo rje srin por gyur te/ de'i phyir bdag nyid kyang sems can thams cad bza'o zhes khros te/ snying po dang / phyag rgya dang sngags dang / rig pa rnams bsgrub par bya'o0)/ /sgrub ( pa'i rab tu bya ba'o/ /de nas sgrub 9kyepa'i thabs kyi 4rab tu bya ba 'byung ste/ ji du ltar 'jig rten 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de ltar sgrub 6)par gsungs pa ste/ /grub pa thams cad byed pa'i mchog /sgrub (7)pa'i thabs kyi rab tu bya ba'o/ /de nas ras kyi rab tu bya ba 'byung ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ras ni skra med par byas la dkyil 'khor rlum por thig gdab bo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ras ni ngos thams cad par gru bzhi po dar ram ras la bri'o/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ni ji lta bur 'dus (8)pa'i 'khor bzhin du'o/ /phyi'i rdo rje'i rigs rnams kyis ma bsdus ༷9༄pa la 'dus pa'i 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du dgod do/ /rdo rje ma rnams kyi ma nyams pa la kha mtshar ma bcad pa ste/ ri mo mkhan gso sbyong can gyis sbyin med pa'i tshon rtsi snod sar 6)par bzhag pas bri/ras kyi rab tu bya ba'o/ /de la cha lugs kyi tshad rab tu bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa lho)ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtho gang tsam du bya ba'o/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ni mtha' med pa'i phyir ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshad du bya'onyurte/ /de la rdo rje'i tshad ni ji tsam du 'gyur zhe na/ rang gi mthe bo'i tshigs kyi sor mo bcu drug tu bya'o / /de la rdo rje'i dbyibs tsheci 'dra bar bya zhe na/ zur bzhi la rtse lnga pa 'od zer gyi phreng ba can sum char 512bya'o/ /sems dpa' chen po thams cad ni mthe bo'i tshigs kyi sor bcu drug gi tshad du bya ste/ thams cad kyang padmo la bzhugs par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sku gzugs kyi tshad las dkyil 'khor gyi tshad kyang de dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /de la 'di ni bzlas pa'i rab tu bya ba ste/ de la de 85—131

bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ni dgongs pa'i gsung ting nge 'dzin gyi tshig ste/ /rdo rje rnams kyi'ang de bzhin no/ /de la rtog pa thams cad kyi spyir ni rdo rje'i tshig gis ①bzlas te bsgrub (pebo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ni rdo rje ((tshig gi glu dang sbyar te bzlas so/ /rdo rje bya/ zhes pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i khro bo rnams ni rdo rje'i khro bo'i tshig gis babazlas so6cho/ /phyi'i rdo rje'i rigs rnams ni chos kyi tshig gis (7)khro bo'i sgra lachen po gsal bar byas te/ khro ba spudang bcas pas bzlas so/ /rdo rje'i 8ma rnams ni rdo rje'i tshig phra mos bzlas so/ /de la ting nge 'dzin gyi ngag ni yid kyis bzlas so/ /de la rdo rje'i ngag ni/ lce thog rab tu mi g.yo bar/ /so mchu gnyis ka sbyar ba stem/ /rtog pa kun la rig pa ni/ /rdo rje'i hunyengag ni sgra spangs pa'o/ /de la rdo rje'i glu 32tshig ni/ /sha ṭa pa la sogs pa'i glu/ /grong dga' ba rnams blangs pa yisko/ /rdo rje'i tshig bzlas rtog pa ru/ /rdo rje'i (7klu zhes grags pa'o/ /de la rdo rje ༅khro bo'i tshig ni 'di'o/ /rgyu zhes pa yi ⑩'brug sgra 'dra/ /de bzhin phra zhing sgra dang ldan/ /khro bo gsal ba rdo rje che'o9/3 khro bo'i tshig ces grags pa'o/ /tshig gi rab tu bya ba'o/ /de la 'di ni bzlas pa'i cho ga rab tu bya ba yin te/ rtog pa dag ni kun la yang / /sems dpa' gang dang gang dag gi/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags bsgrub rtso)pas/ /de yi bdag nyid spyan drang bsgrubs sta/ /gnas dang srog chags thams cad ni/ /rang gi ri tshotshul gyis ༷ ༄cho ga thams cad bsgrub pa'o( snye/ /rdo rje bzlas pa ni rtog pa thams cad bsgrub zhusepa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba'i bzlas pa 'byung ste/ phyag na rdo rje'i snying po dang / /phyag rgya sngags rig de bzhin te/ /bzlas pa'i don gyis khusnyemagon po bzlas/ /rtog pa kun la'ang bsgrub par bya/ / phyi yi sdo 9rdo rje rigs 85—132

rnams kyi/ /khro bo'i mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /rdo rje ma rnams thams cad kyi/ /yid kyis su ni snying yang gzung 1)/ /bzlas pa'i don zhes bya ba la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 'dod pa bsgom 9bzhing bzlas pa ste/ 'di ltar oṃ zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa ste bde ba chen po'o/ /'dod pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /'dod pa ni thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug stapa dang bcing ba dang dbang du byed pa'i phyir rol/ /dzaḥ/ rba hoḥsnyi/ 'dod pa ni shin tu dga' ba'o/ /'dod pa ni bzlas pa'i don to/ /gsang ba'i bzlas pa 'di bzlas na bsod nams chung ngus kyang tshode'agrub par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang bslu gyebar mi nus so/ /thal mo khong stong du sbyar la mchod pa bya ste/ de la me tog gi mchod pa ni me tog gi thal mo gyen du phye bas so/ /bdug pa'i mchod pa ni thur ri7)du brkyang bas so/ /mar me'i mchod pa ni mthe bo ma nyams (8༄pas g.yogs pa'o/ /dri'i mchod pa ni rab tu brkyang 59༄ste stong pa'am gang bas so/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams kyis ⑩yang dag pa nyid du /lhamachod par 'gyur ba ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / dam tshig sems dpa' thams cad dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa dang lha 12thams cad la yang ngo / /mchod pa'i rab tu bya ba'o/ /de la bsod nams med pa'i sems can gyi sgrub 32pa'i rab tu bya ba 'byung ste/ dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba cig nyanyenyin re zhing ci rmogetsam 'dod pa'i tshad du nyi ma bzhir bris nas ji lta ba bzhin du der zhugs 15la phyag rgya chen po bcings nyartenas rang gi lhag pa'i lha lan brgya bzlas so/ /bsod nams med pa'i sems can gyi sgrub lha pa'i rab tu bya ba'o / /de la myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba'i rab tu bya ba ste/ de la de bzhin 85—133

gshegs pa'i myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ ting ①'dzin chos sbyin la sogs dang ske/ /rgya chen tshul rnams klog pa dang / /dad la gnas te de bzhin mchod/ /dngos grub myur sbyin chen po yin/ /de la phyag na rdo rje'i myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ 'dod la chags dang bral min dang / /'dod la chags pa'i dam pas mchod/ /'dod la ci nus chags bya ba/ /myur du dngos grub sbyin pa yin/ /de la 'di ni sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi lamyur du 'grub pa ni/sbyin dang tshul khrims de bzhin bzod/ /brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin blo//ci nus kyis kyang bya ba ni/ /nyin gcig ①bzhin du ci 'dod par/ /phyi'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi grub pa myur ba ni/ sangs rgyas mchod cing de bzhin dang / /phyag na rdo rje'i ④brtul zhugs brtan(pe/ /rdo rje rtag tu lag na bzung (7/ /mi ⑦bgrungs thams cad tshar gcod lamachog /de nas rdo rje ma rnams kyi grub pa myur du sgrub 64)pa'i hu byerab tu bya ba stenarnye/ sems can dge la dang ba dang / /mchod cing dam tshig srung nyugeb ste/ /phyag rgya'i gar gyi mchod pa dang / /sems can ma rungs (nyedrag shul bya/ /grub pa myur ba'i rab tu bya ba'o/ / de la 0slob dpon gyi rab tu bya ba 'byung ste/ de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon du sgrub 8pa ste/ dkyil 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar badzra bid ces bya ba'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas slob dpon rang gis dam tshig gi phyag rgya stong bzlas te/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i snying po ni 'di'o/ /badzra satwa/ badzra ratna/ badzra dharma/ badzra kurma/ oṃ tshes mu kha ma dhi tiṣṭha ⑩sarba ta thā ga ta ārya daste nyarnyeswā hā/ 'di brgya bzlas pa ni snying ga la sogs par (cephyag rgya bzhag nas spyi bor thams cad bzlas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs 85—134

pa'i rigs kyi slob dpon sbyin no/ /phyag na rdo rje'i cha lugs spyi bor bzung nas snying po 'di brgya'am brgya ༅rtsa brgyad du zlos ②shig /brgya bzlas pas ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i (mirdo rje'i slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du stabazlas pas ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rdo rje (geslob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /de la snying po ni 'di'o / /oṃ ma hā su kha 6)badzra satwa dzaḥlnga)rtsu baṃ hoḥ')/ su ra ta 〈pe tshe/ de nas de'i lag tu rdo rje sbyin no/ /de nas rdo rje rigs kyi ste/ lag pa gnyis su rdo rje byin nas rdo rje rigs kyi rdo rje'i dri chus bsres pa'i 7bum pas dbang bskur ro12/ /snying po 'di'o/ /oṃ badzra a dhi pa dhi two a bhi ṣiñtsa mi dri ḍho rka/:bha ba dzaḥ0rgyu baṃ hoḥtshargyu phaṭa/ de nas padmo rigs kyi slob dpon du sgrub ⑩pa ni padmo lag tu byin nas stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ padma'i rtso)phreng bas mgo bcing ngo / /snying po 'di brjod do/ /oṃ padma mā le a nyunyegi ṣiñtsa lo ke shwa ra ra twe swā hā hrīḥ17/ rdo rje rin po che'i slob dpon du bsgrub so )pa ni/ rdo rje rin po che'i phyag rgya slob ma dbang bskur ba'i gnas su bzhag nas snying po 'di stong bzlas so/ /oṃ badzra ratna a gi tuṣiñtsa ratna ( )snyi pa ti twe bha ba ṭa ṭa/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor thams cad du btsud de dbang bskur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje slob dpon du bya ste/yang bdag nyid kyis dkyil 'khor bris la bdag nyid la bdag gis slob dpon du dbang bskur ro/ /de la slob dpon gyi brtul zhugs ni 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob dpon ni zla ba gcig gi du 3bar du rab tu byung la bslab pa thams cad bzung ste/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha dus gsum du bsgrub ri gyibo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi slob dpon gyi brtul zhugs ni zla ba phyed kyi bar du nyin re zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa byas 85wa 135

nas phyag na rdo rje'i sku'am/ rang gi lha nyid la mchod nas kyo ba tang 4)gis bkug ste/ mi skyo bar bzlas te lam dang lam ma yin pa'i skabs mi dbye'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs 'byung ste/ nyin re zhing nang par langs nas bdag nyid byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa byas te/ bkrus la dri zhim po dang ske/ gos 'tsher ba dang / rgyan gyis chas te glu dang sil snyan dang /bkod pa dang / sgeg pa rnams dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das la me (mitog la sogs pa gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas bcom ldan 'das dang / bdag nyid la 'dod pa'i dngos pos mchod pa bya ste/ dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid ci 'dod pa bzlas te/ phyed yol gyi bar du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyad nas/ de bzhin du mchod pa byas te ci 'dod par bzlas so/ /de nas yang mtshan rangs par 'dod pa lnga rnams la brten cing bzlas par bya ste/de ltar zhag bzhi'i bar du bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rigs kyi brtul zhugs ni zla ba phyed kyi bar du smyon (gepar bsgyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing phyag na rdo rje mchod de/ mgo sa la gtugs nas sgron mor byung ④ngam / gos gyon yang rung ste/ mgo bo rdob cing (gemi 'o cog tsho nyel gshe zhing rgya la phyag rgya rnams kyis 7migar byas te/ yid kyis bde bzhin gshegs pa bsams nas mtshams bcing ba la sogs pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das la ji lta ba bzhin du mchod pa byas te brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /de nas padmo'i (spyonarigs kyi brtul zhugs ni bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te/ ba'i gcin hub shigang 'thungs la ba'i rtsi ba cung zad zos na dag pa'i brtul zhugs thams cad 'grub bo / /de nas zhag bdun du ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag nas stong rtsa 85—136

brgyad bzlas so/ /de nas nor bu'i rigs kyi brtul zhugs ni nyin re zhing rang la dbang bskur nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang / sems dpa' chen po rnams mchod de rgyal po lta bur sgom 1)zhing rgyal po'i pho brang du song nas/ rgyal po'i mdun du brgya brgya tshabazhag brgyad kyi bar du bzlas so/ /de ltar na slob dpon gyis grub pa thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / shes pa thams cad dang / kun gyis mchod pa la sogs pa dang / las thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon gyi rdo skurab tu bya ba'o/ /de nas las grub pa ni snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ las thams cad byas na thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya chen po bcings nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa brgyad stong bzlas na 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las thams cad la phyag (gergya thams cad bcings pa tsam gyis bdag dang pha rol gnyis ka 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sngags ni rdo rje tshig gis stong phrag brgyar bzlas na sngags thams cad thang cig bzlas pas las kun byed do/ /rig pa stong phrag brgyar bzlas na/de nas rig pa thams cad thang cig bzlas pas las thams cad byed do/ /de nas snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa rnams 'byung ste/ badzra satwa ni snying po'o/ /satwa 5)badzra ni phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ ni sngags so/ /khi ti ni rig pa'o/ /de nas snying po dang / phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa thams cad sgrub 6pa'i snying po 'byung ste/ oṃ ma hā su kha badzra satwa dzaḥ7)rtsu baṃ hoḥn su ra ta st+waṃ/ 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rdo rje sems dpas bzlas pas 59 glu dang rdo rje'i tshig gis stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ snying po dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 85—137

shing ske/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bya sna tshogs mang po ①skad snyan (na'abyin pa/ rnga dang / cang te'u dang / ker ko dang / gling bu dang / rnga bo che la sogs pa'i sgra grag pa/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha dang /lha'i bu mo sna tshogs rnam par rtsen pal/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa na/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha dang / rig pa ④'dzin pa medang / lha'i bu mo 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang ske/ dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye yichen po dang / klu la sogs pa 'khor du ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad la/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros tshad med pa dang / blo gros mi g.yo ba dang / blo gros yangs pa dang / kun tu blo gros dang / blo gros mtha' yas dang / blo gros ka ma la dang / blo gros chen po dang / blo gros lha rdzas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros sna tshogs la sogs pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i (medage 'dun mtha' thug pa med pa rnams kyis bste dustang du byed/ bla mar byed/ mchod cing rjed (9ral rab tu mchod ⑩cing spel te/ 'khor mang po'i dbus na tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang sdud nyuhepa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu phod85—165

nas byung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas nas hu)sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ②ba las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' 5kyeba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas pas ④mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod dephyi/ lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas mgo bos lan brgya phrag stong du phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de yi'adi skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma'o sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /kye ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangasal/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod/ /de nas lha rnams kyi (shedabang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal spunas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer kun tu snang bas ngan song gi rgyud las rnam par grol zhing / rnam par grol ba'i lam la bkod pa ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rngubaka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po 'di ni ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /lha'i dbang po 'di ni ngo mtshar mi che ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni tshad med pa'i 7bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams yang dag par bsags pa'o / /lha'i dbang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 8ni tshad med pa'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni tshad med pa'i thabs yang dag par rdzogs pa'o / /lha'i dbang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shes rab tshad med 85—166

pa bsags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 51)kyi spyod pa ni tshad med pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gdul ba'i skye bo tshad med pa rnams snod du gyur par mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan patshage/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam ri ripa dang mnyam pa'i smon lam gyi stobs dang ldan pa ste/ lha'i dbang po de lta bas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis stisnod ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang / ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa dang / mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi (zhesadon mdzad pa yin par rig par bya ste/ 'di la the tshom tsho6dang ske/ som nyi ④dang / yid gnyis ma byed cig /gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'dul bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnas ni med do/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin rang gi stan mo las langs nas yang (9)bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa che ba rgya che ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa nyid du bgyi ba dang /sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba nyid du bgyi ba dang / snying brtse 1 rib can nyid du bgyi ba dang / snying brtse ba can chen po can du bgyi ba dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi bar 17bcom ldan 'das bdag spobs pa bskyed 8par gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag spobs pa bskyed par gsol/bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i ris 'di nyid nas lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba zhig shi 'phos te/ dus las 'das nas dgung 85—167

bdun lon lags na/ bcom ldan 'das de gang du skyes/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni ci zhig myong bar 'gyur6)/ bcom ldan 'das lung bstan du gsol/bde bar gshegs pa ②yung bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ①bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po ci ste ④de'i dus la bab par shes na nyon cig /lha'i dbang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dus ni 'di lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa dus dang tshod ni 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis (shebaka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de 'di nas shi 'phos nas mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes nas/des der lo stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi bar du sdug bsngal ma rungs shing mi bzad pa myong nas sems can dmyal ba chung ngu rnams su yang lo brgya phrag brgyar sdug bsngal myong ngo / / de nas (6)byol song dang ⑦/ yi dgas ④kyi ⑨gnas su yang lo brgya phrag brgyar sdug bsngal myong ngo / /de nas yul mtha' 'khob kyi mir skyes nas kyang 'on pa dang / dig pa dang / lkugs ④pa'i rang bzhin can dang /smra ba mi gsal bar lo stong phrag drug cu'i lho)bar du sdug bsngal 8myong ngo 'o:/ /lo stong phrag brgyad cu chartsa bzhir nad rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / mdze dang phol mig rnams kyis gzir ba dang / skye bo mang pos smad pa dang / yongs kyis spangs pa dang / rigs dman pa'i rigs can rjes su myong zhing sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ sdug bsngal brgyud pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa byed pa dang / las kyi sgrib nyugepa bar chad med pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa dang / gzhan yang sdug bsngal gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa myong zhing myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu thams cad kyis thos nas shin tu sngangs shing skrag ste/85—168

skyo nas kha bub tu 'gyel bar gyur 3)to/ /de nas yang langs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal chen po dushebargyud pa 'di las ji ltar na 'di thar bar 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar thar bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das ci nas kyang sdug bsngal gyi ②phung po 'di las rnam par grol bar 'gyur bar ④'di bskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa 'di bskyab 55༄tu gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu yirtsa bzhis kyang bshad pa 'di ngas kyang bshad kyis nyon cig /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis yang bcom ldan 'das la me tog man dā (7)ra ba dang / man dā (sher ba chen po dang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang / dpung rgyan dang / snyan cha dang /do shal dang / se mo do la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya nyu)stong phrag du mar bskor ba byas shing phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so zhes bya bas mnyes par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan pa dang / bde bar bgyi ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud gsum las rnam par thar bar bgyi ba'i slad du legs par bshad du gsol/ de nas yang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha mang po rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so/ /ci nas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis mtshan tsam thos pas kyang ngan song gsum gyi lam las rnam par grol te/ bde 'gro lha'i 'jig rten nam0/ mi'i 'jig rten du skyes nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 85—169

pa'i byang chub thob par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i bu de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'dis byin gyis 17brlab smyon)par bya ba'i phyir don yod gdon mi za ba'i rdo rje'i byin gyis ge brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms gepar zhugs 555so/ /de nas yang de nyid kyi (6thugs ka nas sngags 'di phyung 7nas lha de dag rishesadam tshig 995can du byin gyis brlabs so/ /oṃ sarba bibyā badzra a dhiṣṭha khun dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas kyang gdon mi za bar mi choms pa'i rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs nyu7kyis byin gyis brlabs nas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /oṃ sho dha ni 32sho dha ni nyinasarba 1 pā paṃ bi sho dha de515/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba kurma cho14ā hu ba ra ṇa 12bi shud dhe swā hā/ rig 17pa chen po 2 'di bshad ma thag tu sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi rgyud kyi 'ching 1ba thams cad rnam par chad do/ /ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyangs so/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rnams rab tu zhi ste na / skye bo mang po rnams bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sho dha ne sho dha de snye/ oṃ sarba a pā dge ya na tsi/ sarba sarte :bhyo hūm̐/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba a pā 8ya bi sho dha no tsho (rgyu phaṭa/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ traṭa 0/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i snying po'o/ /ju 1/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang mdor na 85—170

dran pa tsam gyis kyang bsod nams chung ba'i sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las bde blag tu rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba ni 'di yin no/ /na mo bha ga ba te (1)sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā 5ya/ ta thā ga tā tshoya/ arta te saṃ myaka bu bud dhā 95ya/ tarya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne tsho sho dha de / ri risarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne༄9)/ shud dhe bi shud 1 tshodhe/ sarba kurma ā 11bar ṇa bi shud dhe 1naswā hā/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'o/ /1 ma sarba bid 1 sarba ā 15bar ṇa bi sho dha 15ya ha na tsū phaṭa/oṃ sarba bid hu tshos/ oṃ sarba bid 1 phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid 19a/ oṃ sarba bid tā tha skye / oṃ sarba bid 22tsha/ oṃ sarba bid /swa/ oṃ sarba bid 2 ris/ oṃ sarba bid 25rgyu / oṃ sarba bid tāṭa dzi/ oṃ sha /oṃ bha/ lha'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i 7gsang ba'i snying po 'di ni rmo 3rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang yang rung bas ming tsam yang nyan tam/ bcangs sam/ bklags 29sam/ bris nas kyang mgo bo'am/gtsug phud dam/ dpung pa'am/ mgul du btags te 'chang na tshe 'di nyid la dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad dam/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad dang 'brel pa'i 21mi lam gyi rnam pa'am/ ngan song dang 'brel pa'i mtshan ma de dag thams cad rmi lam tsam du yang mi 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor du ji lta ba bzhin du zhugs la/ zhugs nas kyang dbang bskur la snying po yang bzlas brjod byed cing 5/ sngags zhi kyi don yang sgom pa gang yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag la ni sdig pa gang yang nye bar mi 'gyur/ ngan song du 'gro bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam / srin po'am gi/ byol song ngam/ yi dgas sam/ sems can dmyal 85—171

ba la sogs te/ gang yang rung ba shi ba'i lus dkyil 'khor du bcug stenya/dbang bskur na/ de sems can dmyal bar skyes na yang de ma thag tu rnam par thar nas lha'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i rigs der skyes nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid mngon sum du byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsnyen bkur (gel sogs pa yang byed/ phyir mi ldog par yang 'gyur/ rgyud nges pa can du yang 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su yang skye/ sgrib pa rnams rab tu spangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs sam/ lha'i rigs sam/ gzhan gang yang rung bar bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po mdor na 'jig rten nam / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan pa dang bde ba thams cad myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha rnams kyi bdabang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin du bskor ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad kyi dbang du gyur pa rnams la phan pa dang bde bar bgyi ba dang /ci nas kyang sems can de dag ngan song thams cad la rgyab kyis phyogs par bgyi ba dang / bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde blag tu rtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ rje gcig bshad ⑤du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur 85—172

pa / /rgyal bas hu)gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ②ba'i slad du phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /gtsug lag khang dang skyed (kyemos tshal/ /mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs/ /ji bzhin pa yi 4)cho ga yis/ /gnas ni byin gyis brlab pa brtsam(snye/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni/ / phyi yi tso dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dang / /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / /seng ge ban ༅glang rnams kyis brgyanadunas/ /dar dang lda ldi (pedo shal phreng / /dril 7bu dang ni rnga mas brgyananyam/ /rdo rje rin chen padma dang / /rgya gram pa yi phyag rgyas brgyanam / /srad bu 32brgyad dang ldan pa dang / /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan / /dgu yi char ni bgos pa las/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum char bya/ /rdo rje srad bu sa thig gdab bo/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la/ /lte rshabar bcas shing rtsibs 8bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun da zla 'dra la/ /zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje yi / /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs na tshog dang / /ting hu 'dzin phyag rgyar ldan pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan par bri/ / de yi hurtespyan sngar py-i — stangan song kun/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po bri bya ste/ /phyag gnyis ting 'dzin tshul du bsnol/ /zla ba rgyas dang padma'i mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis legs rdzogs la/ /rgyal mchog skyes bus tsho 1gang bar bri/ /rgyab tu shākya'i rigs dbang po/ /gtso bo thub pa bri bar bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyogs char ni/ /rgyal mchog rin chen me tog gnyis/ /85—173

lo tsa nā 1)dang mā ma kri(ge/ /de bzhin dkar mo sgrol ma rnams/ /rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma bzhin/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun du bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad dul/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' mchog /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i sems dpa' rnams/ /go rims 5gebazhin du bri bar bya/ /mkhas pas lā su 94dal sogs pa / /mchod pa grwa 55༄yi phyogs su bri/ /sgo yi phyogs rnams (7thams cad du/ /sgo 7ba bzhi ni bri bar bya/ /rta babs khyams ni thams cad du/ /byams pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams/ /khro bo mngag pa napho nya sogs/ /bri bya yang na ming yang rung / /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa bri/ /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug che/ /shar dang nub kyi gling du ni / /brgya 9byin gtogs 'dod thams cad ni/ /'khor dang bcas par bri bar bya/ /gzhan rnams dag 3 shākyang de bzhin te/ /lha min dri za nam mkha' lding ske/ /gnod sbyin srin po 11sto 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dgas 'dre rnams dang //klu dang grul bum ri rnams dang / /rgyal po bzhi rnams bri bar bya/ /gza' 8dang skar ma rgyu skar sna dang / /khro bo ma rungs 'tshe ba yi/ /bgegs dang bi nā ④ya ka rnams/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /drang srong skal ba (8chen po rnams / /phra 17men ma dang bud med bri/ rme/ /de bzhin sring 3)mo rnal 'byor ma/ /'byung ba 19bzhi yi lha chen po/ /khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang / /shing dang kun dga'i nags la sogs/ /dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa 3 )rnams/ /ming dang brda 21'am yang na ni/ /thig le rnams kyang bri bar bya/ /de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /bla re rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /gdugs dang rnga ma lda ldi pyo rte85wa 174

dang ske/ /'phan dang sna tshogs na bzas mchod/ /gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam hu)bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /dbang bskur rin chen chus bkang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni gzhag ②par bya/ /mar me gtor ma bum pa dang ske/ /mdzes pa'i bshos rnams gzhag bya ste/ /bza' ba btung ba sbyar legs dang / /bca' ba sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag /'byung po dag dang zhiraklu dag dang ske/ /mi dang mi min de bzhin te/ /me tog dri rnams sna tshogs dang / /'o ma mar dang kha ④rar bcas/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi ⑤chus/ /rab tu bkang ba gzhag par bya/ /de nas khrus la sogs byas la/ /dri dang phreng mchog phreng ba canal/ /dri zhim kha bkang mchog mdzes pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas kyang //me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi (6)'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya sngags dang bdag ldan zhing / /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ(7thugs rje'i (kyebadag /tshur gshegs zhes stini brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba'i bcing ba bcings nas ni/ /mdzub treganyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya/ /mtheb 3)gnyis nang du bkug lho nas ni/ //bskyod par gyur na tsodabang du 'gyur/ /de nas mtshan ma skyes nas mgu nas ④ni/ /thog ma tha ma 8med pa mngon sum mthong / /argha tshemachog brtags gsang mal sogs pa yi/tshon/ /dbyangs snyan rtso pa yi bstod 3 byedang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor 31ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom pas gdungs pa dang / /phyogs na gnas pa rnams 85—175

la rnam par brtag /de yi gtor ma ji ltar mthun ①par bya/ /de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su smin bya ba/ /'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub bar/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog skyed ②du gzhug /de rnams byin rlabs ②byang chub smon lam gdab/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ / bsrung bar ④byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ / rab zhi ⑤kha nas sngags brjod gzhug (7par bya/ /dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin dpal padmar (pelag gnyis bya/ /me tog rin chen la sogs de brgyan (shesal/ /yon gyis tshilag pa bkang ste gzhug ⑩par bya/ /sngags ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha phonye / oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/oṃ badzra pra be sha hūm̐/ a nyuges me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ye rghaṃ/ de nas sngags 'dis me tog la sogs pa dor bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa'i tshigatso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongs nas bzhes tshesu gsol/ /oṃ badzra pra 8ti groṇḍa 8rgyu/ oṃ badzra ⑩pra tītstsha tu badzra nyams ma ya st+waṃ/ me tog rin chen la sogs gang / /bab par gyur pa na )rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo'i rigs de bsgrubs na ni/ /dngos grub 'gyur te the tshom med/ /de nas sngags pa mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis dam tshig ༅sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rigs kyi phyag rgya snying gar bcings te dam tshig gi lha snying la gnas par bya ba'i sngags/snyo ma badzra sa ma ya skṛ rme snyed yaṃ ri steme pra be tsho gesha dṛ bye tiṣṭha 39rgyu/ de nas 'dis dam tshig 0bsgrag 3par bya'o / /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg ( ༄par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i shu )chu 'dis 'grub/ /ci 85—176

ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun rgyud 0)rigs ni brlag par mdzad/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad (gemi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ma yin/ /chang ni ( /btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha la sogs pa bza' ④mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i (gesbyor ba ni/ / nams kyang (67bya ba ma yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang ⑦/ /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no / /sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang / /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /lha la phul ba'i rnying ⑧pa dang / /de yi grib ma 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin te/ /sngags dang lha la'ang smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi las (9)sogs bya ma yin/ /mu stegs can la'ang smad mi bya/ /mdor na yid gnyis som nyi ⑩the tshom mi bya ste/ /bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /mos pa brtan dang ldan pas dam bcas nas/ /sarba bid kyis 7ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pas/ /bcu po rnams kyis 12dbang bcu ci dgar bskur/ /de nas lag tu dril bu rtso rdo rje byinam/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la/ /mi dbang dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa dang ske/ /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /sngags bsgrub 8phyir ni mos ldan slob ma la/ /sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /des kyang mos pas spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ /ci ste nor yod bla ma dbul bar bya/ /nor 85—177

dang gter dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser/ /bzhon pa 0)khyim gdan bu pho bu mo rnams/ /skyes pa dag dang bud med yang na ni/ /grong dang grong khyer de bzhin ci bzhed rnams/ /rang gi sems ni rab tu dad pa yis/ /yon gyi mchog nyid dbul ba nyid du bya/ /myur du 'grub phyir mos pas bla ma la/ /mdor na rang gi lus kyang dbul bar bya/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob cha'agyur na/ / lha yi bubade ba smos ci dgos/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla mar mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob ④'gyur bas/ /cung zad tsam yang brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang / /rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni / /rnal 'byor can gyis tshorabarnyas ma yin/ /rtag tu 'khon gyi gcugs ༷6)mi bya / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod 7 byed dang / /bla ma smod byed ma rungs pa/ /dam tshig las ni 'das pa dang / /de la sogs pa'i gnod byed la/ /bzod pa bsgom 52par mi bya ste/ /de ltar gyur na kun rig gis/ /gsungs pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan pa dang / /brtser (spuldan dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang lha'i 'jig rten du bcas pa rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i 57phyir 11sgrub pa'i cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /ras la bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa de bzhin du bris la/ g.yas su ni de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ g.yon phyogs su ni shākya thub pa/ ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i 'og tu ni kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mdog zla ba lta bu phyag na padma bsnams pa'o/ /shākya thub 85—178

pa'i 'og tu ni phyag na rdo rje de gnyis kyi bar du sman gyi bla tirimadog sngon po phyag gcig na 'bras bu a ru ra bsnams pa(5kyi/ phyag gcig ni mchog sbyin du bya/ rta mgrin me dang / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ ma rungs pa 'joms ④pa la (pebartson pa gnyis ni rang gi lha la brten (6)par bri/ de gnyis kyi dbus su lo tsa nā (spyidang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams rang rang gi mtshan ma/ phyag na bsnams (shepar bri/ de dag gi 'og tu padma'i rdzing bu chu dang / chu srin dang / nya dang / rus sbal dang / sbal pa dkar po dang / nya khar ba la sogs par bcas pa dang / chu las skyes pa'i me tog rnam pa du mas yongs su gang bar bri/ bdug pa dang / mar me dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / bshos dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa bri/ de'i 'og tu sgrub 94pa po nyid thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug par bri/ de nas ri mo'i sku gzugs de mngon par mchod de/ bdag nyid kyis pho )spyan dbye ba bya zhing bden pa la byin gyis brlabs par dmigs par bya'o / /de nas ci ste mtshan ma zhig mthong na ni myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur ronyunye/ /'on te ma mthong na ni ring mo zhig nas dngos grub tu 'gyur te/bzhad pa dang ni rnga sgra dang / /dril bu'i sgra dang 'brug 12sgra dang / /dge slong bram ze pho mo dang / /'bras bu mthong na myur du ni/ /mchog dang bar ma tha ma 'grub / /de nas gzugs de gsang sngags dang / /phyag rgya mngon par byin brlabs nas/ /ci bdog pas ni mchod par bya/ /rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang / /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag srud nyisal sogs byas nas kyang / /bdag gi de nyid bsams nas su56/ /dngos grub mtshan ma 85—179

byung bar du/ /'bum phrag gsum mam ①drug 'bum bzlas/ /de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgyad brgya ②nyid du tshang bar bya/ /sngags ni khral ③'khrul ④med par bzlas/ /de nas bzlas pa'i mjug ⑤tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams ⑥la/ /mchod pre rgya chen byas nas kyang / /mtshan gcig ⑦thog thag bzlas par bya/ /ci ste gtso 'am de yi 6)sras/ /yang na lha rnams mthong gyur stin/ /bsod nams snod la ci dga' b.rabo/ /dngos grub mchog ni gsol bar bya/ /lha ni dngos grub 'bras bu ni/ /de la rtag tu dgyes 7nas stsolaske/ /phyag 'tshal dngos grub la 'o)sogs blang / /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /skal ba re re phul nas ni/ /de nas rtag tu bdag spyod hustecing / /med na mkhas pa bdag nyid kyis/ /blangs nas bdag nyid spyad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan brtson par/ /bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur/ /ci ste dngos grub ma gyur na/ /las rnams thams cad nus par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin skar mda'i ④gdon 0la sogs/ /chad pas bcad ⑩cing bka' tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sogs las kun ni/ /bran ⑩bzhin thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sdig pa bgyis pas sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa 'o)rnams ji ltar na sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sdug bsngal spang ba'i slad du bsgrub (7par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po nyon cig /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sdig pa byed pa/ sdig pa chen po byed pa de dag ci nas kyang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal py-i — )las thabs sla bas 85—180

grol bar 'gyur ba nyon cig /de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu brtag① /de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las/ /de ni myur du rnam par thar/ /sdig las rnam grol bdag nyid de//dag par gyur pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /rigs su skyes par gyur nas kyang / /de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / /chos bgro du ba ni thos par 'gyur/ /de yi gzugs brnyan bri ba 'am/ /gur gum ②gyis ni ming yang rung / /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las/ /sems can rnams ni dgrol 'o)ba'i phyir/ /sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson zhing / /snying rje can gyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas (snyede dbang bskur/ / lha yi (6ragazugs su brtags nas kyang / /mchod rten (7)dbus su gzhag par bya/ /rang gi lha 'am lha gzhan gyi/ /snying po snying gar (7bris nas kyang / /lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed dekhya/ /khyim gyi nang du gzhag par bya/ /de yi ming yang smos nas ni / /gur gum mabazang pos sngags bris la/ /rim gyis 'bum ni tshang tsam du/ /mchod rten las ni rab tu bya/ /sdig can sdig ni zad hu bya'i phyir/ /bye 12ba snyed ni tshang bar bya/ /de ltar byas na rtso2nges par ni/ /dmyal ba las ni grol bar 'gyur/ /yi dgas byol song sdug bsngal las/ /grol te lha yi gnas su skye// de yi ④ming nas 8brjod nas ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i sngags bzla zhing / /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba snyed cho15du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /de yi ming nas brjod nas kyang ske/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong snyed the tshodu/ /85—181

sbyin sreg byas par gyur na ni/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur ①pa yige/ /sdig pa de las thar bar 'gyur/ /ji srid mtshan ma shin tu ni/ /'bar ba'i gnas na skyes gyur par/ / mtshan ma yang dag byung bar du/ /nitil dang yungs kur ④'bras rnams dang / / ra yi (gye'o mar ldan (6)pa dang / /dri yis ⑦bskus pa'i yam shing gis/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyin sreg (nyebya/ /de nas de ni nges par yang / / lha yi tshiganas su skyes gyur nas/ /de yi mtshan ma ston par byed/ /yang na lha yi 0mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang na hom khung nang du ni/ /me 7yi ltas ni ston byed cing ske/ /lha yi gnas su skyes pa dang / /sdig pa bcom pa'i mtshan mar ni/ /dkar po nyid dang g.yas su 'bar/ /gyen du 'bar zhing dri ma med/ /skum zhing rnam par mi 'phro la/ /brtan 8la glog nyukhebazhin dri ma med/ /yang na me lha nyid kyis ni/ /bdag nyid de bzhin ston byed de/ /zla ba dri med dkar 'dra la / /bzhin mdog dkar zhing lam mer 'bar/ /de ni mtshan ma 'di dag gis / /dmyal ba la sogs rnam grol zhing / /sdig pa bcom nas bde 'gror ni//skyes pa yin par shes par bya/ /khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ /cho ga bzhin 8du khung brkos la/ /rdo rje mtha' ma bskor ba yi/ /'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya/ /rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams/ /ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri/ /de bzhin sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /'jig rten gtso la sogs pa bri/ /bya dang bum pa gang ba dang / /gtor mas snod 8rnams bkang ba dang / /brgyad snyed tsam du bzhag pa 'am/ /yang na bcu drug snyed du gzhag /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba'i bshos/ /me tog phreng sogs de bzhin te/ /bla re rgyal mtshan dar la sogs / /gdugs mchog rnams kyis legs par brgyan / /sbyin sreg nyu tshodakyil 85—182

'khor dam par ni/ /sbyin sreg 91)rab tu bya ba yin(2)/ /cho ga shes pas ri bris nas kyang / /lha rnams mang po spyan drangs la/ /sngags shes pas ni sngags phyag rgyas / / argha dbul bar rigeshes nas kyang / /mdor na mchod pa byas nas ni/ / lha yi ②sbyor bas (6skarab gnas la/ /ga bur gur gum la sogs pas/ /mar dang 'o 9)ma til bsgos la/ /til dang yungs kur 98)'bras rnams dang / /dri yi chus ni legs bkang ste/ /'bras chan (9noyos dang la du dang / /sbrang rtsi sha kha ri1 skurar ldan pa/ /brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas la/ /yam nyanyeshing la yang de bzhin te/ /rang gi sngags kyis btab pa'i shing / /khung bu'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas su / /bzlas pa'i dri yis 12byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs 1snyenas kyang ske/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug /me tog phreng la sogs pas mchod / /gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du/ /sngags bris nas ni gdags par bya/ /snying ga lkog tsham kha phyogs su/ /sarba bi stos byin gyis brlab/ /dpral ba mdzod 8spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud tshadapung pa gnyis/ /sna dang rked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnas la ni/ /de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags / /mchog tu dge ba rnam 1 gzhag go/ /de nas ngan song sbyang 41 ba'i phyir//stan dang bcas te thab dbus su/ /gzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni/ /btab pa'i gos kyis g.yogs 17par bya/ /de nas byin za dge ba ri norab sbar du stol/ /me lce stong gis 'khrigs shing 'bar ba'i lus / /zla dkar kun da zhi zhal 22zhi ba'i lus/ /mtha' yas pa yi gzugs kyi 85—183

me bkug la/ /argha 7dbul bar brtags nas de bzhin du/ /blo mchog ldan pa'i mdun du gzugs sogs gzhag / ji ltar gsungs bzhin yon tan 'dod pa yis/ /(bde bzhin gshegs tshogs de bzhin spyan drangs la/ /argha ②la sogs brtags (gete de bzhin du/ /bder ༷gegashegs gsungs pa'i mchod pa la sogs bya/ /de nas byin za la ni brtag (6nyebya ba/ /bsreg ⑨byas bkang ste de yang spar 3)ba'i phyir/ /de nas bsreg (khebyas bkang ste rim gyis ni/ /rgyal la sogs la brgya rtsa brgyad du brtag /de nas sbyong ba'i sngags kyi rgyal po la/ /bsreg par bya ba nyi shu rtsa gcig brtag /de nas spyan drangs yo byad lan gsum dang ske/ /argha bol sogs padma'i dkar zhal mchod/ /phyag na rdo rje padma zhags bsnams pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs/ /zhabs kyi padmas sdig mnan cing / /rgyan rnams kun ni rab rdzogs la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi hunyedabu rgyan mtho/ /bsams sam yang na bris kyang rung / /de yi snying pos de bzhin du/ /brgya phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /bye ba'i tshad du sbyin sreg 32bya/ /ci ste mtshan ma la sogs 'byung / /de bzhin sdig can rgyud ces bya//de nas thal bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsdu bar bya/ /thal ba de dang rus pa'i rdul/ /sngags kyis bebatab pa'i dri chu dang / /ba skyes 'o ma la sogs lngas/ /sbyong ba'i sngags kyis blo ldan gyis/ /'bum du bzlas pas brdzis nas ni/ /ga pur dri dang bsgos ④pa yis/ /'jim pa dang ni bsres nas 8kyang / /gzugs su bya ba'am yang na ni/ /mchod rimarten gyi ni ltar byas la/ /gcig gam chaganyis sam gsum mam hu3lnga/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad bar du/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas su/ /'bum phrag gnyis kyi 85—184

bar du bzlas/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar gyur tam/ /yang na gzugs kyi zhal 'dzum mamal/ /dri dang bdug pa 'od kyang rung / /snang ngam yang na ngad ldang ngam/ /lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs par ni snang gyur tam/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa dang / /me tog la sogs 'dor ba dang / /dung dang rnga la sogs pa'i sgra/ /gling bu pi bang la sogs rnams/ /ci ste mtshan ma 'di dag ni/ /sdig can blos ni ma mthong na/ /'bum gyi phrag ni (mibargyad stong ngam / /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bzlas par bya/ /de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang / /mtshan gcig thog thag mi nyal bzlas/ /de nas de yi sdig pa ni/ /dag pa nyid du nges par mthong / /lha yi lus kyi gzugs gyur la/ /rang gi rgyud du ngo shes 'gyur / /mtshan ma 'di dag shes nas ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis kyang //byams dang snying rjer ldan pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /yang na med par gyur na yang / /bzlas shing sgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /ming tsam legs ②par bris nas kyang / /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba dang / /yang na gzugs su bris kyang rung / /sbyin sreg 4mngon par dbang bskur na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /thal ba yungs kur rdogebye ma sogs/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas/ /bzlas pa byas te song nas kyang / /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i klung du dor/ /de ltar na ni sdig can yang / /ngan song las ni thar 'gyur na/ /dge ba'i mchog ni bskyed 6)pa dang / /byang chub sa bon bskyed pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas 'bras bu'i rgyu ldan pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin par ldan / /tshul khrims rgyud (7skudang rab ldan pa/ /bzod pa brtson 'grus mnyam 85—185

gzhag dang / /shes rab rnams kyis rgyu bsgoms 3)pa'i/ /'jig rten bsod nams ldan ci smos/ /myur du de yi ngan song ni/ /bcom par gyur te the tshom med / /dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed la/ /med par lta ba gang yin dang / /byang chub lam las rnam log pas/ /bstan la tshonanozhe sdang gnod byed cing / /sdig pa'i rang bzhin ma mthong ༄kyil/ /ma dang pha la snying ring zhing / /byang chub sems la brten gepa dang / /'dod chags bral ba bsad pa (gernams/ /ci ste ⑥lha rnams med gyur tam/ /sangs rgyas dge 'dun chos de bzhin/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs/ /shes rab thabs rnams med na ni/ /sdig can de dag mi thar (7zhes/ /bder (8)gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs lha/ /padma lta bu'i mig phye nas/ /legs zhes 7bya bas mnyes byas te/ /rab tu mgu bas nyu )mchod byas nas/ /brgya byin gzhan la phan brtson /spepas/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /shākya'i gtso bos bka' stsal pa/ /bden pa nyid du byas gyur nas/ /de nas de ni dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal las ni thar nas kyang / /dga' ldan gnas su sems can kun/ /phan phyir bde gshegs 'dra bar skyes/ /de nas dbang por bcas pa yi/rte/ /grags nyu2chen lha rnams gar byed cing / /mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod bya'i phyir/ / lha yi 7tshogs kyis mdun byas te/ /tshe 'di nyid la mchod pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu yang sems bskyed nas/ /lha rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /me tog bdug pa byug pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan la sogs/ /rgyan la sogs pa rab mdzes dang / /na bza' rin chen char la sogs/ /dga' ba'i tshal ni gang bar byas/ /de nas ya mtshan 85—186

cher gyur te/ /lha rnams kyis kyang phyag 'tshal nas/ /dga' ba'i tshal ni yid 'ong ba/ /kun nas gang bar gyur pa yi(1)/ /sna tshogs 'byung ba 'di ci lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /grogs po dag shes par gyis shig /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa 'di ni lha'i bu nor bu rin dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de yin no/ /mtshams med pa'i dbang du gyur pa yang myong zhing mthong ba'i chos 'di nyid la bde 'gro'i dbang du gyur pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar lags so/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu thams cad kyis khumagrin gcig tu tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med de/ /sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyis brlabs 4kyis dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris 55su skyes pa'i lha'i bu de ci 'dra ba zhig /de'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu ni ji lta bu lags6/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba de bdag cag lta bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha thams cad kyi snying skul 7bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba nyid kyi zhabs kyi mthe bo gnyis las phyung ngo / /byung nas kyang nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i lus thams cad snang bar byas nas snying gar nazhugs te bskul nas yang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i bu de nyid rab tu dga' bar gyur nas lus kyi 'od zer gyis dpag tshad brgya phrag stong tshun tshad kyi nam mkha'i ngos thams cad gsal bar byas te/ lha'i bu stong phrag du ma'i 'khor gyis 85—187

bskor cing mdun du byas nas/ lha'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos mi snang bar byas te 'ongs nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad gsal zhing snang bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das dang / brgya byin gnyis ma gtogs nyunyepa lha rnams kyi 'od zil gyis mnan to/ /de nas lha'i bu des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ②ma shākya mgon po yi / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan (7che/ /gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi sems can myur du glog bzhin grol/ /de nas skad cig ma de nyid kyi tshe shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi ⑥pad mo thams cad rin po che las byas pa/ dpag tshad brgya phrag stong du dri'i ngad ldang ba/ lha'i glu snyan pa'i sgra grag pa/ ya mtshan ⑦du ma yang dag par ston pa/ lha rdzas kyi glu dang / gar dang / brdung ba dang / gling bu dang / rnga 8)dang / ker ko rnams kyi sgra snyan pa 'byin porwapa zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar byung ⑩ste/ de turnyemathong nas kyang shin tu ya mtshan hurteskyes te 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /sngags kyi yon tan sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub rten pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab/ /tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med skye bsam yas/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis de mabalta bar 'dod nas yang thubacom ldan 'das la nyusnye'adi skad ces gsol to/ /lha'i bu de dang / de'i 'khor gyi tsodakyil 'khor rnams blta bar 'tshal lo51 sgyu/ /bcom ldan 'das blta bar 'tshal lo/ /bde bar nyusnyegashegs pa blta bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tsheyang mthe bo gnyis nas 'od zer phyung ste/ 'od zer dri ma med pa des lha'i bu de dang lha'i 'khor de dag kun du snang bar byas te bskul nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de 85—188

nas nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis 0)bcom ldan 'das dang / brgya byin gnyis kyi gdan ma gtogs par dga' ba'i tshal thams cad g.yos par byas te/ lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas shing bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang du ri 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e rdo skama'o sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs 4)ya mtshan (nyeche/ /gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi/ /sems can lha gnas myur du skyes / /de nas lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba la sogs pa'i lha'i bu de zhudag gis bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dang / gser dang / dngul dang ske/ do shal dang / se mo do dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang /snyan cha la sogs pa rgyan gyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs du ma dang / gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan dang / lda ldi dang / rnga (7)ma la sogs pa yo byad kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa dang seng ge'i gdan dang gzims sbyon cha dang pho brang dang ske/ gzhal med khang dang / khang bu brtsegs pa la sogs pa gnas kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa dang / me tog dang / spos la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa dang / rang gi 1༄lus dang / ngag dang / sems rnams kyang phul te / ba lang 0dang / rta dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / spre'u dang /dgo nyunyeb dang / thug re dang / ma he dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang /chu srin dang / phag dang / ra dang / glang dang / ba dang / 'dod pa'i ba bzhon tsol sogaṅge pa bzhin 1 pa'i khyad par du ma yang phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyang mngon par mchod/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyang mngon par mchod de/85—189

legs so zhes bya ba gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang / brgya byin gnyis la bla ma dang bste 3)stang du byas te phyag 'tshal nas de bzhin du song ngo / /de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams mchog tu ya mtshan ladu gyur te/bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du legs so zhes bya bas bstod cing mchod de phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du ma 'ongs pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams 'chang ba dang klog ②pa la spro bar bgyi ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i yon tan bshad du gsol/brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams ngas bshad kyis/ legs par (4)nyon la yid la zung 5shig /lha'i bu rnams dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du thos par 'gyur gyi/ sems can ma rabs rnams kyis ni 6rim yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du nye bar 'gro 7)bar 'gyur gyi/ sems can phal pa ma rabs kyis tsho ci ni ma yin no/ /sems can bsam pa nges pa rnams dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i yon tan mang po la mngon par 'dod pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ mdor (9rin thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la brten ⑩pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas brgya byin dang /tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu de dag yang dag par dga' ba skyes nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni snod du gyur pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag cag ni snod du gyur pa ste/ gang gi slad du bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bgyi ba'i 85—190

mtshan brjod pa 'di bcom ldan 'das padma'i ①zhal nyid nas thos pas bdag cag ni ngan song gis 'jigs par mi 'gyur/ dus ma lags par 'chi bas 'jigs ②par mi 'gyur/ 'chi ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor na/ba dang ske/ rnam par 'jig 90pa la sogs pas 'jigs par mi 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni gdon mi 'tshal bar sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pa'i snod ⑤du gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das brtag pa'i rgyal po 'dis sems can rnams kyi dom bgyid pa gang lags pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gi 'bras bu ni cir yi'agyur/ rnam par smin pa ni cir (7'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po de dag ni skyes bu dam pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du blta (0bar bya ste/ lha'i dbang po gang gi phyir 'jig rten pha rol du song tshoḍanas mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu spong lho )bar byed pa dang / byang chub la gdon mi za bar brtan 11par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa (8phyir mi ldog pa la rab tu 'jog pa'i phyir te/ lha'i dbang po dper na khyod kyis 32lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa'i don byas pa bzhin no/ /lha'i dbang po de ltar gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'i sems can de dag /ci so so'i skye bo yin snyam sems sam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma lags so/ /lha'i dbang po sems can de dag ni skyes 8bu dam pa chen po/gzhan la phan 'dogs pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang phyag bya ba/85—191

mchod pa/ rjed pa/ bste ①stang du bya ba/ 'phrag ②la bkur ①bar bya ba yin na/ lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i bu rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang ske/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde medapon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ske/ gnod sbyin chen po nor bu bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po chen po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa la rab tu gnas pa rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo gnyis dang / 'phrog ma bu lnga brgyas bskor ba rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde (snyedapon chen po partsi ka dang / pa: ka (lechen po la sogs pa dang / gang gzhan dag kyang rgya che zhing rgya che tso)ba'i lha dang —/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / 'dre dang / rims dang / gdon dang /dug dang / skar ma la sogs pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig gtu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'dus shing tshogs pa thams cad kyis skyes bu dam pa chen po de'i rkang pa gnyis mgo bos blang bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na rtag par 9ḍa rgyun du dus thams cad du bsrung bob dang / bskyab pa dang ske/ sba bar bgyi'ohum/ /bcom ldan 'das gang du brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pas 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par 'chad par 'gyur ram/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ske/ ba dan la sogs pas mchod par 'gyur ram/ rgyal rigs sam/bram ze'i rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs 1nyerigs sam/ gzhan yang 85—192
