rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i bu'am/ rgyal po'i bu mo'am/ rgyal po'i btsun mo'am/rgyal po'i 'khor pho'am/ rgyal po'i 'khor mo'am/ gang su yang rung bas 'chang zhing klog pa dang / gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par 'chad cing ston pa'i bar du bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'dus shing tshogs pa thams cad de'i bran du gyur pa lags so/ /rang gi skye bo dang / gnyen gyi skye bo dang / yongs kyi skye bo dang /hu) grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal (gudang ske/ ljongs dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams yongs su bskyang ( bar bgyi'oli / /dus dus su char dbab par bgyi'obu/ /'bru la sogs pa bskyed par bgyi'o(be/ /skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bsgrub rtso par bgyi'o(snyel/ /pha rol gyi phru ma mang po gzhom par bgyi'o⑨/ /sems can ma rungs pa gnod cing 'tshe bob pos de la mi phan pa'i sems bskyed pa gang yin pa de dag brlag par nyurnyebagyi ba'i slad du bsgrub nyu2par bgyi/ ma rungs par 32bgyi/ de la bdud kyi las kyang bgyi/ gnod par bgyi ba la yang nye bar gnas par bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das mdor na ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams ④la brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lta bur gnas pa lags pas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bu bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /lha'i dbang po khyod kyis ji ltar smras pa de de bzhin te/ brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di ni de bzhin du blta bar bya'o / /lha'i dbang po legs kyis/ 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i sems can sdig pa'i chos la kun tu spyod pa/ sems can dmyal ba'i dbang du gyur pa/'khor ba mi gtsang ba'i dong du bying ba'i sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde bar 8bya ba'i phyir yun ring por bag yod par byos la sgrubs 8shig / ngan 85—193

song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa las brtag pa dang po'o// //1)bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi (gemathus brtag pa'i rgyal po brtag pa phyi ma 'di bshad do/ /dpa' bo gdan las bzhengs ①nas ni/ /dgyes ④shing rdo rje gsor nas kyang / /shākya'i dbang po dgyes (5)mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song thams cad 3)rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba rang gi snying po 'di nyid kyi ༅thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da duXha (pen badzra rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a 3)mā maya bi sho dha na badzra rgyu phaṭa / oṃ sarba kurma ā (2ba ra ṇa ni bhasmyu 32ku ru rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ phroṃ rgyu 0bi nā 3gesha ya ā ba ra ṇa nyageni rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ 1 tsho'i sho dha ya ā ba ra ṇa nyusnyeni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na sarba ā ba ra ṇa nya ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ zhu )sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ḍa ཿā du geb ra ṇa tsurteni rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ rtsu ha ra ha ra (nyesarba ā geb ra ṇa ni rgyu gi9phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā sdo tshob ra ṇa ni bi sbo ṭa 22ya ju phaṭa/ oṃ bṛ ta bṛ ta sarba ā ba ra ṇa 39ni rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇa rdu )ni hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sbyin sbyin sarba ā ba ra ṇa sa1ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༷ ma da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga ti ho rtu 2 rtsu sa phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba bre ta ka zhugeg ti he hūm̐ (9rgyu na tshophaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka sgogeg ti he rtu sgorta/ ṭaṃ )phaṭa/ de nas de dag rnams kyi yo byad bshad dol/ /oṃ sarba a pā ya 62bi sho dha ni/ dha ma dha ma dhū (rtepa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba durga ti bi sho dha ni putpa 42bi lo ki 4thuni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a cige pā ya bi sho dha 85wa 194

ni dzñā na ā lo ka ka ri 1)rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā 5nyaya ga ti gan dha nā rin༄sha ni gan dha ba ti ④rgyu phaṭa/ sgo ba rnams kyi sngags la/ oṃ sarba na ra ka ga ti ā kur ṣa ṇi 5rgyu dzaḥ4)phaṭa/ oṃ sarba na ra ka ga ti a rgyus ra ṇi hūm̐ (pe (84)phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ban stidha na bi rtso )mo tsa ni rtsu baṃ 12phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā 32ya ga ti ga ha na bi nā 1lhasha ni hūm̐ hoḥ(gephaṭa/ de nas dkyil 'khor bshad de/ 'khor lo 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsibs brgyad can/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs rten ldan/ /nang gi rim pa bris nas ni/ /lte ba'i nang du shākya yizhuge/ /bdag po thub pa gzhag par 7bya/ /lag na rdo rje stobs chen ni/ /dpa' bo de yi spyan sngar hūṃ 7bri/ /rgyab tu 'khor los sgyur 32ba bri/ /g.yas phyogs rgyal ba'i gtsug tor la/ /g.yon par rnam par rgyal ba bri/ /gzi brjid phung po me yi nyu7phyogs//dbang po'i phyogs su gdugs dkar po/ /rnam par 'thor ba rlung gi phyogs/ /rnam par 'joms pa nee ri tyar )/ /bris nas phyi rol bri bya ste/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /seng ge rta babs brgyan tsu par bya/ /dpa' bos lcags kyu du 3zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu snyan rnams gzhag /grwa 22yi phyogs ni thams cad du / /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /de nas dri zhim dri la sogs/ /rang gi cilus ni bskus nas kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin mas cizhugs nas ni/ /oṃ dzaḥrgyu bo hoḥbha ga bān/ e 32gye hi ma hā kā stiru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ tshos ma ya st+waṃ zhes pas lha rnams thams cad spyan drang ngo / /de nas gshegs par mos pa bskyed /de mchod pa byas nas/ de bzhin du bcug 20ste dbang bskur na ngan song thams cad las rnam par grol te/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dang / gong nas gong du sa rnams su yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang 85wa 195

'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas su yang gdon mi za bar 'grub par ①'gyur rol/ / snga ma ②bzhin du las thams cad kyang byed cing thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /byab ①pa byas pas ni rims nad thams cad dang /gdon dang dug la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ④rgyu zhes bya bas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /brtag pa gzhan gyi cho ga thams cad kyang sgrub ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po rgyal sogs pa ngan song gi rgyud kyi dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi shi ba'i ro'am/gzugs brnyan nam/ ming la sogs pa bris te bzlas pa dang / sbyin sreg ⑦dang ske/ dbang rnams kyis snga ma bzhin du ngan song thams cad las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes seng ge'i lta stangs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas te/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya dam pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes bskul ba'i thugs mnga' ⑧ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyis 0byin gyis rlobasatso / /mnyam par gzhag pas dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi 7thal mo sbyar / /sangs rgyas bder 8gshegs skyes rnams kyis(rte/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi tsophyag rgyar 8bshad/ /rnal 'byor rig hustepas mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo snyim par sbyar ba ni/ /rtag tu padma'i 0rigs nyid kyi/ /padma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad / /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying gar hu༄gung mo'i mtha' sbyar ba/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i thal mo gan rkyal du pang hurtedu bzhag la/ /de'i ( ༷ )steng du g.yas pa bzhag ste/ mthe bo'i ngos gnyis sprad la zhi ba'i lta bas blta du gleb 'di ni de 85—196

bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ste/ dam tshig yin par bshad do/ /de nyid las bzlog ste ltag nyunye'og bsnol la mthe bo (snyedang / mthe'u chung gnyis gcig la gcig lu gu rgyud kyi tshul du bsnol te snying gar sa)gzhag pa 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo rdzogs par sbyar ba las mthe bo dang / mthe'u chung gnyis bsnyams rdo la lhag ma rnams brkyang 5)ba 'di ni padma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdam (6)pa bsdams pa las/gung mo gnyis rdo rje 'dra bar bsnyams (7)la/ mthe bo dang mthe'u chung (2)gnyis brkyang ⑨ba 'di ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe 0bo dang mthe'u chung gnyis de bzhin du byas la/ mdzub mo gnyis dang srin yi lag padmo 'dra bar bkug pa ni/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i thams cad sbyong ba'i 8phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni dbang bskur 3steba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe'u chung dang mthe bo tsoso sor bsdams la8/ lhag ma rnams brkyang ba ni/ sdig pa thams cad sreg 0pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pas de bzhin du bsgyur 1 zhing bya ba ni lha thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /snyim pa bzed la gyen du 'thor 12ba ni bdug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de las 'og nas gyen du 'thor 19ba ni me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las 3 tshomathe bo gnyis gyen du bsnyams 7la mdun du 22'dzin pa ni mar me'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las dung 'dra bar byas pa ni dri'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las rab tu brkyang ste 'dzin pa ni gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gung mo gnyis nang du bcug pa ni argha'i 3phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las gung mo gnyis bsnyams hote/tshigs dang po bcag bul sor mo thams cad brkyang ba ni rnam par 'thor ba'i 85wa 197

phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo dang ༅mthe'u chung gnyis bkug pa ni rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las 'od zer 'bar ba 'dra ba ni ②gzi brjid phung po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las spyi bor bskor ba ni gdugs dkar ③po'i ⑤phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe'u ⑤chung gnyis bsnol te/ mdud la gyen du bskor ba ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i yiphyag rgya'o / /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rdo rjer byas la mdzub mo gnyis rin po che lta bur byas te/ lhag ma rnams 'od zer 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du mdzub mo gnyis rdo rjer byas la/ sor mo lhag ma rnams bsdams nas rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rnam par rgyal ba'i'o/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin du byas la g.yon pa mi 'jigs pa ⑦phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yin no/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang (sheste rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i'o(pe/ /de nyid las me tog 'dra bar byas pa ni mda'i 0'o/ /de nyid las slar bkug 37ste/ mthe bo chogeganyis rtse mo sprad pa ni blo gros 8legs pa'i'o / /de nyid las tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin po che'i'o/ /de nyid las sor mo rnams (7'od zer 'dra bar 'gyed pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o/ /de nyid las spyi bor bzhag pa dpal gyi'o/ /de nyid las mdun du bzhag pa ni tsobazhad pa'i'o/zhe / /de nyid las padma 'dra bar nyu 7byas pa ni padma'i'o/ /de bzhin nyid las rtse mo gnyis bkug pa ni ral gri'i'o(/snye/ /de nyid las gdu bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'khor lo'i'o/ /de nyid las padma'i nyuste'adab ma 'dra ru stabar byas pa ni lce'i'o / /de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bskyed 37pa ni rgya gram mo/ /de nyid las tso85—198

shin tu bskyed ①pa ni bsrung ②ba'i'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /dam du ①bkug pa ni bsdams pa'i'o/ /bsdams pa nyid mdun du bzhag ④pa ni bdug pa'i'o⑤/ /de nyid gyen du ⑥bstod pa ni phreng ba'i 'o / /mdun du mthe bo ⑦gnyis bsdams te/ bskor ba ni mar me'i'o de nyid byug pa ltar byas pa ni dri'i'o(8)/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sprad pa ni zhags pa'i'o/ /de nyid las gcig la gcig mdud ⑨pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o/ /de nyid las bskyod pa ni mnyes pa'i'o0/ /sku gzugs kyi cho ga yang 'dir de bzhin du byas te/ cung zad du na bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs bri'ol/ /yang na sku gzugs ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshul 7du bris la me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de'i spyan sngar 'bum tsam zhig sngar bsnyen ke/pa byas nas las thams cad bya'o/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das las kyi rnam par smin pa gang gis 0lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba de dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi dbang du gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i byin gyis brlabs 8kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i dbang po nyon cig /'di ni sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi ris 'di nyid na/ mtha' 'khob pa'i rigs ngan du gtogs pa'i rgyal po lus mi bde ba hunyezhes bya ba zhig tu gyur te/des mi shes pa'i dbang gis mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen tsol brten 7pas rgyal po 'dod pa'i phyir rang gi pha 'tsho ba dang phral 'o2bar gyur pa dang / ma de'i mya ngan 85wa 199

gyis gzir bas ma yang dus las 'das so/ /lan cig ci zhig gi rkyen gyis nags tshal stug po gzhan zhig tu rtse zhing dga' ba'i phyir nye bar song ngo de na drang srong dgos pa med par byams pa zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de mthong ba dang rgyal po shin tu ya mtshan ②skyes nas/ kye ma 'di lta bu seng ge dang / stag ②dang ske/ ri dgas dang / phag rgod dang / ba lang dang / ma he la sogs pa dang ske/ sbrul dang / sre mo dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrang bu mchu rings dang /sbrul gdug pa can rnams kyis gtse ba/ bza' ba dang / btung ba dang /bgo lab dang / longs spyod rnams dang rnam par bral ba/ rlung dang grang bas yongs su gdung zhing 'tshe ba de na bdag nyid chen po 'di gnas so snyam par sems kyis ④brtags nas de'i drung du nye bar song ste phyin pa dang / de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /drang srong chen po khyod ci'i phyir na rlung dang tsha ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis (gebadag la gnod par byed/ drang srong ༅gis ⑦smras pa/skyes bu chen po bskal (shedapa brgya stong phrag du mar sgrib nyupa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba las/ sdug bsngal gyi khur bu cung 0zad tsam zhig blangs 7nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas 'di ni sdug bsngal ma yin gyi/ skad cig tsam mamartson/ yud tsam zhig yul gyi bde ba rjes su myong bas bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma mtha' thug pa med par nyusnyedamyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes su myong bar 'gyur ro//yul gyi bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir pha ma la sogs pa yang gsod par 'gyur na srog chags gzhan lta ci smos te/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun yongs su mi shes pa'i phyir sdig pa thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong 85wa 200

gis smras pa'i tshig de skad ces thos pa dang shin tu 'jigs skrag skyo ste/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyis gzir nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun zhes bya ba de ci zhig /de'i rang bzhin ji lta bu yin pa dka' thub chen po thos shig dang / de la kho bo yang skyabs su mchi'o3)/ /pha ma la gtses pa dang / srog chags rnams kyi srog bcad na sdig pa ji lta bu zhig thob ②par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun du )yongs su shes na bsod nams ci 'dra ba gezhig yongs su 'thob/ pha ma ma bsad 95)pa dang ske/ srog ⑤chags rnams kyang ma bsad (menyen bsod nams ci 'dra ba cig 3)'thob / 'bras bu ji lta bu zhig 'thob/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod spangs na bsod nams dang 'bras bu ci 'dra ba zhig 'thob/ de nas drang srong des de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci ste sems can chen po khyod/ /nga yi tshig 'di nyan 'dod na/ /thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshol la(pe/ /gus par nyon dang bshad par bya'o / /de bzhin bgyi zhes bsgrubs nas ni/ /ci bdog tshipas ni mchod byas te / /sangs rgyas spyod yul sangs rgyas kyi/ /zab mo'i chos ni nyan par gyur31/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs dag pa32/ /thos 12nas kyang ni skyabs su song / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib med chos/ /rgyal pos thos nas dga' bar gyur57/ /yi dgas byol song dmyal ba rnams/ /sdig pa kun gyi 'bras bu ste/ /yul spyod pa dang srog chags rnams/ /gsod nya2cing shin tu mi bzad panyunye/ /pha ma gtses 0pa'i rgyu las byung / /bskal pa du mar rab sdug bsngal/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad 'osnyepa/ /mgon med skyabs kyang med pa ste517/ /thos nas mya ngan zug rngu yis/ /rang gi yid la gdungs pa na/ /ji ltar rlung gis mar me 85—201

bzhin / /de nyid du ni dus las 'das/ /las kyi ①rnam smin de yis ni/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i lhar skyes nas②/ /brgya byin lha yi dbang po yi/ /blon po gzugs dang ldan pa la/ /lha rnams kun dang yid mthun (kyezhing / /rab dga' bde dang ldan par skyes/ /bde ba'i mchog ni myong gyur stinas/ /ngan song du yang ltung bar gyur(ge/ /de nas da ⑥ltar lha dbang po/ /khyod kyi mthus kyang de nyid ni/ /dga' ldan gnas ni dga' ba'i mchog /bde mang kun gyi gnas su skyes / / lha yi chadabang po nyon cig dang / /gang gi tshe sngon byung ⑧ba de'i dus na byung ba'i drang srong du gyur pa de ni gzhan yin par khyed kyis shes par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par ⑨rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di 7nyid do/ /de'i rtsonyephar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni gzhan yin par 0khyod kyis blta bar 8mi bya ste/ lha'i dbang po de'i tshe de'i dus na khyod de'i phar gyur to/ /ma gang yin pa de ni chagazhan yin par mi blta blaste / de'i tshe de'i dus na sha tsi ka nyid yin no/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de ni gzhan yin par mi blta'itshe/ lha'i 'khor 'di dag nyid yin no/ /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i bu rnams yid rab tu mgu zhing rangs te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas spu rnams langs shing nyunyergyal ba rgyal ba zhes skad chen por bos nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la ming bcu pa 'dis mngon par bstod de gsol ba btab bo/ / ko ṭa nyusheko ṭa kṣa/ ko ṭa ba/ ko ṭa ko ṭa/ ko ṭa bcu/ ko ṭi ka /ko hu la kṣa/ ko la bzhu )/ ko la ko la ⑥brtso/ko tsho nyel sta thā 3yi ti zhes byas nas/ brgya byin la sogs lha mchog rnams/ /sems can kun la phan pa dang / /tshe dang nad med spel ba'i phyir/ /mgon po 85—202

khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe thung ba dang / skal ba 1stechung ba rnams ②kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba dang / tshe bsring (kyeba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ gsang ba'i bdag po bshad ④du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sgibargya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i 'khor mang po de dag la gzigs nas legs so zhes bya bas ⑥mgu bar byas te/tshangs pa la sogs pa'i ⑦lha'i bu rnams gang khyed (nyekyis 'di lta bu'i spobs yodapa yang dag pa ⑩yang dag par 7bskyed pa de ni legs so legs so/ /legs par sgrubs shig dang 3debashad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sems can thams cad kyi tshe dpag tu med pas khyab par 8'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas tshe dang / ④bsod nams dang /ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med par 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nyanyenas phyung ngo / /oṃ pu rtse ⑩phu khye nyi tshom hā pu 28/ a pa ri nyu)mi ta ā ༷ )yur pu ṣyo 0tsā na si bha ro pa tsi te ka ri ( ༄ṇi tsho khug hā / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs ( ho'adi bshad ma thag tu ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song dang ske/ yi dgas rnams su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad grol bar bdag nyid kyis zhunyeyang dag par shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu snang bar byas te/ snang bar byas nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi chos kyi yi ge de nyid du zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 85wa 203

zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshe dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i hu)gzungs 'di bshad do/ /oṃ a mi (kyete/ a mi gta ud bha be/a mi lita saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi mādhes/ a mi ta bi māntaryata/ gā mi ni/ sarba kurma kle ⑦sha kṣa yaṃ ka re swā hā/ de nas 'di bshad ma thag tu de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdon mi za bar sgrib pa rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa gcod 6)pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 59)'di rang gi thugs ka bonas phyung ngo / /oṃ kai ka ni rka ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā /skyes ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba kurma (1nye pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba sa tā nāñtsa tsog hā/ 'di bshad ma thag tu yang thams cad de bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 58sgrib pa thams cad dri ma med cing rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa rnams ma lus par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /oṃ rasne rasne/ ma hā rasne/ ratna si bha she2be/ ratna kyi ra ṇarsha9/ 1 ratna mā la18/ bi shud dhe/ sho dha hu)yasgo )/ sarba pā paṃ cas tāṭa/snye/de nas 'di bshad ma thag tu bdud kyi gnas thams cad bcom/ rnam par bcom par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis shusnyegadon mi za bar mi choms pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung na ngo / /oṃ a mo gha a pra ti ha ta/ sarba ā ltab ra ṇa/85—204

bi nā sha ①ni/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsang sngags 'di bshad ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ yang dag par rab tu g.yos so/ /bskyod②/ rab tu bskyod/ yang dag par rab tu bskyod 5)do/ /bskul / rab tu bskul/ yang dag par rab tu bskul nas rmad ④kyi ya mtshan 5cidu ma 'jig rten du snang bar gyur to(6ci/ /de nas dkyil 'khor ni 'di yin te/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo ba rnams dang ldan pa ste/ /rta babs bzhi dang ldan par tsobya/ /lte ba dang ni sgo khyud ldan/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bya ste/ /rtsibs bzhi dag dang ldan pa la/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor ldan par bya/ /de yi dbus su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen podu/ /phyag na rdo rje dril bsnams 59 shing / zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal 'dzum bri/ /shar gyi rtsibs kyi steng du ni/ /mgon po mi bskyod bri bar bya/ /lho yi phyogs su rin chen bri/ /nub phyogs chu 7skyes padma la/ /byang phyogs su ni gdon mi za/ /dpa' bo stobs chen bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /'khor los sgyur shib chas pa 33dang / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdog 'dra zhing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dang / /phyag ni 12mchog sbyin mi 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung skobazhugs bri/ /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /de bzhin bdug sogs thams cad bri/ /sgo ba dag kyang khros pa la/ /khro ba'i dbang du gyur pa bri/ /de nas rnal 'byor can nyid zhugs/ /sngags kyi lha rnams spyan drangs te bla/ /dzaḥtshe baṃ hoḥ1rte/ oṃ 1 bha ga bān 16e hye hi 3 stas ma ya sdi lha/ de nas gtso bo byon pa dang / /mdor na mchod pa byas nas kyang / /'chi bdag sbrul gyis 'jigs ldan rnams/ /'chi bdag gzhom phyir gzhug )par bya/ /oṃ 85wa 205

badzra sa ma ya ①rgyu/ rdo rje ti rin ②ti ri bcings la/ /lag na rin chen thogs ②te gzhug④ /yang na me tog phreng ba ste/ /de ni dkyil 'khor nyid du dor / /oṃ pra tītstsha ⑤badzra rgyu/ de nas mna'i dam tshig sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya rtsu/ de nas 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra hā su ud gha ṭa ⑥ya hūṃ/ de nas 'di ⑦bstan par bya ste/ oṃ badzra pa shya 0ho/ /de nas 'dis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra a snyi spuṇiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ bud dha a bhi ⑩ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna a gi 0ṇiñtsa ṭwāṃ/ oṃ padma a gi ṣiñtsa hrīḥtso/ oṃ kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥtso/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ka ④la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa rghaṃ/ oṃ bud dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna ka la sha a sgyi ṣiñtsa ṭwāṃ/oṃ padma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ0/ oṃ kurma 8ka la sha a gi ṣiñtsa aḥ0/ de nas phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ ratna mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ oṃ badzra pas tshes ba lo ba na a sgyi ṣiñtsa 8spyo/ oṃ bud dha mu dru a gi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra mu drwa a gi ṣiñtsa /du kye / oṃ ratna mu dā 6a bhi ṣiñtsa ṭwāṃ 3/ oṃ padma mu dā 0a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ/ oṃ kurma mu dā ⑥a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ phyo/ oṃ badzra nā tsom a snyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ oṃ ṭwāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ ⑦ / oṃ badzra kurma zhunyes sgyi ṣiñtsa rtsu aḥ kū/ oṃ badzra tsakra a gi ṣiñtsa hūṃ rghaṃ/oṃ badzra tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ bla )a bhi ṣiñtsa rtsu hūṃ hūṃ oṃ oṃ mas/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ / aḥ.aḥ.aḥ 3/ oṃ badzra dhā ra ṇi 0a bhi ṣiñtsa rghaṃ/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dhā ra ṇi ④a gi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna dhā ra ṇi byas rnyi ṣiñtsa ṭwāṃ/ oṃ padma dhā gyur ṇi 0a sgyi ṣiñtsa hrīḥsoge / oṃ kurma 0ṅgā ra ṇi rtso )a sgyi ṣiñtsa aḥ0/ oṃ 8ta thā ga ta gugya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/oṃ badzra gugya a bhi zhukṣañtsa rghaṃ/ oṃ ratna gu hya ④a bhi dhikṣañtsa rta8/ oṃ padma gu hya (nye.a rnyi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ63/ oṃ kurma mgu hya sro )a gi ṣiñtsa aḥ(nye/ oṃ prarnyo pā 9ya sa ma yo ga 85wa 206

a sgyi ṣiñtsa rdu ཿāḥl/ de ltar dbang bskur nas tshe bsring ba'i rig pa 'di sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ : ②badzra ā ④lu ṣe ⑤rgyu āḥyi/ de'i sgrub pa ni 'di yin te/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i tshe zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang mchog ⑦sbyin du mdzad pa las bdud rtsi 'dzag ⑧pa bri'o/ /de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po'i lag pa thal mo brkyang la/ gdong gyen du bcom ldan 'das la lta ⑨bar bris la mchod pa rnam pa lngas ⑩mchod de/ de'i spyan sngar 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya ba dang mchod pa chen po byas te ba dmar ser gyi mar snod sar par bcug la rdo rje g.yon pas mnan te/ bcom ldan 'chodas rab tu sems shing mtshan thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dri ma mnam zhing sngon ⑩ma byung ba'i dri'i ngad ldang la rlangs pa'am/ du ba'am/ me byung ngam/ 'od zer ram / me sgron nam/ 'od byung ngam/ de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma byung na mar de'am / mar sar ram/ til mar ram/ chu'am/ 'o ma'am/ zho'am/chang ngam/ khrag gam/ zhag gam/ klad 8pa'am/ sha'am/ gang yang rung ba la rab tu bsgrubs 8te/ nang 8par sngar bsrung tsob la sogs pa byas nas bdag nyid sbyangs te 'thungs tsosam zos na mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin du byung na ni nam zla ba dang nyi ma yod kyi ⑩bar du tshe ring zhing rdo rje dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ tha mas ni tha ma 'grub pas 'di la the tshom ni med do/ /mtshan ma ma byung na yang 'jig rten na tsond med/ ldob skyen/ lus la skra dkar dang gnyer ma med par 'gyur ro/ /lus brtan (rtezhing tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bzlas pa byas pa tsam gyis zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang la 85—207

sogs pa'i las rnams brtag mi dgos par 'gyur te the tshom med do/ /de nas ①rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi snying po bshad par 'tshal gyis / bcom ldan 'das kyis gebaka' stsal du gsol/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bka' stsal du gsol/ rgyal po chen po rnams legs kyis ( —)shod cig byadang / ngas kyang rjes su yi rang zhing byin gyis brlab dunapar bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyis (peganang zhing rjes su yi rangs te7)ske/ byin gyis brlabs pas rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ beetsho na/ de nas dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung gis 59 kyang rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ 27/ de nas grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags (11skyes pos kyang rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ birtog/ de nas klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang nyu)gis kyang rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ kṣa/ de nas de dag gi chadakyil 'khor bshad de/gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /dkyil 'khor lngas ni brgyan 8pa ste/ /de yi dbus su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje 'gying 8bcas bri/ /de yi g.yon gyi phyogs su ni/ /rnam thos bu dge'i lag pa na/ /be con ne'u le thogs pa dang / /rin chen rgyan gyis nyu snabargyan pa dang / /sbom zhing seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs18/ /gser mdog gzi can ldan par bri/ /mkhas pas bum pa bzang 19la sogs/ /rin chen chu bo 'bab par bri/ /mdun du yul 'khor srung nyid ni/ /pi bang len pa brtson pa dang / /mdzes shing kha dog ljang khu 3 )ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa 7bri/ /g.yas phyogs dpa' bo lus 'phags po/ /ral gri lag na 85wa 208

thogs pa ①zi/ /nub phyogs su ni mig mi bzang / /rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog /sbrul mgo bdun gyis ②bskor ba la/ /mig kyang dmar zhing shin tu 'bar / / sgo yi ༅phyogs ni thams cad du/ /sgo ba ④rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya zhes bya bas/ /sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs nas kyang ske/ /bcom ldan 'das ni spyan drangs te/ /de nas rgyal po spyan drang ngo / /spyan drangs ⑤nas ni mkhas pas mchod/ / cho ga (7bzhin du argha ⑦dbul/ /de nas sngags mkhan sngags 'di dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya 'dis/ /slob ma rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /bram ze la sogs de bzhin te/ /me tog rin chen thogs te zhugs/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ de nas me tog gam rin po che 'dis dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra /shepra tītstsha ྅ ma hotta po)ma/ gang la bab pa'i rgyal po ni/ /de ni 'dis 'grub gzhan du med/ /de nas grwa na bzhag pa yitshe/ /bum pa bzhis ni dbang bskur te/ /dang po phyag na rdo rje yisanyurnye/ /phyag rgyas dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /de la sogs pa go rims kyis/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du dbang bskur na/ /rgyal po ma yin rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgyal po yin na che bar 'gyur / /'dzam bu'i 1 gling dbang dpal dang ldan/ /gling bzhi pa la dbang ba'i mchog /lan bzhir 51 dbang ni bskur ba dang / /lan bzhir gzhug par byas na yini/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bdag /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang 32 bar byam / /bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/ /bran dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / /pho brang 'khor du bcas pa yi/ sna/ /rgyal po rtag tu bskyang bar bgyi/ /de gnod gzhan gyi phru ma dang / /de yi nad dang 'chi bdag gi/ /'jigs dang mu ge la sogs pa'i/ /gnod pa rnams nyusnyeni gzhom par bgyi/ /rnam thos bus ni rgyas 85—209

par bgyi/ /yul 'khor srung gis ①zhi bar bgyi/ /phyugs chadang gnyen bcas dus min pa'i/ /'chi bdag lus 'phags po yis 'joms/ /mig mi bzang gis bkra shis shing / /mu ge la sogs rnam par 'joms/ /mdor na bdag gis de yi snini/ /re ④dang bsam pa kun bgyi ⑤ste/ /ji ste nges pa ma lags na//phyag na rdo rje la 'khus 'gyur/ /de nas phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis ⑥bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis kyang sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi snying po rnams dbul bar bgyi'o/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ra / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams legs so legs so/ /legs kyis duphul cig(sher /de nas 'byung po rnams kyi 0bdag po dbang ldan la sogs pas rang rang gi snying po rnams phul ba/ oṃ khri/ oṃ matso/ oṃ a/ oṃ ya/ oṃ ri8/oṃ ba / oṃ ya3nye/ oṃ ku/ oṃ a/ oṃ bra/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /mgon po dbus su de bzhin gzhag /phyogs skyong rang gi phyogs gnas ④su/ /gzhag bya spyan sngar nyi ma dang ske/ /phag gi gzugs dang gnyis bzhag ste/ /sgo ba rnams kyang de bzhin nol/ /de nas spyan drangs de kun la/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid zhugs nas kyang / /slob ma rnams ni gzhug (8bya zhing / /phyogs skyong rang gi sngags btab pa'itshe/ /bum pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas phan par 'dod pa yis/ /bsgrub phyir snying po sbyin par bya/ / phyogs skyong nyamarang gi phyogs gnas rnams/ /brtag mi dgos mepar 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas de dag mgu nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang rgyal 85—210

rigs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs ①te/dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa de dag /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis rtag (2)par dus thams cad du bsrung ①ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi phru ma kun gzhom ④par bgyi/ dus dus su char pa dbab par bgyi/ 'bru dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po chen po gshin rjes bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang rgyal po chen po de'i tshe bsring (gebar bgyi'o/ /dus ma nyalags par 'chi ba brgyad po so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /srin po rnams kyi bdag po chen po ni ri tis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / bram ze dang /rgyal rigs dang / mi'am/ gzhan gang yang rung ba dag la nad dang / yi dgas dang / 'dres mi 'jigs par bgyi(3)/ srin po la sogs pas 'jigs par mi bgyi/ dus ma lags pa'i 'chi bdag gis 'jigs par mi bgyi ste /dus thams cad du bsrung ri rib dang / bskyab pa dang / sba (9)bar bgyi'o/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po chen po ba ru ṇas 1 shākyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang rtag (1par dus thams cad du rgyal nyunyepo de dang /yul thams cad so sor bskyang bar nyusnyebagyi/ kun du bsrung rngubar bgyi/ 'bru rnams bskyed par bgyi/ klu'i nyes pa rnams mi 'byung bar bgyi/ thog dang ser ba rnams mi dbab par bgyi/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams so sor dgag par tshebagyi'o/ /de nas rlung gi bdag pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /85wa 211

bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang sems can chen po de la dus thams cad du rlung gis ①'jigs pa mi 'byung bar bgyi/ ②dus ma ②lags pa'i rlung mi 'byung bar bgyi/ 'bru dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu thams cad bskyed par bgyi/'jigs pa thams cad so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po byaku be ras bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tu mchis te⑤/ stobs dang ldan pas sems can chen po de la dus thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad so sor dgag par bgyi/ nor dang ske/ 'bru ⑥thams cad legs par 'byor par bgyi/ rang gi skye bo dang /yongs kyi skye bo dang / yul dang / gnas dang / bran dang / snag gi gnyen dang ske/ rus kyi gnyen dang / grogs dang / bu medang / bu mo dang / chung ma la sogs pa bsrung dubar bgyi/ glang dang / ba lang dang / bong bu dang /rnga mo ⑨dang / lug dang / ma he dang / bal 0glang dang / rta dang / ra la sogs pa la yang bsrung snyi/bar bgyi'o/ /de nas 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag po dbang 8 ldan gyis 0kyang bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang rgyal po de dang / rgyal po de dag gi bu dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze rnams 'di dang pha rol tu bskyab pa dang / phan gdags pa dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / zhi ba dang /bkra shis pa dang / chad pa ④spang ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil 8ba dang / dug gzhom pa dang / mtshams gcad ⑩pa dang / sa'i 'og gi mtshams gcad 7pa dang / phyogs kyi mtshams gcad lhonyepa dang / rdo rje ra 85—212

bas bskor ba dang / rdo rje 1)phur bus gdab pa dang / rdo rje dra ba 'chirnams bre bar bgyi/ dgos pa rdo thams cad la nye bar gnas par bgyi/ dgos pa dang /dgos pa ma lags pa rnams kyi mtshan ma nye bar bstan ④par bgyi/ dge ba dang ske/ mi dge ba thams cad mi lam du yang bsgo bar bgyi/ sgrub na rdogeyang bgegs ma mchis par bgyi/ dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas yang nam mkha' lding gi bdag po nam mkha' la spyod pa rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 6)gis kyang dus thams cad du rgyal po de dang / rgyal po'i bu dang —/ rgyal po'i blon po dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs rnams 'jigs pa thams cad las bdag nyid 'khor thams cad dang bcas par mchis la bsrung (7cib dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi/ mchog thams cad rab tu bstab 98)par bgyi/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ dus thams cad du phyi bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sa 'og gi bdag po phag chen pos kyang yostabacom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'des bdag gis kyang mi'i bdag po de dang / mi'i bdag po'i bu dang / yang na lan gnyis su byung ba'am/ lan gnyis su byung ba'i bu dang / rgyal rigs dang ske/ rje'u rigs dang / dmangs borigs sam11/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang ske/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa rnams kyis dus thams cad du 8don thams cad grub par bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad las dus thams cad du zhu yang bsrung gebar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid kyang yongs su bskyab par bgyi'o/ /de nas gza' tshachen po brgyad dang / 'khor rgyu skar du bcas pa rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces 85—213

gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi sngags kyi snying po rnams 'bul bar 'tshal na/ de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ①byin gyis brlab ②par gsol/ legs so legs so/ /ngas byin gyis ①brlabs ④kyis/ gza' duchen po rnams shod cig de nas nyi ma la sogs pa gza' buchen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ u⑦/ oṃ so/ oṃ saṃ/ oṃ bu/ oṃ bruX/ oṃ shu/ oṃ sa/oṃ 'o⑨/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dbus su ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs su bri'o / /ngos rnams su phyag rgya chen po bzhi bri'o/ /pa ba sangs ni mdun du la/ /zla ba rgyab tu bri bar bya/ /g.yas su phur bu bri bya zhing / /g.yon par gza' ⑩lhag bri bar bya/ / me yi 7phyogs su mig dmar 8dang / /rlung gi phyogs su nyi ma ste7/ /dbang ldan phyogs su 0spen pa'o/ /srin po'i phyogs su sgra gcan 'bri//dkyil 'khor phyi rol khor yug tu/ /rgyu skar thams cad bri bar bya/ /sgo sgor de bzhin sgo ba rnams/ /khros pa'i yid du bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas/ /thams cad kyang ni spyan drang ngo / /de nas slob ma rnams zhugs te0/ /oṃ badzra ha na rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gra ha sa ma ye rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gra ha pra tītstsha 0sa ma ye rghaṃ/ de nas gza' tsobargyad sngags btab pa'i/ /bum pa brgyad kyis dbang bskur yiro/ / du rdo rje'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ /gza' 0rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas gza' chen po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gza' chen po brgyad kyis kyang rgyal po 85—214

chen po de dang / rgyal po'i bu la rtag ①par dus thams cad du de bzhin du thams cad bgyi'o/ /de nas rgyu skar dang / skad cig dang / yud tsam dang /thang cig dang / dus dang / zla tshigs dang / sbyor ba dang / khyim dang /dus sbyor dang / chu tshod la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang dus thams cad du sems can chen po de dag gi bka' mi gcog stergyal/ dpon po bzhin du bskyang (mibar bgyi'o/ /grong khyer dang / grong rdal ④dang ske/ ljongs dang / rgyal po dang / pho brang sbyo 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor gyi gnas thams cad so sor bskyang (6)bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs (7)pa chen po 'byung ba'i tshe yang des bdag cag mchod na gdon mi 'tshal bar 'jigs ⑧pa mi 'byung ngo / /de nas klu chen po brgyad kyis phud ces bya ba'i sgras bcom ldan 'das de mnyes 6)par byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang de dag thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po 'di dbul hu )lo / /klu chen po rnams legs kyis /lhagasang ba'i snying po rnams phul cig /de nas de dag mgu nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to / /oṃ phu/ oṃ pha/ oṃ phu(1ge/ oṃ pā/ oṃ phrisheste/ oṃ phe/ oṃ bee'i/ oṃ phos / /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ padma chen po 'dab 7brgyad la / /kha dog dkar po bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje rab gnas pa/ /sbrul mgo mtha' yas gdengs pa yi/ /ltos 'gro chen po sdigs ⑩pa bri/ /mtha' yas 'jog po de bzhin du/ /kur ko ṭa dang ku phonyeli ka /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /padma chu lha de bzhin du/ /mdor na 'dab cho1785—215

ma re re la/ /de dag sbrul mgo 'bar bar bri/ /sbrul mgo bdun bdun chung ma yis / /mgul nas 'khyud dang bcas par 0)bri/ /bum pa brgyad dang gtor ma dang ske/ /bshos mdzes pa dang 'byung po yi/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas/ /byas pa rnams ni gzhag (gepar bya/ /de nas rdo rje bdag nyid zhugs/ /sbrul mgos sbrul mgo can rnams dgug /phud (mices bya dang lhan cig tu/ /dzaḥbya/ baṃ hoḥdu zhes brjod de/ /de nas bu ni rgyal po dang / /rgyal rigs thams cad rab bcug nas/ /dug gi nyes skyon bsal ba'i phyir/ /phud ces bya bas dudabang bskur ro/ /de nas ming tsam brjod pas kyang / /klu rnams ⑦de dag thams cad 'grub/ /de nas de dag kun mgu nas/ /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ /spyan sngar thal mo sbyar 'khod nas/ /smon lam rab tu 'debs par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la (8mngon par dga' ba rnams gal te dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa rnams la bslus par ⑨gyur na/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid la bslus ⑩par gyur cig /de'i tshe bdag cag gi gnas bye mas bsregs ⑩par gyur cig /rdo rje kun du 'bar bas bdag cag gi nyusnyemago bkas par gyur cig /rtag par (/snyedus thams cad du sems can chen po de bsrung tsob dang / bskyab pa dang /sba bar nyugebagyi/ byin chen po dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus bskyed par bgyi / de'i yul du dug ma mchis par bgyi/ dus dus su char dbab par bgyi/pha rol po'i g.yul thams cad la dus dang / dus ma yin pa'i char dbab par bgyi / 'jigs pa thams cad rnam par gzhom par bgyi/ rgyal ba'i bka' 8dang ske/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' rab tu bsgrub nyu 7par bgyi'o/ /de nas sgrub pa 85—216

bshad de/ lha rdzas 'od phreng dkar po yis/ /dbu la sbrul mgo bzhis 1bskor ba'i / /rdo rje 'dzin gtso bsams (5)nas su/ /phud dus/ces bya ba 'bum bzlas la//de nas dug blangs phud ces ni/ /bya ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas kyang / /lha rdzas 'od zer phreng bas dgang la / /de la phud ces bya ba bsam/ /lag pa sbrul mgo zhags 'dra dang / /phud ces bya ba'i rlung gis (rigator/ /pags 6pa sha dang rus gnas pa'i/ /dug rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /phud (7ces bya ba'i lag pas drangasazhun/ /de nas las rnams kun byed cing / /dug rims dug sbyar la sogs pa/ /khu tshur gyis kyang kun phyin na/ /sprul mgo'i phyag rgyas 9smos ci dgos/ /de nas lha chen po rnams kyi bdag po 'jigs par byed pa chen po bud med chen mo brgyad kyis bskor bas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis skrag pa dang /bud med rnams kyi skrag mapas lha dang klu la sogs pa thams cad skrag /rnam par skragashi /rab tu skrag ste/rta/ kha sbub tu 'gyel nas gos dang bral te/sems kyang stor nas kun du 'phyan 12pa de dag la phan gdags pa'i slad du bdag cag snying po 'bul bar 'tshal gyisarsha/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de legs 15par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jigs par byed pa chen po legs so legs so / /rab tu 'jigs par byed pa bdag nyid dang / lha'i bud med thams cad kyi snying po rnams shod 7cig /de nas 'jigs par byed pa chen pos 'jigs par byed pa'i sgra phyung nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ hai ra ba bhā 3 tshog hā / oṃ bhā tugeswā hā/ oṃ dhī /spus hā/ oṃ bhū 2 snaswā hā/ oṃ bho swā hā/ oṃ hai 7 1swā hā/oṃ rbha swā hā/ oṃ rghaṃ geswā hā/ oṃ bhaḥ geswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed 85—217

chen po ni brgyad po de dag bdag gi ngag nyan/ de nas de dag dkyil 'khor bshad/ /'khor lo chen po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /bris nas dbus su rdo rje 'dzin / /khro chen 'jig rten gsum las ni/ /rnam rgyal zhes bya gzhag ①par bya / /de yi zhabs drung 'jigs byed pa'i/ /drag (shepo chen po khros pa ni/ /'jigs byed ma dang bcas par bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed brgyad po ni/ /bud med rnams dang ldan pa la/ /khros pa'i bzhin dang yid khros par(kye/ /ci bde bar ni bri bar bya/ /'dir ni sgo sgor de bzhin du/ /sgo ba shin tu khros ldan bri/ /de nas lcags kyu ④la sogs pas / /bkug ste mgo yi thod (depa ni/ /khrag gis bkang rdzi)ste mchod nas kyang / /sha chang gtor ma bzang po dang / /snod rnams khrag gis bkang ba dang / /mgo thod (7namago yi dum bu dang / /khrag gam chang bkang ④bum pa brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor der ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum rgyal ba'i/ /mchog gis (7slob ma gzhug 7par bya/ /bum pa'am mgo yi thod pa ni/ /de ltar brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas las rnams sbyin bya ste/ /bud med khyim mam /lhamatshan gcig hu par/ /'jig rten gsum ni 'dul ba'i mchog /tshul bzhin du ni mchod nas kyang / /'bum phrag bzhir 51nyeni bzlas par bya/ /de nas 'jigs par byed pa yi/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sgra thos nas/ /mi 'jigs par ni mgo thod par/ /khrag mchog bkang ste argha byadabul/ /de nas khro bo 'jigs byed pa/ /ma rungs yid can bud med kyi/ /tshogs kyis bskor cing 'jigs byed pa/ / brgyad kyis ri12bskor ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong 'jigs pa med gyur la/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba dran byed cing / /sha 'am yang na chang 85—218

mchog gis/ /thod pa bkang ste dbul bar bya/ /de nas 'jigs byed ma rungs 'joms/ /mgu nas rab tu grub 'gyur stinas/ /ci 'dod ces ni smras nas kyang / /mgu ba'i yid kyis de sbyin byed/ /sa rnams sbyin pa ma gtogs (2par / /bde chen hūṃ gi tshul gyis gsol/ /khu ba bro ba'i btung ba dang / /rdzas dang ral gri 'khor lo dang / /rtse gsum pa dang mtho ris dang / /mi dang sa 'og rgyal po dang / /gling dang gling bzhi brgya byin dang / /gnod sbyin dbang phyug srin po nyid/ /rig cha'adzin nyid dang 90rig rdo 'dzin gyi/ /'khor los sgyur (yedang 'jig rten ni/ /gsum gyi bdag dang bka' nyan dang / /rang gi 'khor dang bud med kyi(3)/ /dngos grub gang yang rung ba ni/ /ci dga' bar yang sbyin par byed/ /byin nas dgod (cing 'gro bar byed/ /skrag na de ma thag tu gsod/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'o/bka' stsal na rang gi brtag pa bshad par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨thugs brtse 7bar dgongs te byin gyis brlab par gsol/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis rang gi mi snying po rnams bshad do/ /oṃ ā rmo / oṃ gi/ oṃ ru/ oṃ i/ oṃ kai/ oṃ ga /oṃ bri / oṃ ka /de nas de dag gi nya dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /dbus su 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba/ /de yi mdun du dpa' bo ni/ /dbang phyug rtse gsum lag thogs 35bri/ /rgyab tu tshangs pa bri bya ste / /g.yon par lag na 'khor lo thogs/ /g.yas par tshadabang po rang gi ni/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma lag thogs 1 bri/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor chung ma rnams/ /85—219

'dir yang sgo ba de bzhin te/ /bya dang bum pa gang bar ①gzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi ni phyi rol du/ /stobs bzang sel sogs mthu chen gzhag① /de nas zhugs nas lha rnams ni/ /mkhas pas kun nas dgug ④par bya/ /dzaḥ(snye/ bai hoḥ(6)lha thams cad/ /dkyil 'khor dam par bzhugs par ⑦mdzod/ /de nas 'ongs par mthong ba dang / /dga' phyo)ba chen pos mchod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /phyag rgyas slob ma rnams gzhug (9)ste/ /oṃ pra tītstsha ṭwāṃ ⑩ma hā satwa badzra dhā nyunyer ā dzñā pa ya hūm̐ /steha ha ha ho8/ /me tog cho ga bzhin du dor/ /mig dbye nas ni bstan par bya/ /de nas sngags kyis 8btab pa yi8/ /bum pa'i chus ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas lha rnams gang dga' ba'i/ /dngos grub rab tu sbyin par bya/ /'bum gcig gam ni 'bum gnyis sam/ /dang po bsnyen pa byas nas kyang / /dbang phyug la sogs lha mchog rnams/ /de dag sgrub pas bsgrub ④bya ste/ /mtshan gcig /( tshol sogs gnas sam ni/ /phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang ngam/ /yang na nyunyede bzhin gshegs pa 'am/ /ring bsrel ldan pa'i mchod rten du/ /lha rnams thams cad cho ga bzhin/ /sgrub (7pas rtag tu bsgrub byas na/ /nam phyed na ni lha bzhengs nas/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa gang yin pa/ /de ni ci bder sbyin bya yis/ /bzang pos myur du soms te smos/ /gang phyir mchog ni khyod la sbyin/ /de nas sngags shes dngos grub phyir/ /lha la mchog ni rngo dīgasol ba gdab/ /lha rdzas khu ba bro btung tsho spedang / /mi snang ba dang mkha' 'gro dang ske/ / ril bu sa rdzas dang rgyal la sogs/ /yid 'dod tshad med gsol ba gdab / /de nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dang 'jig 85wa 220

rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa nyu)gang lags pa de dag /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag lha thams cad kyis sgrib pa ri thams cad rnam par sbyong ngo / /mtho ris kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /(kyengan song ma lags pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dben pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par dben pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o / / 'byung ba'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /(homya ngan las 'das pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i chos kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bde 'gro'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /spong ba'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /nyon mongs pa 5med pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o//rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dus thams cad 6du 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung 7ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o / /bdag nyid kyi bu bzhin du yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /de'i pha rol gyi dgra kun gzhom 8par bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong 'dab dang /ljongs dang / rgyal po dang /9) rgyal po'i pho brang dang / rgyal srid rnams bsrung rngubar bgyi'o/ /yul dang / phyogs dang / grong khyer dang / grong 'khor rnams bsrung nyunyebar bgyi'o/ /rgyal srid kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal srid thob pa rnams ni rgyal srid rgyas par bgyi'o/ /gling gcig pa dang / gling gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa nyu2dang / bde 'gro dang / mi'i gnas dang / sa'i 'og dang / 'khor los sgyur 1lhab rnams stsal bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na brgya byin nyid dang / tshangs pa nyid dang / gtogs 'dod nyid 85—221

dang ske/ dbang phyug chen po nyid kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la kun tu gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/①yang dag par rab tu ②g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/③ yang dag par rab tu ④'gul/ 'bar rab tu 'bar/ yang dag par rab tu 'bar/dgod rab tu dgod/ yang dag par rab tu dgod/ rtse rab tu rtse/ yang dag par rab tu rtse zhing rmad ⑤kyi ya mtshan du ma 'jig rten du yang dag par rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i tshogs rnams shin tu dam par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ 'dzum ⑥pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du 'dzum ⑦pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags pa ④lung bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes lha rnams kyis gsol ba'i tshig gsan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i 'chi bdag zhi bar byed pa'i rig pa nyadang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bdag 'joms par byed pa'i tsherig sngags gzi brjid chen po gang yin pa thos sam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas tshangs pa la sogs (2pa'i lha chen po de dag yang dag 8par rab tu mgu ste ba spu langs nas legs so zhes bya ba 'di dag gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa legs so legs so/ /gang gi slad du tshe thung ba'i sems can rnams 0tshe bsring ④85—222

bar bgyi ba dang / dus ma lags pa'i spyi'achi bdag gis nyen ②pa rnams gang gis ①dus ma lags par ④'chi ba las rnam par grol bar bgyi ⑤ba dang / ngan song du skyes pa rnams ngan song gi yirgyud thams cad las ci nas kyang ⑦rnam par grol bar bgyi ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag ⑧pa'i sems can rnams bde blag tu 'khor ba la rgyab kyis 7phyogs par bgyis nas myur du bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi ba'i slad du gzi brjid chen po'i stobs dang / mthu chen po'i rig pa bshad du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes yitshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis gsol ba'i tshig nyunyegasan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung 8ngo / /oṃ pu tre ⑫pu 28/ ma hā pu rtse 8a pa ri mi tā 7yuḥbyas rtse 81 na saṃ bha 8ro pa tsi te swā hā/snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ hrīḥbu swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ sgro ( sheswā hā / nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ rku swā hā/ snying po yang tsodag par bskul 2snyeba'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ ṭwāṃ swā hā/ snying po dam pa'o/ /oṃ dzrī swā hā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi par byas la/ de yi dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dang / gzi brjid tshad med pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba gzhag ste/ : ④zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de'i spyan sngar ni phyag na rdo rje stes / 0hrīḥzhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /g.yon par ni khro bo ste / skru zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /g.yas par ni nam mkha'i snying po stes/ ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /rgyab tu ni 'phags pa kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa 85—223

zhes bya ste/ trī 0)zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la rig pa ②rnams bri'o/ /bum pa lnga dang / brgyad 'khor los sgyur ②ba'i sngags kyis ④btab la gzhag go/ /bdug pa la sogs pa las thams cad pa'i khro bo'i ⑤sngags kyis ⑥btab pa dang / mchod pa la sogs pa gzhag ste/sgo ba ༅thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la / bde bar gshegs pa dam pa sras dang 'bangs su bcas shing 'khor gyis bskor te rig pa dang lhan cig spyan drang ngo / /de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te / skyil mo krung (8dbacas nas 'dug la stong phrag brgya bzlas na(pe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug kyang rung ste/ mngon sum mdu mthong nas de 'dod pa'i mchog so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste mnyam par gzhag na de'i tshe yid kyis las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badzra dha ra7 / ratna dha nyuger/ padma dha nyusnyer/ bi shwa lidha ra/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ mā ti kra 8ma ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dha ra ādma ko3lha 3lhazhes nga rgyal bskyed la slob ma rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas 'dis me tog dor bar 7bya'o/ /oṃ sarba (snyeta thā ga ta pra tītstsha hu/ho sa ma ya st+waṃ/ de nas phreng ba de nyid kyis tsho )mgo la bcings la / dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 37badzra sa dha ra ā tsodzñā pa sasteya hūṃ :du dzwa/ oṃ badzra badzra bus gi ni ṣiñtsa da /rgyu hūṃ/ oṃ ratna ratna zhu)a sgyi ṣiñtsa ga startsu ṭwāṃ/ oṃ padma padma da a bhi ṣiñtsa gas hrīḥ/ oṃ kurma kurma du a bhi ṣiñtsa sachergyu /du/de nas dam tshig dang / bka'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la ri gyidam tshig ni/dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang 8nye/ /85—224

srog chags rnams ni gsad 3)mi bya/ /ma byin par ②yang mi blang zhing / /brdzun dadu smra bar bya ma yin/ /pha rol bud med spyad mi bya/ /bla ma smad par mi bya ste/ /de yi grib ma mi 'gom zhing / /slob dpon ma yin mi gzung la/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshan mi brjod/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi smad de/ /lha rnams la lta smos ci dgos/ /ji ste glen pas gisasmad na ni/ /nad kyis nges par 'chi bar 'gyur//rnying (snyedang lha yi grib ma dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi(6)/ /phyag rgya yi ge'i mtshan ma rnams/ /gom pas 'gom (7par mi bya'o/ /glen pas dkon mchog gsum sogs dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang / /bla ma smod la (8)brtson pa rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te gsad 59)par bya/ /chos min ldan dang sdig spyod dang / /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang / /dam tshig sdang ⑩rnams snying brtse /stoba'i/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis bsadanyurta/ /'jungs pa rnams kyi hunyenor blangs la/ /sems can phongs rngul sbyin par bya/ /bla ma la ni mchod pa dang / /de ltar dam tshig bsgrub mapa dang / /dkyil 'khor phyir dang dam tshig can/ /phan phyir rgyal ba'i sras rnams la/ /mchod phyir mi yi dbang po'amathu/ /phyug po rnams kyi nor dbrog nyu snago/ /sems can rnams la phan spyod pas/ /rtag tu dam tshig bla ma'i nor/ /srog chags srog ni bsrung nyusnyeba'i phyir/ /brdzun byudu yang ni smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes bya dang zhu )/ /dam tshig rnams ni bsrung 1ba dang / /sngags rig pas ni bsgrub trīpa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad byas shing kun zos kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur na/ /snying rjer ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /de nas 'dis bka'i 85—225

dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā sti1 na te ② dā kyā ②mi grosna ④badzra su sid dha ye/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha hūṃ/ 'dis rdo rje lag tu byin ⑤la las kyi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba kurma (yeni ku ru bud dhā menā ma dus/ de nas ⑨bla ma bla ma'i phyir/ /khyod kyis lus mchog sbyin par bya/ /nor dang dbyig dang 'bru rnams dang / /stan dang bzhon 7pa de bzhin te/ /bran gyi mchog dang khang pa dang / /rgyal po rgyal srid de bzhin te/ /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang / /ma dang sring mo tsha mo dang / /gzhan yang ci bzhed /mthams cad ni/ /phan par bsams phyir bla mar 8dbul/ /de nas byang chub bar du ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang gzhan dag dang / /'jig rten pa yi mthu chen rnams/ /gang 'dod pa dag bsgrub rtsona'adod pas/ /dngos grub rnams ni gsol bar bya/ /de nas bu la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngags mkhan ser sna med sems dang / /dad pas dad pa'i sems ldan la/ /dngos grub rnams ni sbyin par bya/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom pa byas nas kyang / /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam8/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams nas dam tshig ciphyag rgya yang / /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa po ni bsgyur 8bar bya / /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlabatshe/ /ltag hu tsho'og go rims ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas nga rgyal bskyed nas kyang / /mkhas pa yis 32ni bsgrub byas na/ /de bzhin gshegs kyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 85—226

'das rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs lho)rigs dang /gzhan yang dman zhing kho re chung ba phyag dar ba (gedang / mtha' 'khob ②pa'i rigs ngan gyi skye bo rnams dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir zhugs na de dag gi rnam par smin pa ji lta bur 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir nga la zhus pa de ni legs so legs sol/ /lha'i bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir zhugs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang ④/ bris pa dang / 'drir bcug pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang ske/ phyag byas pa dang / mchod pa rnams kyi 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa nyon cig /lha'i bu rnams mdor 7den nga la yang de'i yon tan bshad par spobs pa med de/ nga'i bsod nams kyi phung po gang yin pa de brgya phrag stong du mar bsgyur kyang grangs su yang mi chog /bgrang bar yang mi chog /dper yang mi bzod 4)de/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung pos kyang mi bzod do/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ngo mtshar che'o bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis rkedakyil 'khor du 'dug pa la sogs (0par spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa spro'o/ /de nas lha de dag gis de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can bsod nams chung zhing tshe thung ba dang / ngan song gi rgyud dang ldan pa dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / byol song rnams su 85—227

skyes pa dag kyang mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de dag la bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgrub ①par bgyi/ kye lha'i bu rnams sems can de dag ni dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du chug cig(ge /chos kyi yi ge yang zlos su chug cig dudang / des sems can de dag tshe ring bar 'gyur/ bsod nams dang bral ba rnams bsod nams dang ldan par 'gyur/ ngan song las kyang rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /kye ④lha'i bu (gernams ngan song du skyes zin pa gang yin pa de dag gi ming la yang dbang skur rdzicig /gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig /mchod rten la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig /rang gi lha'i sku la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig /chung ngu na de dang rigs mthun (7)pa dang / de'i bu dang ske/ de dang rus mthun ⑧pa dang / de'i ming 'dzin pa'am/ bran la yang ⑨dbang skur cig dang bozhag bdun du dkyil 'khor du bcug ste (/rnyedabang bskur na gdon mi za bar zhag bdun gyis ngan song gi tu sgrib hu)pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu rnams de'i ④ming nas smos te 'bum phrag gnyis sam/'bum phrag gsum mamatshe/ 'bum phrag bzhi nas 'bum phrag brgya phrag stong gi bar du bzlas pa byas na ⑩mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang rnam par thar bar 'gyur lho tshon/ sdig pa chung ngu byas pa rnams lta smos 8kyang ci dgos/ lha yi bu rnams zhi ba yi/ /hom khung tha ma bar ma mchog /khru gang khru do khru bzhi pa'i/ /zlum po nyid du byas nas ni/ /de yi ming yang yungs kur hu gyis/ /brgya phrag stong du bsregs du )byas na/ /ngan song kun las rnam par thar/ / de yi zhunyesha dang rus pa dang / /spa dang thal ba la sogs pas/ /cho ga de dang 'dra bar ni//sbyin sreg byas nas ngan song yang / /kun las 2nyernam par thar bar 'gyur/ /85—228

de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad 'od zer dkar 'bar bri/ /khor 0)yug rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer ②dkar dang ldan par bri/ /de nas rdo rje rgya gram dang / /rdo rje rin chen chu skyes mchog /de nas sdig pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ / phyi yi nardo rje rigs rnams kyib/ /phyag rgya rnams ni phyi rol bri/ /gza' dang skar ma'i mtshan ma dang / /de ltar 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /gtso bo ri mo lugs (ltema'ang rung / /rdo rje can dang lhan cig gzhag /bya dang bum pa bkang ba dang / /gtor ma lha bshos rab dkar gzhag /mdor na thig ni btab nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /dkar po'i gos ni bgos nas kyang / /sangs rgyas gzugs can mi 'jigs pas / /ngan ⑥song rgyud na gnas pa yi/ /sems can rjes su dran byed cing / /sdig pa'i sgrib pa zhi ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin sreg lini/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi can/ /'bras yos yungs kur 8)bsres pa dang / / de yi hunyerus pa sha la sogs/ /yang na ming nas smos te bya/ /de ni ⑩bde 'gror skyes nas kyang ske/ /mkhas pas rgyas pa bya dgos te/ /khru do pa 'am khru bzhi pa/ /de ltar mchog ni khru brgyad par/ /byas nas hom khung gru bzhi pa/ /kun du mu ran ldan par bya/ /de dbus pad ma rin chen can/ /'od zer ser po ldan par bri/ /khor nyunyeyug tu ni rin chen dang / /mu ran rnams la chu skyes bri/ /phyi rol du ni rigs lnga yi'o/ /so so'i phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de ltar phyi yi lha rnams dang / /lcags kyu la sogs bri bar bya/ /gos rnams ser por bsgyur nas kyang / /mtho ris gnas pa rjes dran zhing / /de la phan phyir rgyas pa'i phyir/ /rgyas pa yi ni las byas narshage/ /lus can de yi tshe dang dpal/ /gzi brjid bde ba'i longs 85—229

spyod 'phel/ /de nas phan phyir nges par yang / /dbang du bya ba'i las bya ①na//hom khung gzhu yi dbyibs 'dra la/ /khru gang pa 'am khru do pa/ /khru bzhir byas la de'i dbus su/ /pad ma dmar po bris nas kyang / / de yi ②dbus su mda' bcas pa'i/ /gzhu yang de bzhin bri bar bya/ /khor ①yug tu yang mda' bcas pa'i/ /gzhu ni kha dog dmar por bri/ /sngags rdzogs pas ni rtag par yang ske/ /phyi rol de dang 'dra bar bya/ /sems can de yang dran byas te/ /dmar por gyur pa'i gos gyon la/ /me tog dmar ram padma 'am/ /'bras bu dmar ram tshon dubaskus pa'i/ /mar dang gur gum ⑤bsres pa dang / /tsandan dmar po'i phye ma yis/ /sbyin sreg ⑥byas na lha la sogs/ /thams cad de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de la gdon rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mngon spyod kyang ni brtsam bya ste/ /byed dang gsum mam 'khru gsum mamadu/ /de ltar dam pa khru dgur bya/ /gru gsum pa dang ldan par ni/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /rtse gsum pa dang rgya gram pa'i/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyig pa dang / /mgo ni rdo rje rtse gsum dang / /dgra sta ⑨rtse gcig mu khyud bskor/ /phyi rol du yang rim gsum du/ /snga ma bzhin du brgyan par bya/ /bya dang gtor ma bum pa dang / /bshos cha rnam ⑩pa mang du gzhag /sha dang khrag gis bkang ba yi/ / mgo yi ⑪thod pa kun tu gzhag / de yi 8lus can sdig sogs dang / /bgegs rnams gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /gos nag bgos shing khros nas kyang / /'jig rten gsum rgyal bdag nyid bsam(3/ /de nas de yi sdig bcom lus/ /bgegs dang phral te ci bde bar/ /mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang / /khams gsum pa na 7ci bder spyod/ /go rims 8'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /tshe 'di'i gnas 85—230

la'ang bya ba ste/ /de nas gang gi phyir byas pa/ /de yi phyir yang de bzhin 'gyur / /gzhan dag kyang ni las rnams kun/ /snga ma ji bzhin de ltar bya/ /des ni sems can thams cad la'ang / /myur du bde skyid ⑦myong bar 'gyur/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa (gelha rnams yid mgu nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di 'dri ba dang / 'drir 'jug pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo rnams bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis (kyebu bzhin du yongs su bskyang ④bar bgyi/ gang rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu (snyedang / rgyal po'i (6)blon po rnams ji ltar sasungs pa'i rjes su slob na de'i rgyal srid 'phel bar bgyi/yul dang phyogs dang / rang gi skye bo dang / yongs kyi skye bo dang / bran la sogs pa bsrung ④bar bgyi/ nor dang 'bru rnams mang du 'byor par bgyi/bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams dang ldan par bgyi/'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / lo legs pa dang / zhi ba rnams su bgyi na/ji ltar bshad (8)pa la mi rtog par bgyi ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal gang gis lho)brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di dad pas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags 7te/ grong dang grong khyer du btsugs tsho/stol/ bdag nyid kyis bsu 12ba dang / glang po che'i steng du bzhag la grong dang grong khyer la sogs pa thams cad bskor na/ nad dang /gnod pa thams cad ma mchis par 'gyur la sems can chen po de'i drung na bdag cag bran gyi tshul lam/ bu'i 3/tshul du gnas par bgyi'o8/ /gang du 'di 8rab tu spyod pa de na bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid 8longs spyod 85—231

rdzogs ①pa'i skus rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs ②par 'tshal ①bar bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po re ba thams cad yongs su skong ba de nyid brtag pa'i rgyal po'i ④gzugs su bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o(nyam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas te bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /sa phyogs de mchod rten du gyur par 'tshal bar bgyi ste(nya/mchod par bgyi/ phyag 'tshal bar bgyi/ kun tu bsrung 9)bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis (8)brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di kun la rgyas par 'chad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub chen po de'i g.yog bgyi'o/ /bran ༅gyi tshul du gnas par bgyi'o/ /bka' nyan pa'i tshul du gnas par bgyi'o / /bsgo tshib thams cad mnyan par bgyi'o/ /phan pa dang bde ba thams cad bgyi'o/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mdor na de'i rkang pa'i rdul hu)mgo bos blang bar 8bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mchod par bgyi'o/ /bdag cag de'i phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang bskur ba gang lags pa de dag kyang bdag cag gi dpon po lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /phyag na rdo rje lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bde ba chen po kun tu bzang po lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes tshangs /3pa la sogs pa lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams chos la rim gro bya bar de ltar dam tshig bcas par gyur pa gang yin pa de 85—232

ni legs so legs so/ /legs par sgrubs ①shig/ //bam po gsum pa ste tha mal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sngags dang / rig pa dang / snying po thams cad brtan par bya ba'i phyir nyid kyi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ badzra ②rgyu rghaṃ badzra pā ṇi dṛ snya (getiṣṭha rtsu oṃ hūṃ a(ge/oṃ badzra rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ dṛ nye (7badzra rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra hūṃ gas/ oṃ badzra hūṃ aḥ98 /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga (7ma bzhin bris la/ /dbus su rdo rje bri bar bya/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /kun tu bzang ngam bde ba che/ /spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje la/ /g.yas su phyag na rin chen 6bsnams / / phyag na padma mnub phyogs bri/ /byang phyogs phyag na rgya gram bsnamasatso / /phyi rol du ni kun bskor cing / /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhag par bya/ /de yi phyi rol sems dpa' rnams/ /go rims 8bzhin du bri bar byayi / /de yi phyi rol sems dpa' rnams/ /byams pa la sogs mchog chen bri/ /de ltar dge slong kun dga' sogs/ /thub rnams de yi phyi rol bri/ /rang gi chung ma bus bskor ba'i/ /tshangs pa la sogs phyi rol bri/ /gza' dang skar ma'i 8lha rnams dang / /rgyal po bzhi po rnams dang ni/ /phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /de yi phyi rol dmyal kun dang / /'dod chags la sogs byol song 'dri0/ /sgo sgor gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /sgo ba stobs kyi hu tshodam pa rnams / /dri rnams lnga hunyeyi chus bkang ba/ /gser gyi bum pa 'od can dang / /gtor ma dang ni lha bshos dang / /me tog bdug pa rab mdzes dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan rnams dang / /bla re dang ni rnga mchog dang / /dril bu rdo rje nor bu dang / /do shal nyi zla kyi la sogs brgyanas bye/ /'dod can 85wa 233

rnams kyi 'bras bu ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas dgang 0)ngo / /de nas sngags mkhan nyid kyis ni/ /spyan drang ②bdag ②nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni dbang yang bskur/ /sdom gnas dam tshig ldan pa dang / /bla ma mos shing mi 'jigs (gel/ /rigs ⑤skyes skyon dang bral ba dang / /ser sna ma lus spangs ④gyur cing / /yon tan mang por ldan gyur pa/ /gtong dang tshul khrims mang du thos/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje'i sems/ /dga' dang btang snyoms gnas pa dang / /stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i sems/ /smon pa med pa'i yid ldan pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa sngags 'di yis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed la/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni gzung bar bya/ /oṃ badzra rtsu dzaḥshi/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya pra be (nyesha (she)rgyu/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi 0pra tītstsha hunyebadzra sa twa ma hā su kha tsos/ ha ha ho 8sa ma ya st+waṃ/ me tog gi phreng ba dor nas gang la bab pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas mgo bo la bcing yibar bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig sbyin par bya ste0/ oṃ ci ste khyod hu9kyis su yang rung ba la smras na ni phyag na rdo rje nyid kyis rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar bas khyod kyi mgo bkas par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya dṛ bye hu tsho a/ de nas 'dis dam tshig gi chu blud la nyushegadong g.yogs tshedagrol bar bya'ol/ /oṃ badzra tsakṣaḥdu — )pa shya ho/ /ā dzñā pa ya ti banda tsho /lhamokṣa ya ma ni rghaṃ phaṭa/de nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bstan te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra pā ṇi swa rdo 2wadhe a nu rasto a bhi ṣiñtsa zhugend+raḥtso/ oṃ badzra badzra du snye.a sgyi ṣiñtsa tsho lhasarba badzra a bhi ṣe ka ta hūṃ āḥri snye/ oṃ bud dha a sgyi ṣiñtsa sortesarba bud dha a bhi ṣe gu ka ta oṃ hūṃ/oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa masarba ratna a sgyi ṣe du ༄ka ta oṃ ṭwāṃ/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa zhunyesarba padma 85wa 234

a gi ṣe hu)ka ta oṃ hrīḥ/ oṃ kurma dzubs bhi ṣiñtsa kyisarba kurma a bhi ṣe tsho༄ka ta oṃ āḥ(she/de nas bdag gi lus la sogs pa yon du phul la bka' mnod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dzñā ⑥a gi ṣe ④ka ta oṃ kun te dā sgyu 6)mi groṇḍa ⑨badzra pra sid bidha ye rghaṃ/ de nas las thams cad byed du gzhug cing dngos grub thams cad kyang nyu 7sbyin no/ /bde bas bde ba bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po'i dbus su ni / /kun du bzang ngam bde ba che/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms nas kyang / /snying gar 8rgyu zhes bya bsams nartson/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan las rnams kun byed cing / /kun tu bzang por bdag nyid 'gyuratso / /de ltar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /rtsu las sangs rgyas gzugs gyur na / /phyag na rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /snying gar 8'khor lo rab bsgoms tshenal/ /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ sna/ /rdo rje khro bor rnam bsgoms te/ /snying ga'i hunyedabus su phaṭa ces pa/ /hūm̐ zhes bya bas bskor bsams na/ /khro bo stobs chen nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje brtan 'o)par bdag bsgyur ri )la/ /snying gar (lha.oṃ zhes bya ba yisas/ /bskor ba'i hūm̐ dang ṭwāṃ ldan pa'i/ /bsams na rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rjer tsugebasgoms la snying gi ni/ /dbus su padmo zhes bya ba/ /oṃ zhes bya bas bskor bsams na/ /phyag na padmo ri snyemanyam par 'gyur/ /'khor lo rgya gram rtsu ldan par/ /a zhes bya bas bskyed nas kyang / /oṃ zhes bya bas bskor bsams na/ /rdo rje las dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de nas las rnams bshad bya stebu/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa'i las/ /de ltar dbang dang mngon buspyod rnams / /bzlas dang sbyin sreg 2 cho ga yis/ /las rnams thams cad bya ba yin / /rdo rje sems dpar snyebadag bsgyur la/ /zhi ba'i las ni brtsam bya zhing / /85wa 235

cho ga shes pas 1nang par nyid/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg nyid byed cing / /'od zer sprin gyis de lus la/ /'phro bar gyur par rnam gebasgoms te/ /rtag tu shar bltas 'od zer gyis/ /nyes pa thams cad sel bar bsamadu/ /'di ni sems can phan dga' bas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs las bya/ /kun du bzang po'i sku chen nam / /bde ba chen por bsams nas kyang / /nang par re re 'od byed na/ /snga ma bzhin du las byas te/ /nang par sngar ni sems can rnams/ /sdig can sems ni 5zhi bar 'gyur/ /gser 'od mdzes shing khya'abar ba yi / /rin chen 'dzin du bsams nas ni/ /bza' ba legs byas nyi ma yin/ /gung la rgyas pa'i las shis tshoshe te/ /rin chen 'dra bar khung rngubarkos themal / /bzlas dang sbyin sreg 512rab tu bya/ /yang na sngags pas snga ma bzhin/ /'od kyis /lus la rab tu dgang / /sbyor dang ldan pas khung bu ni/ /padmo 'dra bar byas nas kyang / /padma 'dzin par bdag bsgyur la/ /bdag chadang nye ba'i nyi ma'i mthar/ / bzlas dang sbyin sreg nyid byed cing / /'od zer sprin gyis lus bkang nas/ /thams cad ma lus dbang du 'gyur/ /8'dren pa kun du bzang po yis/ /zhi ba'i las ni rab tu bya/ /rdo rje rin chen rgyas pa stetshe/ /dbang bskur ba yang de bzhin no/ /dpal gyi 1 rnam rgyal de bzhin du/ /longs spyod dbang phyug dpal mnyam med/ /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid dang / /mdog sdug shin tu 'bar ba 1 bya/ /bzhad cing rmad 519du mdzad pas ni/ /dga' mgu rangs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /padmo bzhad na )pas chos kun ni/ /rtogs mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /mnyes 'gyur lha bran smos ci dgos/ /gzhan gyi rigs sogs tshogs mchog rnams/ /rnon pos gcod 0pa snyed du mdzad/ /85wa 236

gdon dang yi ①dgas 'dre na rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin po bka' nyan dang ske/ /gza' (tsamachog brgyad 94)ni ma rungs rnams/ /'khor los rtsa 5nas 'byin par mdzad/ /lkugs dang lkugs pa ma yin dang / /glen rnams mi smra smra bar mdzad/ /lce la dzi zhes bya ba yis/ /ma rungs rnams kyang lkugs tshipar mdzad / /rgya gram gyis ni mchod pa dang / /sems can don mdzad thams cad ston / /tsā zhes bya bas 'phro mdzad cing / /rdo rje srung bas srung 7bar mdzad/ /rghaṃ zhes bya ba'i so yis ni/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin nyid kyis kyang 8/ /ma rungs rab tu ma rungs kun/ /za byed sdig spyod smos ci dgos/ /ma rungs snying gar 9dam du ni/ /baṃ zhes bya ba bsams nas kyang / /dug dang rims dang gdon la sogasal/ /rdo rje bsdams pas bcing bar khomadzad/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg las rnams kyis/ /dgos pa thams cad sgrub 11par mdzad/ /'od zer bsil 12bas dngos po la/ /rgyas par gyur pas sgom 1 byed cing / /zhi ba'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang ske/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi bar bya/ /rang gi lus ni gser bcos skadang / /nyi ma gsal shar dge 'dra bar/ /bsams la rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /'od zer sprin gyis dgang bobar bya/ /padmo sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /hrīḥ'adra 'od zer btang ba yis/ /snying la kun du skor labyed cing / /'dod pa kun gyi dbang du byed/ /rdo rje rtsu gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /khros nas 1 rdo rje mtshon cha'i char / /sdig spyod lus la dbab byas na/ /de ma thag tu brlag par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir the tshom thams cad gcod pa ngan song thams cad bzlog 18pa'i brtag pa dam pa 85—237

'di bshad pa legs so legs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes ①phyag rgya'i le'u 'di bshad do/ /lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlab ②par bsams te/ hūṃ zhes bya ba dang /a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka (kyel ④a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug gis bkang zhing 'phro bar byas te/ mthe bo gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba gzhag /gung mo gnyis la ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba gzhag /srin lag gnyis la hrīḥ(9zhes bya ba gzhag /mthe'u chung gnyis la a zhes bya ba gzhag /de ltar yi ge rnams gzhag pa byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa (6skabaskyed de/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / bdag dang yang rjes su mthun ④par dran par byas tedu/ lag pa gnyis padma lta bur sbyar ba (pebyas nas oṃ zhes bya ba gnyis brkyang ba dang / a zhes bya ba gnyis bkug ste/de bzhin du hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / hrīḥbizhes bya ba gnyis padma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar bya / ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya las thams cad dang ldan pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nyid rnon po dang ldan pa dang / de nyunyelas rab tu 'khor lo 'dra ba ni 'khor lo'i'o/ /de nyid las khar bzhag pa ni sgra'i ste(8/ 'di ni phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /de nyid las gnyis su byas nas las kyir hunyebyas na las kyi'o/ /g.yon pa mgo thod thogs 'dra dang / /g.yas pa mdung thung rtse gsum dang / /g.yon pa padmo kha 'dzums dang ske/ /g.yas pa oṃ zhes bya bar gzhag /g.yon pa 'khor lo bde skogasum dang ske/ /a dang oṃ gnyis rtse sprad la/ /lhag ma gsum ni rdo rje can/ /oṃ dang 85—238

hūṃ gnyis gzhur ①byas la/ /lhag ma mdar byas mda' can 6nyegyi'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lor bya/ /'od ni nyi ma zla ba'i zhal/ /thal mo dam sbyar sor mo 'phro/ /gza' lhag rtag tu se li gol gtogs/ /de nyid tshig dbang gsungs pa ste④/ /mchu la tshig 'byung 'dra bar gzhag /pa ba sangs ni bde ldan pa/ /spen pa dbyug pa 'dzin par bya/ / ban glang ⑤sna ni chu srin 'dra/ /shes bya rgyu skar me dustag 'drang)/ /de nyid bskor na glog (nyephreng gi/ /bla 'og gzhag na sprin phyag rgya'-i/ /'di dag ni snying po'i phyag rgya ste/ las kyi phyag rgya yang 'di dag nyid do/ /de nyid las srin lag gnyis bcings pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las hūm̐ zhes bya ba tshigs bar ma bcag lco )pa ni dbang bskur ba sbyin par byed pa ste/ nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las hūm̐ zhes bya ba bcings te/ srin lag padma 'dra bar byas pa 'di ni padma las byung ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / hrīḥ༅zhes bya ba gnyis gshibs 8te bsgreng tsob ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las padmo 'dra bar byas pa ni bde ba chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshul du byas pa ni kun du bzang po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid nang du bkug pa ni khro bo sna tshogs kyi phyag rgya gzi can no/ /de nyid bralas shin tu bsdams pa ni rdo rje bsdams pa'o/ /brkyang ba ni gzi can no/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i so ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /rtsu zhes bya ba chosaganyis lcags kyur byas pa ni 'gugs pa'ol/ /de nyid mdar tsobyas pa ni 'dod pa'o/ /hūṃ dang oṃ zhes bya ba gnyis sbyar ba ni dgyes pa'i'o/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor lta bur byas pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o / /de nyid nor bu 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o/ /bskor na bzhad 85—239

pa'i ste/ de nyid khar bzhag na ni dgyes shing 'dzum par mdzad pa'i ya mtshan nol/ /thal mo padmo 'dra bar bkug ①pa ni padma'i'o/ /āḥlazhes bya ba ①dang /oṃ zhes bya ba nang du bkug pa ni ral gri'i phyag rgya'o/ /gcig la gcig sbyar ba ni 'khor lo'i'o/ /snga ma las oṃ zhes bya ba gnyis khar bzhag pa ni tshig 'byung ba ste / mdor na phyag rgya 'di dag ni las thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o/ /de nyid bsdus mdud sbrul mgor 'gyur/ /kun tu gnod sbyin mche ba 'dra/ /srin po yi rdogeni khrag 'phrog (snyepa/ /lag pa yibaskor ba rlung gi ste/ /dbyug tor ldan pa gnod sbyin no/ /bum par gzhag pa nor gyi ste/ /mthe bo sre mo'i sna ⑦'drar bya / /mgo yi thod pa nag po'i ste/ /bhriṅgi buri ti lag brkyang spub/ /pi bang g.yon thogs dri za'i'o/ /lag gnyis 'bar ba me 'bar ba/ /gung mo dbyug 'dra gshin rje'i'olto )/ /rno la khro dang dbang bsgyur 37ba/ /mthe'u chung ral gri mdzub zhags pa/ /rlung gi phyag rgya rgyal mtshan yin/ /de la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnamasal/ /lag las skye ba skyes par 'gyur/ /lha rnams kun gyi 8thun mong du/ /padmo'i nyu2phyag rgya bkra shis te/ /klu rnams shes bya utpa la/ /de ltar so ni gnod sbyin rnams/ /srin po rnams kyi mgo tshal pa/ /bud med rnams kyi sor bcu bsnol/ /gza' rnams kyi ni dbyug pa ste/ /argha (8dbul ba rgyu skar rnams / /de dag kun gyi sems sgrub pa'o/ /mgo bo thod pa khar bzhag pa'i/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phra comen ma'i/ /mgo thod 8rtse yi phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yir rtso sgrubashad/ /de dag kun kyang thun rtso mong du/ /phyag rgya chen po bshad par bya / /thal mo brkyang bar bshad pa ste/rkye/ /yang na thal mo padmor bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /a zhes bya ba lu gu rgyud/ /rtsu zhes bya ba gnyis bsgreng ṭu )85—240

la / /phyag na rdo rje'i ①phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje bsdam (mipa bsdams nas kyang / /rtsu dang a gnyis ②gshibs te bsgreng / /oṃ zhes bya ba ngos bcar ba'i/ /phyag rgya snang ba byed par dgongs/ /de las a zhes bya ba bcings/ /oṃ zhes bya ba nang du gzhug /oṃ zhes bya ba sngon bzhin sbyar/ /oṃ yang ④a dang 'dra bar bya/ /ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba gshibs nas ni/ /a (snyedang oṃ gnyis lu gu rgyud/ / rghaṃ zhes bya ba gnyis bsgreng la/ /(nyalhag ma gshibs pa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil par shes par bya/ /ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba gshibs nas ⑦ni/ /rtsu zhes bya ba'ang rdunyede bzhin rnam/ /de ltar rghaṃ zhes bya ba gshibs/ /lhag ma 'od zer 'dra bar bya/ /rta mgrin 6)phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /de yang las rnams kun la gsungs/ /spyan gyi mig dang 'dra bar bshad/ /mā ma tī yi rdo rje 'dra/ /dkar mo padma nyid du bshad / /utpa la ni sgrol mar dgongs/ /sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra dzra/ twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa/ hūṃ/dza00/ ho/ dhu/ ṭwāṃ/ rlo/ bhri/ hā/ hrīḥ/ dhīḥ17/ skru/ rghaṃ/ kai/ ro/sprul/ si/ oṃ bud dha lo tsa ne hūṃ/ oṃ badzra mā ma tī hurteXhurte/ oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi ④de hi sid dhi bo bodhi na /5lo kotta rasthā hu swā hā/ oṃ badzra tā re tutta re tu re 8hūṃ hūm̐ rghaṃ swā swā swā swā 3)tā/ zhi ba'i brdung ba/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ shasba ta/ rgyas pa'i brdung rdu 3 bsaspre/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ rgyu/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/rgyu / rgyu/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ st+waṃ/ rgyu 2/ dbang gi brdung ba/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/85—241
