ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/ ho dhu ma/mngon spyod kyi brdung ba/ kha two/ kha āoṃ/ kha two/ kha āoṃ/ kha two/ kha two/kha two/ kha āoṃ/ kha āoṃ/ kha two/ kha two/ kha āoṃ/ kha two/ kha āoṃ/ kha āoṃ/kha rtasti/ de nas lha rnams kun dga' nas/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal te/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo bshad pa'i phyir/ /gsol ba 'debs pa nyid du gyur②/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes rang gi sku bor te(gyi/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs nas gnyis su med par mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ④ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i 2khro bo me yi ⑥rdo rje nyi ma zhes bya ba'i ④snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /oṃ badzra satwa gro dhā na lārka ⑧ma hā badzra kro dha dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarpā pā ya nā sha ya nā sha yal /ha ra ha ra mā ṇan 6rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ tree rtsonye losta lo ka kā nyusnyer ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tree ⑫lokya da skyem ka nyuge phaṭa/ oṃ tree 7lokya nā 3 7sha na rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ tree lokya brnya 4)ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ te tsho'e phaṭa/ oṃ kā la daṇḍa du ste/ phaṭa/ oṃ kā zhu)ni dhu ni hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ hrīḥ(2rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kā la i ku 0sha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la pā (9sha hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ kā du snyel brnya rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rākṣa 69sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rākṣa si rtsu phaṭa/(rte.oṃ kā (snyel daṇḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā so)la rā du )tri rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la yakṣi ṇi rtsu phaṭa/hu de nas dkyil 'khor mi bzad ni pa/ /che ba'i mchog ste rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /lha rdzas 'bar ba'i phreng bas dkrigs lha/ /shin tu 'bar zhing cher ( ho'abar ba/ /de ltar gdakyil 'khor bris nas kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa' gzhag par bya/ /'jig rten gsum snang la sog sa khro bo (9kun/ /ma rungs snying gar sa tshomanan nas 85—242

sdigs ①byed cing / /zhal ni shin tu 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /phyag ni brgya ༷ phrag du mar ldan/ sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan la/ /stag ((lpags kyi ④ni smad g.yogs bgos/ /rgyu ma thogs shing dbu mtha' yas/ /mgo thod shas gang phyag na thogs/ /de ltar bris nas phyi rol du/ /srin mo'i tshogs rnams gzhag par bya / /sgo ba rnams ni ji bzhin du/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i lag mtshan can/ /de nas bdud rtsis gang ba yikun/ /bum pa bcu drug gzhag par bya/ /bdug (6)pa me tog dri zhim dang / /mar me dang ni bro snod dang / /kha zas bkang ba'i gtor ma dang / /bza' dang bca' dang bdud rtsi zhes/ /mgo thod (7)gang bar gyur pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor du ni mang du gzhag /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid kyang / /mgu nas mgo thod phyag rgyas 'jug /phyag rgya de dang de yis ni(8)/ /sha rnams kun gyi 6)dam tshig stsol/ /de nas 'dod ldan rnyed nas ni/ /hūm̐ zhes bya bas bsgrub par bya/ /de nas sngags mkhan sgo sgor yang / /de nyid dran byed bsnyen par byam/ /de ni nges par dngos grub ste/ /yud tsam 'jig rten gsum dbang 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor du ni tshogs rnams dang / /rang gi lha yi ⑩tshogs rnams la/ /rgyud las 'byung 12ba'i dam tshig brjod/ /de nas mchod de langs nas kyang / /tshogs spyan cho1 rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /tshul du gnas nas 'byung bar bya/ /de nas slob ma bsdus nas ni/ /lag na rin chen thogs te gzhugatso /oṃ badzra gro dha sa ma ya rtsu/ oṃ badzra rākṣa skasi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dhā na lārka sbu ṭa ra tā pra tītstsha 37 phaṭa1 tsho/ oṃ badzra gro dha na ni rakṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gro dha pā sha hūm̐ phaṭa/3 oṃ badzra gro dha sa ma ya ni bī ra 17rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha sa ma ya mā ti 2 )kra ma hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gro dha ra 1ti sa ma ya a 32gi ṣiñtsa tsho —snyes 85—243

phaṭa / 'dis dbang bskur la de bzhin du dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi sgrub ①pa bshad de/ bdag nyid khro bor snyoms zhugs la/ /de nas snying gar ②nyi ma bsgom/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ge las/ /khros nas yang dang yang 'phro zhing ske/ /de gnyis gcig tu bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min / / khro bo'i ③rgyal po'i las dngos su/ /gsod pa yin par bshad mod kyi//zhi snyidang dbang dang rgyas pa rnams/ /de dag ⑤byed 'gyur gdon mi za/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ⑨ting 'dzin gnas/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom byas na/ /gdug pa'i sems can 'dzin byed cing / /mdor na dug rims gdon la ⑦sogs / /de bzhin de dag thams cad ni/ /thabs la sogs pas 'joms byed pal/ /khros nas snying las 'byung 'gyur bar/ /gsad ⑧pa'i las la bsam par bya / /khros par gyur pa'i 0rgod ma'i khas/ /sha dang khrag rnams 'jib 0byed cing ske/ /de dag 'tsho ba 'phrog byed par/ /bsams na nges par brlag par 'gyur / /khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang mdzad/ /zla ba 'dra ba'i dge bsam zhing ske/ /'od zer 'byung ba mang po yis/ /khyab ⑩par gyur par rnam 8bsams la / /rims dang gdon dang dug la sogs/ /'od zer des hunyeni phyung nas kyang ske/ /de yi nad rgas gnod pa 8rnams/ /zhi bya'i phyir ni ring du dor/ /de nas rtsu gi tshig bzhag la/ /rdo rje lta bu'i lus bsam zhing / /haṃ gi 8'khor los go char bya/ /'od zer chu yis tsodabang bskur ro/ /de nas de yi ⑩ming smos shing 8/ /bzlas pas tshul bzhin bsam par bya/ /de nas khung bu gsum la rnam cig tsheni/ /zla ba rgyas shing 'od zer 'phro 'dra la/ /khru gang tsam mam 0 yang na khru do pa/ /mi rgyal mchog rnams kyi ni gnyis su bsgyur/ /de yi sa 85—244

rnams rnam par sbyang byas te/ /'khor lo'i dkyil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse ltar gyur pa gcig /'od zer dkar po phreng bskor gzi can tshotshogazhag /phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams thams cad bri bya ste/ /rigs brgya la ②sogs phyag rgya zur phyin cing / /rgyal po bzhi yi ji bzhin phyag mtshan 57rnams/ /phyogs kyi bdag po rnams kyang phyogs phyogs su/ /lha chen la sogs phyag rgya khyab 'jug dang / /'khor lo lta bu nyid du bri bar bya/ /dri zhim chus bkang mdog 'od dkar gyur la/ /dkar pos shin tu dkrigs (papa'i bum pa brgyad(ge/ /dkar gsum gang ba'i gtor ma lha bshos dang / /bdug pa mar me me tog rnams kyang gzhag /mchod pa bya ba'i phyir ni bla re dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnga ma la sogs gzhag /nang re ga pur bcas pa'i dri 6)zhim pa/ /tsandan la sogs pa yi byug 97)pas byug /kha ni shar phyogs bltas te sbyin sreg (pebya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan la 'dug bya'am/ /yang na rnal 'byor ldan zhing sems dpa'i gdan/ /gos la sogs dkar phreng ba dkar gyis brgyanas)/ /mar dang 0sbrang rtsi rtsoskye'o ma dang / /nas kyi thug nyu2pa la sogs dang / /til mar dang ni til nyid dang / /yungs kur 1nadang ni 'bras yos dang / /'bras chan bonas dang gro rnams dang / /me tog shin tu dri zhim rnams/ /ga pur dang ni bsres nas kyang / /tsandan dkar pos bsgos pa dang / /'dab bdun me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /zho dang ldan pa'i yam shing la/ /de dag khung bu'i khyad par las / /rang gi sor gyis gzhal bya zhing / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yan chad mchog /sor bcu drug ni bar ma ste/ /tha ma bcu gnyis nyid du shes/ /shin tu chung na sor brgyad de/ /bud shing zho dang ldan pa la/ /dri chus bskus par beshes par 85—245

bya / /bud shing de las byung ba'i me/ /sbyar nas dri chus gtor nas ni/ /padma dkar po zhal 'dra dge/ /padma nor bu ril ba thogs/ /lag na dbyug pa mchog thogs pa/ /padma dkar po'i stan steng 'dug /de lta'i me lha bkug nas kyang ske/ / argha blangs 0)te dbul bar bya/ /de nas zla rgyas dkar po la/ /bzhugs du pa'i 'gro phan spyan drangs te/ /padma dkar po shar phyogs su/ /bsams nas steng du gzhag par bya/ /de nas de ltar bsams nas kyang / /bsgrub 90bya rtag tu mdun bzhag ste(ge/ /de yi nyes pa drangs nas ni/ /shin tu bsrings te sba bar bya/ /nang par sngar ni gtsang 'gyur zhing / /shin tu dri zhim lus byugs (5)la/ /bdud rtsi bzhin bsams 0sbyin sreg ④bya/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'da' bar dka'atsho ri/ /lha rdzas bdud rtsi bro lnga 'di/ /dang por me lha brtag ⑨byas la/ /khro bo de ni de lus su/ /spyan drangs nas ni bzhugs ⑩par bsamasanyunyerka/ /de nas dang po khro bo la/ /bsreg bya lan gsum dbul bar bya/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la gsum/ /de nas me lha nyid la gsum/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /de nas lha rnams re re la/ /de nas bgegs la nyugesogs la dbul/ /de yid 'ong ba'i lha yang rung / /de nas dang po khro bo yi/ /sngags kyis 32yam shing sbyin sreg 8bya/ /de nas gcig tu bsres mnas kyang / /bdud rtsi sngags kyis btab nas ni/ /de bzhin sbyin sreg nyu9byas 'og tu/ /brgya stong snyed dam yang na ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du ni/ /khro bo nyid la dbul bar bya/ /de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par bzhag pas bsrungs hurtenas kyang / /mjug na tu mngon par mchod nas ni/ /lha rnams thams cad gshegs par gsol/ /'dis ni zhi ba'i las rnams kyang / /'grub 'gyur tshe85—246

dang ske/ /bca 1)ka yi me tog gnas/ /me tog 'bras bu dmar tshal ni/ /yid 'ong sems ni chags byed pa/ /der ni stegs bu (2khru brgyad dam/ /de ltar bcu gnyis bcu drug rnams/ /byas nas ( rinade yi dbus su yang / /hom khung dkyil 'khor bya ba ni/ /khru gang yang na khru do 'am/ /de ltar khru ni bzhi bar bya//gzhu 'dra ba 'am padmo 'am/ /yang na rdo rje 'dra bar bya/ /mda' 'dra zla (peb kham 'dra dang / /de ltar padma'i 'dab ma 'dra/ /zheng du chu (deyi phyed kyi tshad/ /zheng gi phyed kyi tshad tsam du/ /hom khung zabs su brko bar bya/ /mu khyud sor ni bzhi par bya/ /nyis 'gyur ba ni nyis 'gyur bya/ /tha ma mchog gi khyad par las / /yam shing so sor shes 96)par bya/ /yang na yam shing sreg ④shing ni/ /tshad ni zhi ba'i las su gsungs/ /shin tu dmar ba'i tsandan nam/ /yang na shing dmar gzhan yang rung / /me tog 'bras bu dmar po'am(nye/ /btsag dang tsandan rgya skyegs ༷94)sogs/ /le brgan rtsi dang gur gum gyis/ /mdor na bud pa'i shing dang ni/ /yam shing la yang bskus bonas ni/ / yungs kur mkha dog dmar po dang / /btsag dang bla mtshal hu yang de bzhin du/ /zangs kyi phye dang yungs kur dang 1 tsho/ /skye tshe 'bru dang lan tshwa dang / /til dang dri 8zhim thig le'i sko'abru/ /la phug yungs rdog de bzhin te/ /khrag dang rdul ni chen po rnamasal/ /bsreg 1 bya phyir ni bsdus nas kyang / /sngar bshad 'bras bu la sogs pa'i / /khu bas yang dang yang bskus nas/ /khro bo'i sngags kyis byin brlabs te / /ba dang ra las bzhos pa yi/3/ /bshigs 51)ma thag pa'i mar sar dang / /mar dang til mar rnams kyis dgang na sta/ /ga pur la 21sogs bsgos nas kyang / /bdud rtsis btab ste na gzhag par bya/ /de nas hom khung dmar po la/ /byi ge85wa 250

cing tsher mar bcas/ /sreg ①shing yam shing byas nas kyang / /sha dang khrag dang lcags phye dang / /rus phye dug dang ske (khutshe dang / /dri chen dri chu la gsogs pa'i / /rdzas rnams kun la dug gis ni/ /bsgos pas lan grangs 'bum bsregs ④nas/ /de yi longs spyod 'byor pa dang / /gnyen dang 'khor dang bran rnams dang / /bu dang chung mar bcas pa rnams/ /spangs te srog dang bral nas ni/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad byamyong bar 'gyur/ /mngon spyod kyi las cardob/thag theṭa(pe// // sgorgya gar gyi mkhan po shīnta spyigarbha ⑧dang / lotstsha ba ⑨bande 0dza ya rakṣi tas bsgyur ba'o// // swa pa ra hi ta bha bskyo0 tso// //8bsdur mchan/275 1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug nas blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉bshan/ dhi 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'am/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉khru gsum 'am/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 khru gsum mam/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉ri yi/ 〈〈zhol〉〉ra yi 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sreg 276 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsreg (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ke/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉las ④〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sregs/ tshoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉zad/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/(me)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉shān ting / 〈〈zhol 〉〉shārnying / 2〈〈khu 〉〉gabha/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 ba/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉brnye/nyu)〈〈g.yung 〉〉swa pa ra hi ta snya brnye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gog pa ra nyi ta bha bskyo/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉 rgyagar gyi bha bskyo/ 32〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 zhus dag85wa 276

༄ga /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su smyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa zhes bya ba/shi༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga 9gyiti pa ri sho dha na te dzo (snye snarā dza su ta thā ga ta myurta gete saṃ myakle 5)buddha su kulpe ka de ⑥sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig 7na/ bcom ldan 'das lha thams cad kyi mchog dga' ba'i tshal na bzhugs te/ nor bu dang gser gyi shing lo ma dang /yal ga dang / lcug mar bcas pa'i sdong po dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang ske/ me tog ka ma la dang / me tog utpa la dang / me tog kuṇḍa tshan)kā 99rinodang /me tog bsku khol dang / me tog ti la ka dang / me tog a sho ka dang / me tog mjo 11ra ba dang / me tog mas 12ra ba chen po la sogs pa me tog rnam pa 85—278

sna tshogs pas nye bar mdzes pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing rnams kyis yang dag par brgyan 91)pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis rnam par spras pa/ bya'i tshogs 2sna tshogs daskad snyan pa 'byin pa/ rnga dang / rnga mu kunda 4ridang / gling bu dang / rnga rnyi ri la /zhesogs pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa dang /lha'i tsho6)bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams rnam par rtse ba / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 8byin gyis brlabs pa na'o/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha thams cad dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / lha'i 9bu mo 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgya stong rnams dang / gnod sbyin dang ske/ srin po 7dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye 11chen po dang / klu la sogs pa 'khor rnam pa sna tshogs pa 12du ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad rnams la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros spobs pa dang / blo gros mi g.yo ba dang / blo gros yangs pa dang / kun du blo 1 gros dang / blo gros mtha' yas pa dang / kun nas legs pa'i blo gros dang / blo gros ka ma la dang / blo gros chen po dang /blo gros lha rdzas dang / blo gros sna tshogs pa dang / blo gros ma lus pa dang /kun du bzang po ste/ de dag la sogs pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun mtha' yas shing mu med pa rnams kyis bste lostang du byas/ bla mar byas/ mchod cing rjed par byas/ shin tu phul du byung bar byas te15/ 'khor gyi tshogs chen po'i dbus su tshangs pa 17chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs 1 shing ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i 85wa 279

ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 0)so/ /de ma thag nyid du ngan song gsum gyi rgyud rnam par grol bar byed pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i 'od zer 'phro ba dang sdud (gepa du ma'i phreng ba rang gi mdzod spu nas phyung ste/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun du snang bar byas so/ /kun du snang bar byas pa des sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las bgrol hūṃ rate/ yang dag pa so so so sor thob par ④byas shing dga' ba'i tshal yang kun du snang bar byas te(lde)/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs pa rnams kyis namangon par mchod nas lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas te (pemago bos phyag btsal 78)nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi (9nyespyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod 7de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho nyunyesangs rgyas e ma ho sangs rgyas chos/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas mdzad pa shin tu legasatshi/ /gang phyir bdag cag ngan song yongs su sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la rab tu bzhag /de nas lha'i dbang pos bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal kyisnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer kun du snang bas ngan song kun las rnam par bgrol bonas rnam par grol ba'i lam la rab tu bzhag pa ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po 'di ni ngo mtshar mi che ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tshad med pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams legs par bsags pa'o/ /lha'i nyusnyedabang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni dpag tu med pa'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'o//85—280

lha 'i ①dbang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni tshad med pa'i thabs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /lha'i ge dbang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni shes rab dpag tu med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyod pa tshad med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul rmo rabya'i skye bo tshad med pa rnams snod du gyur par mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ye shes gang yin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang yang dag par ldan pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i smon lam dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /lha'i cadabang po de'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis tshon snod ji lta ba de 6ltar sems can rnams kyi tsho don mdzad pa dang / gdul bya ji lta ba 85de ltar sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa dang /mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ba 'di la 'dir the tshom 9dang som nyi 1 dang yid gnyis mi bya'o/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gdul bar mi 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas ma yin no7ske/ /de nas lha'i dbang po rang gi stan las langs nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya che zhing che ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang /rjes su brtse zhu bar bya ba'i phyir dang / snying rje dang bcas par bya ba'i phyir dang /brtse ba chen po dang bcas par bya ba'i phyir dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par rshasnobagyi ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das bdag 1 spobs pa bskyed du gsol / bde bar gshegs pa bdag spobs pa bskyed du gsol/ bcom ldan 85—281

'das sum cu riha)rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i (5)rigs 'di nas lha'i (0bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba zhig shi 'phos shing dus las 'das nas dgung bdun lon lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ④de gang du skyes shing / bde ba'am sdug bsngal gang myong bar 'gyur ba de bcom ldan 'das lung bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa lung bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i 〈pe dbang po de'i 56)dus dang skabs 57)su bab par shes na nyon cig /lha'i dudabang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni dus lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'di ni skabs su bab pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lha'i 9rinodabang po lha'i rtso )bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de hunye'adi nas shi 'phos nas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes te/ der lo stong phrag bcu gnyis su sdug bsngal drag cing mi bzod pa myong bar 'gyur ro/ /slar hurteyang dmyal ba chung ngu rnams su lo stong phrag bcur sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro//slar yang byol song dang yi dgas nyusnyernams su skyes te lo stong phrag bcur sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /slar yang mtha' 'khob kyi skye bo'i gnas su skyes nas / 'on pa dang / dig pa dang / lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can rnams su lo stong 1 phrag drug cu nyuge sdug bsngal nyi myong bar 'gyur ronyurte/ /slar yang lo stong phrag brgyad cu 1/rtsa bzhir nad rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / mdze yidang phol mig gis gzir ba dang / skye bo mang pos smad pa dang / yongs kyis ༷ )spangs pa dang /rigs dman par 'gyur 2lhazhing sdug bsngal na nas sdug bsngal du brgyud 22pa rgyun mi 'chad 4par 'gyur te/ gzhan rnams la yang gnod pa byed cing las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs pa yang rgyun mi 'chad 25par byed par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang sdug 85wa 282

bsngal rgyud ①pa gzhan dang gzhan myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu rnams de thos nas dngangs tshonashing skrag ste skyo nanas kha bub tu 'gyel ④rto/ /yang langs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal gebargyud 6)ma de las ji ltar thar bar 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar thar bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das thabs gang gis pa sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po de las grol bar 'gyur ba (8༄des yongs su skyobs 79rimadzod/ bde bar gshegs pa yongs su skyobs mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lha'i 7dbang po sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu 31rtsa bzhis 12bshad pa 'di ngas kyang bshad kyis 0nyon cig /de nas lha'i chadabang pos slar yang bcom ldan 'das la me tog mas mar ba dang / mas 1skur ba chen po dang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa hu tshodang / rin po che'i 1 dbu rgyan dang / phyag gdub 19dang /dpung rgyan dang / snyan rgyan dang / do shal dang / do shal phyed pa la sogs pa rgyan gyi khyad par du mas mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya stong phrag )du mar bskor du lhab byas shing phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so zhes bya ba legs so'i tshig gis 22mnyes par byas nas/bcom ldan 'das lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan pa dang bde bar bgyi ba dang —/ ma 'ongs pa'i 2 sems can rnams 2 ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par thar bar bgyi ba'i slad du legs par bshad pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs lags so/ /de nas slar tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i lhatshogs rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so/ /gang gis na ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis 2 mtshan tsam na yang 85wa 283

thos pa dang ldan na ngan song gsum gyi lam las rnam par grol zhing mtho ris lha'i ①'jig rten nam/ mi'i ri 'jig rten du skyes nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad ②du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang tshangs pa gel sogs pa lha'i ⑤du de khyarnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'dis byin gyis ⑦brlab pa'i don du don yod rdo rje'i byin rlabs /na zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so//oṃ badzā dhiṣṭha 59na dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas zil gyis 51 7mi non pa rdo rje'i nyu1byin gyis rlabs kyi hu)byin gyis brlabs nas/ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di phyung 1 ngo / /oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne thusarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne shurnye bi shudhe sarba kurmā 1lhab ra ṇa bi shurnye swā hā/ rig pa 'di gsungs ma thag nyid ⑩du sems can thams cad ngan song du mi ltung bar byas shing dmyal ba dang / byol song dang ske/ yi dgas 41 7kyi 'gro ba thams cad sbyangs te/ sdug bsngal mi bzad nyushepa rnam par rab tu zhi zhing skye bo mang po rnams bde ba dang ldan par gyur hunyeto/ /de nas gzhan yang srung 5 )ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ya sarba a pā ya na 1sarba satwa bhyo rtsu/ lha'i rinadabang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba a pā ya bi na sho dha ne pu —ste/ phaṭa/lha'i 55dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tā ṭa/ lha'i tsho 5dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i snying po'o/ /hūm̐/ lha'i zhu)dbang po gzhan yang mdor na dran pa tsam gyis kyang bsod nams chung ba'i sems can rnams ngan 85wa 284

ya ga ti ga ha 1)na bi (0sho dha ne tsū hoḥ((phaṭa/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ mi trī ha ra ṇa rdogeya swā hā/ byams pa'i 'o/ /oṃ a mo bhā (nyamo gha darsha ni yis/mthong ba don yod kyi'o/ /oṃ sarpā pā yaṃ dza ha sarpā pā ༅ya bi sho dha ni (shes/ngan song kun 'dren gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba sho ka ta mo nirsā lata na ma ti rtsu/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros kyi'obo/ /oṃ garnya hasti rtsorghani hūm̐/ spos kyi glang po'i'o/ /oṃ shu raṃ nyu2ga me hūṃ/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i 'o/ /oṃ ga ga ne 71dag ga na lo tsa sade (ge// nam mkha' mdzod kyi'o/ /oṃ dzñā na tshege tu dzñā na ba ti hūm̐/ ye shes tog gi'o/ /oṃ a mi 51 7ta pra sgye a mi 3)ta ba ti 7rdzu/'od dpag )med kyi'o/ /oṃ tsand+ra sme 21tsand+ra byā rteb lo ki ni 224 swā hā/ zla 'od kyi'ol/ /oṃ bha dra ba ti bha dra pā 2gele swā hā/ bzang skyong gi'o/ /oṃ dzā py-i nyali ma hā dzā li ni tsū/ dra ba can gyi 'od kyi'o/ /oṃ badzra garbhe rgyu/ rdo rje snying po'i'o/ /oṃ akṣa ye ju rgyu lha/ akṣa ya kurmā 2 thob ra ṇa /bi sho dha ne tsho reswā hā/ blo gros mi zad pa'i 'o/ /oṃ pra ti bhā ne pra ti bhā na kū )she swā hā/ spobs pa brtsegs pa'i 'o/ /oṃ sa manta bha dre gi rtsu/ kun du bzang po'i 'o/ /bskal pa ( rtebazang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sngags 'di dag rim pa bzhin du brjod do / /'di dag gis rgyud du ji skad gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i cho ga'i rim du pas nyin re zhing snga ba'i sdo )dus su skyed 5pa'i rim pa bsgom nilhabazhin pas lha'i ra rmernal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gsum mchog 'bad pas bsgoms te tshon/ ngan song yongs su sbyong bar grub par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dmudabang po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gsang ba'i snying po 'di rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ gang 'ga' 85wa 286

zhig ming tsam nyan pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog 17pa'amachi sku/ bris nas kyang mgo'am / gtsug phud dam/ dpung pa'am/ mgul bar btags te 'chang bar nibyed na de'i batshe 'di nyid la dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad dang / 'chi ba dang 'brel pa'i rmi lam 'byung ba'am/ ngan song dang 'brel pa'i mtshan ma de dag thams cad rmi lam tsam du yang mi 'byung ngo / /gang 'ga' zhig dkyil 'khor du yang ji lta ba bzhin du zhugs nas dbang bskur te snying po yang zlos shing sngags kyi don sgom rigepar byed na lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag la sdig pa gang cung zad kyang nye bar mi 'gyur zhing ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa dang / bud med dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / byol song dang / yi dgas cadang / dmyal ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba shi ba'i lus rnams dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur na de dmyal bar skyes na 7yang de ma thag nyid du rnam par thar nas lha'i 2rigs su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 99rigs der skyes par gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid mngon sum du byed cing phyir mi ldog par yang 'gyur ro/ /rgyud nges pa can du yang 'gyur zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa rnams rab tu spangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs sam/ lha'i 1 rigs sam/ gzhan du yang bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 11dbang po mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan pa dang / bde ba thams cad myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i kyisnyedabang pos bcom ldan 'das la snga ma bzhin du bskor ba byas te 12phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad kyi 85—287

dbang du gyur pa hu)rnams la phan pa dang bde bar bgyi (snyeb dang / ji ltar sems can rnams ngan song thams cad la rgyab kyis (gyiphyogs par bgyi ba dang /bla na ma mchis pa g.yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde blag tu rtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du chos bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (gengan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba 0rigazi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po gsungs te⑦/ de mgon po shākya thub pa nyid kyis du rigasungs pa ni/ dang po re zhig (gernal 'byor pas skye bos dben pa'i yid dang rjes su mthun 7pa'i sa phyogs sul/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'bol 11ba'i gdan nyugel 'dug ste/ dri bzang pos maṇḍal byas nas nye bar spyod pa lnga'i nyisamachod pa bya'o/ /de nas chos 8thams cad bdag med par bsgoms la/ bdag nyid yi ge rghaṃ gis rdo rje nyuge'abar ba me nyi mar bsgoms nyazhete/ de'i nyu tshomagrin par yi ge trī nyusnyelas padma dang de'i steng du 'dab ma'i 17rtse mor yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rdo rje de lce la thim par bya zhing badzra dzi hwa bu zhes bya'ol/ /des rdo rje'i 21lcer 'gyur zhing sngags zlos pa nus par 'gyur ro/ 2/ /lag pa gnyis kyi dbus su yi ge a sosnyedakar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i cenasteng du yi ge tt+waṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang de 2lhaganyis lag pa'i mthil du thim par bya ste rdo rje'i da lag par 'gyur zhing phyag rgya 'ching bar nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bsrung 28ba'i 'khor lo bsgom 9par bya ste tsho/ oṃ groṇḍi —4badzra sa ma ya hūṃ bam̐ (2zhes brjod cing khro bo ti rin /ti ri bcing bar tsho tshobya ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang 85wa 288

byas nas/ /mthe bong rdo rje dam po yis/ /khro bo'i yid kyis ①dgab bya ba/ /khro bo ti rin ②ti ri bcing / /de nas rdo rje phyed (kyepa'i gdan gyis 'dug pas rdo rje ti rin (geti ri bcings la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur stib gzung du6 bar bya ste/oṃ badzra dzwa lā na lārka (7ris a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ 58)zhes pas so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las / mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgreng 597ba rdo rje bsdams nyu )pa'i steng du dgab pa'i tshul du gzung nyu1ba ni rdo rje ti rin nyudzāti ri'o/ /oṃ sum̐ zhes bya ba'i yi ge gnyis po 'di'i nyusnyego chas go cha bgos 1rinas/ oṃ badzra dzwa lā na lārka mas zhes bya ba sgrogs shing g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar 7bya ste/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gsor zhing bgegs thams cad la bsnun 1 no/ /de nas rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas bgegs bsreg par bya ste/ oṃ badzra dzā lā na la ha na rtse da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza /kār ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la sor mo rnams nang du 'bar ba la mthe bo rdo rje bsgreng (2 ba 'di ni rdo rje me'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sbyo nyerjes la badzra ne ṭī brnya sarba bi: di na zhes pa'i ( 2phyag rgya dang ldan pas bgegs thams cad bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la mthe bo gnyis brkyang 2ste mnyam la bzung ba ni rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa ri gebarkyang ba sa la bzhag ste 'og bcing bar ri 5bya'o/ /oṃ badzra dṛ ru snaḍho me bha ba rakṣa saX 2shes hā zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas steng bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ hu 95lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa ces su )pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la mgal 1me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor nas mgo bo'i steng du bzung ba ni rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de'i ( ge'og tu rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas slar steng bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra yakṣa 85wa 289

tt+waṃ zhes pa 3)'di dang rdo rje thal mo mthe bo gnyis brkyang la mdzub ②mo gnyis mche ba lta bur byas pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas shar phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ rdu bharnya ①rta zhes pa'o/ /dṛ zhes pa yang ngo / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis mthe'u ⑤chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel la mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar la bzlog nas spyi bor bzhag pa ni rdo rje gtsug metor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /yang rdo rje zhags pas shar de nyid bcing bar bya ste④/ oṃ badzra pā 7༄sha hrīḥdunasazhes pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis mkhrig ma (spumadud pa byas pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje ba dan gyis nub phyogs bcing bar bya ste/oṃ badzra pā tshe tt+waṃ ke pa tt+waṃ gi ni ra ṭa 17zhes pa dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung 1 byas la mdzub mo gnyis mnyam por gshibs te phye la mthe'u chung ba dan ltar byas pa ni rdo rje ba dan gyi'o/ /phyogs dang mtshams dang steng dang 'og gi bgegs rnams tshar gcad 8par bya'o/ /rdo rje dus kyis byang phyogs bcings te hrīḥbadzra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa 8zhes pa dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya snying gar bstan 1gepar byas pa ni rdo rje dus kyi'o⑩/ /rdo rje rtse mos lho bcings te/ oṃ badzra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa nya tshozhes pa 12dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul ni rdo rje rtse mo'i'o/ /rdo rje las kyis tsodakyil 'khor bcing bar byas la ra ba bya'o/ /hūm̐ badzra kurma zhes pa'o/ /yang rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyis nang du ra ba bya ste rgyu 2 zhes pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la rdo rje mkhrig 1ma gnyis bsnol te mthe'u chung gnyis lcags kyur 'asbrel la mdzub mo gnyis sdigs na mdzub tu sgreng )ba ni 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi'o/ /'di nyid las mdzub mo dang gung 85wa 290

mo gnyis rdo rje ltar byas pa ni rdo rje las kyi'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje'i gur sbyin par bya ste/ badzra brnya 1bo zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun du rdzogs par bya ste/ oṃ badzra bibadzra tsakra rin rghaṃ zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings (minas / /mdzub ④/mo mthe'u chung rdo rje bcing cir/ /rdo rje 'khor lo zhes grags pa/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /'dis phyogs thams cad du g.yas skor yinyid kyis bskor ba las dkyil 'khor thams cad sprul par 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid khar bzhag nas nges par blta mebazhin du rdo rje 'khor lo'i sngags lan brgyad(she bzlas so/ /de yis dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mngon sum 59༄lta bur blos dmigs la me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de'i/ phyogs thams cad du yan lag lnga pa dang / 'dis phyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba bityā kā ya bārtsitta pra ṇa 17me na badzra banda rna ka 12ro mi zhes pa'o12/ /de nas phyag bzhi bya ba ste 'di ltar lus thams cad kyis dang / rdo rje thal mo brkyang bas shar phyogs su phyag byas te/ oṃ sarba biji dzo pa'i nā lnga'i rna nirsā mita yā mi/sarba ta thā ga ta chogebadzra sa twa a dhi tiṣṭha māṃ 17zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas de bzhin du langs la rdo rje thal mo snying gar cho1 byas te/ lho phyogs su dpral ba sa la reg cing phyag bya ste/ oṃ sarba bibadzā bhi ṣe kā ya/ āḥ rna nirsā nyusnyeta yā nyu mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ratna bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ 2 zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas de bzhin du langs la / rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bzhag ste/ nub phyogs su kha sa la reg cing phyag bya ste/nyal/ oṃ sarba bibyu dzā pra brta nā ātna rna nirsā 22ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra dharma pra brta ya māṃ lhazhes bya ba 'dis so/ /de nas de bzhin du langs la 24rdo rje 85—291

thal mo spyi bo nas phab stetshi/ snying gar ②byas la byang phyogs su spyi bo sa la reg cing phyag bya ste/ oṃ sarba biji dzā kurma ṇi ātna rna/ nirsā ②ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra kurma ku ru māṃ ④zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas pus mo'i lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs te/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar ⑤byas la sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags par bya ste/ phyogs bcu na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / nor bu dang /padma dang / las kyi rigs su bzhugs bo pa thams cad dang / snying po dang /phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / rig ④pa dang / lha thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba phyogs bcu'i dusangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan snga dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang /rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / padma dang / las kyi rigs su bzhugs ⑨pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / rig ⑩pa dang /sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi yang spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags tsunyepar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams dang / sems can gyi rigs thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rgya cher rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba thams cad la mchos kyi 'khor lo bskor 12bar bya ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i snyisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'bazhed pa thams cad 85—292

la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 0cigasol ba 'debs so/ /de nas me tog gi phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /oṃ sarba binutpa pū dzā ②me gha sa mu dra (mispa ra ṇa sa ma ye rghaṃ zhes pa'o/ /bdug pa'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de / oṃ sarba bi pa pū dzā ④me gha sa mu dra (gespa ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu zhes pa'o/ /mar me'i yiphyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ oṃ sarba bi dā lo ke pū dzā game gha sa mu dra mesga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /dri'i (rsha)phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ oṃ sarba biṅgas pū dzā 8me gha sa mu dra 7spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pa'ol/ /thal mo snyim pa khong stong du sbyar ba bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/oṃ sarba bisgo bhyo ga ratna lang kā ra pū dzdza kyi me gha sa mu dra nyu)sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pa'o / /oṃ ④ binta su lā su ra ti bī ḍā sau nyu9khya a nutta ra pū dzā tsose gha sa mu dra 0sga ra ṇa sa ma ye rghaṃ zhes pa dang / oṃ sarba bi da nutta ra bo rgya lang kā ra was gu dzā 8me gha sa mu dra masga ra ṇa sa ma ye skru zhes pa'o/ /de nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rjes su dran par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i las kyi bu phyag rgya bcings la/ snying rje'i —1dbang gis gesems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bya ste/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral 22ba'i phyir dang / ma grol ba rnams grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus pa 'khor nageba'i rgya mtsho las yang dag par bsgral ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba bityā 2gebadzra bo 36snyi tsitta pū dzā du ri tshome gha sa mu dra ( shesga ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu zhes pa'o/ /de nas sgeg mo'i ci phyag rgya bcings la 85wa 293

'di skad ces brjod de37/ sems can thams cad yo byad thams cad dang (miyang dag par ldan zhing phun sum tshogs pa rnams 'dod pa tsam la so sor 'byor par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bidma hā badzradha (kyeb dā na pā ra mi tā ④su dzā (geme gha sa mu dra 4)sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ phreng ba ma'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de / sems can thams cad mi dge ba'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /dge ba'i lus dang / ngag dang —/ yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par 0gyur cig /oṃ sarba bi da nutta ra ma hā bo rgyu hā (sher shrī la 9༄bā ⑩ra mi tā nyurnyes dzā nyi me hunyegha sa mu dra 1 spha ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu/ glu ma'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 8yang dag par brgyan 39pa'i lus dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu phan tshun 'jigs pa med pa dang /zhe 'gras pa med par zhugs shing snying dang mig mngon par dga' ba dang /chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bi da nutta ra ma hā dharmā tsho1 snab bo dhi kṣarnyi pā (1snyer mi tā (175 dzā 3 )me gha sa mu dra tsho stospa ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu zhes pa'o / /gar ma'i 2phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi spyod pa dang mngon par ldan zhing sangs rgyas nyid la mchog tu gzhol zhing 'khor ba yongs su spong ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bi sā ra pa ri tyā gā nutta ra tsho ༄bīrya pā ger mi tā pū dzā sgo me gha sa mu dra 27spa ra ṇa 2rjes ma ye rtsu zhes pa'o/ /me tog ma'i /phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral zhing bsam gtan 29dang / rnam par thar pa 85wa 294

dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang ske/ rig pa dang / dbang thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bi da nutta ra sau khya bi hā ra smyu na pā hu)ra mi tā (gesu dzā (bame gha sa mu dra ④spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /bdug pa ma'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang (ge'ajig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab dang ske/ ye shes dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /so so ⑥yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang dag par thob ste bzo dang bstan nyabacos thams cad shes shing sgyu nirtsal dang / sbyor ba dang / cho ga shes pa dang / de kho na nyid mthong ba dang ske/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad yang dag par gcod pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bi da nutta ra kle shatstsha (7da sarba dharma sa manta dzñā na ma hā pradzñā pā ra mi tā pū dzā 7me gha sa mu dra 3)sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa'o / /mar me ma'i (2phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ sems can thams cad log par ltung ba thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /oṃ sarba bitpablo pā na ya bi sho dha ni dzñā nā lo ka pra ṇi dhā na rnyimā ra mi tā pu dzā nyusteme gha sa mu dra tsospha hu tshor ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /dri chab ma'i ti phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod de/ sems can thams cad mi shes pa dang bral bar gyur cig /oṃ sarba bitpablo pā ya garnya bi nā sa ni badzra gasto cho1ḍapā ya pā ra mi tā pū dzā du )me tsho ཿgha sa mu dra ༷ gnespha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pa'o/ /lus kyi bsnyen bkur zhugebya ba'i phyir bdag nyid phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du phyin par lhag par mos pa 2 cibyas la/ oṃ sarba biṅgā ya nirsā snyeta na pū dzā na me gha sa mu dra zu spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes bya'o/ /thams cad du lce 85wa 295

brgya pa'i kha yis mnyam med mi g.yo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod ①pa nye bar spyod pa lhag par mos pa (kyebyas la/ oṃ sarba bi:sdirsha (mita na pū dzā ④me gha sa mu dra (snyespha ra ṇa sa ma ye rghaṃ zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa'i sbyor ba nyid kyis chos mnyam pa nyid du lhag par mos pa ⑥bya ste/ oṃ sarba birtsitta nirsā (7༄ta (8)na pū dzā dzi༄me gha sa mu dra 0sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya'o/ /chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam pa'o zhes lhag par mos pa 7byas lam/ oṃ sarba biṅga hya pū dzā hurteme gha sa mu dra /tsho gespa ra ṇa mas ma ye rtsu zhes bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa rnam pa nyi shus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par mchod la/ bdag nyid dbul bar bya stebla/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag dus thams cad dang rnam pa thams cad du so sor bzhes tshes gsol lo/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol zhes bya'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /bde ba dang yid bde ba nyid kyis mi yi mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag 1 tshogis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang 85—296

pos gzir las sgrol te / /zhes bya'o/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su (gebasngos la/ sdom rdo pa gzung bar bya ste/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims ni/ /bdag gis so sor byabartan por (gegazung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum mchog bla med pa6)/ /sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor byung / /deng tsonas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /de nyid kyis ni rab tu gzung ske/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog gis2/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /padma chen po'i rigs dag pa/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las chen rigs ni bsdus pa lapon/ /sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan / /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin/ /kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa / /dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyis 57shing / /sdom pa ma lus gzung bgyis nas/ /ma bsgral ⑩ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol 12ba rnams bdag gis dgrolas/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung bgyi4lha/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod//ces bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la lha la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par lhag par mos te/ nye bar spyod pa lnga la sogs pas mchod par bya'o//85—297

yang dag par mchod nas ni bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan bsngags ②par byed de/ces ma'o sangs rgyas ces sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas mjo(da pa mchog legs so/ /ngan song thams cad legs sbyangs nas/ /sems can byang chub thob mdzad phyir//zhes pa'o(kye/ /de nas badzra añdza li zhes pa dang / rdo rje bsdams pa snying gar ①dral bar bya ste/ oṃ sarba bid rigebadzra brta tāṭa (nyezhes brjod cing ⑥/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya bcings 0)la/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra dṛ (nyephyo me bha ba shā shwa 7to me bha ba hre da yo nyu )me a dhi tiṣṭha sarba sirnyim tshim yatstsha rgyu ha ha ha ha hoḥ0zhes bya'o/ /oṃ badzra muṣṭi 12 / sems ma rdo rje bcings tsonas/ oṃ sarba bita 8sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā pa ma pa rtso9na ya hūṃ/ rdo rje bsdams pa brtan 0bcings nas/ /rdo rje'i nyu)phyag rgya gnyis par nasanyarta/ /myur du gyen du legs 'phen la/ /ltung ba slong bar byed pa'i ni stamachog /ces du nyepa'o/ /oṃ sarba bita sarpā pā duya bi sho dha ne hūṃ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags sos/ /rdo rje bsdams ( stepa brtan byas nas/ /gung mo dag ni kha sbyar te/ /mtha' ma bzhi po tsokha sprad pa / /myur du sdig pa dral bar 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba bita tāṭa du nya// sems ma rdo rje bcings la/ oṃ sarba bita sarpā 2 tshob ra ṇa bi sho dha ni 'u mu ne ⑥ phaṭa/'don pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas de'i sno 7rjes la rnal 'byor pas hunyesnying ga'i hunyedabus su yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i du steng du oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na zhusteye swā hā/ oṃ na maḥsarba durga ti sho dha ne sogesho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha 0de shudhe bi shudhe sarba kurmā ri tshob ra ṇa gi bi shurnye swā hā/ de dag gis ruttangan song thams cad yongs su sbyong 4 staba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas bkug nas bcug ste bcings nas dbang du byas 85wa 298

la① / nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gzhug ②ste dkyil 'khor gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor du gyur pa las dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag nyid kyi dngos po 'khor los sgyur ②ba'i gzugs shākya seng ger ④bsgom mo/ /de nas shākya thub pa'i thugs kur (nyeyi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom (7zhing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na (7ye swā hā/ de nas rdo rje rgyu'i las kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor sprul te/ oṃ sarba bid (kyebadzra tsakra rgyu zhes pas so/ /sems ma rdo rje bcings nas de nyid kyi sor mo dbus ma gnyis kyis phreng ba thogs la sa ma ya rtsu zhes pa 'dis yid kyis ⑨'jug go / /phreng ba de yang rang gi mgo bor bzhag ste/ pra tītstsha 7badzra hoḥ(1zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas rang gi mgo bor bcings te/ oṃ pra ti groṇḍa nyage sta mi mi sa twa ma hā tsob la zhes pa 'dis so/ /gdong 8pa bcings la yang 'dis dgrol lo/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid de/ /khyed kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad mig 12ni bye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang /he badzra pā 7bya zhes pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen por (1 tshoji srid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de srid du blta'o/ /yang sems ma rdo rje bcings la thugs kur phonyedagrol zhing rdo rjer byin gyis 51rtabarlabs pa'i bum pa nas dbang bskur ba rdo rje khu tshur gyis shu )sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bibyā nyebadzra a bhi ṣiñtsa 3)zhes pa'o/ /yang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas gdab ste/ oṃ sarba bibyā badzra dha ra tiṣṭha brdza ṇi du snye a bhi ṣiñtsa 2riṅgācig/ oṃ sarba bityā badzra badzre ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/tshe ma sarba bibyā 2 ratna badzi ṇi shes a bhi ṣiñtsa sa(shrī/ oṃ sarba bityā 85wa 299

dharma brdza ṇi ①rgyu a bhi ṣiñtsa ②ṅgā/ oṃ sarba bibyā kurma brdza ṇi ni/ a bhi ṣiñtsa liṅgā/oṃ rtsu badzra tu ṣpe ehoḥyiyi ge gnyis kyi stigo chas go bgos ⑧la/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba gzung bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi0/ /dbang gis ⑩de 0ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir gzung / /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti stam bhi ṣiñtsa mi 8tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra nā mā abhi ṣe ka ta/ oṃ badzra sa twa stam ④snyi ṣiñtsa 84/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta masirji badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dhā 3 snar yā hunyemi badzra sa twa nyi hi hi hi hūṃ zhes pa'o / /oṃ sarba bibyā badzā dhiṣṭha na sa ma nyu)ye hūm̐/ bdag nyid byin gyis c-i )brlab pa'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas mthe bong dang gung mo dang mthe'u chung gyen du bsgreng naXste kha (2sbyar nas mdzub mo dang ming med sems dpa'i skyil krung gebyas pa ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste/ snying ga sadang / mgrin pa dang ske/ dpral ba dang / mdzod spu dang / smin 4snyematshams dang / sna dang /rna ba dang / dku dang / pus tsho 9mo dang / rkang pa dag dang / byin pa dang /mig gnyis dang / gsang bar byin gyis brlab pa yang bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lus la sa ma ya aḥyi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sa bon las byung ba'i mtshan ma thams cad kyi snying po'i nga rgyal bskyed cing oṃ sarba bibyā dṛ 0bya dzaḥrgyu bam̐ hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ sa ma ya ho/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na 2snyen swā hā zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /thun mong ba yang ngo / /de nas rang gi lus la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcings te/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥbarjod cing 37gnas ji lta ba rnams su bkug (3 nas 85wa 300

bcug ste bcings la dbang du bya'o/ /rang gi thugs kur ①rgyu yig ni/ /sbyor bas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /shākya seng ge'i (gyidam tshig gi/ /phyag rgya rab tu bshad par bya / /dbus su ting 'dzin mchog gis ni/ /bzhugs pa dam tshig phyag rgyar (mibashad / /rdo rje bcing ba dam byas la/ /gung mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar/ /rdo rje phyag rgya ④dam bcas pa(5)/ /rdo rje gtsug tor phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid gung mo rin chen dang / /gung mo padma'i rnam pa dang / /de nyid gung mo rdo rje las/ /sor mo lhag ma 'bar byas nyid/ /sor mo de nyid 'bar byas pa/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las ni srin lag dang / /mthe'u gnyis ni mnyam ste bsgreng ⑥/ /mdzub (7mo padma'i 'dab ma las/ /gung mo rdo rje bsgreng (8)ba dang / /de nyid mdun du bzhag nas ni/ /rdo rje dra ba'i tshul du bya/ /snying gar (6yang ni mthe bo ⑩mnyam/ /rab tu brkyang 3)ba phreng ba ma/ /thal mo sbyar ba kha nas dbyung ske/ /gar byed spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /rdo rje bsdams pa thur du sbyin/ /thal mo legs sbyar gyen du gtor/ /mthe bo mnyam ste rab tu bsdamanyude/ /rab tu brkyang ba byug pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mdzub mo mthe bong gung mo rnams/ /re re zhing yang phan tshun du/ /mngon du phyogs pa gzung bar bya/ /mdzub mo gcig ni cung zad bkug /mthe bo gnyis ni mdud pa bcing ske/ /mthe bo mdzub mo bsnol 32ba bcing / /rdo rje khu tshur rtse mo bsdamatshe/ /mgrin par pad zla'i dkyil 'khor durige/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rnam par bsgomatso/ /sngar gyi ⑩'byin pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /chos kyi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /thugs kur hu sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ / bsams te 3)las kyi phyag rgya bya/ /ji skad bshad pa'i chos 'khor lo/ /shākya'i rna rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /sa gnon rinamachog sbyin 85—301

ting 'dzin dang / /mi 'jigs ①sbyin sogs rim pa bzhin/ /ting 'dzin mchog tu gnas pa ni/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i lag ngar dbyug pa dang / /g.yon pa snying gar sbyosaral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs ①mdzub bsgreng bya ste/ /g.yas pa bteg ste brkyang ④bar bya/ /lag pa gnyis ka gar bsdoms nasaphyi/ /gdugs kyi rnam par gzhag par bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga gang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas skyob min pa'i yang / /rdo rje bsgyings pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /btags pa'i bsam yipas 'dud gyopar bya/ /phreng ba bcing dang kha nas dbyung dunas/ /gar gyis yongs su bskor ba nyid/ /rdo rje khu tshur sbyor ba yis/ /bdug 59dpa la hu )sogs de bzhin sbyar/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu bcing ba yis/ /mthe chung la ni lcags sgrog che/ / mkhrig ma mdud sgronyecing mdzub gnyis bsnol/ /rgyab dag kyang ni nges par bsdam512/ /de nas de phyir go rims 'ogebazhin / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che'i/ /las kyi phyag rgya 'chang ④ba yilcage / /mtshan nyid yang dag rab tu bshad/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas / /phan tshun lhan cig gshibs nas ni/ /mdzub mo dang ni gung mo dgug /me tog rnam par gzung bar bya/ /byams pa yi ni 8phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur 3 tshobazhag la/ /g.yas pa'i dpung pa'i thad kur ni/ /mdzub mo gung mo brkyang (/snyenas ni/ /mig gi tshul du gzhag 3)par bya/ /mthong ba don yod phyag rgya'ordu )/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mdzub mo dag ni brkyang 2lhanas su/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu legs bzhag pa/ /ngan song thams cad spong ba'i yin/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur bzhag la/ /g.yas pa'i 3 dbyig pa lta bur ni/ /gyen du bsgreng nas lhagazhag par bya/ /mya ngan mun pa kun 'joms 85wa 302

kyi'o① / /g.yon pa khu tshur lte bar gzhag /lag pa g.yas pa glang po che'i/ /sna yi tshul du bzhag pa ni/ /spos kyi glang po'i (kyephyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur bzhag ste/ /g.yas pa ral gri thogs pa yi / /tshul du 'jog par byed pa ni/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar (gegazhag /g.yas pa steng skor (snyemakha' mdzod kyi/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings pal/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /g.yas kyi logs su 'jog byed pa/ /ye shes tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis (7bum 'dzin ltar / /bzhag pa 'od dpag med pa'i 'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur brla steng ⑧gzhag /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gzhogs su ni/ /mthe bo 1rimathe chung brkyang ⑩byas la/ /zla tshes rnam pa zla 'od kyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni snying ga 1lharu/ /padma'i rnam par rnam phye nyurtel//rtse mo phan tshun sbyar ba ni/ /bzang skyong gi ni phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /go cha 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /nu ma gnyis su legs bzhag pa'oste / /dra ba can 'od phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur gzhag la/ /g.yas pa snying kur ri7bzhag nas ni/ /sor mo dbus ma bsgreng byas la/ /rdo rje snying po'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar tshegazhag /g.yas pa mi 'jigs 7sbyin rnams la/ /blo gros mi zad pa yi'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur lte bar gzhag /g.yas pa se gol gtogs (ho pa ni/ /spobs pa brtsegs 8pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur nyu9bzhag ste/ /g.yas pa rin chen khu tshur bya / /kun tu bzang po'i phyag rgya yin/ /mtshan ma dang bral cho ga yis/ /las kyi phyag rgyar rmo ri stabashad pa yin/ /snying gar na/rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /gzugs can yang dag gzung bya zhing / /'byin pa rnams su ji ltar gzung / /phyag rgya mtshan ma 85wa 303

bsnams pa dag /rdo rje dril bu bzung nas ni/ /thugs kur ①rdo rje 'dzin pa ni / /phyag rgya che zhes byang chub gang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che'i//'byin pa rnams su ji ltar gzung / /phyag rgya mtshon cha bsnams pa rnams/ /bdag nyid chen po gang gang gis/ /phyag rgya gang dang gang bcings nas/ /snying po don gyi bzlas pa dang / /rang gi bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi rnams sgrub 2byed pa/ /lha rnams thams cad rgyas btab dang / /kun mkhyen g.yon tan rdzogs pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ /ngan song thams cad legs sbyangs sanas/ /sems can byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /de nas sngags rab bshad bya ste/ /ngan song kun sbyong dkyil 'khor du/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi dun)rab sbyor gyis/ /bya ba thams cad nus par 'gyur/ /so so so sor rdo rje gar/ /byas nas sngags rnams brjod par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba yite/sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā 9pa ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakli buddhā ya / tabya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shurnye bi shurnye sarba kurmā ba ra ṇa 98)bi shudhe swā 99skuhā/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu blangs la lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje 'gying ba dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor zhing 'di skad ces brjod dortso sta/ /badzra bā tsa na 11ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥrang gi snying gar bsgreng tshugeste gsal ba'i sbyor bas gzung zhing ṭakki 12dzaḥhoḥ(7zhes brjod do/ /de nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya ste/ de dag gis lobyang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa'i dbang phyug dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams bltas la mchod pa thams cad kyis rab tu tsomachod do/ /de nas de rnams kyi 3)bstod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod par bya ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /khams gsum 85wa 304

pa yi ①'gro kun gyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa/ /shākya seng ge khyod phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rang gi de nyid ston mdzad pa/ /rdo rje gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal//mnyam nyid de nyid bsgoms pa yis/ /khams gsum la gnas thams cad la/ /dbang bskur ②rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /rin chen gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal//so sor kun rtog rang bzhin can/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas/ /sems can dbugs 'byin mdzad pa por ri/ /padma'i gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal//sems can sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bya ba rjes sgrub rang bzhin can/ /phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po/ /sna tshogs gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum 'od kyis gsal mdzad nas/ /sems can kun gyis 'phags pa yi/ /bden pa mthong bar mdzad pa po/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams(ge/ /sbyin pas sems can thams cad kyi / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor ⑧rgyal mtshan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag /gcod cing bdud bzhi'i stobs bcom nas/ /sems can byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor rnon po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /gdugs dkar gyis yini brgyan pa yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po thob mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar (3nyekhyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar mkhan lha mo bzhi po dang / /spos dang me tog mar me ma(she/ /dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dad sogs ngo bo las byung ba/ /sgo bzhi'i 9nyedabus na gang bzhugs 8pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /sgo skyong khyed rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /sgo 85—305

bzhi yi ni logs dag na/ /khyams rnams su ni bzhugs mdzad pa/ /rab dga' la sogs bcu gnyis gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed phyag 'tshal/ /tshangs dbang drag po zla ba sogs/ /phyogs bzhir 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /me dang srin po rlung lha dang / /'byung po'i bdag po khyed phyag 'tshal/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor mdun du kun bstod nas/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril 'chang bas/ /bstod 97)pa 'di dag yang dag brjod/ /phyi nas rang gi lus la ni/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor rab tu gzhug② /de ltar nges par bsgom bzhin pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dang po sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal stamachog ces 0bya ba rab tu bshad par bya ste / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa mārya nutpanda tāta(ge/ de'i don ni rnam par thar pa las phyogs bcu'i ri 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad stong pa nyid bcu drug tu lhag par mos pa 7bya ste/ ngar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid stong pa nyid du blta'o/ /de nas yi ge hūm̐ las rdzogs pa'i rdo rjes rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du 8༄yi ge ro gyis 9me'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i 7steng du yi ge baṃ las chu gter chen po dang / de'i 11steng du yi ge kai las nyugegaser gyi dkyil 'khor dang /de'i )steng du dbus su rtsu sum̐ hūm̐ zhes bya ba ste/ de las ri rab gru bzhi pa rin po che'i rang bzhin rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed sal/ oṃ badzra dṛ ḍho zhes pa snarnyil sogs pa dang rdo rje bsdams pas 8byin gyis brlab 3 tshobo/ /de'i thertesteng du rdo rje'i 1rtargyu'i 2 las kyi phyag rgyas yi ge rghaṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che'i rtse mo can gyi 57gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pal/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan lha/ /grwa tsho snyebazhi rnams ni thams cad du//85wa 306

sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /zla ba mtshan ma rdo rjes 6)spras/ /dra ba dra byed kyis brgyan ②cing / /thig le dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor ni 'khor lo rtsibs (gyibargyad pa rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i nga lte ba'i steng du seng ge'i gdan no/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /'khor lo rtsibs tshogebargyad pa'i nang rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te lha rnams kyi gnas so/ /phyi'i (6)dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas ni snam bu rnams la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad blta'og / /seng ge'i gdan gyi steng gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yi ge a la sogs pa dang ske/ yi ge ka sal sogs pa shes rab dang thabs kyi yi ge zhu bar gyur pa mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gyis sems can gyi don gyi rgyu 99༄rdzogs pa'i sngags kyi gzugs hu )su gyur te/oṃ mu ne 0mu ne ma hā mu na 8ye swā hā/ sngags 'dis dpal shākya'i 8rgyal po rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sgrib pa thams cad sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs skopa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de'i 15phyag rgya dang sngags bshad par bya ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings tsonas/ /rim gyis rnam par dbye bar bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ /'khor (1 ba thams cad gcod byed yin/ /de yi dpe ni 'di lta ste//ji ltar padma la chags pa'i/ /bung ba la 12sogs bsdams pa rnams/ /padma'i 'dab ma kha phye na/ /bcings pa'i sdug bsngal las thar byed/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi516/ /srid gsum 'khor bar bcings pa 'di/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid shākya yi/ /seng ges bcings pa las grol mdzad/ /de 85—307

nas dpal shākya thub pa'i thugs kur 6)yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rol/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags thams cad kyis ②bskyed par bya ste/ rdo rje gtsug tor nas brtsams te ji srid rdo rje 'bebs pa'i mthar thug pa 'byung ba yin no/ /de nas sngags rnams 'byung ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ④te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā (snyeya/ ta thā ga tā yiya/ arta te saṃ myakli buchu g.ya/ tabya thā/oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha (kyene/ shurnye bi shudhe sarba kurmā ⑨ba ra ṇa bi shurnye swā lho )tā/ sngags 'di nges par brjod do/ /de nas de'i 0phyir go rims ni / /rim 8bzhin yang dag rab bshad tsobya/ oṃ badzra rtsu phaṭa/ kha yi sgo nas phyung nas ni/ /kun nas 'od zer lnga par 'thon/ /kun nas phyogs bcur snang byas nas/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni thar mdzad de/ /'od zer rnams ni slar log tsonas/ /thugs kur 8zhugs te de rjes la/ /sngags dang 'od zer gnyis 'dres bskye/ /las byung sku ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rtsibasa'o tsho/ /shar phyogs padma zla bar bzhugs/ /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /thugs ka nyushelas byung bzhugs pa ni/ /sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'bar/ /sa gnon rtso'iphyag rgya yang dag bzhugs/ /de ltar 'od zer spro bsdu ni/ /sngar bshad pa yi so )thams cad kyang / /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis / /sngags dang 'od zer legs 'dres dang / /sku ni bskyed ( nyecing yang dag rdzogs / /ji bzhin chaganas su bzhugs par bya/ /oṃ rasnosta ma ṭwāṃ zhu zhes bya bas dbyung bar bya'o/ /lho yi rtsibs tsho stesu yang dag bzhugs/ /padma zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /rin chen gtsug tor de bzhen gshegs/ /thugs ka rdusnyenas ni 85wa 308

nges bton ①nas/ /sangs rgyas mtshan gyis yang dag brgyan②/ /sku mdog sngo zhing shin tu mdzes/ / 'di yi rdzu phyag rgya mchog sbyin nyid/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa'i/ /sems can kun la dbang skur mdzod④/ /sngar bzhin spro dang bsdu ba dang / /gzugs bskyed pa yi rim pa yis(pe/ /oṃ padmotta ma hrīḥ(7zhes dbyung bar bya'o/ /de nas nub kyi rtsibs gnas pa'i/ /pad stengs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sa bon 'od zer gyis rdzogs pa'i/ /padma gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /thugs ka rtsodalas ni phyung gyur nas/ /rjes su ston mdzad bzhugs pa ni/ /padma rā /shega'i 'od 'bar bsti/ /bsam gtan phyag rgyas rnam par bzhugs/ /oṃ bi shodha 7ma aḥskyezhes dbyung ngo / /byang phyogs rtsibs gnas padma yime/ /steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thugs ka nas bton ⑫sangs rgyas ni/ /sna tshogs gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /sku mdog ljang gu ④'od 'bar ba/ /'di yi phyag rgyas mi 'jigs tsosbyin/ /phyag rgyas phrin las sna tshogs mdzad/ /sems can 'khor ba las sgrol ba'o/ /yi ge oṃ gyis sadas rgyas dbyung / /gtsug tor gzi brjid de bzhin gshegs/ /me yi mtshams gnas padmar gnas/ /yang dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /g.yas pas ④nyi ma yang dag bsnams/ /phyag g.yon pa ni dku tshoḥ tshol gnas/ /sku mdog dkar dmar 'od kyis ni/ /khams gsum po ni snang bar mdzad/ /hūṃ gi sa bon las byung ba/ /gtsug tor rgyal mtshan de bzhin gshegs/ /thugs ka 'onyalas byung phyung nas ni/ /bden bral rtsibs la bzhugs nas ni/ /pad gnas zla nyusteba'i gzugs la yang / /sku mdog dmar zhing gnag pa la/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams no/ /sems can ser sna sbyong mdzad pa/ /dhīḥ yig sa 85—309

bon las rdzogs pa'i/ /gtsug tor rnon po de bzhin gshegs/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs rnams/ /gcod mdzad rlung gi rtsibs su phyung / /padma zla ba la bzhugs shing / /'di yi phyag mtshan g.yas ral gri/ /g.yon na glegs bam bsnams ①pa ni/ /sku mdog mkha' ltar sngo ba'o/ /padma la gnas zla bar bzhugs / /ṭwāṃ (geyig sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar ②de bzhin gshegs/ /sems can rnams kyi chos kyi rje/ /dbang ldan rtsibs su dbyung bar bya/ /kunda lta bu'i mdog lta bu/ /'di yi phyag mtshan gdugs bsnams rdzusapa/ /de kun sna tshogs padmar gnas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i/ /(sem ṭwāṃ 6)hrīḥ.aḥ/ sngags de rnams su brjod nas su/ /thugs ka ⑦nas kyang tshon dbyung ba dang 9ra/ /mtshams kyi gnas ni bzhi po ru/ /padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /rigs kyi sku mdog 'dzin pa ste / /dkar ser dmar po sna tshogs mdog /de nas phyag rgya bcing ba ⑩ni/ /sngar bshad ji skad bshad 3)bzhin du/ / sngags de 8nyid ni brjod nas su/ /thugs ka nyurtenas kyang dbyung bibya ste/ /bdug 8pa la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /padma la ⑩gnas zla ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni mtshams bzhi pohu tsho/ /thams cad du yang sku mdog ni/ /rigs kyi (12rim pa nyid kyis so/ /oṃ sarba saṃ ska nyunyer pa ri shurta 2 stedharma te ga ga na sa muṅga 31te swa bhā rmo deb bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/sngags kyis tsho snyedabyung ste shar gyi sgo'i/ /gzhogs gnyis dag tu gnas pa ni/ /byams pa la sogs gnas bzhi po/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thams cad sems dpa'i skyil krung tsu )can/ /phyag rgya sku mdog rim pa yang /byams pa thugs ni rnam dag pa/ /sku mdog ser po 'od zer bzang / /g.yas 85—310

pa klu shing me tog can/ /g.yon pas spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /gnyis pa mthong ba don yod ni/ /sku mdog ser po 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag g.yas padma spyan can te/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni dkur 0)bzhag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum pa yang / /mtshan ni ngan song spong 'joms pa/ /sku mdog dkar po 'od 'bar zhing / /phyag rgya lcags kyu bsnams ②pa can/ /bzhi pa mya ngan mun pa kun/ /nges 'joms blo gros de bzhin te/ /dkar ser 'dres pa'i mdog tu snang / /de yi phyag rgya dbyug pa bsnamasal/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur ④bzhag cing / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ⑤du bzhugs/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi rnams kyang / /lho sgor rab tu bzhugs pa'o/ /dang po spos kyi glang po yang / /dkar po sngo ba'i sku mdog can/ /'di yi phyag rgya phyag g.yas na/ /dri yis yidung ni rab tu bkang / /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur ⑦bzhag la / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong / /gnyis pa dpa' bar 'gro ba mtshon//nyon mongs thams cad rab grol mdzad/ /shel gyi mdog can 'od bzang ba/ /'di yi phyag rgya ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni dkur ⑧bzhag nas/ /sems can sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa'o/ /gsum pa nam mkha' mdzod nyid de/ /rgyan ni thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /dkar ser bsres pa'i sku mdog 'od/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /'di yi phyag rgya phyag g.yas na/ /padma la gnas chos kyi mdzod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni dkur bzhag la/ /nam mkha' nor kun 'chang ba po/ /bzhi pa yang ni ye shes tog /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /sngon po'i du9༄mdog can yang dag gsal/ /yid sbyin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnamasa'i/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur nyu)'jog cing / /dbul ba'i 85—311

sdug bsngal dgrol ①bar mdzad/ /nub sgo'i drung du padma la/ /gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dang po bdud rtsi 'od ces (kyebya/ /zla ba'i mdog gis ①rnam par mdzes/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa legs par bsnamasaX/ /cod pan rin chen phyag gis so/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur 'jog cing / /rgya chen tshe ni ⑤stsol ⑥ba po/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan ni zla ba'i 'od/ /mi shes pa yi gamun pa bsal(she /sku mdog dkar po mdzes pa ni/ /phyag rgya g.yas pa'i phyag nyid kyis/ /padmar ⑨gnas pa'i zla ba'i gzugs/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur bzhag pa'o/ /gsum pa bzang ⑩skyong zhes bya ba/ /dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdog can nyid/ /chos rnams thams cad rab gsal rtsonamadzad/ /phyag rgya phyag ni g.yas pa yis8/ /rin chen 'bar ba yang dag bsnams/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur gnas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi pa yang / /dra ba can gyi 'od mtshan can/ /sku mdog 8dmar po 'od 'bar ba/ /rdo rje'i 8gur ni bsnams pa can/ /byang sgo'i rtsa bar padma la/ /gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sangs rgyas sras po dang po nyid/ /mtshan ni rdo rje snying po zhes/ /dkar zhing sngo ba'i mdog dang ldan / /phyag rgya phyag ni g.yas pa yis/ /utpa 8la ni rdo rjer 0ldan/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa blo gros zhes pa yi/ /mi zad pa khror yang dag ldan/ /kun du zla ba'i mdog ltar gsal④/ /phyag rgya phyag ni gnyis pa yis/ /ye shes bum pa yang dag bsnams/ /sems can thams cad rab tshim mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po gsum pa yang / /spobs pa brtsegs pa'i tha snyad can/ /sku mdog dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag rgya phyag g.yas padma la/ /gnas pa'i rin chen phung po nyid/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur gnas pa'o/ /85—312

rgyal ba'i sras po bzhi pa ①ni/ /kun du bzang po zhes (9bya ste/ /sku mdog ser zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gi phyag rgya ni/ /rin chen snye ma bsnams pa la/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur brten ③pa'o/ /de lta'i gzugs dang yang dag ldan/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtse skyibadag (denyid/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po (6)mchog ces ④bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/na maḥsarba dun ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakli buchu ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne bsho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shudhe bi shurnye sarba kurmā ⑨ba ra ṇa bi shudhe swā ⑩tā/ sngags 'dis shākya'i rgyal po la nyunyesogs pa lha sum cu 8rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs par bsgom phortemo/ /de nas de'i rjes la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang bar bya'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas / /sgo ni dbye bar byas nas su/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rab tu brkyang ④/ /mthe 0chung lu gu rgyud byas la/ /sgo dbye ba yi phyag rgya yisaci/ /oṃ sarba biṅgā rorsā ṭa ⑩ya hūm̐/ sgo dbye ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas sgo dbye'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor yongs su bteg ste/ oṃ sarba thabadzra hu tsakra rtsu/ lag nyurtengar dag ni rdo rjer rdu )bcings/ /rdo rje se gol rnam grol bas/ /shākya'i rgyal po sbyor bdag dpal/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /g.yon 217pa se gol brdabs pa yis/ /mnyam par brdabs par grub par 'gyur/ /g.yas pa yis kyang brdab par gsungs/ /gnyis ka yang ni sdud ༄ gyepa yin/ /oṃ badzra sa mā du dzaḥng stedzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥshusnye/ bka' bsgo ba 'di bsgrags tsam gyis/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byon 'gyur nadu dzī/ /gzhan rnams rab 'jug lta ci smosason/ /85—313

de nas mdun gyi 1)nam mkha' (midakyil 'khor gyi ①'khor lo bltas la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags kyis (gemachod yon gyi snod na gnas pa'i dri'i ⑤chu yis yang dag par bsangs te/ zhal ⑥bsil dbul lo/ /de nas mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas zhabs bsil ⑦gyi phyag rgyas zhabs bsil dbul lo/ /de nas ⑧badzra purje hūṃ/ badzra dhū 7pe rtsu/ badzra dri 7pe hūṃ/ badzra garnye hūm̐/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad 7la/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug go/ /de nas yang phyag rgya dang por sngar 8bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i 8cho gas dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams bcing 0ngo / /de nas sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis chos kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga bya'obla/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya'i sngags kyis las kyi phyag rgya bcing ngo / /de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ⑩sngags kyis phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o / /de nas rdo rje gtsug tor la bla tshosogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sems ma rdo rje ma dang / rin chen rdo rje ma dang / chos kyi rdo rje ma dang /las kyi nyusnyerdo rje ma rnams spros te dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha dpal shākya'i yirgyal po nas brtsams pa'i rdo rje 'bebs pa'i mthar thug dzña )pa la dbang bskur 0ba sbyin par bya ste/ dbang bskur du rteb lnga dang / bdag po ste sa bcu'i mthar thug pa sbyin no/ /dbang bskur du sem thag tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū ④pa pū dzā 0me gha sa mu dra ri 0spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 0putpa 3nye pū dzā 0me gha sa mu dra 'i byespha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dī pa pū dzā zhunyame gha sa mu dra zhusga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta garnye gu dzā du me gha sa mu dra busga ra ṇa sa ma ye rghaṃ/de nas sgeg mo la sogesogs pa bzhi yis mchod do/ /rdo rje gsor zhing rdo rje'i tshig yi ge brgya pa sngon du 'gro bas sngar bzhin bstod pa rgu nyebya'o/ /de nas/85—314

mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med snying po'i chos can ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /yon tan dngos grub thams cad mtha' yas sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog rab chos can rnams/ /yon tan mchog ni phra mo'i cha la'ang mtshams med do/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam dper gyur pa nyid yod ma yin/ /sems can khams la grub mchog stsol ༅ba rnams la gsol/ /dngos grub mtha' yas rnams la dpe dang rnam par bral/ /dri med thugs rje brgya pa nyid kyi shugs las byung ②/ /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub ②lhur mdzad mtha' yas mnga' ba can / /thugs ④rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /'gag med nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum la mchog gi tso)dngos grub stsol ⑥ba 'jug /dpag med dpag bral rnams la shin tu rdzogs nyid rdzogs / /bde ba'i gnas su gshegs kyang e ma'o chos nyid bzang / /rtag tu mchog sbyin nyid de bde 'gro nyid du gshegs/ /mtha' dag 'jig tshigasum la 8༄ grub mchog ni stsal phyo)ba po/ /bde gshegs dus gsum bsgrod nyid sgrib ⑩pa mi mnga' nyid/ /dam tshig gsum mchog dngos grub mchog sbyin bdag la stsol/ /ces 7pa dang / thams cad la tsho2lce brgya pa'i kha yis bstod pa nye bar spyod par mos te rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bcur de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phyi rol gyi lha rnams la mchod pa thams cad dang gtor ma'i cho ga nye bar mkho ba dang bcas pa'i gtor ma dbul lo/ /dpung pa bzang po'i tshigs bcad hu༄brjod do/ /dang por se gol la 8sogs sgras/ /85—315

khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya yis/ /sdig pa'i phung po dgug bya zhing / /yi ge gsum sogs yang dag ldan/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad mnyam por spong / /dgug dang gdon dang bcing ba rnam ①par gzhoms / /sngags bzhi po rnams legs par sbyar ba ni/ /bdag sogs bsngags te yungs kur dang ④po brdeg /shi ba'i rus pa gos la rab bkru ba/ /oṃ sho dha ne zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ /srid gsum dri ma chu yis bkru bar dubya/ /oṃ kai ka ni zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ /ba yi rnam ⑤pa lnga yis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ stirasne rasne zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ /dri bzangs rnams ni kun gyis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ a mo gha ā 6skab ra ṇa sogs/ /sngags kyis ba yi 'o mas bkru bar bya / /oṃ a mi (kyete a mi (7te zhes sogs/ /sngags kyis chang mchog gis kyang bkru bar bya/ /oṃ pu dme sogs pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bar dang bar du chu yis bkru bar bya/ /yang bkra shis kyi glu 8blang zhing dbang bskur te⑩/ lam sbyang ba tsobya'o / /bdug skopa la bosogs lha mo bzhi'i sngags so/ /de nas 'di yi thab khung ni / /khru gang tsam la sbyin sreg 8bya/ /ngan 'gro kun du gnas pa yi/ /sems can de rjes dran byas nas/ /dge ba'i rgyud phyir sdig ⑩pa dang / /sgrib pa zhi phyir bsreg bya ste/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras yos nyungs kur ⑩bsres pa dang / /til dang 'bru dang 'bras la tsosogs/ /bud ⑩shing rnams su lag gnyis kyis/ /las rnams gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang / /snga ma ji ltar de ltar gyis/ /de yis myur du sems can rnams/ /bde ba mmu phun sum tshogs pa 'thob / /las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i 27ting nge du'adzin to/ /de dag kyang sems can de la byas pa de nas de dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las rnam par grol 85—316

bar 'gyur te/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su sems can thams cad la phan par mdzad pa bde bar gshegs pa dang ldan par skyes so/ /de nas dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams snyan grags ①dang bcas pas gar byed cing / sngags kyi ②mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pas (bskye ba 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa la ④mchod pa'i phyir lha'i tshogs rnams mdun du bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / bdug ⑤pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang /rgyan du ma rnams kyis kyang mdzes shing na bza' dang ⑥rin po che'i char la sogs pas kyang dga' ba'i tshal yongs su gang bar byas so/ /de nas ngo mtshar tsoche bar gyur to/ / ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa las brtag pa dang po'o// //⑧de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyis nyunyebyin gyis brlabs kyis sngags kyi 0brtag pa'i rgyal po brtag pa phyi ma hunyegasungs te/ dpa' bo gdan las bzhengs nas ni/dgyes tu pas rdo rje gsor zhing shākya'i bdag po dgyes pa thub pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal nas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs lhonyenas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di nyid rang gi thugs ka 8nas phyung 8ngo / /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarpā pā ya bi 0sho dha na badzra rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba kurmā ba ra ṇa ni bhasnyi 8ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phroṃ (1)bi nā nyustesha ya sarpā ba ra ṇa ni rdu stabadzra bus phaṭa/ oṃ rdu bi sho dha ya sarpā ba ra ḍā ༷ geni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na sarpā du snye85—317

ba ra ḍā ①ni rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarpā ②ba ra ṇa ②ni rghaṃ phaṭa / oṃ rtsu ha ra ha ra sarpā ④ba ra ḍā ⑤ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa sarpā stib ra ṇa ⑦ni rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ bṛ ta bṛ ta sarpā ⑧ba ra ṇa stini hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa 0sarpā 0ba ra ṇa ⑩ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sbyin sbyin sarpā /snyib ra ṇa ④ni rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka 8ga ti he rtu tso phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga ti ho rtu 7rgyu phaṭa/oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir ya ka 8ga ti he rtu tshe phaṭa/ de nas de dag gi zhu )nye bar mkho ba rnams spyad de/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne dha ma dha ma dhū ⑥pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ sarba durga ti bi sho dha ne putpa 'bi lo ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarpā pā 0ya bubi sho dha ni dzñā nā gelo ka ka ri hūṃ phaṭa25/ oṃ sarpā pā rdzo — tshoya ga ti garnya nā busha ni garnya ⑥ba ti hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ sarba na ra ka ga ti ā kursha du )ni rtsu dzaḥn/phaṭa/ oṃ sarba dun ra ko ra ṇi 0hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarpā so/pā ya bharnya na bi mo tsa ni rgyu baṃ rgyaphaṭa/ oṃ sablo pā duciya ga ti ga ha snye 1na bi nā sa 2snyeni rghaṃ hoḥ ()phaṭa/ de nas dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/nang gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad pa yis dzu )shin tu mdzes/ /lte ba mu khyud yang dag ldan/ /nang gi rim pa bris nas ni/ /lte bar shākya'i dbang po yi/ /bdag po thub pa bri bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen ni/ /dpa' bo de yi spyan sngar bri/ /rgyab tu 'khor los 47sgyur ba yang / /legs par mngon par bri bar bya/ /g.yas su rgyal ba'i gtsug tor bri/ /g.yon du rnam par rgyal ba bri/ /gzi brjid phung po yang ni mer/ /dbang ldan du ni gdugs 6rnyedakar po / /rnam par 'thor 4 ba rlung nyid du/ /rnam par 'joms pa bden bral bri / /de nas phyi rol yang dag bri/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi pa shin tu mdzes/ /dpa' bo lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu 85wa 318

snyan ①rnams bzhag /grwa ②yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /de nas me tog phreng ba dang / /dri sogs rang gi lus la byug /slob dpon 'jug par bya ba ②ste/ /dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ༅bha ga bān⑤/ e hye hi ma hā kā duru ṇi kā ⑦ dṛ shya 2hoḥ/ zhes bya bas lha thams cad spyan drang ngo / /de bzhin du bcug ste dbang bskur ⑨na ngan song thams cad las rnam par grol te bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dang sa gong ma rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang gdon mi za bar thob par 'gyur ro/ /snga ma bzhin du las thams cad kyang byed cing thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ / byab pa ⑩byas pas rims thams cad dang gdon la 7sogs pa rnams las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 'o rgyu zhes bya bas las thams cad byed do/ /brtag pa gzhan gyi hurtecho gas kyang las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa ngan song gi dbang du gyur pa rnams 'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan la sogs pa mngon par bris pa las bzlas pa dang sbyin sreg chadang dbang bskur ba rnams kyis ngan song thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas seng ge'i lta stangs kyis zhal du bltas te phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya mchog gi mtshan nyid dam pa bshad par bya ste/ thugs rje'i gdung ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems kyi hunyergyal ba thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab ⑩par bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin du gnas pas rte/shedapral bar thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag 'tshal ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor 85—319
