rig pas mgrin pa'i phyogs su thal mo kha phye ①ba padma'i rnam par bya'o/ /thugs kur ②rdo rje thal mo byas sor mo dbus ma rtse mo sbyar ba 'di ni rdo rje rigs kyi ②dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du pang ④par bzhag la de'i ⑤steng du g.yas pa bzlog ste bzhag la mthe bong gnyis sbyar te zhi ba'i lta bas blta'o / /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi 0ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid yongs su bskor te phan tshun sbyar te mthe'u chung dag dang mthe bong dag lu gu rgyud kyi rnam par bcings la snying gar phyagazhag go/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo gang bar sbyar nas mthe'u chung dang mthe bong sbyar te bzung zhing lhag ma rnams rab tu brkyang ba'o/ /'di ni padma rigs kyi padma'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams par brtan par byas nas/gung mo gnyis rdo rje rtse mor byas la/ mthe'u chung dang mthe bo rab tu brkyang ba'ol / /'di ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid kyis mthe'u chung dang mthe ⑨bong gnyis de bzhin du byas la/ mdzub mo dang ming med padma'i ⑩'dab ma'i tsornam par bya'o/ /'di ni ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o / /de nyid kyi mdzub mo dang ming med dag rin po che'i 8rnam par bya'o8/ /'di ni dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe'u chung dang mthe bong so so ④so sor sbyar nas lhag ma rnams rab tu brkyang ba ni mtshon cha thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa de kho na bzhin du rab tu 'jug pa ni las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya'o / /snyim pa gyen du 'thor 1geb ni bdug spos kyi ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid 'og nas 'thor 'ab ni me tog gi nya)phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid mthe bong gnyis gyen du bsnyams khyacal 'dzin pa ni mar me'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid dung du )'dra bar byas pa 85—320

ni dri'i ①phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid rab tu brkyang ste 'dzin pa ni gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o//de nyid gung mo rnams nang du bcug pa ni argha'i ②phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las gung mo gnyis bsnyams ④te ④tshigs bar ma bcag nas sor mo thams cad brkyang ba 'di ni rnam par 'thor ⑤ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid mthe bo dang mthe 6)chung gnyis bkug pa ni rnam par 'joms ⑦pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid kyi snyim pa 'od zer gyi rnam pa ni gzi dubarjid phung po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid spyi bo'i gnas su bskor ba ni gdugs medakar po'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis ⑩mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du bcings la bskor ba 'di ni 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rdo rjer byas la mdzub mo gnyis rin po che ltar bya ste/ lhag ma 'od zer 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du mdzub mo gnyis rdo rjer byas la sor mo lhag ma rnams bsdams nas rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'o / /g.yas pa mchog (5sbyin dang g.yon pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa ni 8de bzhin gshegs pa'i yin no/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mda' 'dra bar byas pa ni mda'i phyag rgya'o / /de nyid kyi yiphyag rgya dang mthe bong rtse sprad pa ni blo gros legs pa'i'o/ /de nyid kyi tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin po che'i'oge/ /de nyid sor mo rnams 'od zer 'dra ba ni cigazi brjid kyi'o/ /de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid mdun du bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i'o/ /de nyid padma 'dra bar byas pa ni padma'o/ /de nyid gung mo dang mdzub mo bkug pa ni ral 85—321

gri'o / /de nyid gdu ①bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'khor lo'i'o/ /de nyid padma'i 'dab ②ma 'dra bar byas pa ni lce'i'o/ /de nyid rtse mo yid tsam bskyed ③pa ni sna tshogs kyi'o/ /de nyid shin tu bskyed pa ni bsrung ④ba'i'o/ /de nyid ༅rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /de nyid dam du bkug pa ni bsdams pa'i'o / /de nyid mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa ni lcags kyu'o༅/ /de nyid rtse mo gnyis sprad pa ni zhags pa'i'o/ /de nyid phan tshun mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o / /de nyid bskyod pa ni dril bu'i 'o⑦/ /de nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i shebu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das tshe thung ba dang / skal ba chung ba rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / tshe bsring ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ /bdag la gsang ba'i bdag po bshad du gsol/ /de nas dushe)bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de dag la gzigs nas legs so zhes bya bas mgu bar bya ste/ brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu rnams gang khyed la 'di lta bu'i she )spobs pa yang dag par skyes pa de ni legs so legs so/ /legs par sgrubs nyunyeshig dang bshad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje thams cad tshe dpag tu med par khyab par 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phel ba zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /oṃ pu rtse pu khye/ ma hā pu tre a pa ra nyu mi tā 3/yuḥthupu khye tshwa na si bha ro pa tsi te meka ri ṇi tsos hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs 'di bshad pa tsam gyis tshungan 85—322

song thams cad rab tu zhi ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang byol song gi 'gro ba rnams su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad grol bar bdag nyid kyis rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas shing snang bar byas nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid du zhugs par gyur to / /de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshe dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di bshad do/ /oṃ a mi te a mi 6①/ a mi 0toddha chabe/ a mi ta ④si bha be/a mi ta bi sāddhaPROB/ a mi te (yebi mānta gā tso)mi ni sarba kurma (gyekle 0sha kṣa yo ka ri swā hā / de nas 'di bshad pa tsam gyis de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi'o/ /de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdon mi za bar sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa gcod ⑩pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs ka 511nas phyung ngo / /oṃ kai ka ni kai ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na sarba kurma hu pa ro pa rā rtsi༄ṇi me sarba satā nāñtsa rnyiswā hā/ 'di bshad pa tsam gyis thams cad de kho na bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 8sgrib pa thams cad dri ma med cing 7rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par she zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di 85—323

rang gi thugs ka stinas phyung ngo / /oṃ rasne rasne/ ma hā rasne/ ratna saṃ bha be / ratna ki rasnel/ ratna mā lā ③bi shurnye/ sho dha ya/ sarba pā paṃ rgyu traṭa④/de nas 'di bshad ma thag tu bdud kyi gnas thams cad bcom zhing rnam par bcom par gyur rgyato/ /de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdon mi za bar mi choms par sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs ka dunas phyung ༅ngo / /oṃ a mo gha a pra duti ha ta sarpā ⑨ba ra ṇa metha sho dha 7ni ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di bshad ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad g.yos rab tu g.yos yang dag par rab tu g.yos/bskyod rab tu bskyod yang dag par rab tu bskyod/ bsgul rab tu bskul yang dag par rab tu bskul zhing ngo mtshar che zhing rmad du byung ba du ma 'jig rten du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor ni 'di yin te/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /logs 8bzhi dang yang yang dag ldan/ /rta babs bzhi dang kun du ldan/ /kha khyer dang ni sgo khyud bcas/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo yi8/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /rtsibs bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ /de yi dbus su mgon po ni/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen pos/ /phyag na rdo rje dril bu can/ /zla ba rgyas zhal 'dzum pa bri/ /shar gyi rtsibs kyi dbus kyi char/ /gtso bo mi bskyod pa nyid bri/ /lhor ni rin chen bri bya zhing / /nub tu chu skyes padma ste/ /byang du gdon mi za zhes grags/ /dpa' bo stobs chen bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /'khor los sgyur 8ba'i cha lugs mdzad/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdog 'dra 85—324

zhing —/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa rnams/ /phyag ni ①mchog sbyin mi 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje skyil krung (gyebazhugs pa bri/ /grwa yi cha rnams thams cad du//de bzhin bdug pa la sogs bri/ /sgo skyong rnams kyang khro bo dang / /mchog tu khro bar gzhol ba bri/ /de nas rnal 'byor rang 90nyid zhugs/ /sngags kyi lha rnams spyan drangs te/ /dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ༅bha ga bān⑤/ badzra e hye ⑥gyi 4)sa ma ya st+waṃ/de nas mgon po byon pa la/ /mdor (khun mchod pa byas nas ni/ /'chi bdag nyid dang sbrul 'jigs pa'i/ /'chi bdag gzhom phyir gzhug ⑨par bya/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje ti rirnyi 7ri bcing hunye/ /lag na rin chen thogs pa gzhugatso /yang na me tog phreng ldan pa/ /de dag dkyil 'khor nyid du dor/ /oṃ pra tītstsha tshubadzra hūṃ/ de nas dam tshig sbyin te/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya rgyu/ de nas 'dis gdong g.yogs 8dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra hā phyos ṭā 8ya hūm̐/ de nas 'dis dkyil 'khor ⑩bstan hunyepar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra dṛ shya 8ho/ /de nas dbang bskur ba sbyin te/ oṃ badzā 7gi ṣiñtsa c-i )rtsu/ oṃ bus 0gi ṣiñtsa sum/ oṃ ratna 0gi ṣiñtsa buX/ oṃ padmā bhi ṣiñtsa zhuge'iḥ/ oṃ kurmā bhi ṣiñtsa ⑩aḥ/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur sbyin 3te/ oṃ badzra ka la shā ri shegi ṣiñtsa zhu)rgyu/ oṃ buddha ka la shā bhi ṣiñtsa gu oṃ/ oṃ ratna ka la shā bhi ṣiñtsa sa/rta/ oṃ padma ka la shā gi ṣiñtsa du hrīḥ/ oṃ kurma ka la shā bhi kṣi: zhunye.aḥ/ de nas phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ ratna mā lā gi ṣiñtsa chaX ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ oṃ subadzra pas ba lo ba nā gi ṣiñtsa ④spyo/ oṃ badzra mu drwa 0gi ṣiñtsa 3 rgyu/ oṃ buddha mu drwa ri /rnyi ṣiñtsa ci )tsha/ oṃ ratna mu drwa 9rnyi ṣiñtsa (ge:/oṃ padma mu drwa (nyegi ṣiñtsa tsuge'iḥ/ oṃ kurma mu dā (ge bhi ṣiñtsa (lhamaḥ/ oṃ badzra nā mā ṭaṃ tshogi ṣiñtsa (beeḍū/ oṃ hūm̐ ṭwāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ/4) tsha badzra kurmā bhi ṣiñtsa so )rtsu aḥ/ oṃ badzra tsakrā hphu85wa 325

bhi ṣiñtsa ①rgyu /②/ oṃ badzra tsakrā sedhi pa dhi sta ma ④nyi ṣiñtsa ⑤rgyu rgyu rgyu/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ6)/ aḥ.aḥ.aḥme/ oṃ badzra dhā ra 6 ⑧nyi ṣiñtsa ⑨// oṃ ta thā ga ta dhā ra ṣyo 7gi ṣiñtsa 0i/ oṃ ratna dhā ra 6 8gi ṣiñtsa 0tsā0/ oṃ padma dhā ra rgya 8gi ṣiñtsa 0hrīḥ0/ oṃ kurma tso dhā ra rgya phyegi ṣiñtsa ༷ )aḥ 0 i sarba ta thā ga ta gu tyā 3gi ṣiñtsa dum/ oṃ badzra gu tyā bugi ṣiñtsa bya// oṃ ratna gu tyā tsosnyi ṣiñtsa zhu 7tsā/ oṃ padma gu gyu phyogi ṣiñtsa 0hrīḥ/ oṃ kurma tsu )gu tyā 0gi ṣiñtsa ⑥aḥ/ oṃ pra snyo pā maya sa ma yo gā ④gi ṣiñtsa dus aḥ/ de ltar dbang bskur nas tshe 'phel ba'i rig pa 'di ⑩sbyin no/ /oṃ lha badzra ā 0yu ṣe 64 aḥ0/ 'di'i sgrub pa ni 'di yin te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe dpag med zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i bu dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa las bdud rtsi 'dzag pa 0bri'o/ /de'i 8'og tu sgrub pa po lag pa thal mo sbyar ba brkyang zhub gdong gyen du bcom ldan 'das la blta (steb bris la mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod pa bya ste de'i spyan sngar stong phrag brgya bzlas so/ /de nas zla ba nya byal mchod pa chen po byas la ba dmar ser gyi mar snod sar par bcug la g.yon pa'i rdo rjes mnan te/ bcom ldan 'das la rab tu sems shing mtshan thog thag bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas dri mnam ⑩zhing sngon ma byung ba'i dri'i byangad kyang ldang ngo / /dro ba dang du ba dang me yang 'byung ngo / /'od zer gyi snang ba rab tu 'phros te de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma byung na mar de'am (nyamar gsar pa'am/ til mar ram/ chu'am/ 'o ma'am/zho'am / chang ngam/ khrag gam/ zhag gam/ klad (7pa'am/ sha'am/ gang yang rung ba dang lhan cig tu rab tu bsgrubs te nang par sngar srung so )ba la sogs 85wa 326

pa 6)byas nas bdag nyid sbyangs te 'thungs rin sam zos na mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin du byung na ni nam zla ba dang du nyi ma ji srid pa'i tsher 'gyur zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i tsher yang 'gyur ro/ /tha mas ni dngos grub tha mar 'gyur te 'di la the tshom med do/ /mtshan ma ma byung na yang 'jig rten na nad med pa dang yid gzhungs ④pa dang ldan zhing skra dkar dang gnyer ma med pa dang lus brtan zhing tshe lo brgya thub par (5)'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bzlas pa byas pa tsam gyis zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang la tshormesogs pa'i las rnams brtag mi dgos par 'grub ste the tshom med do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi tsho snying po bshad par na'atshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 89ci bka' gnang bar zhu/rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' gnang bar zhu/ rgyal po chen po dag legs so legs so shod cig dang / ngas rjes su yi 1 )rang zhing rang gi dam tshig byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu mngal bso /nyapos/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang 1 zhing rjes su yi rangs te nyugebyin gyes brlabs nyugepas rang gi snying po rang gi snying ga 17nas phyung la1rte/ oṃ betna / de nas dri za'i nyurtergyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis de kho na bzhin 2 tshorang gi 27snying po bshad pa/oṃ :ri snye/ de nas grul bum gyi rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos de kho na bzhin du rang gi ri gisnying po bshad pa/ oṃ gi / de nas klu'i rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis de kho na bzhin du rang gi 25snying po bshad pa/ oṃ 75 9/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad den / gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /dkyil 'khor lngas ni 85wa 327

brgyan 3)pa ste/ /de yi dbus su mgon po ni/ /phyag na rdo rje 'gying (mibacas bri//de yi g.yon pa'i logs su ni/ /ngal bso rnam thos bu dge yi/ /lag na ninge con ④de'u le/ /rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan⑤/ /sbom zhing seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs / /gser mdog gzi brjid ldan pa bri/ /mkhas pas bum pa bzang la sogs / /rin chen tshogs char 'bab pa bri/ /mdun du yul 'khor skyong nyid ni / /pi wang 97sgrogs par yang dag brtsonag/ / mdzes shing (kyekha dog ljang gu ⑨nyid / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa bri/ /g.yas su dpa' bo lus 'phags po / /ral gri phyag na bsnams pa 7bri/ /nub tu yang ni mig mi bzang / /rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin cing mchog /sbrul mgo bdun gyis yongs su bskor/ /mig ni dmar zhing shin tu 'bur/ /sgo yi phyogs ni ༅thams cad du/ /sgo skyong rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas sngags pa rang nyid 'jug /'khor lo'i phyag rgya zhes grags pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid spyan drang zhing / /de nas rgyal po spyan drang ngo / /spyan drangs nyurtenas ni mkhas pas mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil rshanyecho ga bzhin/ /de nas slob ma rgyal rigs sam/ /rje rigs bram ze la sogs kyang / /me tog phreng bas rnam brgyan skopa/ /sngags shes pa yi sngags 'di dang 51ge/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas gzhugatshe /oṃ badzra sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas me tog gam rin po che 'dis kyang dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra pra tītstsha ma ⑩hotta ma/ gang la lhung ba'i rgyal po de/ /'di yis 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min / /de nas grwa na gnas pa yi/ /bum pa bzhis kyang dbang bskur te/ / lnga pa nyu2phyag na rdo rje'i 'o/ /phyag rgya nyid kyis nyartedabang bskur bya/ /de la du )sogs pa'i go rims na1bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas dbang bskur bas/ /85—328

rgyal po ma yin rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgyal po yin na chen por 'gyur/ /'dzam bu gling dbang dpal dang ①ldan/ /gling bzhi po yi bdag po mchog /lan bzhir ( gedabang ni bskur ba dang / /lan bzhir rab tu zhugs na ②ni/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bdag /rang gi bu bzhin bsrung ④bar bya/ /bdag cag rgyal chen bzhi pos kyang / /'bangs dang 'khor du bcas pa dang / /yul 'khor pho brang bcas pa yi/ /rgyal pos rtag tu bskyang chubagyi ste/ /de yi ma rungs (6)pa rnams dang ske/ /de yi pha rol sde spridang nad/ /'chi bdag 'jigs pa mu ge dang / /yams dang nyer 'tshe gzhom par bgyi/ /ngal bso 2pos ni rgyas par bgyida'i/ /yul 'khor srung gis zhi ba nyid/ /phyugs dang gnyen bcas dus min pa'i/ /'chi bdag lus 'phags po yis 'joms/ /mig mi bzang gis bde bar byed/ /mu ge la sogs rnam par 'joms/ /mdor na bdag gis de yi ⑩ni/ /re ba kun dang bsam pa kun/ /bgyi ste gal te ma nges na/ /phyag na rdo rje bslus hunyepa yin / /de nas phyogs skyong bcus bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nyugebadag cag kyang sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi snying po rab tu dbul lo/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams legs so legs so/ /de legs par masmos shig /de nas 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan la sogs pas rang rang gi snying po rnams phul ba/ oṃ snyikhiske/ oṃ yi8/ oṃ a/ oṃ yam/ oṃ 2nyarte/ oṃ rba/3/ oṃ yonyushe/ oṃ ku/ oṃ e( )ske/ oṃ bā0/ de nas de dag gi tsho —snyedakyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /mgon po dbus su de bzhin gzhag /phyogs skyong rang gi phyogs kyi char/ /gzhag bya spyan sngar rnam pa gnyis/ /nyi ma dang ni phag gi 85wa 329

gzugs / /sgo skyong rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas de kun spyan drangs la/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par 0)bya/ /de nas rang nyid zhugs nas kyang / /slob ma rnams ni gzhug (kyebya zhing / /phyogs skyong la sogs sngags bzlas pa'i/ /bum pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas phan par 'dod pa yis/ /sgrub phyir snying po 9basbyin par bya/ /phyogs skyong rang gi phyogs gnas rnams/ /brtag mi dgos ri par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas de dag mgu nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang su zhig rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor (snyedabang bskur bas dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs te dbang bskur ba 'dzin pa dang /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa de dag bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kun nas bsrung (6)ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi sde rnams gzhom tsho ripar bgyi'o/ /dus dang dus su char dbab par bgyi'ol/ /'bru dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po chen po de'i tshe bsring narabar bgyi'o/ /dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba brgyad po so sor dgag par bgyi'o / /srin po rnams kyi bdag po chen po bden bral gyis (7'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po chen po de dang / rgyal po chen po'i 7bu dang / bram ze'am/ rje rigs sam/ mi gzhan gang yang rung ba dag la nad med pa dang / yi dgas dang / 'dres 'jigs pa med pa dang /srin po 11la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa med par bgyi'o/ /1gdus thams cad du bsrung 12ba tshadang / bskyab 85wa 330

pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /de nas klu'i ①rgyal po chen po chu bdag gis (na 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dus thams cad du rgyal po de dang / yul thams cad kun nas so sor bsrung (gebar bgyi'o/ /kun du bsrung ④bar bgyi'o/ /'bru rnams kyang bskyed par bgyi'o/ /klu'i ('unyes pa rnams mi 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /dug dang thog kyang mi 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /me tog dang 'bras bu thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad kyang so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /de nas rlung gi bdag pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang sems can chen po de la dus thams cad du rlung gi 'jigs pa mi 'byung bar bgyi/ dus ma lags pa'i rlung mi 'byung bar bgyi/ 'bru dang me tog dang 'bras bu (6)thams cad kyang yongs su bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po lus ngan pos / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad cu (medadang lhan cig tu mchis te/ stobs dang ldan pas sems can chen po de la dus thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad (deso sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /nor dang 'bru thams cad legs par 'byor par ⑨bgyi'o/ /rang gi skye bo dang / yongs kyi skye bo dang /yul dang / gnas dang / bran dang / snag gi muganyen dang / grogs dang ske/ bu dang / bu mo dang / chung ma la sogs pa yang bsrung 37bar bgyi'o/ /glang dang / ba dang / bong rinyu2bu dang / rnga mo (2dang / lug dang / ma he dang ske/ glang po che dang / rta dang / ra la sogs pa yang bsrung 57bar bgyi'o/ /de nas 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag po dbang ldan gyis kyang 32bcom ldan 'das 85—331

la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po de dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze rnams 'di dang pha rol du yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ①ba dang / yongs ②su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bkra shis pa dang / chad pa yongs su spang ba dang ske/ dug gzhil (gub dang / dug gzhom pa dang / mtshams bcing ba dang /sa gzhi bcing ba 5shedang / phyogs bcing ba dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i phur bus gdab pa dang / rdo rje'i ༷nyegur yang bgyi'o/ /dgos pa thams cad la nye bar gnas par bgyi'o/ /bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa rnams kyi tsoramatshan ma nye bar bstan par bgyi'o(7)/ /dge ba dang mi (2)dge ba ma yin pa thams cad rmi lam du yang bsgo bar bgyi'othor/ /bsgrub nyu )pa thams cad la bgegs ma mchis par dngos grub thams cad kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas yang nam mkha' la spyod cing nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i bdag pos bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dus thams cad du rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i 517bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / bram ze'am(snye/rgyal rigs lam la gnas pa thams cad la bdag nyid 'khor thams cad hunyadang bcas pa mchis te/ bsrung 8ba dang / bskyab nyunyepa dang / sba ba kun nas bsgrub nyu9par bgyi'o/ /bgegs kyi gnas thams cad so sor bzlog par bgyi'o/ /nad thams cad bsal nyu tshobar bgyi'o/ /dus thams cad du phyi hu bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sa'i 'og gi bdag po phag chen pos kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mi'i nyunyebadag po dang / rje rterigs dang / bram ze dang / dmangs du ri lharigs sam/ gzhan 85wa 332

yang rigs kyi bu dang 07/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa rnams kyi (midus thams cad du don bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /'jigs rin pa thams cad las kyang bsrung 3)bar bgyi'o / /gzhan yang yongs su bskyab par bgyi'o/ /de nas gza' chen po brgyad 'khor rgyu skar dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi snying po rnams 'bul bar 'tshal na de la bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlab rinatu gsol / legs so legs so/ /ngas byin gyis brlabs 97kyis gza' chen po rnams shod cig /de nas nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ oṃ ā te/ oṃ so/ oṃ i/ oṃ bu/oṃ bdu/ oṃ shu/ oṃ sa/ oṃ rākha/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs su bri'o/ /mtha' rnams su ni 7rgya mtsho chen po bzhi bri'o/ /de yi mdun du pa ba sangs/ /zla ba rgyab tu bri bar bya/ /g.yas su phur bu bri bya zhing ske/ /g.yon du lhag pa bri bar bya/ /me yi gnas su mig dmar nyid/ /rlung gi phyogs su nyi ma ste/ /dbang ldan du ni spen pa nyid/ /srin po'i phyogs su sgra gcan bri/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol khor yug tu/ /rgyu skar thams cad bri bar bya//sgo sgor de bzhin sgo ba rnams/ /khros pa'i yid du bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas 'jug bya ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la nyu)sogs pas/ /thams cad kyang ni spyan drang ngo / /de nas slob ma rnams gzhug 12ste/ /oṃ badzra ha na ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gra ha sa ma ye rtsu/ oṃ badzra gra ha pra tītstsha 51nyis/ de nas gza' brgyad sngags ni sngags pa yis/ bum pa brgyad po rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rdo rje 85wa 333

phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ de nas gza' rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas gza' chen po dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gza' chen po brgyad kyis rgyal po ①chen po de dang / rgyal po'i bu la kun du dus thams cad du de kho na bzhin du thams cad bgyi'o/ /de nas ②rgyu skar dang / skad cig dang / thang cig dang ske/ yud tsam rnams so/ /tshes dang / sbyor kha ba dang / khyim bdang /dus sbyor dang / 'jug ༷zhephod la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang dus thams cad du sems can chen po'i bka' mi bcag cing dpon po bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang /ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang gi gnas thams cad so sor bskyab par bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa chen po 'byung ba'i tshe na yang des bdag cag mchod na gdon mi 'tshal bar 'jigs pa de mi 'byung ngo / /de nas klu chen po brgyad kyis phud ces bya ba'i sgras bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byas te 46)'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis (legasang ba'i snying po rnams 'bul 85lo/ /klu chen po rnams legs so legs so/ /gsang ba'i snying po rnams phul cig /de nas de dag mgu nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ phuḥ(9ra/ oṃ phuḥ/ oṃ rmi/ oṃ phuḥm /oṃ phrinyam/ oṃ phe12/ oṃ pho/ oṃ pho1 / /de nas de dag gi bedakyil 'khor bshad de / padma chen po 'dab brgyad pa/ /kha dog dkar po legs par bri/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus bzhugs pa/ /phyag na rdo rje rab tu nag /sbrul mgo mtha' 85—334

yas gdengs ka bdun17/ /ltos 'gro chen po sdigs (gepa bri/ /mtha' yas (kye'ajog po de bzhin du/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang / /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /padma chu bdag de bzhin du/ /mdor na 'dab ma re re la/ /de dag sbrul mgo 'bar ba bri/ /sbrul mgo bdun bdun chung ma yi/ /mgul nas 'khyud dang bcas pa bri/ /bum pa brgyad 0rnams gzhag bya ste/ /gtor ma lha bshos mdzes pa dang / /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas bcos pa'i dbye ba rnams kyang ngo / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid bzhugs pa ni/ /sbrul mgos sbrul mgo can rnams dgug /phud 9geces bya ba lhan cig ste/ /dzaḥ(7rgyu bo hoḥzhes brjod do/ /de nas rgyal po'am rgyal rigs ni/ /de dag thams cad bcug lanas su/ /dug gi nyes skyon bsal ba'i phyir/ /phud ces bya bas dun)dbang bskur ro/ /de nas ming tsam bzung bas kyang / /klu ⑨rnams de dag thams cad 'grub/ /de nas de dag kun mgu nas3 trī/ /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ /spyan sngar thal mo sbyar 'khod nas/ /smon lam rab tu 'debs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi hoḥbastan pa la mngon par 32dga' ba gang dag dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa de dag bslus par gyur na de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid la bslus nyu par gyur cig /de'i (skyetshe bdag bye tshan gyis sregs nyagepar gyur cig /rdo rje kun du 'bar bas bdag cag gi mgo 'gems par gyur cig /rtag par dus thams cad du sems can chen po de bsrung 17ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /gzi byin 3 chen po dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus bskyed 32par bgyi'o/ /de'i 76dug rnams dug ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /dus dang dus su 2 )char dbab 85wa 335

par bgyi'o/ /me tog thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi g.yul thams cad la dus dang dus ma yin pa'i char dbab par bgyi'o/ /'jig rten pa thams cad bskyed par bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' rab tu bsgrub 0)par bgyi'o/ /de nas sgrub pa bshad de/ lha rdzas 'od 'phro dkar gepo can/ /klu rnams 'dud pas gnas pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin gtso bsams nas ni/ /phud ces bya ba 'bum du bzlas/ /de nas dug gis zin pa la / /phud ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /lha rdzas 'od zer phreng ba 'khrigs②/ /bsams nas de la phud yig bsam/ /lag pa sbrul mgo zhags 'dra dang / /phud kyi brlung gis pags 95)pa sha /rus gnas phud kyi rnam pa'i dug /mtha' dag drangs te gso bar bya/ /de nas las rnams kun byed cing / /dug rims dug sbyar la sogs pa/ /khu tshur (6)gyis kyang kun sel na/ /sbrul mgo'i phyag rgyas smos ci dgos/ /de nas lto 'phye du chen po'i bdag po 'jigs dubyed chen po'i ma mo chen mo brgyad kyis bskor bas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis 'jigs pa dang ma mo rnams kyis 'jigs pas lha dang klu la sogs pa kun du skrag rnam par skrag ste kha bub tu 'gyel nas gos dang bral te sems stor nas kun du 'phyan pa dag la phan gdags ⑨pa'i slad du bdag cag gi snying po 'bul bar 'tshal gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis de legs par byin gyis brlab tu gsola'i/ 'jigs byed chen po legs so legs so/ /rab tu 'jigs par byed pas rang nyid dang lha'i 7bu mo thams cad kyi snying po rnams shod 12cig /de nas 'jigs byed chen pos 'jigs par byed pa'i sgra phyung nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ lha nyunyer ba lha tso85—336

ra swā hā/ oṃ bha swā hā/ oṃ bhi swā hā/ oṃ bhu swā hā/ oṃ bho swā hā/ oṃ lha swā hā/oṃ dzha swā hā/ oṃ rghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bhaḥswā hā/ bcom ldan ①'jigs byed chen po ni / /brgyad po de dag gdams du ngag nyan/ /de nas de dag dkyil 'khor bshad la/ /'khor lo chen po rtsibs brgyad bri/ /dbus su phyag na rdo rje ni/ /khro bo chen po 'jig (derten gsum/ /rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya gzhag /de yi zhabs 'og ma rungs pa/ /'jigs byed rnams kyi bdag po che/ /'jigs byed ma dang bcas pa bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang rnams thams cad du/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed brgyad po ni/ /ma mo rnams dang ldan pa ni/ /khros pa'i bzhin dang yid khros par/ /ci bde bar ni bri bar bya/ /'dir ni sgo sgor de bzhin du / /sgo ba shin tu khros ldan bri/ /de nas lcags kyu la sogs pas/ /bkug ste mgo bo'i thod pa ni/ /khrag gis gang bas mchod nas su/ /sha chang gtor ma bzang po dang / /snod rnams khrag gis bkang dun7ba dang / /mgo thod mgo yi dum bu dang / /khrag gam chang bkang bum pa brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhag par bya(6)/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum rnam rgyal/ /mchog gis slob ma rnam gzhug (3)bya/ /thod pa dang ni bum pa yang / /brgyad po rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas las rnams ri sbyin par bya/ /ma mo'i khyim mam mtshan gcig thosapar / /'jig rten gsum ni 'dul ba'i mchog /tshul bzhin du ni mchod byas nasal/ /'bum phrag bzhir ni bzlas par 1 bya/ /de nas 'jigs par byed pa'i sgras / /bdag nyid chen pos thos gyur te/ /mi 'jigs nyunyepa ni thod pa ru/ /khrag mchog bkang ba'i argha nyu2dbul/ /de nas khro bo 'jigs byed pa/ /ma rungs yid can ma mo ni/ /tshogs kyis bskor cing 'jigs byed ni/ /brgyad 85wa 337

kyis bskor ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong 'jigs pa med byas la/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba dran byed cing / /sha'am yang na chang mchog gis/ /thod pa bkang ste dbul bar bya/ /de nas 'jigs byed ma rungs 'joms/ /mgu ①zhing rab tu 'grub gyur 9genas/ /ci 'dod thos py-i dashig ces ④bya ba/ /mgu ba'i yid kyis de sbyin byed/ /sa rnams sbyin pa ma gtogs par/ /ro dang bcud len rdzas dang ni / /ral gri 'khor lo rtse gsum dang / /mtho ris sa stengs (nyes 'og dang / /gling dang gling bzhi'i snyurgyal srid dang / /brgya 3)byin nyid dang gnod sbyin dbang ske/ /srin po nyid dang rig 8༄'dzin nyid/ /rig (pe'adzin 'khor los sgyur bob nyid/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po nyid/ /bka' nyan nyid kyang rang nyid dam/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ster bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub gang yang rung ba ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa blang 11bar bya/ /rtsu gi 32rnam par /bemangon phyogs shing ske/ /byin nas dgod 1 cing 'gro bar byed/ /skrag na de ma thag tu gsod/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' gnang na rang gi rtogs nyudepa bshad par 'tshal gyis/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse nyu6bar dgongs te byin gyis brlab par gsol / de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis /rtserang rang gi snying po rnams bshad cado/ /skyoni /1 / skyos bi/ skyoni ru/ skyoni 6)hu'i/ skyes kai/ skyoni ga /skyoni bṛ che / oṃ ka /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /dbus su 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba/ /de yi mdun na du dpa' bo ni/ /dbang phyug lag na rtse gsum bri/ /rgyab tu tshangs pa'i rnam par 85wa 338

bri / /g.yon du lag na 'khor lo can/ /g.yas na dbang po rang nyid kyi/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma lag thogs bri/ /sgo skyong rang bzhin 'dir de rnams/ /chung ma rang gi dkyil 'khor du/ /bum pa bum pa bkang ba yang / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor du ni gzhag /stobs bzang la sogs mthu chen yang / /de nas 'jug bya lha rnams yin/ /mkhas pas kun nas spyan drang zhing / /dzaḥs rba hos lha thams cad/ /pho brang dam par 'jug par mdzod/ /de nas de rnams gshegs bltas nas/ /dga' ba chen po mchod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis①/ /phyag rgya slob ma rnams gzhug naste/ oṃ pra tītstsha ṭwāṃ tsho ma hā sa two badzra dha rā ④sto pa (deya hūṃ ha ha ha ha kyeho/ me tog ji lta bzhin du dor/ /mig phye nas ni bstan par bya/ /de nas mngon par bsngags ri7pa yi/ /bum pa'i chu yis dudabang bskur ro/ /de nas lha rnams gang 'dod pa'i/ /dngos grub rab tu sbyin par bya/ /'bum phrag gcig gam 'bum phrag gnyis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas ni/ /dbang phyug la sogs lha mchog ni/ /de rnams sgrub pa po yis 'grubarka/ /mtshan ma gcig pa la sogs su'am/ /yang na phyag na rdo rje'i gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang ngam/ /ring bsrel ldan pa'i mchod rten du/ /lha rnams thams cad cho ga bzhin/ /sgrub pa po yis rtag tu bsgrub59/ /de nas nam phyed ⑩na ni lha/ /'ongs nas khyod kyi 1/'dod pa ci/ /ji ltar bde zhing phan pa ni/ /sbyin zhes nges par go bar byed/ /bzang po myur 32du soms nya te smosatso / /gang phyir mchog ni khyod la sbyin/ /de nas sngags shes dngos 15grub dang ske/ /mchog gi lha la gsol ba gdab/ /lha rdzas bcud dang bcud len dang ske/ /mi snang ba dang mkha' 'gro dang / / ril bu 17rgyal srid rdzas la sogs/ /85wa 339

yid 'dod tshad med gsol ba gdab/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag lha rnams kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyang ngo / /mtho ris kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bde 'gro'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i chos kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i ①lam bstan par bgyi'o / /nges par 'byung ba'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /mya ngan (ge'adas pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /spong ba'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /nyon mongs pa ②med pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o//rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dus thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung bab dang bskyab pa dang sba bar bgyi'o/ /grong khyer dang / grong rdal 9shedang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho 96 brang 'khor rnams bsrung sbyo/bar bgyi'o/ /yul dang phyogs dang grong 'khor 3)rnams kyang bsrung ༷khebar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po yang stsal mabar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po thob pa'i rgyal po che bar bgyi'o/ /gling gcig dang gling gnyis dang gling gsum dang ske/ gling bzhi pa (1rnyedang / bde 'gro dang / sa stengs 'dang / sa 'og gi 'khor los sgyur 32ba'i rgyal po rnams stsal bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na brgya byin nyid dang ske/ tshangs pa nyid dang / khyab 'jug nyid dang / dbang phyug chen po nyid kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes slar yang nyid 85—340

kyi 'khor gyi dkyil sti'akhor la gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag g.yos/ rab tu g.yos yang dag par rab tu g.yos/'gul rab tu 'gul/ yang dag par rab tu 'gul/ 'bar rab tu 'bar/yang dag par rab tu 'bar/ dga' rab tu dga'/ yang dag par rab tu dga' / rtse ②rab tu rtse nad/ yang dag par rab tu rtse sa/zhing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba du ma yang 'jig rten du tshan yang dag par rab tu mthong ngo / /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams shin tu ya mtshan skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa 'di'i yirgyu gang lags/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum ④pa mi mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i phyir 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu lung bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes lha rnams kyis gsol ba'i tshig gsan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa lha ⑧rnams gang sngon sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa 'chi bdag zhi bar byed pa'i rig pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba 0'joms par byed pa'i rig pa'i sngags gzi brjid chen po nyon cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kun du dga' zhing ba spu langs shing phyag btsal tenas legs so zhes bya ba rab tu phul te / bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa legs so legs so / /gang gis nyu7tshe thung ba'i sems can rnams tshe ring bar 'gyur ba dang /dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bdag gis zin pa rnams dus ma yin par 'chi ba las rnam par grol ba dang / ngan song du skyes pa'i sems can rnams ngan song las ji 85—341

ltar grol ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag pa'i sems can rnams bde ba'i thabs kyis 'khor ba la rgyab kyis ༅phyogs par 'gyur zhing myur ba nyid du bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par (gerdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba gzi brjid (miche zhing stobs che 9 ba pha rol gnon pa'i rig pa bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis (5༄gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig gsan nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rig pa 'di rang gi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ pu tre pu rtse ma hā pu rje a pa e ri mi tā mi yuḥ(des rtse dzñā na si bhā tso)ro pa tsi mite swā hā/ snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ badzre (1ཿswā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ rghaṃ 32su hā/ snying po'i nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ ṭwāṃ ri(snyeswā hā/ snying po yang dag par bskul ba'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ ṭwāṃ /steg hā/ snying po dam pa'o/ /oṃ hrīḥhu9swā hā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi par byas la de'i dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhag ste/ : nyu6zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de'i nyu 7spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje ste/ badzi 18zhes bya ba'i snying po'o 16/ /g.yon du ni khro bo ste/māṃ dzwa tshozhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /g.yas su nam mkha'i snying po ste/ ṭwāṃ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /rgyab tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba ste/ hrīḥ21zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la reg par bri'o/ /bum pa lnga dang brgyad 'khor los du rtasgyur ba'i sngags kyis btab la gzhag go/ /las thams cad pas mngon par bsngags na85—342

pa yang ngo / /bdug pa la sogs gzhag go/ /mchod pa'i dang po can sgo skyong thams cad nyid kyang ngo / /de nas sngags 0)pa yang dag par 'jug pa'i phyir bde bar gshegs pa dam pa sras dang bcas pa 'khor gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba rig pa dang lhan cig spyan drang ngo / /rig pa yang bde bar gshegs pa'i g.yon gyi logs su bri'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te/mi/ skyil mo krung rdo gis ci)'dug la stong phrag brgyar bzlas so/ / de nas (pede bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur zhing rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gam/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i mchog so sor 'thob 57bo/ /gang gi tshe mnyam par gzhag pa de'i tshe yid kyis (7)las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob ma rnams gzhug ༷8)ste rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgyas nga rgyal 'di bskyed ⑨par bya ste/ oṃ badzra dha nye star/ ratna dha 1nyer/ padma dha hu ra/ bi shwa dha hunyer/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya mā muti kra ma/ ta thā ga ta hunyes ma ya dhā rātra ko3rta ⑩zhes pa'o/ /de nas 'dis me tog dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra tītstsha hu 7ho sa ma ya :nyusnye/ de nas phreng ba de mgo la bcings la dbang bskur/oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣiñtsa dhā rā 19tshwa pa ya tsū :nu sta/ oṃ badzā 21gi ṣiñtsa ru rgyu rghaṃ risnye/oṃ ratna bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ ṭwāṃ/ oṃ padmā bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrīḥ/ oṃ kurmā ri genyi ṣiñtsa (ges aḥ(9/de nas dam tshig dang bka'i dbang bskur ba sbyin no/ /de la dam tshig ni/dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa yong mi spong sno tsho/ /srog chags rnams ni gsad na mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang nyid/ /brdzun yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /pha rol bud med spyad mi bya/ /bla ma smad par mi bya zhing ske/ /grib ma'ang 'gom da par mi bya'o/ /slob dpon ma yin mi gzung zhing / /85wa 343

mtshan ma slob dpon spangs pa yang / /sngags dang phyag rgya mi smad de/ /lha rnams la yang ga la zhig /gal te rmongs pas smad na ni/ /nad kyis nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mchod rnying 0)lha yi grib ma dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /phyag rgya yi ge mtshan ma yang / /gom pas bgom par mi bya'o / /blun po dkon mchog gsum sogs dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang / /bla ma smod la brtson ( pa rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te gsad ②par bya/ /chos mi ldan dang bsreg (0pa dag⑤ /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang / /dam tshig snang rnams yisnying brtse bsali/ /sngags pas sngags kyis gzhom par bya/ /'jungs pa'i nor yang yang dag blang (she/ /sems can sdug bsngal can la sbyin/ /bla ma mchod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / /de bzhin dam tshig sgrub (7pa dang / /dkyil 'khor don dang rgyal sras la/ /mchod pa'i don phyir bsams 8pa yis/ /nor 'phrog 'jungs pa'i nor yang 'ong sems can rnams la phan dga' bas/ /dam tshig dang ni bla ma'i rdzas/ /sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung 37phyir/ /rtag tu brdzun mni smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes bya dang / /dam tshig rnams ni bsrung hunyeb dang / /sngags rig pa yi chabasgrub mapa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi bud med kyang bsten ⑩bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug pas/ /thams cad spyod cing kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /de nas 'dis bka'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā tshwa te dā kyā ⑩mi groṇḍa tsobadzra su sidha ye/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha rghaṃ/ 'dis rdo rje lag tu byin la phrin las kyi dbang bskur sbyin no/ /oṃ sarba kurma 36ṇi ku ru buddhā 37rna ge// de nas bla ma bla mar 85—344

bya ba'i phyir/ /khyod kyi 17lus mchog sbyin par bya/ /rdzas dang nor dang 'bru rnams dang / /rta dang bzhin 9gepa nyid dang ni/ /bran (bgyi mchog dang khang pa dang ske/ /rgyal srid dbang phyug de bzhin te/ /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang / /ma dang sring mo tsha mo dang / /gzhan yang ci bzhed ④thams cad ni/ /phan pa'i bsam pas bla mar (pedabul/ /de nas dngos grub sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sgrub ⑥dang gzhan yang ni/ /'jig rten pa yi (7)mthu (8)chen rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pas gsol ba gdab/ /de nas bu la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngags rig ser sna med sems dang / /dad pas dad pa'i sems ldan la7/ /dngos grub rnams ni sbyin par bya/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med par ni/ /sems kyis bsgom par ⑩byas nas kyang / /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams (1nas dam tshig phyag rgya yang / /bsam bzhin de bzhin de nyid kyang / /lha yi rnam pa'i rnal 'byor du/ /sgrub pa po yis yongs su bsgyur8 / /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlab/ /gong 'og go rims (geji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 8dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar nga rgyal bskyed nas ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub bya ste/ /de bzhin gshegs kyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu dang /rgyal po'i blon po dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u marigs dang /dmangs 0rigs dang / gzhan yang dman pa phyag dar ba dang / mtha' 'khob kyi skye bo'i gnas dang 51 / skye bo'i gnas kyi rigs su skyes pa dkyil 85wa 345

'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir zhugs pa de dag gi rnam par smin pa ji lta bur 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i tshogs rnams gang ma 'ongs 0)pa'i sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir zhus pa ni legs so legs so/ /lha'i tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir zhugs shing dbang bskur ba dang / bris pa dang / 'drir ②bcug pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang ske/ phyag byas pa dang / mchod pa byas pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa nyon cig /lha'i bu rnams mdor na nga la yang de'i (sde)phan yon bshad par spro ba ④med de/ gang nga la bsod nams ⑤kyi phung po de brgya phrag stong du mar bsgyur yang grangs su yang / bgrang bar yang / dper yang mi bzod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsod nams kyi phung po'i bar gyis kyang mi bzod do/ /gang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /rdo rje (nya'adzin pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs par zhugs pa (7/spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa spro'o/ /de nas lha de dag gis de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i sems can rnams bsod nams chung zhing tshe thung ba dang / ngan song gi rgyud dang ldan pa dang / dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / byol song rnams su skyes pa dag kyang mchis na/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ kye lha'i bu dag de dag ni dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du chug cig /bcug 8tshonas kyang dbang skur (9nicig /chos kyi yi ge yang zlos su chug cigabo /de nas sems can de dag tshe ring bar 'gyur/ bsod nams dang 85wa 346

bral ba bsod nams dang ldan par 'gyur0)/ ngan song las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu rnams gang ngan song du skyes pa de dag gi ming la dbang bskur ②ba mdzod cig /gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig /rang gi lha'i sku la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig /tha na de dang rigs mthun (gupa dang / de'i bu dang de dang rus mthun (pepa dang / de'i ming 'dzin pa dang /bran la yang dbang skur (nyecig /zhag bdun lan bdun dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur bas/ nges par ngan song gi sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu rnams de'i ming nas smos te/ 'bum phrag gnyis dang /'bum phrag gsum dang / 'bum phrag bzhi dang / 'bum phrag brgya (6)stong gi bar du bzlas na/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang rnam par grol bar 'gyur na/sdig pa chung ngu byas pa rnams lta ci smos/ lha'i bu rnams zhi ba'i thab khung skum po tha ma dang bar ma dang mchog khru gang dang khru do'am/ khru bzhi pa byas nas de'i ming gis yungs kur (7)dkar po rnams brgya phrag stong du bsregs na (kyengan song kun las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sha dang / rus pa dang / skra dang /thal ba la sogs pa la cho ga de bzhin 995nyid kyis sdig pa kun las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ / de yi 51 byedabus su 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad dkar po 'od zer 'bar/ /khor 1lhayug rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer dkar po dang ldan bri/ /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje bya/ /rdo rje rin chen chu skyes mchog /de nas sdig pa gzhom nyu)pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs bya/ /phyi rol rdo rje rigs rnams kyi / /phyag rgya rnams ni phyi rke rol bri/ /gza' dang skar ma'i mtshan ma dang / /de ltar 'jig rten 'khor rnams kyang / /gtso bo'i ri mo lugs ma dang / /rdo 85—347

rje can dang lhan cig gzhag /bum pa bum pa gang ba dang / /gtor ma lha bshos shin tu dkar/ /mdor na thig ni btab nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /dkar po'i gos ni gyon 3)nas su/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ②can mi 'jigs pas/ /ngan song 'gro bar gnas pa yi(kye/ /sems can de rjes dran byed cing / /sdig pa sgrib pa zhi ba'i phyir/ /rgyud dag pa yi ④phyin sreg ni/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsir (gebacas/ /'bras yos yungs kur ⑥bsres pa dang / /de yi (7skurus pa sha la sogs/ /yang na ming tsam gyis kyang byani/ /de nas bde 'gror skyes nas su/ /mkhas pas rgyas ⑨par bya ba ni/ /khru do pa 'am khru bzhi pa / /de bzhin mchog ni khru brgyad par/ /byas nas thab khung khru bzhi pa/ /kun du mu boran dang ldan pa/ /de dbus padma rin chen can/ /'od zer ser po can bri zhing / /khor 31yug tu ni rin chen dang / /mu ran la ni chu skyes bri/ /phyi rol du ni rigs lnga yi/ /dbye bas phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de bzhin phyi yi lha rnams rtsonyadang / /lcags kyu la sogs bri bar bya/ /na bza' 8ser porasagyon byas nas/ /mtho ris gnas pa rjes dran zhing / /de la phan phyir rgyas pa yi/ /don du rgyas pa'i las byas na32/ /lus can de yi tshe dang dpal/ /gzi brjid skal ba bzang po 'phel/ /de nas de la phan pa yi/ /dbang du bya ba'i tsolas bya ste/ /thab khung gzhu yi dbyibs 'dra ba/ /khru gang ba'am khru do pa/ /khru bzhi byas la de dbus su/ /chu skyes dmar po yang dag bri/ /de yi dbus su mdar bcas pa'i/ /gzhu nyid kyang ni bri bar bya/ /khor 0yug tu ni mdar bcas pa'irtson / /gzhu ni kha dog dmar po brim/ /sngags 'dzin pa yis rtag par yang /phyi rol de yi na )lha yi bya/ /sems can de ni dran byas la/ /na bza' pro spedamar po 85—348

gyon ①pa yi/ /me tog dmar zhing padma yang / /'bras bu dmar dang khams bcas pa/ /mar dang gur gum bsres pa dang / /tsandan dmar po'i phye ma dang ske/ /sbyin sreg (kyebyas nas lha la sogs/ /thams cad de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de yi gdon rnams rnam gzhom phyir/ /mngon ri spyod yang dag brtsam sa)par bya/ /khru do phyed bcas khru gsum mam(5ci/ /de bzhin mchog ni khru dgu pa/ /zur gsum dang ni ldan par bya/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /rtse gsum pa yis mu ran bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 56)yang byas la/ /dbyug pa mgo dang rtse gsum rnams/ /rdo rje dgra sta (7rtse gcig gis/ /phyi rol du yang mtshan (8)par bya/ /rig pa gsum pa sngar bzhin brgyan597/ /bum pa gtor ma bum pa yang / /zhal zas mang po gzhag par bya/ /sha dang khrag gis bobakang ba yi/sto/ /thod pa rnams kyang kun du yang / /de nas gos nag bgos shing khros/ /rang nyid 'jig rten gsum rnam rgyal/ /lus can de yi sdig las nyigasogs/ /de nas de yi sdig bcom zhing / /bgegs dang bral te ci bde bar/ /mtho ris 'jig rten mi rnams nyid/ /ji snyed khams gsum 'jig rten spyod/ /myur du go rims 8'di nyid kyis/ /tshe 'dir gnas pa rnams la bya/ /de nas gang gi phyir byas pa/ /de yi phyir ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /gzhan dag kyang ni las rnams kyang / /snga ma ji bzhin de bzhin bya/ /des tshini sems can rnams la yang 8/ /myur du bde skyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams yang dag par dga' bas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang ngan song du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang phan yon dang bde ba'i slad du brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di 'dri tsheb dang 'drir / 'jug 85—349

pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs 3)kyi bu mo de bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis bu bzhin du yongs su bskyang bar bgyi ste/ yang ji ltar bshad pa ma tshang ba med par bgyid ②pa lta ci smos/ gang yang rgyal po dang rgyal po'i bu dang rgyal po'i blon po ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags rjes su slob pa de'i rgyal srid 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /yul dang / phyogs dang / skye bo'i gnas dang / 'khor gyi skye bo'i lo thog la sogs pa yang bsrung shibar bgyi'o/ /nor dang 'bru rnams mang du 'byor par bgyi'o/ /bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams phun sum tshogs par yang bgyi'o/ /'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang /lo legs pa dang / bde bar bgyi'o/ /gang zhig brtag ④pa'i rgyal po 'di la dad pas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags dunate grong dang grong khyer la sogs par 'jug pa bdag nyid kyis bsdu bar yang brgya'o/ /glang po che'i steng du bzhag la grong dang grong khyer la sogs pa thams cad du bskor bar bya ⑥ste/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can chen po de'i drung na bdag cag bran gyi tshul lam bu'i tshul du gnas par gshes par bgyi'o/ /gang na 'di rab tu spyod pa de na bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' kun du bzang po 'anyere ba thams cad yongs su skong 79 ba de nyid brtag phyo )pa'i rgyal po'i gzugs su bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /sa phyogs de yang mchod rten du gyur par ⑩/'tshal bar bgyi ste/ mchod par bgyi32/ phyag 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /kun du bsrung hunyebar bgyi'o / /gang yang brtag pa'i rgyal po 'dir skorab tu spyod pa'i tsherdo rje slob 85—350

dpon dka' ①thub chen po de'i (gebadag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis lagayog bgyi'o/ /bran gyi tshul du gnas par bgyi'o/ /mngag gzhug 0pa nyid du gnas par bgyi'o/ /bsgo ba thams cad mnyan par bgyi'o/ /phan pa dang bde ba thams cad bgyi'o⑤/ /dngos grub thams cad 0stsal bar bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das mdor (pen de'i rkang pa'i rdul mgo bos gzung bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de'i phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang bar bgyi'ol/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dkyil 'khor du zhugs te medabang bskur ba de kho bo cag gis mnga' bdag tu 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /phyag na rdo rjer 'tshal bar bgyi'o / /rdo rje sems dpa' lags (pepar 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bde ba chen po kun du bzang po lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lags tshe par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal kyi to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams gang chos la rim gro gcig gnyis byas pas de ltar yang dag pa'i dam bca' ni legs so legs par sgrubs nya shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sngags dang rig pa dang / snying po thams cad brtan par bya ba'i phyir rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ rghaṃ (12rdu badzra pā ṇi dṛ snyi litiṣṭha hūm̐/ oṃ rghaṃ āḥbi / oṃ badzra rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dṛ nye tsho badzra hūṃ/ oṃ badzra rtsu sa/ oṃ badzra rdu aḥha rmo/de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /dbus su rdo tsho/nyerje bri bar bya/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /kun tu bzang po bde ba che/ /spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje nyid/ /g.yas su phyag na rin chen spyan/ /phyag na padma nub phyogs bri/ /byang du phyag na sna tshogs bri/ /phyi rol du ni skum 85—351

por bskorame/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgod par bya/ /de yi (gyiphyi rol sems dpa' rnams/ /go rims ④bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de yi phyi rol sems dpa' yang ske/ /byams pa la sogs mchog chen gri④/ /de phyir rjode bzhin dge slong ni/ /kun dga' bo sogs thub pa bri/ /rang gi chung ma bus bskor ba'i/ /tshangs pa la sogs phyi rol bri/ /gza' (gyedang rgyu skar nyi zla ⑦dang / /rgyal po bzhi po rnams dang ni/ /phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams(nye/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni yang dag bri/ /phyi rol du ni dmyal ba sogs/ /klu la 0sogs pa dud 'gro'i dpe'i/ /sgo dang sgor ni de bzhin du/ /sgo skyong stobs kyi skyodam pa rnamasal/ /dkar po 'dod pa'i nyi ma la/ /rab tu 'bad pas dkyil 'khor bri/ /gang bsngags phonyenag po'i phyogs la yang / /dkyil 'khor 'gal ba ma yin no/ /lnga pa de rjes bdun pa dang / /nya gang ba ni khyad par du/ /bsngags te /2phyag na padma yi/ /dkyil 'khor bya ba'i cho ga la'o/ /gang yang drag po'i las rnams la / /de ni nag po la yang bri/ /khro bo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor yang / /zla ba nya ba khyad par du/ /rgyal po tshernams kyis tsodakyil 'khor bsngags8/ /gzhan yang rang gis 'dus byas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor la brtson gdab bya zhing / /shar nas 'char ba'i dbang bya ste/ /phyogs kyi cha ni brtag 0par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dgod pa ni/ /yid kyis yongs su brtag par bya/ /sngags dang rgyud ni dang por byas/ /'jam zhing sngags gzugs dge zhing zhi/ /rjes mthun /sherang gi slob nyid kyi/ /slob ma lhan cig tsam gyis spyad/ /de nas nang par rab sngar langs/ /legs bkrus gos dkar 'chang zhing gtsang / /blo ldan bla ma slob lho)mar bcas/ /dkyil 'khor drung du kun nas 'grong )/ /dkyil 'khor 85—352

phyogs nyid shin tu yang / /nye bar byugs ①shing legs par mnyes②/ /khro bo chen po bzlas pa yi/ /dri yi chu yis bsangs zhu pa yi༅/ /dbus su rigs rnams snying po yis/ /lhag par gnas par bya ba nyid/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni gtso bo yi / /sngags kyi las rnams thams cad bya/ /sa la sor ni bcu gnyis pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dri yis (shebyas nas su/ /dkyil 'khor rig pas lan bdun du/ /lhag pa de nas bzlas par (6)bya/ /de rjes lha rnams nyid kyi yang ⑦/ /byang chub chen po zhes bya ba'i/ /snying pos skal ba ji lta bdu/ /dri dang me tog sogs mchod pa/ /byas nas gtor ma dbul bya zhing / /mngon par bsngags ⑨pa'i spos kyang ngo ⑩/ /de nas tsandan la sogs pa/ /bsres pa'i chu la mngon par bsngags7ske/ /de la dbul ba'i me tog dang / /bdug pa la yang cho ga bzhin/ /so shing u dum bā ra dang / /a shwattha 32sogs rma med 0cing / /shin tu phra min ④sbom pa min/ /sor mo bcu gnyis tshad tsam ni/ /dri yi chu yis rab bkrus ⑫shing ske/ /me tog phreng ba yis kyang bcing tshe/ /dri bzangs 0la sogs byugs shing bdug /lag pas reg na snying po ni/ /mang po yang ni bzlas bya zhing / /rigs nyid kyis hurteni lan bdun nam/ /slob ma rnams kyis nyu)tshad gzhal bsang nye/ /so shing tshul sogs yang dag gzung / /gcig la sogs pas go rims du sebazhin/ /rtse mo nyid nas bca' bar bya/ /de nas mkhas pas bdag nyid kyis/ /slob ma srung tsob brtan byas nas/ /sbyin sreg (stelas ni mar byugs (nyepa'i/ /yam zhu'ushing rnams ni mar dang bcas/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang bsres pa dang / /mar gyi sreg du ༄blugs bsreg du nyebya zhing / /zho zan gyi yang sbyin sreg 3bya/ /dang por bgegs ni zhi bya'i phyir/ /de nas thugs kyis rjes 'dzin phyir/ /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 85—353

cing 1)/ /sdig pa zhi bar bya phyir ram/ /de nas slob ma rnam ②brtags nas/ /cho ga yi du ༄ni lhag gnas bya/ /de yis ji ltar nus pa yis/ /de bzhin sdom pa gzung lnga)bar bya/ /de rnams cho ga 'di yin te/ /gtsang zhing dkar ba'i gos can ni/ /mdun du bltas te 'dug (5)pa la/ /lhag par gnas par brtsam par bya / /bla mas dang por skyabs gsum sbyin/ /de yi kunarjes la byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed (75pa ni bskyed (8dbya zhing / /bskyed pa slar yang rjes dran bya/ /de nas khro bo mngon bzlas pa'i/ /chu yis (gespyi bor bsang rsha )gtor bya/ /mgo bor kun tu reg nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag par lan bdun bzlas/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po ni/ /lag pas dri bzangs /tsho)sbags pa la/ /'jigs pa bzlog la mkhas pa yis/ /lan bdun rtag tu bzlas par bya/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 512yis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po yi ge gcig /rta mgrin 8chu skyes rigs la ni / /rig pa'i rgyal po'i 1 yi ge bcu/ /sumbha zhes bya rdo rje'i 8rigs/ /rig 8pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /yi ge rghaṃ bzhi rnams dang ldan/ /las kun rab tu spros pa la'o/ /rigs gsum rnams la thun mong ba/ /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nyid / /bgegs kun rnam par gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsang hūṃ snab pa yi bdag pos hu gsungs / /las ni thams cad pa yi sngags/ /spyi bor reg cing bzlas de nas/ /bsang nyurtagator yang bya de nyid kyis/ /bdug pa yis kyang ༷ )bdug par bya/ /dbang bskur ba ni bum pa bcas/ /'bru la sogs pa thams cad ldan/ /cung zad cung zad gang du blugs/ /rig 21pa'i rgyal pos mngon par bsngags/ /cho ga bzhin du lhag gnas bya/ /dri yi chu yis mchod yon sbyin/ /me tog kyang ni gzhug par bya/ /bdug na pa yis kyang bdug par bya/ /dbang bskur ba ni bum 85—354

pa bcas/ /mkhas pas yang dag yongs su bzlas/ /de yis dbang bskur bya ba yin/ /slar yang bzlas pa dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma dam tshig can rnams ni / /thal mo sbyar zhing mngon phyogs la/ /de nas so shing sbyin par bya/ /slob ma rnams ni go rims 3)bzhin/ /gzung zhing shar du kha bltas (zhesate/ /phyi rol nyid du so shing bca'/ /ma gas par ni 'chos tshonadanas su/ /logs ma yin par 'dor ༅bya ste/ /so shing mdun du dor byas pa/ /gang tshe mdun ༷ra du rtse mo lhung ske/ /de tshe dngos grub mchog shes bya/ /gang zhig steng du bltas pa yang /de bzhin shar du rtse mo bstan/ /dngos grub 'bring du yongs su grags/ /byang du bstan yin thad ka nyid/ /rig pa'i dngos grub 'jig rten pa/ /so shing dor ba brgya lam nartsi/ /gang tshe 'og tu kha bltas pa/ /de tshe sa 'og dngos grub ni/ /'byung ba 'di la the tshom med/ /slob ma nye bar reg pa ni/ /snga ma bzhin du gzung (nyebyas la/ /thams cad las byed (7sngags kyis ni/ /bla mas dri bzangs 7chu sbyin no/ /re re la yang btung ba'i phyir/ /khyor ba gsum ni sbyin par bya/ /de nas blo ldan langs nas su/ /'di dag kun du spyad par bya/ /de nas mchod pa yang byas nas/ /lag pas spos ni bteg nas su/ /blo ldan gus pas lha rnams la/ /gsol ba gdab cing gus gnas bya/ /dang por sngags ni snyan 7gsan dbab/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa/ /de yi nyi rim pa'i sbyor nyugeb yisabo/ /lha rnams spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /bcom ldan che ge mo zhes bya/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud512/ /slob ma rnams la brtse 7phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor thugs rje yi/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan de ni bdag gus la/ /bka' drin 85—355

mdzad par rigs lags so/ /'jig rten mgon po brtse ①ba can/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dgra bcom gang ②gzhan sngags kyi ②lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / /'byung po rdzu 'phrul che gang dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la stimangon dga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol / /che ge mo zhes bya ba dang / /che ge mo yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rang nyid 'byung ba bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar gus pa'i nyer ⑤spyod kyis/ /slob ma dang bcas bdag la ni/ /rjes su brtse ba ⑥nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad par rigs/ /de skad smras te tshig gang zhig /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstod pa'i nyer spyod kyang byas nas/ /de dag gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /chags bral so sor ldan pa yi/ /slob ma rnams la chos bshad bya/ /blo ldan shar du mgo bstan te/ /dge ba'i gnyid kyis rdzinyal du gzhug /de nas snga dro ②nyid du ni/ /mtshan mo'i rmi lam mthong ba drishi/ /gang tshe dge ba'am mi dge ba/ /dogs 0med nyin par thos nas su/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pas ni/ /rigs bdun rnams kyi dam tshig bskyang ⑪/ /de nas bu khyod dam tshig dang / /sdom pa rgyal ba yis gsungs hu3pa / /dad pas bla ma'i bka' yang bskyang / /khyed kyis 8srog chags gsad ④mi bya / /ma byin mi blang 'dod log dang / /dngos grub 'dod pas mi bya'o/ /chang mi btung zhing 8sha la sogs/ /bza' ba nam yang ma yin nyid/ /sems can kun la gnod mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum yang mi spang zhing / /dus rnams kun du byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /bla ma lha rnams de bzhin nyid/ /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /gang las sdig 85—356

'gyur de las 'da'/ /de la phul ba'i rnying pa ①dang / /grib ma la ②yang 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i rnam pa'ang de bzhin nyid/ /sngags dang lha la mi smad cing ske/ /gdon gyi las rnams mi bya'o/ /mu stegs pa yang smad mi bya/ /mdor na bdag nyid the tshom dang / /som nyi layid gnyis mi bya ste/ /rgyud dang lha sogs bul de bzhin/ /dad pa brtan pas dam bcas nas/ /sarba bid 9dekyis dbang de bzhin/ /bum pa la 97sogs mchog rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur bcu po 'dod ji bzhin/ /de nas lag tu (gerdo rje dang / /dril bu sbyin bya de rjes la/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun/ /bzung ponyenas 'khor los sgyur ⑨ba yi7 / /rgyal po dbang phyug thob phyir 3nyedang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang bskur zhing / /sngags bsgrub tso'adod pa'i slob ma la/ /rjes su gnang ba nyan tsodu gzhug /de nas bstod pas mgo bo yis/ /phyag 'tshal ji ltar 'dod pa'i rdzas/ /bla ma la ni dbul bya ste/ /rin chen gter dang 'bru dang dbyig /gser dang bzhon 8pa khyim dang gdan/ /bu dang bu mo skyes pa dang / /bud med rnams ni dbul bya zhing / /grong dang grong khyer ci bzhed rnams/ /rang gi sems ni rab dang bas / /yon rnams nges par dbul bya zhing / /dngos grub myur phyir bla ma la/ /mdor na bdag nyid kyang 'bul bya/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /'jig rten pha rol bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob 8'gyur te/ /lha yi bde ba lta ci smos/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa gang / /de yis rtag tu sdug 19bsngal 'thob/ /de phyir slob dpon smad mi bya//rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang / /gang yang smad par mi bya zhing / /khon 3/par yang ni mi bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /bla ma smod byed ma 85—357

rungs rnams/ /dam tshig 'das la bzod mi bya/ /de lta bu sogs gnod byed la'ang ske/ /de lta nyid do de byas na/ /kun rig gis gsungs dngos grub 'thobaci1)ske/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /dngos grub myur du 'byung ba 'thob / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po dang / lha dang bcas pa'i rin 'jig rten la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du sgrub ②pa'i cho ga gsungs te/bri gzhi rtsol bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa de kho na bzhin du bri zhing (gegayas su de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang ske/ g.yon du shākya thub pa dang / ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yidabang phyug sku mdog zla ba lta bu phyag na padma can dang / shākya thub pa'i 'og na phyag na rdo rje dang / de dag gi (pedabus su sman pa'i rgyal po phyag gcig gis a ru ra'i 'bras bu bsnams shing de las gzhan ni mchog sbyin du bya'o/ /rta mgrin dang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba ma rungs tsho0pa 'joms pa la brtson pa dag ni rang gi lha la mngon par phyogs par bri zhing de dag gi (9)dbus su lo tsa nā rtso byedang / mā ma tī thadang /gos dkar nyurtemo dang / sgrol ma dag phyag na rang gi mtshan ma can bri'o/ /de rnams kyi 'og tu rdzing bu chu srin dang / nya dang / rus /2sbal dang / sbal pa dkar po la sogs pa dang bcas pa dang chu las skyes pa'i me tog du mas yongs su gang bar bri zhing bdug cipa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang /zhal zas dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa nyunyebyi bar bya'o/ /'og nyid du sgrub pa po thal mo sbyar te rab tu 'dug nyugacing 'dud bla snapar bri'o/ /de nas de rdzogs pa la byin gyis brlab pa dmigs par bya ste/ spyan dbye ba byas 85wa 358

nas mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas gal te mtshan ma mthong na myur du 'grub bo/ /gal te ma mthong na ring mo zhig na 'grub pa'o/ /bzhad tsa)pa dang ni rnga sgra dang / /dril bu'i sgra dang 'brug sgra nyid/ /dge slong bram ze bu mo dang ske/ /'bras bu mthong na dngos grub ni/ /mchog 'bring tha ma myur du 'grub//de nas ②sku gzugs phyag rgya dang / /sngags rnams kyis ni byin gyis brlabadu / /ji ltar bskyed pas thob bya zhing / /'jig rten gsum ni rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la ④sogs byas nas su/ /bdag gi de nyid kyang bsgoms nas/ /ji srid dngos grub rtags 'byung ba/ /'bum phrag gsum mam drug 'bum bzlas//de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /sngags kyang 'a)chad lhag bskang (6)bya ste/ /brgya phrag brgyad rnams bzlas par bya/ /de nas bzlas pa de yi mthar/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la/ /mchod pa rgya chen yang byas nas/ /mtshan mo gcig ni bzlas par ④bya/ /de nas gal te gtso bo 'am/ sras sam lha rnams mthong gyur dun/ /de tshe snod 'dod ji lta bar/ /dngos grub mchog ni gsol ba gdab/ /lha rnams rtag tu dgyes pa yis/ /dngos grub 'bras bu de la 475la / /phyag byas nas mni dngos grub ni/ /mchog la sogs pa blang bar bya/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la/ /rang rang skal 1lhab phul nas su42/ /de nas rtag tu bdag nyid spyad/ /de rnams med na shes rab can/ /blangs nas rang nyid spyad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan brtson zhing / /bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur/ /legs par bsgrubs na thams cad byed/ /gnod sbyin rgyu skar gdong la sogs/ /tshig tsam gyis ni bran bzhin du/ /zhi ba'i las la nyurtesogs pa ni/ /thams cad byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 85—359

'das la lha'i dbang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can sdig pa bgyis pa dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa rnams kyis dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rab tu spang ba'i phyir ji ltar ①bsgrub ②par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sdig pa chen po byed pa de rnams dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams las tshegs med par grol bar 'gyur ba ①de bzhin du nyon cig /de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni bzlas pa yi/ /bum pa rnams kyis dusnga ma bzhin/ /dbang bskur ba ni brtag ⑤par bya/ /de nas sngon gyi sdig byang ༅zhing / /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal ni/ /kun las myur du rnam grol 'gyur/ /sdig las rnam grol bdag nyid che/ /de yang gnas gtsang lhar skyes nas/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas chos bgro thosame/ /phyir mi bzlog pa'i sa la gnas/ / rim gyis (nyebyang chub mngon sum byed/ /de yi gzugs brnyan dang ni ming / /gur gum gyis ni bris nas su/ /ngan song gsum gyi 'jig 6)chen las/ /sems can rnams ni thar ba'i phyir/ /sngags pa gzhan la phan brtson bozhing / /brtse bas mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas su/ /mchod rten dbus su gzhag par bya/ /rang gzhan hunyelha yi snying po ni/ /snying ga pho de yi phyogs bris nas/ /lha mnyam par ni sems bskyed lho de/ /khyim du yang ni gzhag par bya/ /de yi ming dang spel ba'i sngags/ /gur gum bzang pos bris nas ni/ /'bum ni yongs su rdzogs par bya8/ /mchod rten las ni rab tu bya/ /sdig chen sdig ni zad bya'i phyir/ /bye ba yang 85—360

ni rdzogs par bya/ /de ltar byas na de nges par/ /dmyal ba las ni grol bar 'gyur / /de bzhin yi dgas byol song las/ /grol te lha rigs rnams su skyes/ /de yi ming dang spel nas ni/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags stong bzlas/ /gal te brgya phrag stong yang tshang / /bye ba'i bar du rdzogs par bya/ /lha 1)rigs rnams su ②skye bar 'gyur/ /de yi ming nas spel ba yi/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong snyed du/ /sbyin sreg (0byas na dmyal ba ni/ /chen po'i sdig pa las grol 'gyur/ /ji srid mtshan ma 'bar ba yi/ /gnas su yang dag skye bar 'gyur/ / yungs kur ④dkar po'i til dang 'bras/ /ra yi 'o ma yang dag ldan/ /de bskus yam shing de srid du/ /cho ga ji bzhin sbyin sreg ⑤bya/ /de nas de ni nges par yang / /lha rigs rnams su skyes pa yi/ /mtshan ma nye bar mthong bar 'gyur/ /gal te lha yi mchog skyes dang / /yang na thab khung nang du ni/ /dkar po g.yas bskor 4)'bar ba dang / /gyen du 'greng zhing dri ma med/ /'phro ba bsdoms bzhin 'bar ba dang / /glog bzhin dri ma med 'od brtan(7da/ /me rtags 98༄'di rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang na me lha bdag nyid ni/ /de bzhin kho nar ston 9'gyur tetshe/ /zla ba bzhin du dri ma med/ /dkar po bzhin du 51)'bar ba'o/ /mtshan ma 'di dag mthong ba la/ /de nas dmyal sogs rnam (1)grol zhing / /sdig pa bcom nas bde 'gror ni/ /skyes pa yin par 8shes par bya/ /khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ /cho ga ji bzhin thab khung sko0/ /rdo rjes mtha' ma bskor ba yi/ /'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya//rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams/ /ji bzhin rang gi 7phyogs su bri/ /ji bzhin sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /'jig rten la sogs phyi (tshanas bri/ /de nas bum 85—361

pa 0)gang ba dang / /gtor mas snod rnams bkang ba ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug dag tu gzhag /bza' dang bca' 9bab zhal zas dang / /me tog phreng sogs de bzhin te/ /bla re rgyal mtshan dar la sogs/ /gdugs mchog rnams kyis ①legs par brgyan/ /de ltar sbyin sreg (༄thab khung ni/ /mchog tu yang dag sbyin sreg (shebya/ /cho ga shes pas de bris nas/ /lha yi tshogs ni spyan drangs te / /sngags shes pas sngags phyag rgya yis(6)/ /argha (7)la sogs phul nas ni/ /mdor bsdus mchod pa byas nas su/ /lha yi sbyor bas rab gnas la/ /ga pur gur gum (8)la sogs pas/ /mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la/ /til dang yungs kur kha'abras rnams dang / /dri yi chus 7ni legs bkang hu)ste/ /'bras chan tsospos dang la du dang nyusnye/ /sbrang rtsi sha ka rar 8ldan la/ /brgya 'iphrag du mar yongs su bzlas/ /yam shing la yang de bzhin te/ /rang gis tsosngags kyis btab pa'i shing / /khung bu'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za la hu sogs su gnas pa'iXsnye/ /ro la sngags kyis btab nas su / /chu mchog gis ni 3)bkrus nas ni/ /sngags bzlas dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan bya zhing / /sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug ri )pas bdug /me tog phreng ba la sogs mchodasalha/ /gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du / /sngags bris nas rin ni gdags par bya/ /snying ga 32mgrin pa kha phyogs su/ /sarba bibyās 20byin gyis brlabs/ /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo spyi gtsug dpung pa gnyis/ /rna ba dku 35dang pus (9mo bolas nye/ /sna yi rtse mo long bu dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnas dang ni / /de ltar gzhan du'ang gnas yi ge/ /mchog tu dge ba de dag gzhag /85wa 362

de dag ngan song yongs 0)sbyang (5)phyir/ /stan dang bcas te thab dbus gzhag /de nas sngags pas sngags kyis ni/ /mngon par bsngags (7pa'i gos kyis cigayogs / /de nas byin za yang dag rab sbar (5skal/ /me lce stong gis dkrigs shing 'bar ba'i lus/ /zla ba kunda bzhin du zhi ba'i yid/ /dpag med kun la mchod yon yongs su brtagaye /de bzhin ji ltar gsungs pa'i mchod pa bya/ /de nas dang po de yi sbyin sreg niri tsho/ /rdzogs par byas shing 'bar ba nyid la ni/ /yongs brtags (2rinas ni rgyal ba las/ /sogs pa rnams kyi brgyad ni lhag pa dang ske/ /bcas pa'i brgya ni yongs su brtag par bya/ /de nas sbyong ba'i sngags kyi rgyal po yi(9sna/ /bsreg bya nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su brtag /de nas zhal ras dkar po spyan drangs la/ /yo byad rnams sam mchod yon sogs gsum mchod/ /phyag na rdo rje padma zhags pa bsnams/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis ni rab brgyan cing / /rdzogs pa'i 1 tshosangs rgyas nyid kyi 11dbu rgyan can/ /bsam par bya zhing yang dag nyu2bri bar bya/ /de yi snying po brgya phrag stong ngam ni/ /ji srid rtso2bye ba'i bar du sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /yang na mtshan ma yang dag byung na ni/ /de bzhin sdig rgyun spangs par shes par bya/ /de nas thal bar 'gyur ba cho ga bzhin / /rdo rje bsdu bas thal ba rus pa bsdu/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dri chu dang / /ba yi rnam lnga dang bcas la/ /sbyong ba'i sngags ni 'bum bzlas te/ /gong bu byas nas ga pur drir15/ /sa dang legs par bsres byas la/ /sku gzugs mchod rten lhar bsam lazhing / /lan gcig 1 tshoganyis gsum bzhi lnga 'am/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nyusnyel/ /'bum phrag gnyis ni bzlas par bya/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar gyur tam/ /85wa 363

yang na sku gzugs zhal 'dzum mam0)/ /dri spos ngad ldan 'od snang ngam/ /lha la sogs pa sna tshogs pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa dang / /me tog la sogs 'dor ba dang / /dung dang rnga dang gling bu dang / /pi bang ②la sogs sgra thos 'gyur/ /gal te lha yi mtshan ma de/ /sdig mang nyid kyis ma mthong ba/ /de tshe 'bum phrag brgya stong bzlas(8)/ /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bzlas par byabya/ /de mthar cho ga shes pa yis/ /mtshan gcig thog thag mi nyal bzlas/ /de nas de yi sdig pa ni/ /rnam dag bdag nyid nges par mthong / /lha yi lus kyis gzugs dang ni/ /de yi rgyud du ngo shes 'gyur/ /mtshan ma 'di dag shes nas su / /rnam par mi rtog (5sems kyis ni/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu bya/ /gal te de yang med (nyagyur na/ /de tshe bzlas bsgom tshul gyis bya/ /de yi ming tsam bris nas su/ /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba dang / /sku gzugs kyang ni byas nas su/ /sbyin sreg ⑦dbang bskur byas gyur na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /thal ba yungs kur ⑤bye ma sogs//ming spel sngags ni mngon btab nas/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dor/ /de ltar byas na sdig pa can/ /yin yang ngan song rnams las ni/ /rnam par thar bar gyur nas kyang / /dge ba mchog gi sa bon ni/ /bskyed dang ldan pas sangs rgyas nyid/ /'bras bur yang dag ldan pa yi/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab rgyu/ /rab tu bsgoms pa'i bsod nams ldan/ /'jig rten ngan song bcom pa ni/ /'di ltar lha yang ci zhig smosathos/ /'di la the tshom med pa yin/ /gang yang dge ba'i rtsa ba ma 85—364

bskyed pa dang / gang yang med pa'i lta ba can dang / gang byang chub kyi 0)lam las rnam par 'das pas ༷ bstan pa la zhe snang gi (guganod pa byed pa dang /sdig pa'i rang bzhin mi shes pa pha dang ma la sems mi ④brtse ba dang / byang chub kyi sems la mi brten pa dang / /'dod chags dang bral ba bsad pa dang / lha dang ske/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / sngags dang /phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs pa rnams la med pa nyid du lta (snyeb la sogs pa'i sdig pa can rnams la de lta bu'i shes rab snyodang thabs med na grol ba med do zhes pa/bde bar gshegs pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs so/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs pa spyan padma rgyas pa rnams legs so zhes bya bas mnyes par mdzad do/ /mnyes par mdzad nas mchod pa mdzad do/ /brgya byin gzhan la phan par brtson pas kyang ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du byas so/ /'bras bu de bzhin du thob par gyur to/ /dbang ldan du mgrin 7༄pa sngon po glang khyu mchog la zhon pa/sku mdog dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang mchog sbyin du bcas pa/ g.yon pa'i gcig gis rtse gsum pa 'dzin cing gnyis pas ral gri 'dzin pa sbrul gyi 98)mchod phyir thogs pa can bris te / oṃ pa shu pa ti nī tsal kursā u mā dzrī 7ya swā hā zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas phyag rgya 'di yin te/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur byas la mthe'u chung mthe bong gis mnan te sor mo lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i mtshan nyid du byas shing ming med dang mdzub mo'ang /lhardo rje'i rnam par cung zad 'dud nyurtapar bya'o/ /'di ni phyugs bdag gi phyag rgya'o/ /khyab 'jug khyung la zhon pa/ mdog nag po phyag bzhi pa/phyag g.yas pa dag na dbyug to 1 dang rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pa dag na dung 85wa 365

dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /gser gyi rdo rje ma khyab 'jug lta bu gser gyi mdog can du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ma hu)rma bya la zhon pa/ zhal drug pal/dmar po g.yas pa dag na shasti dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa dag na khyim bya dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma rdo rje dril bu lta ①bur shes par bya'o/ /mi smra ba rdo rje ngang pa la la bzhon pa/ gser mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa ( phyag g.yas pa dag na 6)rdo rje dang bgrang phreng ⑦'dzin cing / g.yon pa dag na dbyug tho dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma tshangs pa lta bur shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje mtshon cha glang po che shedakar po la lazhon pa/ phyag g.yon pas rang gi rdo rje 'dzin cing g.yas pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'ol/ /rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje mtshon cha ltar shes par ⑩bya'o/ /rdo rje 'khyil pa khro bo yang shing rta la nyamazhon pa/ mdog dmar po/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa na padma dang ske/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi ma dang rdo rje 'khyil pa khro bo lta bu nyid do/ /rdo rje 'od zer khro bo dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pas padma dang zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'od zer ma rdo rje khro bo lta bu'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo rus 8sngal la 7zhon pa mdog sngon po phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o④/ /dbyug pa rdo rje mchog ma rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo lta bu'o/ /rdo rje dmar ser khro bo glang po che la zhon pa tsho1gemadog dmar po/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin cing /g.yon pas mi bzung lanas za zhing gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje ska ⑩rags ma rdo rje dmar ser khro bo lta bu'o/ /rdo rje tshogs bdag glang sna 8glang po che la yizhon pa can / phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pas gshol ( )'dzin cing 85wa 366

gnas pa stimadog dkar po'o/ /rdo rje 'dul ba ma rdo rje glang sna lta bu'o/ /'di ni khyad par te gang zhe na/ phyag g.yon gyis kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba tshogs kyi bdag po mdog ljang gu bye/ bya ku li ku'i shing rta la bzhon pa/phyag g.yas kyis ④rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gdan ma rdo rje phreng ba lta bu'o/ /'di ni khyad par te gang zhe na/ phyag g.yon gyis shasti phyi'adzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbang can ne tso'i shing rta la (gezhon pa mdog dkar ser/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje dbang can ma gerdo rje dbang can lta bu ste 'di ni khyad par ro/ /gang zhe na/ mdog dmar po'o/she/ /rnam rgyal rdo rje tshogs kyi bdag po sbal pa la (7zhon pa/ mdog dkar po'o/ /phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin pal/ g.yon pas ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gdengs pa ma rnam rgyal rdo rje lta bu'o / /rdo rje gtun shing pho nya mo 7me tog gi shing rta'i (homakhar bu zhon pa mdog dkar ser/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas gtun shing 'dzin pa'o / /rdo rje gtun shing pho nya mo rdo rje gtun shing lta bu ste 'di ni khyad par ro/ /gang zhe na/ g.yon gyis nyu kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rlung 1 gi pho nya mdog sngon po ri dgas bol zhin pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas dar 'dzin pa'o/ /mgyogs 8pa'i rdo rje ma rdo rje rlung gi pho nya lta bu'o/ /rdo rje me'i pho nya mor skyes la (7zhon pa mdog dmar po gyen du 'bar ba'i 'od rtse gsum pa 'bar ba'i phyag g.yas 1rtodag na rdo rje dang go cha 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dag na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ma nya rdo rje me lta bu'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed pho nya ma nyu)sngon po ro langs la rizhin pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin 85wa 367

pal/ g.yon pas rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gtsigs ①pa pho nya mo rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu ste/ 'di ni khyad par ro/ /gang zhe na/ g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bran klu ②lhag pa la gzhon pa/ sngon po phag gi gdong pa can/ g.yas pas ④rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o / /rdo rje nag mo du bran (6)mo ro langs kyi bzhon ⑦pa can/ phyag g.yon gyis kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa mdog nag mo'o⑧/ /rdo rje log 9'dren phran bra ba byi ba zhon pa/ mdog dkar po/ glang po che'i gdong pa can / phyag g.yas dag na rdo rje dang dgra sta ⑩'dzin pa/ g.yon dag na rtse gsum dang ni dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyi nyamamachod phyir thogs pa'o/ /rdo rje srul mo bran mo mdog sngon mo g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin pa mgayon pa phyags ma 'dzin pa bra ba byi ba zhon pa'o/ /klu rdo rje'i chu srin zhon pa gdengs ka brgyad pa/mdog dkar po g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas nyi klu'i zhags pa 'dzin ⑩pa'o / /rdo rje chu 15srin ma bran nyu9mo chu srin la mazhon pa/ mdog dkar mo/bdengs ka brgyad ma// g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin 'dzin pa'o/ /'jigs mdog ma ljang gu snanagayas pas rdo rje 'dzin cing ske/ g.yon pas ral gri phe maṭa ka 'dzin pa'o )/ /dpal mo mdog dkar ser g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pas padma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyangs can ma 21mdog dkar mo/ phyag g.yon pas pi bang 22g.yas pas rdo rje ma'o/ /bgrod 22ka mdog ljang gu ( tshoseng ge la 22zhon pa/ phyag g.yas pa dag na rdo rje dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dag na lde men 37dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /ma mo thams cad dang / drag po la sogs pa dang / chu bdag gi mthar thug pa 85wa 368
