rnams kyi dang / gang phyag g.yas su rdo rje gsungs pa de ni rdo rje rtse gsum par shes par bya'o/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad rnam par snang mdzad la mngon du bltas pa'o/ /de nas thun mtshams kyi 3)dus su rdo rje ti (0rirnyi ②ris dag par bcings te me tog sngon po'i phreng ba bzung rlo la dkyil 'khor du 'jug go/ /yi ge hūṃ bzhi pa brjod cing rdo rje 557rnam par snang mdzad la bskor 55)ba bdun dang dung dang dril bu'i sgra bsgrag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi yang lhag pa dang chad pa'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i nges par bltas te phreng ba bcom ldan 'das la phul nas rdo rje'i gar byas la blangs te yi ge hūm̐ bzhi pa nyid kyis rang gi mgo bor bcing ngo 7/ /ji ltar cho ga bzhin du yang / /gang zhig chad pa yongs su bskang tshon/ /mkhas pas lhag pa rnams spang phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu kun rtog 59bya/ /'grub 'gyur nyes pa spang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas 'dug par gyur pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag pas/ /rdo rje sgo ni bzhi po rnams/ /yid kyis nyu )dbye bar bya ba nyid/ /oṃ badzra ṭa tshonaya nyugs ma ya hunyam be sha tsū zhes bya'o/ /phyag rgya yang 'di yin te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te/ /mdzub mo gan rkyal 1 yang dag gzung nyusnye/ /legs par drag tu rnam par 15dbye/ /sgo dbye ba yi 1 cho ga yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas lcags kyu la sogs pas las rnams byas la rin po che bdun las byas pa'am sa las byas pa'i bum pa nag po la sogs pa med pa18/ mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lto ba che ba/ lha rdzas kyi dri'i chu dang / rin po che dang / sman thams cad dang / 'bru thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs pa/ yal 'dab dang bcas pa/ mgrin pa la gos dam pas legs par bcings la bsrung ba /(byas pa/85wa 369

phyi rol lho)kun du lha rdzas kyi dri rjes su byugs pa me tog gi phreng ba btags du pa'i rdo rjes steng du mtshan pa/ rdo rje chen po'i ( byin gyis brlabs ④pa/ khro bo ti rirnyi (geris yongs su bzung ba'i rdo rje dang me tog gi yal 'dab kyis/ oṃ badzo da ka (65rgyu zhes bya ba 'di stong rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags 9)pa'i yi ge hūm̐ bzhi pa brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags nasapa byas la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi spyan sngar legs par bzhag go/ /'jug pa'i sgo la mngon par phyogs pa'i phyi rol du bum pa gnyis pa la yi ge hūm̐ bzhi pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa bzhag go / /de'i chus bdag nyid dang slob ma dbang bskur ba bya ste gzhug pa'i phyag rgya (9ribacings nas sam 1 ma bcings pa yang ngo / /byi ga11ru de bzhin sa le sbram/ /dung dang de bzhin nor bu ni/ /rin chen kun te sing sgri dang / /byā sgri gi ri nyusnyebe be re/ /sman kun til nas 1 sran ma sha /'bras dang gro ni lnga pa ste/ /sman lnga 'bru kun sgras mtshon pa'o/ /de'i rjes la phyag bzhi la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sdom pa 'dzin 1 du 15bcug nas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi gos sngon po la yang yongs su bzlas te sems dpa'i gtsug tor gyis gtsug tor bcing ba dang 6nya/sgo skyong gis gdong bcing 1 ba dang 18/ rdo rje go chas stod g.yogs dang /gtsug tor la sogs pa can gyis 19slob dpon gyis khro bo ti rirnyi 3 )ris me tog sngon po'i phreng ba bzung nas/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya pra be shā lhami zhes brjod cing zhugs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba gdab ste/ bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba la sogs pas so/ /de nas rdo rje'i chu 'thungs nas bdag nyid 'jug par 22byas la/ phreng ba de dkyil 'khor chen por dor la rang rang gi mgo la bcings te gdong bcings pa bkrol lhal/ ji lta ba zhugebazhin du dkyil 85—370

'khor 0stel bltas te/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pa la sogs pas gzhug tshon pa'i phyag rgya dgrol ba yang byas la chu'i dbang bskur ba dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs (snyedang / rdo rje dang / phreng ba dang / bdag po la sogs pas dbang bskur ba dgu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas blangs pa de kho na nyid dang / chos dang / dam tshig dang /dngos grub dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs kyang bzung tshong la/ me tog la sogs pas kyang bdag nyid legs par mchod de tshigs su bcad pa lnga pas rjes su gnang ba dang ske/ yi ge hūm̐ gis gzengs 95bstod pa dang / lung bstan pa yang smos zhiral/slar yang byin gyis brlab 77༄pa la sogs pa byas la ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i bzlas pa yang ste/ hūṃ kā 48cir badzra haṃ 9zhes pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan brjod par bo bya zhing hunyernam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya chen po bcings dzel de'i sngags aḥ'i rtso rnam pa'i mtha' can gyi 8rnam par 12snang mdzad kyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i bdag nyid dbab bo/ /badzo 19rta zhes bya ba yis rdo rje'i nga rgyal rnam par bsgoms la de ri tshordo rje rnam par snang mdzad du 12bsgoms te/ badzra dhā tu a haṃ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar rdo rje 'bebs 19pa'i bar gyi phyag rgya chen po bcings la byang gi sgor de'i sngags aḥ'i rnam pa'i mtha' can gyi rdo rje 21rdo rje dril bu'i 5bdag nyid dbab pa'o/ /badzra ghaṇḍi na rta zhes pa'i nga rgyal bskyed la de badzra ā na be sha kro rnyo zhugerta zhes bsgom 7mo/ /de lta bus rdo rjer 7bsgrub snyepa yin no/ /de nas yang rdo rje slob dpon gyis sems dpa' rdo rje lcags kyus bcings la se gol legs par gtogs 9par byed cing sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus par 21bya ste/oṃ badzra sa mā 2 ya dzaḥ na/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥzhes pa jilan nyi shu rtsa gcig rab tu 85—371

brjod do/ /de nas myur du phyag rgya chen po dang / rdo rje khro bo'i dam tshig brjod do/ /de ma thag tu mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa mchog go/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu 0)la sogs pas rang gi sgo nas spyan drangs la bcug ste/ bcings nas dbang du byas la ji lta ba bzhin du dusayi ge rtsu bzhi pas mchod yon phul te dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams dang / bskal pa bzang po'i mthar thug pa rnams bsgrubs te rang gi sngags brjod pa ji lta bur brjod cing dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ(gyis ma ya st+waṃ (pes ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ de nas rang gi sngags brjod do/ /de lta bus 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi ⑤phyag rgya rnams dbyung ste/ rdo rje las gsang dam pa byung / /dam tshig mchog rnams nyid du grags/ /khro bo'i bcing ba bla 6)med pa/ /de rnams bcing bar stirab bshad bya/ /lag ngar rdo rje kun du bsnol(8)/ /mthe chung 9lcags kyu bcing ba nyidal/ /mdzub mo dag boni rab tu brkyang / /'jig rten gsum po rnam ⑩rgyal zhesal/ /de bzhin mdzub mo kha sprad cing hu3/ /nor bu nyid ni bar ma bskumatso/ /bsnyams 〉la dbu ma padma nyid/ /gung mo mdzub mo gnyis sdigs tsomadzub/ /sdigs hu9mdzub gnyis ni rdo rje yang / /g.yas pa bkug ⑩pa lcags kyu'o/ /de dag nyid sbyar yi ge hūm̐/ /legs pa'i rnam pa de bzhin yang / /mdzub gnyis logs gnas khro gnyer du/ /snying gar nyi nyi ma mdzub gnyis zlumatha/ /lag pa mgo bor rab tu brkyang / /mdzub mo kha ru dgod pa can/ /mdzub mo sen mo kun du rig /g.yas pa mdzod kyi khu tshur yang / /gung mo'i mgo bcas 'khor lo nyid/ /kha las rab mchog thon pa yi/ /mdzub mo dbu ma rdo rje yang ske/ /mdzub mo mgrin dzo — )pa bskor ba dang / /mdzub mo lhag ma mche ba che/ /85—372

rdo rje khu tshur mthe bong bsdam1)/ /sgeg mo la sogs pa rnams ni rdo rje dbyings su tshanabashad pa bzhin du bya ba 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings nas su/ /snying gar ②yang na mthe bong mnyam(ba/ /legs par rab brkyang phreng ba ma/ /thal mo sbyar mchog kha nas dbyung / /gar las spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /rdo rje bsdams pa thur du sbyin/ /thal mo legs sbyar gyen du gtor(zhin/ /mthe bong bsnyams tshanate nges par bsdams/ /rab tu brkyang ba byug pa yis)/ /mdzub mo gcig ni bkug pa dang / /mthe bong gnyis ni mdud zhu)pa bcings/ /mthe bong mdzub mo bsnol ba bcing / /rdo rje khu tshur mchog bsdams thoganyid/ /ces ⑩pa'o /snying po'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnam par bsams la hunyes gi rnam pa nyid brjod cing phyag rgya thams cad bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i nges par 3/'byung ba ste/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya ni/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad rin chen hūm̐ mdzada'osnye/ chos kyi hūm̐ mdzad/ las kyi hūm̐ mdzad kyi gnas su yang ngo / /de nas rin chen hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa rnams kyi sngags rnams 'byung ste / oṃ badzra sgro 8ku ṭi nyugegro dhā tshan ya sarba ratna ni hrīḥkyi 7rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra hrīḥjiḥpho ’kro dha duṣṭa mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bi shwa /(gro dha ku ru sarba bi shwa rū pā ya sā 2 byedha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gzhan rnams ni sems dpa' rdo rje ma nas brtsams par blta'o / /de nyid kyi phyir rig 1pa thams cad kyi mchog rnams kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags su bshad do/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya bsdu bas yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tsū mdzad bklag napar bya'o/ /gzhan rnams rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad du 'gyur ba rigs pa yang ma yin te/ rgyud thams cad du rtsu mdzad nges par bstan par yang ma yin no/ /de'i rjes su de kho na bzhin lce la rdo rje 85—373

bkod de rim pa bzhin du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i chos kyi yi ge rnams dgod do/ /de rnams kyang rtsu yig sangs rgyas rdo rje can/ ṭwāṃ yig rdo rje'i snying po yi/ /hrīḥhu)yi 5gernam pa rdo rje'i sde'i/ /aḥyig rdo rje sna tshogs kyi/ /rtsu sems dpa' rdo rje ma yi/ /ṭwāṃ rin chen rdo rje ma yi(gyi/ /hrīḥ5chos kyi rdo rje ma yi45ra / /aḥlas kyi rdo rje ma yi(ye/ /rgyu hūm̐/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥhrīḥ/ aḥ.aḥchazhes bya'o / /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa dga' ba chen po la hūṃ/ gzugs mdzes pa la hūm̐/ rna ba bde ba la hūṃ/ mchod pa thams cad la rtsu/ rab tu dga' ba la hūṃ/ dbus su bgrod 78)pa la rtsu/ legs par gzi khu)mchog la rtsu/dri bzangs 7mchog la hūm̐/ ā yā hi dza ju/ ā nyunyanyi hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ (3gyi 0sgo ṭa rba rgyu gha a aḥrgyu/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa nas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i mthar thug pa rnams kyi'o/ /de ma thag tu a'i yi ge las snying gar tsosna tshogs rdo rje bskyed pa las kyi phyag rgya bcing ngo / /de la khro bo'i khu tshur rnam pa gnyis byas la g.yon pa'i rdo rje sor mo g.yas pas bzung 8zhing bsgreng tsob byang chub mchog ces ⑩bya ba'i phyag rgya 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rab tu ster 'ostero/ /gnyis po de dag gis 'gying 19ba dang bcas pas gsal bar byed pa ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang rdo rje sems dpa' dang sems dpa' rdo rje ma rnams kyi'o/ /lcags kyu 'dzin par yang dag gnas/ /mda' gsor ba yi sbyor ba dang / /legs so zhes bya du )snying gar 0gnas / /rdo rje gnyis nyid dbang bskur ba/ /rin chen hūm̐ mdzad dang / rdo rje khro gnyer 22dang / khro bo dang / rin chen rdo rje ma rnams kyi'o/ /snying gar ( snyenyi ma rab tu blta/ /g.yon gnas lag ngar dbyug pa dang / /de bzhin 'di ni yongs su bzlog /g.yas dang g.yas min rnam par bsnol/ /chos kyi rtsu 85—374

mdzad dang / rdo rje chos dang / chos kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi'o/ /snying gar tsho1)nyi ma la ral gri'o/ /mgal ri me'i 'khor lo bskor ba nyid/ /rdo rje gnyis ni khar gnas shing / /rdo rje'i gar ni bkrol rabs ni/ /'gram pa spyi gtsug yang dag gnas / /las kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje las dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi'o / / go cha bumathe chung mche ba mchog /khu tshur gnyis ni nges par bcing 95ri/ /rdo rje 'gyings pa'i (lerab sbyor bas/ /bsam pa g.yos pas 'dud par bya/ /phreng ba bcings te kha nas dbyung / /gar las spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /'og tu 'phyang dang gyen du 'thor/ /mthe bo bsnyams (7)te nges par gshibs na/ /dri byug pa yi sbyor ba las/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /mdzub 99rimo lcags kyu bcings pa yis/ /mthe chung las ni lcags kyu che/ /mkhrig 1 rim mdud pa mchog dag bsnol/ /rgyab dag kyang ni nges par gshibs37/ /zhes sgo skyong rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya thams cad kyang gar las 'byung ba yin no//de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rnams kyi 12bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje sems ma dang / rin chen dang / chos dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi yang 1lhaste rdo rje dang po dang / mthar gnas pa yi 1 ciskyes pa dang / bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin pa de rnams kyi bdag nyid chen po gang dang gang gi phyag rgya gang dang gang yin pa rnams bcing ngo / /thams cad kyi phyag rgya dam tshig phyag rgya 12yang yin te/ g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gan rkyal du byas la lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe bong dag dang mthe chung nas brtsams te kha phye ba'i thal mo kha sbyar ba'o/ /'di ni byams pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams kyi rig 57pa ni sngar bshad pa nyid de/ de rnams kyi rig pa ljags rnams 85—375

la dgod ①do/ /'di ni de rnams kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yi ge a las rang gi thugs kur (misna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la de rnams 'dri bya'i ②rjes su 'brangs nas phyag rgya chen po bcings pa ni las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi thugs kur ④rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams la bri ⑤bya'i rjes su 'brangs pa nyid las de rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po bcing ngo / /de nyid kyis yang rig pa'i thun mong ba'o/ /mthe'u chung dang ske/ mthe bong bcings nas kyang g.yon pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum po rtse gsum pa la dbus ma rtse mo yang rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bzung ༷zhing rdo rje'i rig ⑦pa mchog 'di ni rdo rje'i dpal zhes grags so/ /de las dugazhan ni rab bshad bya / /sgyu ma rdo rje sogs ming 6)can/ /rdo rje bsdams ⑩pa brtan byas la/ /g.yon pa rdo rje yang bcing bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur zhes grags pa/ /rdo rje'i rigs rnams kun la 'di/ /rdo rje rnam hunyaganyis dang yang byas/ /mtshan ma thams cad bkod ⑩pa ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya rnams su'ang ⑫dgod 8par bya/ /mdun dang rgyab gnas rab tu brkyang / /mthe bong rgan po 'dzin pa 8chos/ /oṃ gyi rnam pa spyi bor gnas/ /rdo rje shugs kyi tsorab tu gnas / /rig pa'i rgyal po'am phyag rgya chen po'i hu snatshogs tsoso/ /lag pa'i mdun nyid rab tu brkyang / /lag pa'i mdun yang hunyede bzhin du/ /lag pa gnyis kyang khu tshur gnas/ /kha las yongs su bskor ba nyid/ /rdo rje khro bo'i phyag rgya'i rmo )tshogs (skyeso/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bo legs gnas kyang / /phreng ba 'dzin pa nges ( —)rgyal nyid/ /g.yas pas nor ni sbyin pa dang / /ral gri'i phyag rgya khu tshur son/ /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /g.yas pa du gshol ni gzung ba dang / /de bzhin lag pa rab tu brkyang / /g.yas pas tso85—376

'bar ba kun du ston/ /rdo rje khu tshur rab tu 'dar①/ /pho nya chen po'i phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /bsnyems bcas kha dang mche ba rtse/ /byugs pas 'joms pa rab tu sbyor/ /lag pa bskum gyipa sbyar ba dang / /rdo rje g.yas pa 'phrog pa'o②ske/ /bran gyi phyag rgya'i ④tshogs so/ /de nas u ma la sogs pa ma mo'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya 'byung ste/ g.yon pa rdo rje bsdams pa yis/ /rtse gsum mtshan ma bcing bar byas/ /'di bcing ba yi ⑥yang dag pa'i/ /dngos grub rig pa mchog rang nyid/ /rdo rje'i )rigs rnams thams cad kyi/ /g.yon pa rdo (8rirje mchog bsrungs pa/ /cho ga ji bzhin dam tshig gi/ /phyag rgya bcing bar rab bshad bya/ /'khor lo thams cad mchog kun bsdamatho)/ /de bzhin bu yi ⑩phyag rgya dang ⑪/ /oṃ yig phyag rgya'ang de bzhin nyid/ /yi ge rna can yongs su gzung ske/ /phyag rgya mdzes pa can dang ni/ /'bar ba yongs su gzung ba nyid/ /'od zer bsdus pa kho na yang / /dbyug pa khu tshur gzung 7ba nyid/ /kha las yongs su bskor ba dang / /khro bo'i dam tshig gdengs ka yis/ /phyag rgya phreng ba rdo rje bcings/ /ming med spyi bor gnas pa nyid/ /rtsibs can dkyil 'khor bzhin du bza'/ /'od can rtsibs can dam tshig rnams/ /lag ngar bskum zhing kha phyogs dang / /rgyab nas yongs su bskor ba nyid/ /'od zer 'bar ba grol ba dang / /mdun du dul bar gnas pa nyid/ /pho nya'i nyusnyedam tshig rnams so/ /gnyis mthar zhugs 8pa rtse mo sbyar/ /bcings pa nyid dang rab ltung 7byed/ /lag ngar bsnol dang ma bsnol dang / /de bzhin stobs ni 'phrog pa'o/ /bran mo rnams kyi dam tshig yin no/ /de nas lha chen po la sogs pa'i ljags rnams la sngags bkod la yi ge a las rang gi snying gar tshede bzhin du 85—377

rdo rje bskyed la de rnams kyi phyag rgya bcings te las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying gar 3)rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgoms la (kyephyag rgya chen po bri bya'i rjes su 'brangs te bcing bar (gebya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang /bskal pa bzang po pa ri nodang phyi rol rdo rje'i rigs rnams la rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur ma dpal rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad la sogs sangs rgyas lnga'i cod (snyepan dang phreng ba dang / dar dpyangs kyi 96)dbang bskur bas dbang bskur rodzin/ /de nas mchod yon phul la mchod pa (8༄bya'o/ /de nas rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa sngar tshoterabashad pa'i mtshan nyid can rdo rje la sogs rang gi mtshan mas mtshan pa bornam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa rnams phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du dgod par bya'o/ /bum pa gang ba rnams dang ske/ gos zung 'bum dang / stong phrag bcu dang / stong dang / brgya'am/re re la re re'am/ thun mong ba'am/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bla re dang /zur bzhir rnam par bkra ba'i ba dan bcings pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ske/ ba dan rnams kyang yi ge oṃ dang / dpal rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad yongs su bzlas la/ badzra spha ra ṇa 31kho 12zhes pa 'dis lha thams cad la nges par dbul lo / /me tog gi nya shing brgya dang / bzhi'am sngon shing rnams dang me tog thams cad la rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / oṃ badzra saspre ci// zhes pas me tog gi (15phyag rgya mngon par bsngags so15/ /dri thams cad dang / ngad zhim pa 17rnams dang / dri ma med pa'i dri bzang po rnams la de kho na bzhin du rdo rje me dang ske/ oṃ badzra gadhe rgyu12/ zhes pa 'di dri'i nya phyag rgya dang bcas pa yis so/ /ga bur dang / a ka 3 ru dang / du ruska 31dang / tsandan la sogs pa da legs 85wa 378

par bsres la/ de kho na bzhin du rdo rje me dang / oṃ badzra dhū (1)pe hūm̐/ zhes pa 'dis bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spos 2)phor 'bum dang / stong phrag bcu dang stong dang brgya'am rdzo/ ji ltar rnyed pa tshosala'o/ /sgron ma 'bum dang /stong phrag bcu dang / stong dang / brgya'am/ sgron ma thams cad sgron ma'i sdong bu 'bar ba dang ldan pa'i kong 5bu stong dang / bcu'am bcu gcig la de kho na bzhin du 6)rdo rje me dang / oṃ badzra ā lo ke rgyu zhes pa 'di mar me'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas yongs su bzlas la/ oṃ spha ra ṇa ridzodakho zhes pa brjod cing dbul bar bya'o/ /gtor ma'i nye bar spyod pa 'bum dang / stong phrag bcu dang /stong dang / brgya'am/ bcu'i grangs sam/ bkra shis can dang por bya ste/rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bza' ba rnams la de bzhin du rdo rje me yongs su bzlas te/a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa mā bya nutpanda natāta zhes pa brjod cing dbul bar bya'o/ /rol mo bcu dang / brgya dang / stong dang / stong phrag bcu dang / rol mo 'bum dang gang 9 yang rung ba la yi ge rtsu dang / rol mo'i phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur dag gi lag pa'i sor 〉mo rnams kyis rol mo'i stang stabs rnam pa bcu bzhi 'di lta ste/ pi bang dang / gling bu dang / rnga mu ra dza 11dang / rnga mu kunda 12dang /'khar rnga dang / rnga bhi ri dang / rnga pa ṭa 1 ha khudang / rnga kun dzā 15dang /rnga ti mi la yi stang stabs so/ /rol mo dang / zlos gar dang / gar dang /rna rgyan dang / cod pan la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang yi ge oṃ gyis mngon par bsngags te'o/ /de bzhin du dar dpyangs 'phyang bar bya zhing me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab kyis 17rnam par brgyan 1 pa dang / dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas spras pa dang / zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes pa dang / rta dang glang po che 85—379

dang ske/ ba lang ①dang / shing rta rnams 'bul te/ brtags pa dang bcas pa yang ngo / /rta babs nyams dga' ba'i dril bu dang / bcas pa rnams kyang badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ ②zhes pa 'dis so/ /oṃ badzra sa twa su si gra hā ta dang ②/badzra ratna ma nutta ④ro/ badzra dharma gā (geya niḥyi/ badzra kurma ka rotta be ⑦zhes brjod cing gar byas la/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa nibargyad ⑨po rnams kyis khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis dang ldan pa'i ⑩las kyi phyag rgya rnams kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/mdzub mo hu)gnyis rab tu brkyang ba khro bo'i hu)khu tshur gnyis yin no/ /slar rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du bshad pa'i las kyi phyag rgya bcu drug pa rnams kyis kyang legs par mchod la/ khro bo'i rigs thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/sems can thams cad kyi don du dngos grub thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi mchod pa dbul te/ sgrub 3/pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du bzhag la/ /'bras yos bcas shing til dang bcas/ /chu bcas zas bcas me tog bcas/ /sran chan bcas shing snum khur la④/ /sogs pa'i bza' ba (6rnams la ni/ /yang a kā 0ro mu khaṃ zhes pa la sogs bzlas nas shar phyogs kyi cha nas brtsams te gsum gsum gtor nyunyebar byas te/dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pho pa dang / mar me dang / mchod yon rnams kyang thog ma dang tha mar dbul bar bya'o/ /de la dang po re zhig ⑩maṇḍal rnams byed du gzhug 2 )par bya'o/ /de nas spyan drang ngo / /de nas dam tshig bstan no/ /de nas mchod yon yang phul te dri la sogs pas rngo nyalegs par mchod la/ gtor ma dbul lo/ /de nas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de la sngags ( rnyi85—380

dang phyag rgya ni ①'di yin te/ shar phyogs su kha bltas te g.yas brkyang (migi gom pas 'dug cing / lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje bstan la/ g.yas pa dku'i (miphyogs su bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyus spyan drang ngo / /de'i mdzub mo lcags kyu dang bral ba ni brgya byin gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon libarkyang gi gom pas 'dug la spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas de'i sngags ni/ na mo ⑤badzra su di (6)shi di shi badzra pā ṇi tso)rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ me'i phyogs su bltas te lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo skum po'i rnam par bkug ste gung mo bsgreng (8)ba'i tshigs gsum skyupar btsugs la mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa ni me lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mthe bong mdzub mo'i gzhogs tshil bstan pa ni me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid lag pa'i dbus su mngon du phyogs te / gcig tu sbyar ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags ni asna (steye hi e hye hi ka pi phortel dzwa la dzwa 3nyel da 3steha da (steha shi khi to li 9/9bi rū rtso tshopākṣa swā hā/ gshin rjer bltas te lag pa mdun du phyogs par byas la nang du rdo rje bsdams pa'i dbus su mthe bong gnyis dang phyi ru ming med gnyis sbyar zhing bsgreng 8ste slar nang du bzung hu ba ni gshin rje spyan drang ba'i ( ze phyag rgya'o/ /srin lag gnyis yang phyi rol du gshibs du nyete bsgreng ba 32snying gar bzung 0ba ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las srin lag sbyar ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o / /de'i sngags ni ya mā geya swā hā/ bden bral du bltas te mnyam pa'i gom pas 'dug la lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs sogepa mdzub mo dang gung mo bkug ste bzung zhing dri'i 39rnam par bzhag la/ lag pa g.yon pa sta zur tsho tsho85—381

phyogs su g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bkug nas gzhag pa ni bden bral spyan drang ba'i ①phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid lag pa g.yon pa sta (gezur phyogs ①su gnas par ral gri'i phyag rgya ni bden bral gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags ni sarba bhū bta bha (5 yi ka ra 6 ku ru ku ru swā hā/ chu (7)lha'i phyogs su mnyam pa'i gom pas 'dug la lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs nas mthe bong dang mdzub mo gcig tu sbyar te g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar chos)bzhag la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyus spyan drang ba ni chu bdag spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o⑨/ /phyag rgya de nyid g.yon pa'i mdzub mo khu tshur la sbyar te bzung ba zhags pa'i phyag rgya chu bdag gi khudam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i hu)phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags ni tre tre phu ṭa tre tro 12shi khi to li 1 bi rū 1 pākṣa swā hā/ rlung lha'i phyogs su bltas te 'dug pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs te gung mo bsgreng kyilhaba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo bkug pa'i rtse mo btsugs la mngon du phyogs te brkyang ngo / /lag ⑩pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du byas te sta zur logs su bzhag cing mthe bos bskul ba ni rlung lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid mthe bong snga ma bzhin du bzhag pa ni rlung lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mthe bong brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ swā sa khā kha kha 3 rmekha swā hā/ ku be ra la mngon du bltas te 'dug nas lag pa gnyis kha sbyar la rdo rje bcing ba nang du byas la mthe chung gnyis gshibs 12te brkyang / de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis so sor bzhag nas gung mo dag bsgreng nyu)ba rdo rje'i mdud 3 )pa bya ba ni ku 85—382

be ra spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid kyis lho)gung mo gnyis nang du rdo rje gung mo bcing ②ba'i sbyor bas gzhag pa ni ku be ra'i (khudam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o / /de'i sngags ni oṃ ku be rā ya chosaswā hā/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bltas te 'dug la lag pa dag gcig tu sbyar te thal mo sbyar ba bya ste srin lag dang mthe'u chung lag mthil ⑤du rdo rje bcing ba byas te mthe bo zung dag gzhan la brten cing nang du bkug ste bsnol la gung mo gshibs te bsgreng 97ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rnam par gzhag la de nyid bkug ste steng du phan tshun sen mo sprad par bya ba ni dbang ldan spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid kyi mdzub mo sngar bzhin rdo rje'i rnam par bzung dumerab ni dbang ldan gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang (8)ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang 99)ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni rdzu rdzu shi ba swā hā/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas 'dug rngul lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar te bzhag la steng du bltas te mdzub mo gnyis kyi lcags kyu ni tshangs pa la sogs pa spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid kyi mdzub mo gnyis snga ma ltar gzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams kyi sngags ni oṃ u: 17brahma ṇi 512su hā/ srurya gra hā 1 dhi pa ta 7ye swā hā/oṃ tsand+ra nakṣa tā dhi pa ta ye chogeswā hā/ mnyam pa'i gom pa'i gnas pas 'dug la lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar tshab ste 1 sor mo'i rtse mo rnams 1stebar mtshams med par phan tshun sbyar te/ mthe bong skum po byas la 'og tu bltas te sa'i lha mo la sogs pa mdzub 17mo lcags kyus spyan drang ba ni 'og gi lha mo na spyan drang ba'i phyag 85wa 383

rgya'o / /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las sngar ①bzhin du mdzub mo dag gzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o②/ /mdzub mo dag brkyang ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags rnams ni a rnyo mṛ thi byi niswā hā/ a su re ༷bhyaḥduswā hāX/nā ge bhyaḥphyag hā/ de nas rang gi sngags kyis thams cad la 'thor ⑧'thung phul ⑨la / bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa la bgegs med par mdzod cig /las kyi dngos grub kyang bdag la stsol ⑩cig ces brjod la/ thams cad gshegs su gsol lotum/ /yang na dpung bzang gi 0ched du gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis gtor ma dbul te/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye ⑫grul / /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang ④lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang su sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mamo sa stengs ⑩'dir btsugs 1 nas/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed tsol gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags 19slad du 'dir spyon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim gnas dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo tsho rtakun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gnas pa dang rka/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng rdu nyeka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can dang khron par gnas/ /gong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dang ni lha yi khang par yang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas dag dang ske/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang 3chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor tsokhang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang / /85—384

gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang ske/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan 1)gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang ske/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gang gnas rnams/ /dgyes shing mgu bas phreng ba byug ②pa dri/ /bdug pa gtor ma mar me bstod pa 'dis/ /gus 'bul snoms mdzod gsol mdzod 'thung mdzod cig /las 'di rnams kyi ⑧'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de ltar gdon la mchod pa ④byas nas ni⑤/ /rtse gcig yid kyis phyogs skyong mchod par bya(6)/ /dbang po rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma khyad 'phags 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i )dbadag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi shun klu rnams dang (pe/ /ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus rnams/ /dpung bcas sde bcas bu dang bshes gnyen bcas / /rang gi skye bo'i tshogs shing mnyes pa rnams/ /so sor so so'i thugs dgongs gcig mdzad nas/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par byon nas ni/ /rang gi bu smad tsomadza' bshes 11gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig 8tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa mar me dang / /zhal zas gtor ma 'di dag bzhes nas kyang / /gsol mdzod snoms mdzod legs par 'thung tsomadzod cig /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de la 'di ni phyi dang nang thams cad du gtor ma rab tu dbul ba'i sngags te/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ḍā mā rya nutpanda /7tāta zhes pa'o/ /de nas nye reg bya ste shar 85—385

sgor mngon par phyogs te gnas pa la/ las thams cad pa'i thab 0)khung gi dbus su dpal 'jig rten gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi sngags brjod cing me tog dmar pos /kyenges par bkod la sbyin sreg gi tshogs dpal rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi sngags kyis ba'i mar gyis sreg ②blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul lo/ /dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags nas ④rdo rje 'bebs pa khro bo'i mthar thug par kyang sreg rirablugs bdun bdun slar yang ngo / /de nas ji lta ba bzhin du thab khung gi rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rnams me tog kho nas spyan drangs la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang gi gnas su dgod (rmedo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la bdag ming che ge (7༄zhes bgyi ba'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug 995par bgyi/ /'dir yang dkyil 'khor chen por 7'jug pa la snod dang snod ma yin pa brtag par mi bya ste/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sems can kha cig ni sdig pa chen po bgyid pa de rdo rje tsū mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di mthong ste zhugs nas ngan song thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor dang bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la chags pa dang / dam tshig la mi 'da' ba dang / sngags 11 spyod pa 12la sogs pa 'dod cing mi nus pa'i sems can dag mchis te/ de dag kyang 'dir ji ltar bya bar 'dod pa bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa rnams kyi 1dbasam pa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can kha cig ni gar dang / glu dang / gad mo dang / rtsed 1 mo 85—386

dang ske/ kha zas la spyod pa la dga' ba nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po chos nyid khong du ma chud pas lha'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor gzhan du 'jug par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin du rigs 1)thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor re ba thams cad yang dag par rdzogs par 'gyur ba bla na med pa'i dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rangs pa rnams 'byung bar tsho rimadzad pa der ni bslab tsho)pa'i gnas la 'jigs shing skrag nas mi 'jug pa dag kyang mchis te/ngan song gi dkyil 'khor gyi lam du ji ltar gnas pa'i bde ba'i bdag ④nyid kyi gnas skabs can de dag kyang dga' ba dang / mgu ba dam pa dang (5// bde ba dang / yid bde ba myong bar bgyi ba dang / ngan song gi rgyud thams cad du 'jug par kha bltas pa'i lam las bzlog 6par bgyi ba'i slad du rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug tu (7rung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das chos ldan gyi sems can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab dam pa tshonara'agrub pa'i thabs kyis 9)sangs rgyas kyi 7byang chub 'tshol 3lheb na / bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa la sogs pa dang / sa rnams la 'bad pas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba dag kyang mchis te/ de dag kyang rdo rje nyurterghaṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du zhugs ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa nyid thams cad kyang rnyed par dka' 1 ba yang ma lags 1 na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci 'tshal zhes gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya stenyuge/de la bslab 9pa'i gzhi 51 lnga yongs su bzung ba'i dge bsnyen 13nam/ dge slong ngam (17dge slong gi sdom pa yongs su gzung 5 )zhing slob dpon du dbang bskur bar 'os pa/ slob dpon gyi zhabs dag la phyag byas te/ 'di skad ces brjod de/85—387

bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la 46pa/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa'o / /de nas slob ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas pa'i gos dmar po'i ༅stod g.yogs ②smad g.yogs dang / rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sgo skyong bzhi bzlas pa'i gdong g.yogs bcing bar byas la phyag bzhi byed du gzhug ①go/ /yang 5gelag na me tog thogs ⑤pa'i slob mas slob dpon la phyag byas la lag na me tog thogs pa nyid kyis bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba medang / bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa byas la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /thub pa (7nyi ma ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs / /bdag ming che ge zhes bgyi ba/ /slob dudapon dbang du gnas pa la / /sangs rgyas rol mo 'byung ba yi/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun can/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi'o/ /gsang ba thams cad rigs bsdus pa/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug ⑨mdzodam/ /phyir mi ldog 1 )pa'i dbang bskur ba/ / skal ba 7chen po bdag la stsolaske/ /mtshan rnams rjes su gsol btab pa/ /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan / /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che/ge/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyurahū/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyi rigs thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ che ge mo zhes bya tshe'adi nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /gsang ba yis 85—388

ni 'khor lo 'dir/ /'jug cing byang chub sdom pa 'tshal/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ①'di skad ces brjod do/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa brtan por gyur/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang (mi/ /blo gros chen po khyod kyis zung (kye/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyisago/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs / /rin chen rigs ni bsdus pa ni/ /nyin mo gsum dang mtshan mo gsum / /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam ⑤bzhi rab sbyin bya/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung ⑥bar bya/ /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs༅/ /las chen rigs ni bsdus ⑧pa la/ /sdom 59)pa gsum po yang dag ldan/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bzhin/ /yang dag nyid du nges gzung 7gyis/ /de las gzhan pa bzhi po yang / /'di dag phas pham par ni bshad/ /mi spang hunyedor bar yang mi bya/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'di bshad do/ /nyin mo gsum dang mtshan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni brjod par bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /ltung ba sbom po dag tu 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog 1gechags gsad tsomi bya/ /ma byin par ④yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi spyad 8cing / /brdzun yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi sartsa ba yi/ /chang ni btung 1 ba rnam par spang ske/ /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs pa32/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang ske/ /dam pa'i drung du gnas bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur (1985wa 389

bya / /lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus pas hu)ni rjes su bskyang ②/ /theg pa dman la dga' mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa / /khyed (7kyis brnyas pa ④mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom (depa shiyang mi bya/ /'di dag dam tshig zhes stibashad do/ /de dag ni/ /blo gros khyed kyis bsrung bar bya/ /des kyang 'di skad brjod par bya//slob dpon khyod ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bo ji ltar bka' bsgo ba/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /zhes pa nas sems can mya ngan me'adas la dgod 7ces bya ba'i bar du brjod par bya'o/ /gang zhig sdom pa mi 'dzin pa de la ni gzhug ⑩pa tsam sbyin par bya zhing deng khyod bya ba la sogs pa brjod par mi bya ste/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba yang mi bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba yo ga tsi ta mund+ra da yā '-imi zhes pa 'dis/ byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi12/ /de yi snying gar ho:snying pos ni/ /rdo rje rab tu gzhag par bya/ /su ra ta sa ma ya st+waṃ mahoḥbadzra sirnyi 512ya thā tshesu khaṃ zhes pa 'dis so/ /de nas rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad du byin gyis brlabs la dri dang me tog la sogs pas mchod de me tog gi phreng ba gdags 7shing / gdong dri zhim pos byugs la yon gyi mchog bzung 'o ste / phyi rol na gnas pa la bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/ oṃ groṇḍa tsobadzra sa ma ya hūṃ baṃ zhes pa 'dis khro bo ti rirnyi ri ( — )rang nyid bcings la slob ma 'ching ( —1du gzhug go/ /rdo rje bsdams pa nang byas la/ /mthe bong rdo rje dam po geyis/ /85wa 390

yid kyi khro bas 0)dga' bya bas95)/ /khro bo ti rirnyi ri ci dran/ /de nas de nyid kyi (4༄mthe bong dag gis 5)me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug la snying po 'dis gzhug (6par bya ste/ badzra sa ma yaṃ pra ti byā mi zhes pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor yang rdo rje lcags kyus de dgug cing lhor zhags pas gzhug go/ /nub tu lcags sgrog gis bcing zhing ske/ byang du rdo rje 'bebs pas dbab bo/ /yang shar gyi sgo nas de bzhin du bcug la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rigs kyis deng tsho)rinas ngas khyod la rdo rje'i nas ye shes bskyed par bya'i(9)/ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan 1rtarnams lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun 11du smra bar mi bya'o/ /khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur /geta re/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid khro bo ti rirnyi ri 12kha gyen du blta beb dang bcas pas bcings la/ rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste ma'adi skad ces smras te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje yin te/ gal te khyed 'ga' zhig la smras na spyi bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid dang / mna'i snying po lan cig 17bzlas pa'i chu rdo rje slob ma de 'thung 1 du gzhug go/ /de la 1 mna'i snying po 'di yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod hu)kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzod/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs / /badzra utpa ṭhaḥ21zhes bya'o/ /de nas slob ma la 'di skad ces smra'o lha/ /deng nas brtsams nas khyod kyi na/phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis ske/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ / khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig gi /khyod ya nga ba 2tshom spangs par tshe'i dus 2 ribyas nas 85wa 391

dmyal bar cing bar 'gyur ①rta re zhes pa'o/ /de'i ②rjes la rang gi snying gar ②yi ge a rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de nas slob ma'i snying ga ④dang / mdzod spu dang / mgrin ⑤pa dang / spyi bo rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'bar ba dang / rin po che dang /padma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje ⑥bsams ⑦te/ hūṃ ṭwāṃ hrīḥdusaḥzhes pa 'di dag gi go rims bzhin du'o/ /sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgyas stirang dang slob ma'i snying gar 0phye la rang gi snying gar 0yi ge yo las yi 8ge phyung la slob ma'i snying gar 8gnas pa'i rdo rje budabus su blos bcug la lus thams cad gang bar bsam mo/ /'di skad ces brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis rlobs la/rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab 8tu gsol zhes smos ⑩shig⑩ /de nas myur du rdo rje slob dpon gyis khro bo ti rirnyi ri bcings 8la 'di skad ⑩brjod par bya ste/'di de dam tshig rdo rje yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 0zhes byar grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /khyod la de nyid 'bab gyur cig /badzra ā be sha āḥ0zhes pa bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu sornyedang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang /drug cu du snyedang / bdun cu 3chedang / brgyad cu du snyedang / dgu bcu dang / lan brgyar brjod de nges par 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje'i khu tshur bcings la sems ma du 9rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya dral bar bya zhing 'di dag brjod de/oṃ sumbha ni sumbha bla phos/ groṇḍi groṇḍa hūṃ/ gros pa ya gro: 3pa ya hūṃ/ ā 0na ya ho bha ga bān zhu badzra bibyā rā mdza du rgyu phaṭa/ aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ/ bcu dang / nyi shu dang ske/ sum cu gi dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang / drug cu chadang /bdun cu chadang / brgyad cu zhukhudang / dgu bcu dang / lan brgyar brjod 85wa 392

par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdo rje rlung gi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje rtsu gi rnam pa'i 'od zer gyi mdog dmar po 'bar ba ①gang bzhin par bsam mo /slar yang gal te 'bab par ma gyur na/ de'i tshe dril bu dang bcas pas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la rkang (2)pa g.yon pas de'i rkang pa mnan la steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi steng du de nyid la dbab pa'i phyir khro bo hūṃ gi rnam ②pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis mnan bzhin pa dang / 'og nas kyang rdo rje rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang /rgyu gi durnam pas brdeg bzhin pa dang / de bzhin du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su bzhugs pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa (snyernams kyis hūṃ ṭwāṃ hrīḥ(6)aḥzhes bya ba rang gi sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis yang dag par 'bebs par mdzad par bsam zhing de la dbab ste/ hūm̐ badzra ā chabe sha ya aḥzhes rnam pa brgyar brjod par bya'o/ /gal te sdig pa mang ba nyid kyis 'bab par ma gyur na de'i tshe sdig (8)pa dral spuba'i phyag rgyas de'i sdig pa rnams yang dang yang du dral 0bar bya'o/ /yam shing 'jag ma rnams kyi 43me/ /rab 'bar rdo rje khro bo yi/ /mnyam par bzhag pas dbul ba yis8/ /de yi sdig pa thams cad ni/ /til gyi sbyin sreg hurtedes nges bsregaphonye /oṃ sarba pā paṃ nyusnyed ha na badzā hu9ya swā hā zhes bya ba dang /lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil 0du til nag po las sdig pa'i gzugs brnyan 8byas la/yi ge rghaṃ dbus su bsams ༅te/ mdzub mo dang mthe bong dag gis sbyin sreg ༷ — )bya'o / /de nas sbyin sreg gi thab khung las 'byung ba'i 'bar ba'i phreng ba kun du 'khrugs pa'i rdo rje rnams kyis de'i lus kyi nyesdig pa sreg py-i 3bzhin par bsams la de nas yang rdo rje babs pa de kho na bzhin du bcings la dbab par bya ste/ nges 85wa 393

par 'bebs par 'gyur/ de lta bus kyang gang la bab par ma gyur pa de la dbang bskur 3)bar mi bya'o/ /babs na skad cig ma de nyid de'i mngon par shes pa (55lnga la sogs pa rdzogs tsho par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang dag par babs par shes nas yang oṃ badzra sa twa su si gra hā ta ④zhes pa la sogs pa'i glu brjod la/khro bo'i khu tshur dang de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dral bar bya'o/ /de phebs na rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /de'i dzubatshe slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur khro bo'i phyag rgyas bcing bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du ji srid du gyur na de'i tshe rdo rje bzhad pa'i phyag rgya (6rabacing ngo / /de'i metshe rdo brje chos khro bo'i phyag rgya bcing ngo / /de lta bus nye bar byon cing dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i lce la rdo rje bsams la bru klanagyi badzra zhes pa brjod do/ /de nas thams cad smra bar 'gyur/ de nas phreng ba de dkyil 'khor chen por dor te/pra tītstsha hu )hoḥzhes bya'o/ /de nas gang du babs pa de 'dis 'grub bo/ /de nas oṃ pra ti groṇḍa nyu7rta i mi satwa 12ma hā ri12ba la zhes bya ④bas phreng ba de nyid kyi mgo bor bcing ngo / /de nas/ oṃ de skoring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi ⑩mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad mig ni bye bar 'gyur/ /te 1 badzra bā nya bya nya zhes pa 'dis gdong g.yogs 2 )dgrol lo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje lcags kyu nas brtsams te ji srid rnam par snang mdzad kyi mthar thug par bstan no/ /de nas tiṣṭha badzra zhes pa la sogs pas slob ma masnying gar 22gzhug pa'i phyag rgya dgrol lo/ /de nas phyi rol gyi tsustedakyil 'khor du'am/ phyi rol du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar sgo la mngon par phyogs pa legs par bris la slob ma dpal rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi phyag rgya sems ma rdo rje ma la 85wa 394

sogs pas kyang byin gyis brlabs 3)la/ phyag rgya chen po de la bzhag ste dbang bskur ro/ /dri dang me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ mchod yon dbul/gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dang / dung dang rol mo la sogs pa'i sgra bsgrag ②pa dang / de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams kyis mngon par dga' bas dang po re zhig /kyechu'i dbang bskur ba dang / cod pan dang / dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje dang / bdag po dang / ming gis dbang bskur ba dag gis dbang bskur la yang me tog la sogs pa dang sgeg mo la sogs pa ④mchod pa rnam pa brgyad kyis mchod do/ /slob ma rnams kyis 5rdo rje thal mo sbyar bas slob dpon la rab tu btud la yon gyi mchog phul la me tog la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba yang gzung bar bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba ni dpal rdo rje rgyu mdzad kyi phyag rgyas de kho na bzhin du ji ltar nges par bstan pa'i gnas su bzhag la de tshig gi phyag rgya rnams kyis de'i lus la dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad la sogs pa bkod de slar yang / oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi dṛ yisto me bha ba dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ: phaṭa zhes pa 'di 75rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la brgya rtsa brgyad dam stong yongs su bzlas pa byas la/ de nas oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa (87zhes pa 'di brjod cing rdo rje khu tshur gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa nas chu blangs la lichu'i dbang bskur ba byin no/ /'di yang brjod de/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs 1 na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chus 'grub bo/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang —/ /dkyil 'khor can min na mi smra/ /skye bo 'dus pa gnas pa ni/ /dgod 51nyedang ma dad pa la min/ /de nas cho ga thams cad nyams su blangs la 85wa 395

mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas legs par bstod ①de tshigs bcad lngas rjes su gnang ba ②byin nas gzengs ①bstod pa dang lung bstan pas slob ma duthams cad lung bstan no/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba 'byung ste/ slob dpon du dbang bskur bar 'os pa dkyil 'khor thams cad du bcug pa de ltar mdzod cig ces bya'o/ /'di yi las kyi dngos grub ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyang / /tha ma 'bring dang mchog rnams ni/ /ma lus nges par 'thob rjopar 'gyur/ /mchog gi sa rnams 6)bgegs med 'grub/ /dngos grub phran ⑦tshegs (0slar ci zhig /sangs rgyas nyid kyang sems can nyid/ /rdo rje sems nyid rnyed mi dka'(pe/ /gang la dngos grub nges 'byung dang / /gang la sdig pa gdon chen dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams dang yang / /'chi bdag dang ni bdud sde ⑩rnams/ /'jigs pa sna tshogs bstan bcos 0rdo/ /dngos grub las 'joms de dag ni/ /bdag nyid 8chen po 0de la ni/ /mi 'byung skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg bulas kyi cho ga yis/ /nges par dngos grub myur rab 'byung / /lha rnams kyang ni cher mnyes shing / /skad cig gis kyang rab rnyed 8'gyur/ /yams dang nyer 'tshe skyon la 0sogs/ /ches lci nges par ring du 'gyurahurte/ /de yi yul du nad dang gdon/ /rims la 0sogs pa mi 'byung zhing ske/ /mu ge ca co che rnams dang / /pha rol dmag tshogs nyams par 'gyur/ /lha dang klu rnams spro chen gyis/ /bde bar yang ni skyong bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba rgyu skar bcas/ /gnod sbyin rnams dang gza' la sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams kyis skyong / /de nas brgya byin la sogs lhas/ /yang dang yang nyanyedu phyag btsal zhu nas/ /rin chen 85—396

rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i rnyog ma 'joms pa po/ /dus kyi g.yo ba gcod pa'i mchog /zhal ni ljags kyi glog 'phro ma0)/ /rdo rje me ste rab tu gtum / /gtum pa'i rab snang 'joms pa po/ /nyi ma stong gi 'od zer zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ /khro bo du ma'i 'od 'phro ba/ /phyag ni du ma'i mtshon cha brgyasas/ /du ma'i zhal te sku yang stong / /'khyil zhing ②sku yang 'khyil pa lags/ /thugs chos bdag nyid sku mi mnga'/ /rnam par rtog (gepa ma lus spangs/ /ma rig 'joms pa tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang dri mthar mdzad/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ /mdung can rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog byed/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong tshogeb/ /zhi zhing dul la dag pa che/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs mdzad / /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /rdo rje legs skyes rdo rje sems / /kun du bzang po cher bzang ba/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis 3nyematshan pa po / /khams kun bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje'i tsobadag nyid gtsang rin/ /gang gis 'di bris klog pa dang / /rtag tu don ni 'chang byed dam//dran nam nyan par byed kyang rung / /phyag na rdo rje mnyam par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa phan pa dang bde ba thob pa'i (pephyir bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o⑩/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi 11rgyal po'i brtag 12pa phyogs gcig pa rdzogs 85—398

༄ga /dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/91)༄༅bha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī pa ra mā di ṭanā ma ma hā yā na kulpa rā dzā /bod skad du/ dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig nan/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs nadang / dam tshig dang mkhyen pa'i bye brag rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (6)rin po che thams cad kyi cod pan gyis khams gsum du dbang bskur 97rib brnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor can chen po'i dbang phyug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa sna tshogs kyi bya ba mdzad de/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi 85wa 447

re ba thams cad yongs su skong (1)ba'i phrin posalas mdzad pa thugs rje che ba/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po rtag pa/ dus gsum gyi mnyam pa nyid la bzhugs pa/sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs shing / bsngags pa/ bstod pa/ nor bu chen po dang / rin po ches spras pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dril bu btags (bapa/ dar gyi ba dan dang me tog gi phreng ba dang rnga ma dang dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod ④pa rnams kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa'i 'dod pa'i khams thams cad kyi gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i rgyal po'i gnas na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad dunadang / thabs cig 6tu bzhugs pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' lnga chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khu tshur dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam (8)dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 0chen po nam mkha'i mdzod dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba phrag brgyad dang thabs cig boste/ yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston te/thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig ⑪'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/85—448

yongs su byang ba①/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa'i sgo zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di yang dag par ston te/ 'di ltar rab tu dga' ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /'dod chags kyi mda' rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /reg pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /sdug pa'i 'ching ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /thams cad la dbang phyug dang dbang rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /lta ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /dga' ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /sred pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /bsnyems rdzogepa rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /rgyan rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas sol/ /yid tshim par byed pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /snang ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /lus bde ba zhi)rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /gzugs rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /sgra rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /dri rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /ro rnam 85—449

par dag pa'i gnas de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa ste/chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /badzra hūṃ/ lag na rdo rje su la tshilas chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa'i gnas bsgrub (gepa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di lan cig thos na 9gyiyang / de byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad ④chod pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib ⑤pa dang / chos kyi sgrib (6)pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa chen po bsags kyang / sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan song rnams su nam yang (7)skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa yang byas ma thag tu sdug bsngal med par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig 'dzin pa'am nyin re bzhin tshanaraklog pa dang / kha ton du 99ri byed pa dang / tshul bzhin 0yid la byed pa de tshe 'di nyid la chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin thob nyu1pas chos thams cad la dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad la dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos 32bcu drug gis de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad pa/ rdo rje dbyings mtha' dag gis sems pa'i 12mchog /khams gsum po mtha' dag na 'jig rten gsum po ma lus pa las rnam par rgyal ba/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa 'dul 1 bar spyod pa/ don thams cad grub pa/ lag na rdo rje mtha' yas pa 85wa 450

thams cad pa ①dam tshig chen po pa/ rdo rje gsang ba'i sems can chen po du mas g.yog byas pa de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi don 'di ston te②ske/ bzhin rab tu 'dzum zhing lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje bsgyings (mite thog ma'i rdo rje chen po gsor nas rang gi snying gar stod ④pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba rang gi de kho na nyid kyi snying po 'di smras so/ /rgyu/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi khams gsum ⑤thams cad nas (6 rjes su mnyes pa brtan pos (7rimanyes par byas te bkug nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste/ dam tshig gis nirabacings nas dbang du byas te dngos grub thams cad grub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis bde ba chen po'i bsnyems pa'i 7phyag rgya bobacings nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas bzhugs so//de nas phyag na rdo rje gsang ba chen po rdo rje'i 11dam tshig 'byung ba dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob /)pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid rdo rje dbyings kyi 51 byin gyis brlabs pa 8chen po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /de nyid dang po nyusnyedam tshig che//rdo rje byin brlabs 0zhes bya'o/ /gru bzhir bgyi /rtezhing sgo 12bzhi dang / /khyams rnams kyis ni yongs bskor ba/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /'od zer 'bar ba hu)'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni grwa rnams dang / /sgo 85—451

khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /zla ba phyed la rab gnas pa'i/ /rin chen kun gyis nye bar mdzes/ /rtse mo sna tshogs ba dan ni/ /dril bu mchog btags rlung gis bskyod/ /me tog chun ①'phyang ②me long spras/ / phyi yi dudakyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad dang mnyam pa ru/ /rdo rje thig gis thig btab la④/ /rdo rje 'khor lo zhes byar bshad/ /de yi dbus su ci rigs par/ /sangs rgyas sku ni gzhag ⑤bya ste/ /'dzum bcas zla ba'i mdog can la/ /rdo rje bsnyems pa du'adzin pa'i mchog /rdo rje phreng sogs ⑦kyis spras shing / /sna tshogs 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /padma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /lugs ma'am mngon par 'dus byas pa'o/ /rang gi snying po kun bzlas te/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /rdo rje sems sogs ⑧sems dpa' rnams/ /snying po nyid kyis yang dag dgod/ /rdo rje shugs kyis rgal spunas ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag bsdus/ /gzhag gam yang na bri bar bya/ /tshogs ⑩rnams kun du ston pa'o/ /mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje mtshon ni gsor bar brtson / /dmar skya dag ni 7nges par dgod/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni g.yas logs su / /rdo rje tī li 8khri la ni/ /yan lag kun gyis yongs 'khyud 0pa/ /rdo rje'i gzugs can ④nyi ma'i 'od/ /rgyab tu rdo rje 'dod pa ni/ /chu srin gyi ni rgyal mtshan thogs/ /sngo 7skya'i mdog can ci rigs par/ /blo dang ldan pas gzhag par bya/ /g.yon du rdo rje bsnyems pa ni/ /bsnyems pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyis ni/ /rdo rje bsnyems pa gnyis 'dzin pa/ /btso ma'i gser dang 'dra bar ⑩dgod/ /sangs rgyas0 kyi ni mtshams 8rnams su/ /me tog la sogs kyis mtshan cing / /85—452

thal mo spyi bor legs 'jog pa'i/ /mchod pa chen po gzhag par bya/ / phyi yi hu)dkyil 'khor mtshams (gyirnams su/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams dgod ①par bya/ /sgo yi dbus ni thams cad du/ /gzugs mtshan la sogs bsdus pa dgod/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor can brgyad ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs ④gri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin gyis bskor/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor gnas rnams su/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug bri bya ste/ /mdun du 'jig rten gsum rgyal pozhu)/ /'dod pa'i (yitshangs pa zhi byed mchog /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'jug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa la'abyung ste/de la dang po nyid du ci 3)skad (9)bshad pa'i cho ga 'dir zhugs pa'i slob dpon ni/ rdo rje chen po'i slob dpon dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi slob dpon dang ske/ dam tshig thams cad shes pa dang / chos thams cad rig pa dang /las thams cad sgrub ⑩pa dang / dngos grub thams cad grub pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas nyu)byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dbang bskur ba thams cad thob pa dang / thams cad shes pa dang ldan pa dang / mchod pa thams cad dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'di'i dbang du 'gyur ba dang / 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / 'di'i phyag rgya thams cad kyang rang nyid kyis bcings pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig thams cad kyi lam la nyes nya pa dang bcas kyang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing /byin gyis brlab hu par rtog par 'gyur ro/ /ma bslabs nyu0par yang thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad rdzoge'agrub par 'gyur ro/ /mdor bsdus na tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub kyi mchog ci 7ltar 85—453

mngon par 'dod pa de lta bur sangs rgyas nyid dam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid 'thob hu)par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 'di'i snying la bzhugs shing don yod pa'i phyir bkug cing dam tshig gis bcings la dbang du byas te/ rjes su mnyes pas bdag nyid slob dpon du gyur nas 'jug cing bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur rol/ /de nas rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings la/ dang po'i rdo rje'i lta ④bas bltas te ④snying po lan cig dubarjod nas dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rnam par sgeg pa'i phyag rgyas bzlas brjod lan cig ⑥byas la phyag byas nas gos dmar po gyon la/me tog gi phreng ba thogs te gdong dris byugs (3)pa dang rdo rje thal mos rdo rje'i ⑧gar byed cing skor (pebs snying gar 7me tog thogs te bdag nyid 'jug par bya'o / /zhugs nas kyang yang 3)rnam par sgeg pa dang skor 4)bas gdud cing (stesnying po yang bzlas tsobarjod bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rdo rje'i lta bas bltas te de bzhin du 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das bsgrub par bya'o8/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid la 7dgyes pas mthong ba stsol bar 'gyur zhing smin ma bskyod la sku thams cad dam yan lag rnams bskyod cing kha dog dmar por 'gyur ro/ /'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyi zhal lam/ sku thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa yang ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid mthong ba stsol ba'am dngos grub mchog kyang stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas brtsams te nyin re zhing dngos grub thams cad 'thob nyurtepar 'gyur ro/ /gang du zhugs 3 ripa tsam nyid kyis mi tshugs pa dang /mi gsod 3)par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa 85wa 454

thams cad dang / ye shes thams cad dang / bya ba thams cad bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes sgrub ①par mdzad do/ /de nas de yang dag par lamachod de rdo rje'i ①ming gis dbang bskur zhing / dpa' bo'i rdo rje ④bcom ldan 'das la mnos la/ snying po bzlas na ⑤bcom ldan 'das mthong ba stsal nas/ rang nyid kyis stsol cig ces brjod ⑥la rang gis blang bar bya'o/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la dngos grub mchog yid la 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang na bdag nyid kyis zla ba drug gis yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje ⑦ming gi dbang bskur ba la sogs pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa yang ②byas nas yang ji ༅ltar 'dod pa'i cho gas bsgrubs la 'byung bar bya zhing dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang ba bsgrub ⑩pa lan cig ⑩bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya ste/ de la dang por rdo rje slob dpon gyis dang po'i rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas de bzhin du phyag byas la snying pos ci nyunyeltar mngon par 'dod pa'i tshig dang /bcom ldan 'das bsgrubs hunyepas phyag rgya chen pos bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bsgrubs pas mtshan ma de nyid 'byung ste tsoshes nas phyag rgya chen po nyid 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur te/zhugs pa 'dis ni rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro//de nas de bzhin du rdo rje blang ba la sogs pa byas nas/ rdo rje slob ma la cho ga rgyas pa 'di 8bzhin du byas tetshe/ phyag rgya bcing ba yang bslab par bya'o/ /gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa'i dam tshig la mos pa de 85—455

rnams la yang rang gi ②lhag pa'i lha'i 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa dang / de bzhin du yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha gzhan dag la dad pa rnams la de bzhin du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas par byas nas de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ci ②ltar zhugs pa rnams zas dang /ro bcud dang gnas pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par tshim par byas la ci ③ltar shes pa'i gar dang glu dang dgod ④pa dang bu dang bu mo dang mdza' dubashes dang nye du dang gnyen mtshams yidang bcas pas kyang mchod par bya'o/ /de la 'dir ni snod dang snod ma yin pa brtag par mi bya ste sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams bde ba chen po rdo rje'i medam tshig 'di dang /'dod pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rdo rje ⑧sbyor bas rdo rje 0chos kyi tsomanyam pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas yibatab pa yin pa'i phyir ro⑩/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'o/ /de nas cho ga 'byung ste/ zla ba nya nas brtsams nas phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings la ci snyi/ltar skyo bar ma gyur par dang po tshebyin gyis brlab 8pa la sogs pa byas la rdo rje'i ⑩tshig gis brjod cing ci hu)srid zla ba gcig 8gi bar de srid du bzlas brjod byas na sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas brtsams te 7phyag na rdo rje'i bka' ci rjo lta ba bzhin du dngos grub 8)thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ras ris 'dri ba'am 32'drir gzhug 9par 'dod na ④/ dang por rdo rje bri ba'i phyag rgyas bris la de'i 'og tu ni ci bder bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du yang de nyid kyis dang po ri ltebartsam par bya ste/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das cho ga ci ⑩lta ba bzhin du bri zhing / dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis sems dpa' chen po 85—456

brgyad bri bar bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya nas brtsams te phyag rgya chen po bcings la/de bzhin du sngon du bsnyen pa'i tshul ltar bzlas nas spyizla ba nya'i ②mtshan mo thog thag tu ci ①lta ba bzhin du skyo bar ma gyur pas phyag rgya ma bgrol bar bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas nang par bcom ldan 'das kyi byazhal 'dzum zhing zla ba dang mnyam pa'i mdangs can mthong ba stsol cing / sangs rgyas nyid dang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub mchog rnams stsol bar 'gyur ro/ / cho ga ⑤gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba dang / phyogs thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / rdo rje 'chang ༅thams cad bri bar bya'o/ /de nas ⑦de bzhin du bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas nyid la sogs pa dngos grub thams cad 'grub bo / /ras la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje bsnyems ⑧pa dang bcas pa 'bris la/ de'i spyan sngar dang po'i phyag rgya chen pos gnas nas bzlas brjod 'bum byas te⑩/ 'bum rdzogs na phyag na rdo rje nyid thob ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo gcig pu hu3bris nas yang mthar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bklags hunyepa tsam gyis 'grub pa'i las rnams dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bya ba la ni 'dod chags la sogs pa bde ba thams cad phul bas so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po mnyes par bya ba la ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'khyud ④cing 'o byed pas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rjes su mnyes par bya ba la ni dpag tu med pa'i bzlas pas so/ /rdo rje 8thams cad rjes tsos mnyes par bya ba la ni rang gi snying po bzlas pas so/ 7/ /lha la sogs pa sems 85—457

can thams cad rjes su chags ①par bya ba la ni thams cad du 'bum bzlas pas sol/ /bdag bsrung ②ba la ni yungs ①kar la lan cig ④bzlas pas so/ /gzhan bsrung ⑤ba la ni rdo rje skor dubs so/ /thams cad bsrung ⑦ba la ni yid kyis lan cig dugo/ /mtshams ⑨dang phyogs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad bcing ba la ni blta ⑩ba'am yungs 7kar la sogs pas so/ /sems can thams cad rengs par bya ba la ni dbugs mi 'byin par bzlas pas so sems can thams cad rmugs par bya ba la ni rdo rje btsir ⑩bas so/ /sems can thams cad rmongs par bya ba la ni mig btsums tsonas bzlas pas so/ /thams cad gsad pa ④la ni rdo rje dral 8bas so/ /sems can thams cad rgyas gdab pa la ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag rgyas so/ / snying thams cad ⑩'dren cing 'byin pa la ni yid kyis bzlas pas so/ /sems can thams cad za ba la ⑩ni ldang zhing myur bar tsozlos pas so/ / sems can 7thams cad skrag du par bya ba la ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi phyag rgyas so/ /nor thams cad dgug pa la ni gser gyis tībazlas pas so/ /nor dang 'bru thams cad dgug pa la ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag rgyas so/ /thams cad rjes su chags par bya ba la ni pi bang brdung ⑤ba dang bcas pa'i ka ka la'i glu len pas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /thams cad 'bigs pa dang rjes su chags par bya ba la ni rdo rje mda'i phyag rgyas so/ /thams cad phyags dupar bya ba la ni phyogs thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes pas so/ /gdug 3stepa'i 'ching ba brtan ④par bya ba la ni snying brtan por 0nges par 'tshir ⑦bas so/ /ma rungs pa rab tu bsgrub so)pa la ni rdo rje bsnyems 0pas so/ /rgyan thams cad dbrog pa la sno )ni 'bar ba'i blta rgyabs dbrog pas so/ /thams cad 85—458

yid tshim pa la ni rdo rje khu tshur snying gar ①bzhag pas so/ /mun pa snang bar bya ba la ni rdo rje kha shar du bltas te bskor ②bas so/ /lus bde bar bya ba la ni rang gi mtshan gyi bzlas pas so/ /gzugs thams cad snang bar bya ba la ni rdo rje gzugs kyi mchog gi phyag rgyas so/ /sgra thams cad thos par bya ba la ni rdo rje pi bang nigis so/ /dri zhim po sna tshogs pa'i phyir ni sna'i dbugs 'byin pa'i glu ④yis so/ /zas dang skom thams cad dang bcud thams cad spo ba la ni rdo rje spo bar dubya'o/ /dbab pa thams cad la ni mnyam pa'i thal mo dang se gol dang glu'i ༅bzlas pas so/ /thams cad gar byed du ⑦gzhug pa la ni dubadag nyid gar byed cing bzlas pas so/ /thams cad glu len du gzhug pa la ni lce bskyod cing bzlas pas 0so/ /thams cad smrar gzhug pa la ni rdo rje mchu 7yis so/ /thams cad babs nas lan ston nyunyepa la ni rdo rje 'bebs pas so/ /gdon thams cad las thar bar bya ba la ni rdo rje myu 'o)gu'i phyag rgyas so/ /gdon thams cad 'dzin du gzhug pa la 0ni tshogs kyi bdag po rab tu dga' ba'i khro bos bzlas pas 8so/ /rims nad 8thams cad 'dzin du gzhug pa la ni rdo rje'i rigs ⑩kyi gdon gyis so/ /rims thams cad bsal ba la ni rdo rje'i lta 'o tshobs bsal bas so/ /dug thams cad spar ba la ni rdo rje lta ba'i dug gi phyag rgyas 8so / /dug thams cad gzhig pa la ni rma bya'i chun pos so/ /dug thams cad bza' ba la ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i phyag rgyas so/ /bdud la sogs pa ma rungs pa thams cad brlag pa la yini 'khrugs pas dpag tu med par bzlas pas so/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon thams cad las grol bar bya ba la ni rdo rje chen po gsor ba'i phyag rgyas so/ /phyag rgya thams cad gzhig pa la ni rdo rje 'phen pas so/ /85—459

mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / gdul ba la ni rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga'i ①phyag rgya 'dzin pas so/ /ma mo thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dang /dam tshig dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig pa dang ske/ gsang ba gzhig ②pa la ni rdo rje khro bo'i yi ge duphaṭa kyis so/ /ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad mngag gzhug mar ④bya ba la ni ma mo'i gnas su khros ①pas bzlas brjod 'bum bya'o/ /bdud thams cad kyi stobs gzhom pa la ni rdo rje drag po'i ha ha zhes bya ba'i gad rgyangs kyis so/ /gzhan gyi dudapung thams cad gzhom pa la ni rdo rje la yongs su bzlas la 'phang ngo 'thab pa thams cad las thar bar bya ⑦ba la ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgyas so/ /thams cad bcing ba la ni gos la mdud pa bya'o⑧/ /thams cad dgrol spub la ni yi ge mu yis so/ /ro langs dang 'khrul 'khor thams cad gzhig pa la ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis so/ /lcags sgrog 0thams cad dgrol ba la ni rdo rje khab 7long gis so/ /me yang dag par bskyed pa la ni rdo rje me shel gyis so/ /chu med par chu yang dag par bskyed pa la ni rdo rje chu shel gyis so/ /nam mkha' las zas dang skom dang gos dang rgyan thams cad la sogs pa yo byad mang po 'byung ba la ni nam mkha' la lta 8zhing bzlas brjod 'bum bya'o/ /nam mkha' las sangs rgyas kyi sku la sogs pa gzugs thams cad ston pa la ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la 3nyenam mkhar lta nyustezhing bzlas pas so/ /nam mkha' las 8yi ges 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i lung bsgo ba'i ⑩bden par ston pa la ni yi ge a bris la bzlas brjod 'bum byas pas so/ /pra se na thams cad las 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i lung bsgo ba bden par ston pa 85—460

la ni rdo rje pra se na thams cad dbab pas so/ /de bzhin du mig gis bden pa thams cad mthong ba la ni rang gi mig la bzlas pa 'bum byas pas so/ /rna bas thos par bya ba la ni rang gi ①rna ba la bzlas pa 'bum byas pas ②so/ /snas mnam ③par bya ba la ni sna la bzlas pas so/ /lces rang nyid smra ba la ni lce la bzlas pas so/ /lus kyis reg par bya ba la ni lus la bzlas pas so yid kyis shes par bya ba la ni yid la ④'bum bzlas pas so/ /rmad du byung ba thams cad bstan pa la ni sangs rgyas kyi sku bsgrubs pas so/ /sgyu ma thams cad bstan pa la ni rma bya'i sgro'i chun po la 'bum bzlas pas ⑤so/ /thams cad g.yog par bya ba la ni zhi ba'i gnas su 'bum bzlas pas so/ /thams cad la yilan ldon par bya ba la ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rdo rjes so/ /rdzu 'phrul thams cad bstan pa la ni rdo rje rdzu 'phrul gyi phyag rgyas so/ /cho 'phrul thams cad bstan pa la ni rdo rje ting nge 'dzin gyi 0phyag rgyas so/ /rang gi lus la sogs pa dngos po thams cad las sangs rgyas dang / rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 9kyidangos po thams cad bstan pa la ni rdo rje rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas so lha thams cad dbab pa la ni rdo rje skor (khebs so/ /klu thams cad rjes su 'brang bar bya ba la ni klu'i rgyal po'i mtshor bzlas brjod bya'o/ /gnod sbyin thams cad mngag gzhug par bya ba la ni rdo rje'i 0bka' bsgo bas so/ /'byung po thams cad gdul ba la ni lha chen po mnan nas khros shipas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /ser ba thams cad bzlog pa la ni rdo rje srid srung skogi phyag rgyas so/ /glog 'bab pa thams cad bzlog pa la ni rdo rje khro gnyer can gyi hu phyag rgyas so/ /char dbab 8pa la ni klu'i mtshor bzlas brjod bya'o/ /char gcad chogepa la ni dri ma 85—461

med pa'i chu'i sbyin blug ①bya'o/ /sprin bskyed pa la ni klu bris nas bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ /sprin bshig pa la ni rdo rje nam mkha'i spyan ②gyis so/ /chu med pa'i phyogs su shin tu bsil ba'i chu'i tshogs rtag tu 'byung ba la ni rdo rje klu'i phyag rgyas so/ /gter thams cad shes par bya ba la ni snod du chu blug ②par bya'o / /gter thams cad brko ④ba la ni rdo rje 'jor ⑤gyis so/ /gter thams cad rnyed pa la ni rdo rje nor gyis so/ /rgyal srid thams cad thob par bya ba la ⑥ni rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgyas so/ /sa'i bdag por bya ba la ⑦ni rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgyas so/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bsgrub dupa la ni rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas so/ /phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub ⑨pa la ni bde ba chen po'i dam tshig gi ⑩phyag rgyas so/ /dam tshig thams cad bsgrub ⑩pa la ni rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgyas so/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub ⑫pa la ni rdo rje bsnyems phortepa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas so/ /ma grub pa thams cad grub par ston pa la ni rdo rje grub pa'i phyag rgyas so/ / rdo rje ④rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad bsgrub 8pa la ni rdo rje rig pa 'dzin gyi ⑩phyag rgyas so/ /rdo rje thams cad bsgrub 'o 7pa la ni rdo rje thams cad kyi mchog gi hunyephyag rgyas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsgrub hunyepa la ni thugs kyi rdo rjes so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid bsgrub sum̐ )pa la ni rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyas 0so/ /sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub zhunyepa la ni rdo rje ye shes kyi phyag rgyas so/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig thams cad kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po las dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po rdzogs so ⑤/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i rtog pa'o2ste// //85—462

gshegs pa thams cad kyis hu)zhi ba'i chos nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par ②bsgrub ①pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di ④gsungs te / rdo rje sra ba nyid kyi (nyephyir rdo rje mnyam pa nyid stimangon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni byang chub chen po'o/ /don gcig ⑦pa nyid kyi phyir don gyi mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa sprini byang chub chen po'o/ /ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa nyid kyi phyir chos kyi mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni byang chub chen po'o/ /thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa nyid kyi phyir thams cad mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni byang chub chen po'o / /lag na rdo rje gang la la chos mngon par bsgrub ⑨pa bzhi po 'di dag nyan pa dang 'dzin pa dang klog pa dang / sgom 0pa de ⑩sdig pa thams cad la spyod kyang byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du ngan song thams cad las yang dag par 'das par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi khu tshur yongs su 'dzin pa'i don gyi gnas 'di nyid rgya cher nyirteston cing bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas te chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /aḥhunye/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus par mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyogs thams cad du rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rimatshul gyis bzhugs 8pa dang / sems dpa' chen po brgyad phyi'i dkyil 'khor du phyogs brgyad du bzhad pa chen pos 8bzhad cing bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom 85—463

ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor chen po ②'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du phyi'i dkyil 'khor bris la de'i dbus su thig gsum gyi 'khor lo bris nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad kur sna tshogs padma ②rab tu gnas pa de'i ④'khor lo'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa chen po sa la sogs pa las byas pa gzhag par bya'o/ /de'i phyogs thams cad dus la sogs pa las byas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad gzhag gam bri bar bya'o/ /de nas tshon gyi (gethig le rnams kyis gyedakyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la bzhugs tsho)ripa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi dang mtshams rnams su byang chub sems dpa' brgyad ci ④lta ba bzhin bzhag nas/ bum pa gang ba bzhi sgo rnams su dgod par bya zhing (pe/ byang chub kyi mtshan ma rnams gzhag par bya ste / shar nas brtsams te ne'u gsing sa 7dang bcas pa'i dum bu dang / ro drug gis yongs su gang zhing dbyig dang gser dang rin po che dang / gos la sogs pas yongs su bkang ba'i snod dang / 'jam zhing shin tu bde ba'i stan ⑩dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dgod do/ /de nas de bzhin du gos gyon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings 'ostenas zhugs na bdag nyid slob dpon med par yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rmo byin gyis rlob mipar 'gyur ro/ / de nas brtsams te 8de bzhin gshegs 85—464

pa thams cad kyi rtog pa dang dngos grub thams cad la mi tshugs pa dang / mi sod pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba 'thob ①par 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob ma yang de bzhin du gzhug go/ /zhugs nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa byin la rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba yang sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig 'di dag bya bar bsgo bar bya'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /bstan pa thams cad bsrung ②ba'i phyir/ /rnam par mi rtog sbyor ba yis/ /ci bde bar ③ni thams cad kyis/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas mtshan ma bzhi 'byor pa ci ④lta bas skal ba ci ⑤lta ba bzhin du sbyin par bya'o/ /dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor ro//de nas sgrub ⑥pa ni/ ras ⑦la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'dzum (kyepa dang bcas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur gyi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin par bya'o/ /gzhan thams cad ni dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du sems dpa' mchog bsgrub nyupa dang ske/ dngos grub mchog rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /gzhan yang ras la bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig mas bris te/ 'di'i mdun du rdo rje tshig gis nyu7bzlas brjod 'bum byas nas ye shes kyi khu tshur yongs su 'dzin pas mtshan mo thog thag bzlas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'thob cing dngos grub thams cad grub 8pa'i byang chub sems dpar 8'gyur la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma bsgrubs pas 8kyang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa tsam nyid kyis las rnams 'grub par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa la ni/ ci 8snyed pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde ba thams cad phul bas so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams 85—465

cad mchod pa la ni/ bdag phul bas so/ /dkon mchog gsum ①mchod pa la ni / me tog la sogs pa la bzlas pas ②so/ /sems can thams cad mchod pa la ni/ thams cad la byams pa'i bzlas pas ①so/ /chos thams cad bsdu ba la ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshig bzhi po gdon pas so/ /bdud thams cad 'dul ba la ni brtan zhing nges pa'i bzlas pas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba thob pa la ni rgyan thams cad phul ④zhing rang nyid bcings pas so/ /chos nyid thams cad thob pa la ni rdo rje padma la blta dubs so / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi ⑥dngos grub ⑦thob pa la ni thams cad durdo rje'i ⑨las kyi mchog gis so/ /sangs rgyas nyid rab tu 'thob ⑩pa la ni rdo rje ye shes kyi khu tshur gyi de kho na nyid kyi phyag rgya chen pos so/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig gi 7rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje dam tshig ces bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rdzogs so/snye/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtog pa'o0// //de nas ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 8thub pas kyang yang chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyis 8rnam par rgyal ba bsdu ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub 8pa 'di gsungs soyi/ /'dod chags kyi spros pa med pa nyid kyis zhe snang gi spros pa med pa nyid do/ /zhe sdang gi spros pa med pa nyid kyis 'o2gti mug gi spros pa med pa nyid do/ /gti mug gi spros pa med pa nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi spros pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad hu spros pa med pa nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu du )phyin pa spros pa med pa 85—466
