bde ba chen po rdo rje pra dbab pas so/ /rang gi lus dang ngag dang yid rdo rjes mthong ba dang thos pa dang smra ba dang ston pa'i shes pa grub pa ni bde ba chen po'i ①rdo rje'i bdag nyid bsgoms pas sol/ /thams cad las 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad ②bka' mthong ba'i yi ge sna tshogs pa'am / dngos po sna tshogs pa ④thams cad kyis rna ba'i shes pa rab tu 'jug pa ni bde ba chen po'i rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pas so/ /glog rjodang char pa dudang thog dbab pa thams cad bzlog pa dang / sprin gzhig pa ni bde ba chen po'i rdo rje khro bo'i lta bas so/ /sa'i 'og thams cad las sngar ma byung ba'i 'bru la sogs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / nye bar len pa dang / chu med pa'i gnas las chu'i dngos po 'byung ba dang nye bar len pa dang / mun pa chen por snang ba chen po bskyed pa dang nye bar len pa dang rlung thams cad la bka' bsgo ba dang nye bar len pa dang nam mkha' thams cad las yid kyis ⑦'dod pa'i dngos po thams cad mthong ba dang nye bar len pa ni bde ba chen po'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas so/ /thams cad gzhom pa dang rengs pa dang dral dub dang rmugs pa dang gnyid log par bya ba dang rgyas gdab pa dang ltung ba dang rmongs pa dang gsad ⑨pa dang phyir ldog pa ni bde ba chen po'i gdug pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgyas so/ /thams cad rjes su chags pa dang dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang dbab pa dang bcing ba dang bkrol ⑩ba dang dral 0ba dang ltung ba dang ltung ba bslang ba dang 'dren tu pa dang bran du byed pa dang mngag gzhug bka' bsgo ba byed pa dang thams cad tshur drang ba dang phar btang ba dang gsad 0pa dang slar gso ba la sogs pa'i las thams cad byed pa dang dbang du byed pa'i sgrub pa ni 85—580

bde ba chen po'i rdo rje ①thams cad sgrub ②pas so/ /rigs thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos grub la sogs ②pa'i mchog gi dngos grub thams cad dang /mchog gi dbang bskur ba la sogs pa thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang thams cad rjes su chags pa la sogs pa'i bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad rab tu gzhug pa dang / mchod pa chen po thams cad la sogs pa'i las thams cad myur du grub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni ④bde ba chen po'i rdo rje ⑤mchog gi dngos grub kyis ⑥so/ /de la bde ba chen po'i ⑦rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig gi dang po'i mchog gi dam tshig gi ⑧las kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud ni 'di yin te bde ba chen po'i rdo rje stini rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ster ba'o/ /'di'i las kyi phyag rgya thams cad bcing ba'o/ /dbus ma'i rdo rje btung bar bya8/ rtse mo'i 'od zer byas pas (nyagadong pa yongs su sbyangs te gdong par dgrol bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid la 8kun du bskor nas snying gar 0dgrol bar bya'o/ /gtsug tor ⑩dang phyogs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor bskor ba'o/ /snying ga 8dang yid kyis rgyab dang phrag pa dang / spyi bo dang dpral bar bzhag la rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis phreng ba bcings la go cha bya steklu/ mdud pa byas nas rdo rje'i gnas rnams su slar yang phreng ba byas pas rgyab tu mdud pa byas te mdar dpyangs bya'o/ /snying ga 8dang dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang spyi bor gzhag par bya'o/ /dbus ma'i dar mchog go/ /byab pa'i gyen du kha bltas pa'i dbug ⑩pa dang 'jig 'i )pa'i gdong gis lta ba'o0/ /'bar ba bzhi'i tshul gyis 'dor zhing khros pa'i ༄ derang gi snying gar 0bcings te zhi ba'i lta bas rtse mo 'phrog par bya'o/ /lta bas 'phrog du stepar bya'o/ /dbab pas myur du dgrol zhunyebar bya'o/ /yongs su bskor nas 85—581

dpral bar bzhag ste/ dbus ma'i rdo rje sor mo'i rtse mo gnyis bskyod par byas na ci lta ba ①bzhin du las byed pa'i snying gar ②bzhag ste dbus ma rdo rje'i las ni 'di lta ste/ snying gar stod ⑤pa dang skyed pa dang 'ching ba dang gar byed du bcug pa dang mgrin pa gsal ④ba dang rdo rje (gyertse mo btsir ba dang kha dbub ⑥pa dang mgrin pa gsal ⑦ba dang bcings pa myur du dgrol (kyeb dang bsrung stib dang byab pa'i las so/ /snying ga mkha sbyor bskyed tu pa'o/ /nyin re zhing pho snga rol du lan cig hunyelus yongs su sbyang ba dang / mgrin pa gsal ba'i ngag dang snying gar blagazhag pa dang phyag rgya la hunyelta ba ste/ nyin re snga rol du lan cig tsodabang po thams cad la kun du bskor bar rtso tshobya'o/ /dbus ma rdo rjes byed pa ni khro bo'i rdo rje'i lta bas so/ /dbus ma'i rdo rje'i nyusnyelas ni 'og nas 'byung ste nye bar longs spyad 37pa dang / thams cad la dgug par byed pa dang dbab pa sbyin pa dang 'bar ba'i me stag byed pa dang nye bar len pa dang rlung gi tshul dang nam mkhar sgom ( )pa las du ma'o/ /dbus ma'i rdo rje'i lus ni phyag rgyas gzhom pa dang rtse mo gnyis snying gar 7btsir ba dang sen mo brud pa dang mig 'degs du ༄pa dang btsum pa dang / sor lhamo mnyam pos snying gar tsho snyebateg na pa dang ltung ba dang slong 35bar byed pa dang / phan tshun rdeg pa dang rang gi snying gar 2 tshorang bzhin du gzhag pa'i las so/ /dbus ma'i rdo rje las ni mda' stod ‘ — pa dang lcags sgrog 37gnyis kyis snadagug pa dang g.yon pa la g.yas pa bcug 21pa dang rtse mo bskyod pa dang gdu bur bcing ba dang myur du dgrol ba dang sor mo mnyam por myur du dral ba dang ltung bar byed pa dang 'og nas bteg pa dang g.yon pa g.yas pas drang ba dang / las thams cad la sbyar tsho bar byed sa2pa dang 'og nas bskyod 85wa 582

cing gyen du drang ba dang tshur 'dren pa dang phar gtang ba dang g.yon ①dang g.yas kyis drag por 'degs ②pa dang rang gi snying gar 0rtse mo 'dren pa dang /las thams cad la nges par sbyor ba byabyed pa'i las dang snying gar ⑤'khor lo gzhug pa dang dbang bskur (caba'i phreng ba dang dar dpyangs 'ching bar ⑦byed pa dang snying gar shelas drangs te bde ba tshur 'dren pa thams cad yongs su sbyang ba dang gar gyis blangs te spyi bor dgrol ba'i las so/ /bde ba chen po rab grub dang ske/ /chags pa chen po rnam dag phyir/ /don yod thogs med sna tshogs pa'i//phyag rgya'i rgyud ni rab tu bshad/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yis/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas bdag nyid kun/ /sems can thams cad myur 'grub phyirardzi/ /don yod dngos grub kun stsol ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs pa/ /sdig pa'i las ni kun dang ldan/ /de dag kyang ni grub ⑩'gyur te/ /bcings pa tsam gyis sdig byang phyir/ /gang zhig le lo nyid kyis sam/ /brtson 'grus ldan tsoyang ma 'tshang ba/ /dkyil 'khor med pa'i sems can gang / /slob dpon nyid byin ma brlabs nyusnyedang / /de dag grub mchog rdo rje che/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid du 'gyur/ /don yod mchog dang sna tshogs pa'i/ /bcings pa tsam gyis myur grub byed/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /mchog gi dngos grub kun la 'jug /dang po 'byung ba'i rdo rje mchog /bde ba che mulas 8yang dag 'byung / / dag cing 8shin tu grub pa dang / /'gro nyi tshob thams cad la yang ngo / /de nas phyag rgya thams cad sgrub 3)pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud ni / las 'dod thog mar phyag rgya ni/ /skal ba ci bzhin snying pos grubanyurte/ /rang gi bdag nyid nges sbyar ( — )bya/ /bde ba chen po'i rdo rje gsang ba'i rtog 85wa 583

pa'i rgyal po chen po ①las/ bde ba chen po ②thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sridam tshig don yod pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog ces bya ba ④rgyud phyi ma'i cho ga rgyas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yongs su mthar thug pa med pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje thams cad kyi las kyi ⑤sbyor ba niyi/ rdo rje 'chang ba ⑦dang bcas pa rnams kyis bde ba chen po'i rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po 'dis nisems can gyi khams ma lus pa kun du khyab cing spro ba dang ⑨dngos grub thams cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa/srid pa thams cad kyi rtse mo'i yongs su mthar 7thug pa'i gsung rab yongs su mthar thug pa'i don du thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba btab pa yin no/ /rdo rje'i yinam mkha' chen po yis8/ /chos kyi dbyings ni spro ba mchog /rdo rje'i 8nam mkha' chen po yi/ /chos dbyings spro ba'i dngos grub ster8/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bcas pa dang ske/ /rdo rje 'chang gi theg 8pa ni/ /yongs su mthar thug nus pa min/ /e ma'o mngon zhen sems can dang / /le lo can dang las kun ldanatso/ /thugs rje dam pa'i rdo rje khyod/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /bde ba chen po rab sgrub hu 7dang / /chags pa chen po rnam dag phyir/ /rtog pa 'di ni mthar thug pa//rab tu sgrub phyir mthar thug brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gsan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi hu)ting nge 'dzin yirdo rje sems dpa' byin gyis brlabs du pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di gsungs so/ /bde 85—584

ba chen po rab sgrub dang / /chags pa chen po rnam dag phyir/ /thams cad dgongs ⑨grub don du ni/ /yongs su mthar thug byin brlabs ②pa'o/ /gang gis tshul mchog 'di ni nyan 'gyur dang / /gang gis khyim na gsang ba thams cad gnas/ /bde chen mchog gi rdo rje mchog gsang ba'i⑧/ /dngos grub tshe 'dir de dag rnams la bstanabya/ /brtan pa nyid phyir 'dul bar nga (nyemi byed/ /sems can don du rgyal ba las dag phyir/ /rnam par sbyang bar mdzad pa 'di yin te/ /rtog pa 'di ni bgegs med bdud rnams med/ /dngos grub 'phel med min pa dubyin gyis brlabs/ /bdud dang brtan med nyid ni bdag mi byed/ /brtan ⑦pa nyid phyir 'dul bar nga mi byed/ /rtog pa chen po'i mchog 'di dugang bsgrub ⑨pa/ /myur du dngos grub mchog phyin 0bdag brtan 'gyur/ /brtan zhing rab bgyis ⑩brtan pas rjes su chags/ /bde ba chen po kun byed 8shin tu rgyas/ / nga yi 8dang po'i ④snying po gang sgrub 0pa/ /de la nga ni rtag tu dngos grub ster/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod phyedo / /bde ba chen po rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po mchog tu grub pa'i rgyud phyi ma ⑩yongs su rdzogs so/nye// //de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' mchen po phyag na rdo rje 'di nyid slar yang ston par mdzad cing zhal rab tu 'dzum pa dang / mchog dang po'i rdo rje bde ba chen po rdo rje bsnyems ṭu )pas gsor nas rang gi thugs kur bstod 0pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing mchog tu gsang zhing mchog tu grub pa don yod 85—585

cing thogs pa med pa bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig 'di rtog pa thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang bdud thams cad 'dul bar byin gyis brlab 3)pa'i dbang gis ma grub pa rnams kyang mchog dam pa 2grub par byed pa dang mchog tu gsang ba dang 0thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i mtshon cha mchog dang po zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i chen po rgyud phyi ma gsungs pa/de nas thog ma'i gnas nyams dga'/ /nam mkha' kun la rab tu gnas/ /rin chen 'od mdzes stirab tu gsal/ /dri ma med pa'i mdangs kyis brgyan⑤/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo yibazhi pa/ /sgo khyud rnams kyis rab tu brgyan(me/ /kha khyer gyis ni yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje lha mo'i kunanatshogs kyis mchod/ / grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /7zla ba phyed ni rab tu gnas / /rdo rje rin chen 'bar byed pa/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i rtse mo mchog /dar 'phan 7dril bu sgra sgrogs pa/ /dra ba me long tog me toganyuskye /me tog chun po'i rgyan gyis bskor/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje kun gyis legs sbyar ba / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bzhugs gnas che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rjes bsten tsopa / /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas kyi mchog /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gnas/ /bde ba chen po'i 32rdo rje che / /rdo rje rin chen mchog bya ba'i8/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bzhugs nas ni/ /bde ba chen po rnam par bzhugs/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba chetshe/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems 3 tshotshul bdag po'i hu bdag /sems can kun gyi sems gang ni37/ /brtan 3 )pa'i phyir ni dpa' zhes bya/ /brtan 0par bzhag pas ting 'dzin te/ /nges pa las 32ni rdo rjer gyur/ /sems dpar byin 85wa 586

brlabs hu)sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /byang chub spyod pa'i rjes mthun ri pa/ /bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba nyid/ /byang chub sangs rgyas de nyid do/ /rdo rje drag po mthar byed nyid / /phyag na rdo rje nyid kyang ste④/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /de nyid rdo rje'i ④rigs chen po/ /de nyid padma'i rigs dag pa/ /de nyid nor bu'i rigs bzang bshad/ /de nyid 'dod chags bral ba nyid/ /'dod dang grol ⑤ba de nyid de(6)/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /mi g.yo thams cad mchog de nyid/ /bstan 3pa sra ba nor chen po/ /rgyu ba sems kyis 'dus (kyebyas pa/ /thams cad byed pa thams cad nyid/ /dang po'i sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde rab 'byestsol/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung ⑩bcas nas ni/ /padma'i steng du bzhugs pa ni7/ /btsun mo'i tshogs bcas sna tshogs pa/ /rdo rje lha mos yongs su bskor/ /bde ba chen po grub don du/ /'dod chags chen po rnam hurtedag phyir/ /ma lus 'dul rmo bya'i don du ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab grub phyir/ /dam tshig mchog ni rnyim lus pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni bsrung bar bya/ /bsnyems mabacas rdo rje gsor ba dang / /rdo rje bsnyems rtsapa'i tshul 'chang zhing / /phyag rgya kun myur grub mngon du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog grub phyir/ /dngos grub kun gyi thabs chen po/ /bsod nams kun gyis cher mthong ba/ /ye shes phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /snying po chen po dam yin te/ rme/ /gang gis bsod nams mi ldan pa'amanyusnye/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor ma zhugs pa'ang hu'e/ /don yod thogs pa med mchog 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad 85—587

rnyed dka' yin①/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig brtan / /dngos po thams cad sgrub ②pa ster/ /rtog pa thams cad myur grub ③byed / /thog mtha' med phyir dang por 'byung / /mchog dang dang 0po zhes byar ⑤bshad / /tshig kun gyis duni ci 'dod dang ⑦/ /chags pa kun gyis 0ci dga' bar / /rjes su chags par bgyi'o ⑨zhes/ /ci bzhin 'bab pa'i ye shes 'jug /nye ba'i snying po bcas snying po/ /bskal pa dang por bcom ldan gsungs/ /hūṃ/de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sras bcas pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin bcas sna tshogs pa/ /skad cig gis ni 'dus par 'gyur⑩/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen ⑩/gyis thog mar8/ /yud kyi 'jig rten gsum po 'byung / /ci ltar 'gro ba 8rab grub ces/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis dngos grub dris/ /de rnams kyi ④ni bka' gsan nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin rang grol tsob ni/ /'byin dang 465 chadang 0ston pa poyi/ /byed pas tshig ni 'di skad gsol/ /chags bral gyis 'dul 'jig rten rnams/ /chags bral nyid kyis dag par 'gyur/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che7/ /'di ni ji ltar grub 63 par 'gyur/ / de yi tītshig de gsan nas ni/ /rgyal ba rang nyid kyis gsungs pa/ /byang chub sems de thog ma'i lha/ /khyod ni thabs chen nyid yin no/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i tsoganas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /ci srid sems can rnam rtog pa/ /de srid byang chub srid pa che/ /byang chub sems can mel phan phyir/ /rdo rje can gyis ci bder gyis/ /de nas thog ma dang dkyil 'khor/ /dang po'i tsodakyil 'khor byin gyis brlabasatso/ /rdo rje kun gyi phyadam tshig mchog /ci bzhin 85—588

cho gas bsgrubs ①pa nyid/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de ni/ /bde ba chen po grub phyir dang / /'dod chags chen po rnam dag phyir/ /gtso bos ②mgon la gsol ba btab/ /bcom ldan khyod la gsol ba ni/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba chedu/ /snying po 'di ni rtog pa mchog /bde chen myur du grub byed ④pa'o / /de rnams kyi ni bka' gsan nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bka' stsal to/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste④/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje mchog /gsang ba dam pa zhes bshad pa'o༅/ /thog mar dam tshig gsum thob pa'i / /rdo rje slob dpon rang phyag rgyas/ /'khor lo kun gyi cho ga la/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril 'chang bya/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag 'bebs/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /dam tshig che gsum zhes bya ba'i/ /rgya ⑦'di thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /dngos grub cho ga thams cad ladu/ /rdo rje dril bu rab bskul bsal/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang yang / /'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas ⑩gsungs so/ /mchog gi dang po mtha' yas mchog /bla na med cing mnyam med 0pa/ /nam mkha' kun la rab tu gnas/ /mchog ste yi ge dam pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni 7sbyang byas la/ /de yi tsodabus su cho ga bzhin/ /dngos grub byin rlabs ④cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor de 8ni grub par bya/ /glu dang rol mo'i cho ga dang / /me tog spos sogs mchod pa yis0/ /ji snyed ⑩pa dang ci 'dod par/ /mchog dang por ni rtag par bya'o8/ /mchog gi dang por mtha' yas mchog /bla na med cing dpe 0med pa/ /nam mkha' kun la rab tu gnas/ /grong khyer dag ni mi 85—589

'gyur mchog /thog ma med mchog rtag pa ste0)/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang rab tu bzhugs/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid rten pas/ /lhag dang ma tshang med kun gang / /mtha' dang dbus med nam mkha' ni/ /'di ni dbu mar rnam brtags pas(kye/ /phyag rgya'i khusbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ / de yis ④dbus mar rnam brtag (genyid/ / de yi 56)dbus su padma'i gzugs/ /yu bar bcas pa rab tu gzhag /sna tshogs padmas yang dag khebs/ /thams cad dag pa'i gdan de yin/ /de nas srad bu gnyis ⑦'gyur du/ /byas pa'i thig ni gdab bya ste/ /nam mkha' kun gyi tshad yin phyir/ /gdul bya'i blo ni mtha' yas pas/ /tshad ni tshad med pa nyid yin(she/ /mi mnyam med pas ⑨thur bzhi pa / /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi ste/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi 7rta babs bzhi/ /ting 'dzin khyams su bshad pa yin/ /khyams la brten (1pa'i rdo rje'i bdag /gzugs rnams lha mos mchod pa'o/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis bkra ba ni/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o3)/ /gdul bas bskyod nyunyepa sna tshogs mchog /dam chos mchog ste kun du 'gro/ /rlung gis bskyod ④pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /ba dan rtser bebatags 7dril sgra sgrogs/ /me long ye shes rtag me togazhu tsho /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dra ba me long me tog che/ /me tog phreng ba'i rgyan gyis bskor/ /kun grub mi 'gyur bde ba ni/ /bde ba chen po zhes bshad do/ /bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /dang po'i gnas su 3)bri bar bya/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /kun mchog de ni legs bris nas/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du bsam/ / de ni lho) phyi yi ༷ )dkyil 'khor ro lku/ / de yi 3rtanang gi 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa lta 85wa 590

bu yin/ /'di ni rnam thar brgyad po ste/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba ster0ri / /byang sems theg pa chen po yi/ /mdo sde'i 'khor lo rab bskor bas/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs bskor ba/ /rdo rje 'khor lo yang dag bri/ /der ②ni sna tshogs padma cher/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dgod par bya/ /lugs ma'am yang na brkos pa 'am/ /byas pa'am yang na bris pa ste/ /'dzum bcas zla ba'i mdog can la//dmar zhing sna tshogs 'od 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang la ①sogs④/ /rgyan dang na (sebaza' sna tshogs pa/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung yidag gis bzhugs//rdo rje bsnyems gatshul 'chang ba'i mchog /su ra ta st+waṃ ⑧zhes brjod cing / /rang snying pos kyang gzhag par bya/ / de yi 7phyogs ni thams cad du/ /tshon benam de bzhin phye ma yis/ /go rims 7dag ni ci bzhin du/ /rdo rje lha mo yang dag bri / /rdo rje mchod bstod tsol brtson bya/ /rdo rje chags ma mdun du bri/ /lha mo rdo rje rol pa 8ni/ /rdo rje can la rab 'khyud pa④/ /rgyab tu rdo rje dran ma ni/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bsnyems brim/ /de nas 'di rnams dgod pa'i phyag rgya ni/ dzaḥtshebadzra dris yis ma ke ma ṭa hunyertsu/ oṃ badzra ki li ki li /ces/ bam̐ badzi ṇi sma rle )ra ra 7ṭa / ho badzra kā me shwa ri st+waṃ/ mtshams 3su rdo rje sems ma sogasashusnye/ /dus kyi mchod pa yang dag bri/ /rdo rje sbrang rtsi bum dang sprin/ /ston dang dgun nigeni rdo rje ma/ /me tog bdug pa mar me che/ /dri ste tsospyi bor thal sbyar ba/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i lha mo ste/ /de nas phyag rgya rab bshad bya/ /oṃ ma dhu badzi ri tsho rghaṃ/ oṃ badzra me ghi gu lu gu lu/ oṃ oṃ tsosha rad brdzu kū/ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ badzra shi ru )shi ri rtsu hūṃ/sgeg mo bzhad sgomam glu chen ma/ /gar mdzad ma tsoyi lha mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje rol 85—591

mo 'di dag ni/ /phyi rol gyi ni mtshams ①su bya/ /ho ②ra ti badzra ma gha ③bi la si ni tra hasti/ ho ra ti badzra dzra 7⑤/ be ba be ba/ sgo yi gnas ni thams cad du / /gsol ka ba ni bzhi po ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog de bzhin dril ma yiyi/ /badzra i gu ⑦sha dzaḥme/ badzra pā she ⑨ / badzra shri kha ⑩le bo/ badzra ghaṇḍi 0hoḥ8/ dam tshig 'di 0ni thams cad kyis8/ /dgongs shing brtag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje lha mo la sogs tshogs/ /dngos grub kun la 'byung bar 8'gyur/ /gsol ka ba dang tsogayog mo yi/ /gtso mo ⑩pho nya 'o)bran mo'ohu)/ /de nas kun bu mchog la sogs pa/ /mngon bris yang dag bsgrub par bya/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas su/ /dzaḥs baṃ hoḥzhes brjod bya / /sems dpa'i skyil krung zhubacas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyi spyan sngar 'dug /bde ba chen po'i 3rdo rje mchog /bdag po lan cig duyang dag dgug /hūṃ ma hā bus kha badzra sa twa/ ya hi shrī rgyus/ ma hā 0su kha badzra a mo bhā 0ya / a nu pā dul ⑥ya/ pra bud du byedha su ra ta st+waṃ a nu rasto ⑥me bha ba/ su 9to ṣyo du me bha bci/ su po nunya6 me bha ba 4lha/ bha ga bān nā 'di na dus twa/ sarba sid dhi mme pra yatstsha/ a 0she ta ( )ma tri ṣa ā be sha ya byas ma ye ra bad dha/ ba shī ka 9ro me/ i (nyamer mu dā (stepa(nye deḥdzaḥbya/ baṃ hoḥ0/ 'di yis bcom ldan 'das rtag par(nye/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rang nyid gshegs/ /bkug cing bcug la shin tu brtan/ /dbang du gyur nas rab tu thub/ /ces bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen pos 4)gsungs so/ /rdo rje slob dudapon rang lha 0ni/ /'od zer kun du bla ston la sogs/ /mtshan ma rnam pa mang po ni/ /ngo mtshar gyur pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje mchod yon ni/ /rdo rje thal mo kha dbyes 85wa 592

dbul① / /bum pa gang dag ②ci snyed pa'i/ /me tog la ①sogs kyis kyang ④ mchod / /ba dan rtse mor dril btags ⑤pa/ /mtshams 6)kyi ⑦char ni gzhag par bya/ /bum pa spos chus gang ba la/ / rdo rjer bcas pas byin brlabs pa/ /'u)lcug ⑨ma la ni yongs su bzlas/ /de la bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig gi chur bsgrub 0pa ni 'di yin te/ rghaṃ ma hā su kha badzra a mo gha sa ma yo da ka sad dha yis rnyi ṣiñtsa.a/ sarba su kha sau tunyem na myu rsā da da ku ru ku ru/dzaḥtso baṃ hoḥ8/ 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas la/ bdag nyid la rdo rjes tsodabang bskur bar ⑩bya'o/ /bsang 8gtor bya ba dang / 'thungs pas kyang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal yib dang bde ba chen po du thams cad 'phel bar du'agyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas tsogasungs so/ /de nas 'khor lor ma zhugs kyang / /rang nyid thog mar byung zhugs shing / /rdo rje kun gyi slob dpon che/ /rdo rje can gyis rang byin rlob/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin slob dpon/ /rang nyid khrus byas dris legs 'byugs/ /ci snyed ( ste pa yi ⑥rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shin tu dmar ba'i gos bgo 0zhing / /me tog phreng btags kha dris bsgo ⑦/ /rnam sgeg dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / /rdo rje gar gyi sbyor ba yis/ /spyi bor me tog thal sbyar nas/ /gnas de mgon la phyag bya'o/ /zhugs nas dkyil 'khor de la ni/ /bskor ba dag ni lan gsum bya/ /de nas mdun du 'dug nas ni/ /de kho na nyid lan cig phyobarjod/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /rdo rje chen po nor che ba/ /ye shes chen po las chen po/ /de dag rdo rje sems grub brjod/ /de nas me tog sil ma ni/ /mgon la gtor te cho ga bzhin / /dang po sha ra la sogs padu nye/ /bstod pa ( )glu ru lan cig hunyeblang / /85—593

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyunyebastod pa'i rgyal po mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ②de kho na nyid chen po ni 'di yin te/ dpal mchog dang po sems dpa' che/ /dga' ba chen po'i dga' chen po②/ /kun tu bzang po (༄kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems ②tshul bdag po'i bdag /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje rdo rje mchog chen po/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog /bdud dang bdud ni rab 'joms pa/ /thams cad thams cad ⑥byang chub che/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas skyes mchog skyes/ /rdo rje rtsu mdzad yi ge rghaṃ/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor rab gsal/ /'dod chags chen po bde chen gnyid/ /'dod dang thar pa nor che ba/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum dang (she/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /brtan par rang byung gsal ba ste/ /rab phra sbom (9)dang legs bsags pa/ /rgyu ba rab mchog thob mdzad pa/ /srid pa 'khor ba 7sbyong mdzad pa/ /thog mtha' med cing thog mtha' can/ /mdangs (17ldan dang por thams cad gnas/ /snying po phyag rgya sbyor dam tshig /de nyid bden pa mchog pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub che/ /chos dang las ni khams chen po/ /dam pa'i chos te (rtalas mchog bdag /byang chub sems ni rab sbyong mdzad/ /rdo rje khro bo khro bo che/ /dus mtha' ltar 'bar 'dul ba po/ /'dul mdzad chen po gdug pa'i mchog /drag po drag nyid zad mdzad pa/ /thams cad dag pa padma che/ /shes rab thabs te tshul chen po/ /'dod chags dag pa'i lho ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs chags pa dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag nya tshopa'i don/ /'byung po thams cad gnas chen po/ /'byor ba 15thams cad gnas 'byor ba/ /dpal dang gtso bo rgyal po ste / /85—594

bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pas khyed la bdag brten ①bgyid//rdo rje sems dpa' ②bdag grub mdzod/ /gang zhig bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di / /nyin re nang par rjod ②byed dam/ /chos kyi tshig gis lan cig ④brjod/ /dngos grub shin tu myur bar 'gyur/ /gal te 'dir grub mi 'dod na/ /dang por ⑤nyin re dus gsum du/ /bstod na sdig pa las nges grol/ /zhing dag pa ni grub par byed/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /lan cig (nyarab tu brjod pa yis/ /dngos grub thams cad skal ⑦bzang byed/ /phun sum tshogs dpal 'phel bar byed/ / dngos grub (kyedon yod yon tan can/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pas ni/ /rab tu dga' bas mgon spul mchod/ /rang gis ⑩phyag rgyas 9/—1lan cig 8ni/ /rang gi phyag rgyas hurtebacings te grub/ /de nas lha yi 8chu dang ni/ /de bzhin sku mchog gis dbang bskur / /rang nyid rdo rje phyag rgya lasko/ /snying po 'di ni blang bar bya/ /de la rdo rje sems dpar tsodabang bskur hu)ba'i snying po ni 3nye'adi yin te/ hūṃ ma hā hu)su kha badzra satwa a bhi ṣe ke na hrīḥrdo )a sgyi ṣiñtsa rdo cho)mi/ sarba badzra ( nyes dhi pa zhu ti st+waṃ dṛ ri ri )ḍho me zhugebha ba mi (yedha nā ma ma ste bha ga bānadu — tsho/ ma hā badzra dha ra su ra ta st+waṃ/ ma hā badzra satwa/ oṃ bhur ci rinyebyu ku —)ba swa/ de nas rdo rje dbang bskur du )ba/ /phyag na rdo rje ming zhunye'adzin pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen slob dpon du/ /'di nyid du ni rab 'grub dunya'agyur/ /de nas kyang ni ci 'dod par/ /cho ga'i dam pa bsgrubs nas ni / /rdo rje gar gyi sa mchod pa yis/ /legs par mchod la phyir byung sa༄bya/ /de nas brtsams sa)te rdo rje'i bdag /rdo rje kun gyi gsung sanyerab 'dzin/ /rdo rje 85wa 595

thams cad 'dzin slob dpon/ /dngos grub thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ①dngos grub che/ /phyag rgya kun bdag dbang phyug che/ /dhīḥl/thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo rje che/ /las rnams thams cad dbus la brtag② /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pa/ /kun byed dngos grub thams cad ster/ /sems can kun gyi rgyal po che/ /tshar gcod pa dang phan 'dogs nus/ /thams cad rjes chags byed kun mchog /kun rig pa dang kun gyi gnas④/ /'dod pa thams cad la rab sbyor/ /phun tshogs kun gyi dbang phyug che/ /lha la sogs pa'i sems can kun/ /bsgo (5)ba thams cad rtag tu byed/ / sems dpa' kun ni gyortag tu mthong / /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub ⑦par 'gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni 'dod par ldan/ /dga' zhing rang nyid de bdag por/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas dugasungs so/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje slob dpon byin gyis brlab ༅cing 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do// // de nas 0slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rjes su bshad par bya'o zhes huXbacom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rdo rje mchod yon snying gar pho bskor/ /bcings nas bsam g.yos bzhin gyis 7ni/ /mgo bos yang dag phyag bya ba/ /dngos grub thams cad grub 8byed yin/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab zhugs la/ /bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ni/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'gro ba kun la'ang 'grub mdzad brjod/ /de nas dus kyi tsomachod pa yis/ /bde ba chen po yang dag mchod/ /de bzhin du ni dbang bskur bar//85—596

rdo rje gsang ba'i slob ma gzhug /de nas ci bzhin brgyan nas ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis rab gzhug /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bcug nas ni/ /ci 'dod pa yi ①dngos grub 'thob②/ /de nas slob ma bcug nas ni/ /dga' ba ③chen po 'di brjod dubya/ /rab dgyes rab bde bstan pa yi/ /rdo rje sems bdag deng dugrub mdzod/ /de nas me tog phreng ba ni/ /spyi bo nas ni myur du 'dorayi//gang du me tog babs gyur te/ /lhag ⑦pa'i lhar ni rab 'grub ⑧'gyur/ /de nas lha yi 0chu yis ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang ⑩rang dbang bskur/ /rdo rje chen po rdo rje lnga/ /byin la rdo rje bo dhi brjod/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badzra/ badzra a bhi ṣe ke ⑩na st+waṃ/ a rnyi ṣiñtsa 0mi/ ma hā badzra dhā tsor/ he badzra nā ma sid dha nā bumaḥ/gang la rdo rje ming gang zhig yin pa de la kye ⑩zhes bya ba'i sgra dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas snying po byin la phyag rgya bcing ba bslabs ⑩nas/ ci ltar mngon par 'dod pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga 'am/ /gang 'dod rang grub pa de ⑩la/ /de nyid kyis 8ni dam tshig nyid/ /'jug la sogs pa'i cho ga bshad/ /'jig rten pa ni sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa rnamasayi/ /thams cad rang gi go rims pya ni/ /rgyas par bsgrubs na rab tu 'grubatso / /'di la rab tu 'jug tsam gyis/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi ldog pa/ /nyid du rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur zhing / /bde ba chen po rab grub gester/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin slob dpon 3/ /mna' ni dam ④du bsgags linas kyang / /de nyid chos dang dam tshig ni/ /rang nyid dang ni gzhan gyis bslab/ /de la 'di ni mna' grub pa'i rdo rje chus dbang bskur nas brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na 85—597

'grub par 'gyur/ /dngos grub rdo rje bdud ①ci chu/ /de nyid chos dang dam tshig ni/ /gal te dkyil 'khor ma mthong smras(kye/ /skye bo 'dug nang ①gnas pa 'ga' / /dad pa med pas bgad ④par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de kho na nyid dang dam tshig gi gsang ba'i cho ga rab tu sbyin pa yin te/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems phyetshul bdag po'i bdag /de kho na nyid mchog gi ⑥gsang ba (75lnga'i de kho na nyid chen po po)bshad par brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das (6de nyid chos kyi mchog bka' stsal par mdzadabya/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dganyunye /ngo bo nyid kyis 1gesrid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog ni byed pa yin/ /de la srid pa rnam 8par dag pa'i thabs rtog bopa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mchog dam tshig chen po bsten 0par bya ba ni 'di yin te/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyiranyusto/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsten ⑩par bya / /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten hunyebazhin du / /rang gi lhag 10pa'i lhar 3)sbyor ( tshabs/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya / /de la rtog pa thams cad kyi 3rtagasang ba'i mchog gi dam tshig chen po 'di brjod par bya ste/ ci srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par bugyur pa'i tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig thabs/ /bsod nams byin rlabs sgrub )byed pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug mchog snye /rgyun du sems can don byed pa'o/ /de ltar sems ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam 85wa 598

tshig mi zad ①bde skyid bsten ②par gyis/ /de ni 'gro la myur du bde ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rab tu mtshungs shing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur / / de nas khyed kyis dubacud dang / kha zas dang gnas pa dang glu ④dang rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams legs par bstabs (snyepa 4)bas bdag nyid gang la srid 4)pas kyang rdo rje slob dpon chen po mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon me tog sogasari nye/ /ci 'dod par ni legs mchod cing / /rdo rje gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /yang dag par ni mchod de byung / /de nas rdo rje 'dzin slob dpon/ /gar gyi (9)mchod pas mchod nas ni/ /rdo rje thal mo'i bo sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /ro dang kha zas gnas pa dang ske/ /glu hunyedang rol mo ci 'dod pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin bdag /yang dag mchod nas phyir byung bya/ /dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba'i 32dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsang ba'o// //de nas bsgrub nyunyepa bshad bya ba/ /dngos grub shin tu rtag pa ste/ /gang gis misrid pa 'di nyid la/ /dngos grub rtag pa thob byed pa'o/ /'di yis byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /srid par gnas shing srid par sangs/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug grub/ /rtag tu sems can kun don byed/ / 'di yi ci /skaltar mchog grub pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod sogs 8pas/ /dge ba'i tshul ni nya tshogazhan gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas kun sogs nyushethob mi 'gyur/ /'dul nyurtabya min pa bsod nams med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /rnam pa kun du mthong sogs )kyis/ /sems can don byed mi nus so/ /de bas rgyud chen las grub 85wa 599

pa / /sangs rgyas sam ①ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthong la sogs pa ②sems can don//nam mkha' mnyam par ②byed pa yin④/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /srid pa'i nges pa dri ma med/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs pa'am⑤ bsod nams med pa'am le lo can/ /de yang kun mchog grub pa yis0 tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyuraX/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas don yod cing ⑧thogs pa med pa myur du sgrub pa'i mchog rjes su bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /lugs ma 'am ni brkos ⑨pa 'am/ /byas pa 'am ni bris pa yi/ /dang po'i sems dpa' ⑩brtags 0nas ni/ /mdun du de ni bsgrub ⑫par bya/ /nyin re zhing ni dang po ru/ /de bzhin yul dang ldan gyur pas/ /dang po'i gsang mchog gis bkug 'orteste/ /phyag rgya chen po rab ④byin brlabatso/ /rdo rje mig gis de bzhin bltas/ /rdo rje bsnyems hustetshul bdag po rang 0 rdo rje hūṃ ni glur blangs pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub par bya/ / rdo rje 8cha lugs ci bzhin du/ /mchog gi dang po rab tu dgyes4)/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs dang por ni/ /ci 'dod par ni rab tu bsgrub( — sta/ /'di yis 'dod pa kun dbang phyug /'dod pa tsam gyis zhunye'agro 'ong lding / /dngos grub kun gyis tsodabang phyug grub/ /kun mchog dam pa'i (snyedabang phyug yin/ /phun sum butshogs kun bdag thams cadang snye/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /thams cad 'jug 29mdzad sna tshogs pa/ /rtag par kun du 'dul ba'o(rte/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba mchog /phyag rgya kun bdag dbang phyug yin/ /rdo rje kun 85wa 600

gyi dngos grub che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'byung gnas che/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pa/ /thams cad byed cing kun gyi gnas/ /khams gsum las rgyal sna tshogs pa/ /tshar gcod pa dang phan 'dogs pa/ /kun la rjes chags kun gyi mchog /kun rig dngos grub thams cad ster①/ / 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /②rang gi rnam 'phrul rab ston byed/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po'i ②dbang phyug che/ /gzugs dang tshe ④stobs rdo rje mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis pa bzhin/ /'gro ba rnams kyis mchod cing brjodadu/ /rang gi gnyen rnams kyis brten ⑥pa/ /rgyal po rdo rje 'chang chen ltar/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /gal te rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems nyid 'dod/ /dngos grub ci ltar 'dod pa nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub 9)par 'gyur/ /phyi ma 'am ni 'jig rten pali/ /rtog pa kun bshad cho ga 'am/ /rang nyid kyis mdzad kyis rtag tu/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub ⑨'gyur zhes/ /bcom ldan rdo rje dngos grub kyiphya/ /dbang phyug bde ba chen po ni/ /rdo rje 'chang ba che ⑩rgyal po/ /kun mchog sa yi 8dbang pos gsungs/ /de la ci ltar na rang gi phyag rgya sgrub 8pa'i rgyud yin zhe na/ phyag rgya chen por skomanyam gzhag la/ /rang gi snying pos 8lan cig tsosgrub / /dṛ ⑩bha su to ṣpe si rakta/ su po siddha ta la gu/ de la ci ltar yi ge hūṃ gi glu blangs pa'i /3rgyud yin zhe na/ ri dhi ta sogs ⑩kyis brgyan dzña )ldan/ /ci nus pa dang ci dga' dang / /gaṇḍi phyal sogs byagru blangs pa'i/ /yi ge hūm̐ gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya thams cad kyi/ /mchog de sgrub pa'i rgyud bshad de/ /gal te phyag rgya sgrub 'dod na/ /de bzhin yul dang ldan gyur pas//85—601

rang nyid kyis ①ni rgya bcings la/ /yongs su mi skyo'i bar du bsgrub(kye/ /de la ci ltar na (kyedam tshig thams cad grub pa'i rgyud yin ④zhe na/ dam tshig phyag rgya bcings (5)nas ni/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ (nyazhes brjod la/ /rang gi snying gar tso)rim bzhin du/ /phyag rgya'i mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya'i ⑤mchog sgrub rirsha) pa'i rgyud 7ni/ rdo rje gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /yongs su mi skyo'i bar 37bsgrubs na/ /mchod pa kun sogs tu las rnams ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub 3 par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'chang chen nyid dang ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyidarngu/ /gzhan yang dngos grub thams cad ni/ /dam pa 8myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtog pa thams cad kyi 8sgrub pa chen po don yod par 'grub hu tshopa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do// //de nas rtog pa thams cad sgrub (18pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud ni/ nyin re zhing dang por lan cig pophyag rgya bsgrub par 2 )don yod pa dngos grub thogs pa med par tsho 1bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /thams cad rjes su mnyes par bya ba dang / dgug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba bsgrub 22pa la ni bde ba chen po'i na rdo rje lta bas so mi/ /bde ba dang yid bde ba dang phun sum tshogs pa dang dngos grub thams cad mngon mipar 'phel bar bya ba la ni bde ba chen po'i ri lhardo rje chos 2 tshoso/ /tshe dang lang tsho dang gzugs dang gzi byin 22chen po mngon par 'phel bar bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje bcud kyis len gyis so/ /dpal chen po dang skal pa 29bzang po dang / grags pa dang /snyan pa 'phel bar bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje grub pas so/ /stobs chen po dang /85wa 602

ye shes dang / chos dang las bsgrub par bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje snying stobs che bas so/ /rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul dang rmad du byung ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad ston pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje'i rnam par 'phrul pas so/ /thams cad du yi ge dang gzugs kyi (7bden pa thams cad mthong ba dang thos pa dang smra ba dang 'dri ba grub par bya ba la ni dang po'i (kyerdo rje don yod pa'i bden pas so/ /dbang po thams cad kyis (kyebaden pa tham/sa cad mthong ba dang thos pa dang smra ba dang zil gyis gnon 94)par bya ba la (snyeni dang po'i rdo rje don yod pa'i bden pas so/ /sgyu ma thams cad dang bde ba'i mchog dang lung bsgo (nab dang lan thob pa grub pa la (7)dang po'i rdo rje rmad du byung tshoshe)bas so/ /gter thams cad dbyung ba dang nor dbrog pa dang rgyal srid thob pa dang / sa la nye bar longs spyod pa la ni dang po'i rdo rjes (9)dbang bskur bas so/ /yul thams cad dang boskye bo dang grong khyer dang / nags dang chu bor nye bar longs spyod pa 'o:sprul pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje grub pas so/ /thams cad las sngon 3 ma byung ba'i lha yul dang rin po che dang kha zas dang btung nyudeb dang g.yog 'khor tsol sogs pa sprul tenyuge/ nye bar longs spyod pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje sprul pas so/ /skad cig gis sa gzhi hu9thams cad 'bru la sogs pa nyu smin par bskyed 3)pa dang /chu'i phung po chen po 'byung ba dang / snang ba chen po bskyed (17pa dang rlung thams cad dbang du bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje dbyings kyi ri byedabang phyug gis so/ /rgyu ba dzo 7dang mi rgyu ba'i dngos po thams cad bza' ba dang btung ba dang rang rtser —rtegazhug pa dang las thams cad la sbyar na ba la ni/ dang po'i rdo rje don yod pa'i thams cad dbang du byed pas so/ /dngos grub thams cad las de bzhin 85wa 603

gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang rdo rje 'dzin pa dang rdo rje la sogs pa stimathong ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje'i bsnyems ②pas so/ /rang gi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad sprul cing ston pa/ mi snang ba dang nam mkhar 'gro ba grub pa dang / shin tu phra ba dang sbom pa dang du mar ston pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje gzugs sna tshogs pas so/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag por gyur pa ②thams cad dbab pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang bcing ba dang ④/ las thams cad la sbyar ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje rgyu mdzad kyis so/ /lha thams cad dbab pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang las ⑤thams cad la ⑥nges par sbyar ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje lha'i bdag pos so/ /klu thams cad gdon pa dang / 'dul ba dang dbang du bya ba dang las thams cad la nges par sbyar bar bya 97rib la ni dang po'i rdo rje 'bar ba'i rdo rjes so/ /gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad dgug (kyepa dang dbang du bya ba dang las thams cad la nges par sbyar bar bya ba dang rtsi)skrag par bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje gdon 'dul bas so / /dkyil 'khor thams cad brtag ⑩pa dang 'jug pa dang mchod hunyepa dang bsgrub 'o pa dang las thams cad la nges par sbyar bar bya ba la ni dang po'i rdo rje 'khor los so/ /phyag rgya thams cad dgug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang brtan par bya ba dang bsgrub hu pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje phyag rgya 7grub pas so/ /dam tshig thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang bsgrub snyipa la ni dang po'i rdo rje dam tshig mchog 7gis so/ /las thams cad rab tu bsgrub hu)pa la / rnam par hunyemi 'jigs par bya ba dang brtan phostepar bya ba dang grags pa chen po rab tu bsgrags pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje las kyis so/ /rdo rje thams cad 85wa 604

dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba bsgrub ①pa la ni dang po'i rdo rjes so/ /sems dpa' chen po thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba bsgrub ②pa la ni dang po'i rdo rje sems dpas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba bsgrub ②pa la ni dang po'i de bzhin gshegs pas so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ④ba dang dbang du bya ba la ⑤ni dang po'i rdo rje 'dzin pas so zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs pa'am/ /sdig pa thams cad byas pa 'am/ /rang gi snying po ma bsgrubs pa'am(na / /dngos grub thams cad grub par 'gyurasti/ /ma bsgrubs par ⑧thams cad 'grub bodhi/ /don yod par 7grub pa phyag rgya chen po humachog tu grub pa'o// //de nas dang po'i snying po ma bsgrubs de/pa'i thams cad don yod pa thogs pa med pa las thams cad kyi rgyu skad cig la bsgrub 0pa rjes su bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje thams cad kyi sna tshogs pa'i phrin tsolas rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /don yod pa dang 8thogs ②med pa/ /bdag kyang bde gshegs lhan cig tu/ /las kyi rab 'byam ⑩'di dag ni/ /dngos grub skad cig gis grub 8byed/ /'di lta ste thams cad shin tu bsrung yib dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang zhi ba dang bde legs su bya ba dang tshe mngon par ༷ — )'phel bar bya ba la ni dzu nyerdo rje gar gyi sems dpa'i tshul gtsug tor 3gyi phyag rgyas so/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mtshams 3dang phyogs dang dam tshig dang dngos grub 85—605

bcing ①zhing bsrung (sne ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi so sor la'abrang ba chen pos so/ /nyin gsum pa dang nyin bzhi pa dang slar zlos ④pa dang rtag pa can ⑤dang khyab 'jug gi rims thams cad bsal yib la ni rdo rje gar gyi rims tsond med pas sol/ /gdung ba thams cad dang gnod byed dang nad dang mya ngan dang sdug bsngal thams cad gzhig pa /shel ni rdo rje gar gyi ②sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bas so0//dug dang sbyar ba'i dug las 32nye bar thar ba dang dbab pa dang bcing ba dang bza' ba dang bdud rtsir bya ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi nye ba'i dug gis so/ /gdon thams cad dbab pa dang bcing ba dang dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug pa dang rab tu gdul ba dang / bsrung 712ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi 3degadon las thar ba'o thams cad la bcing ba dang thar ba dang dral ba dang ltung ba dang ldang ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi rdo rje chen po'i khro bos so/ /mkha' 'gro cham thams cad kyi phyag rgya gzhig pa dang gdon las thar bar bya ba dang shi ba bslang bar bya 3 ba dang tshe mngon 8par 'phel ba dang shin tu bsrung pho tshob la ni rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya'i lan gyis so/ /sgrib pa thams cad dang / sdig pa thams cad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang /ltas ngan pa dang byur gzhig pa la ni rdo rje gar gyi zhi bas so/ /thams cad dbab pa dang / bskyod pa dang gar byed du gzhug pa dang thams cad bden par smrar 32gzhug pa dang / pra nyirte se na 3 )thams cad bsgrub 2nyapa la ni rdo rje gar gyi 32thams cad 'bebs snyepa'i phyag rgyas so/ /thams cad rgyas gdab pa dang gsad tsho 9pa dang ltung bar bya ba dang bslang ba dang / slar tsho gegaso ba la ni don yod grub rdzo 5pa'i rdo rje gar gyi tsho tshomakha' 'gro ma chen mos so/ /tham/sa cad rengs par bya ba dang rmongs par bya ba dang gnyid log par bya ba dang gsad sbyo nyepa dang 85wa 606

bza' ①bar bya ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi gdug pa'i srin pos so/ /gzhan gyi dpung thams cad skrag par bya ba dang gzhig par bya ba dang dbang du bya ba dang lhung bar bya ba dang gsad ②par bya ba la ni rdo rje gar gyi gshed byed kyis so/ /khro bo thams cad gsal ②ba dang bzhin ras dang bar bya ba dang rtsod ④pa las rgyal ba dang 'jigs pa las thar ba dang g.yul 'gyed pa las rgyal ba ⑤bsgrub (6)pa la ni rdo rje gar gyi rgyal mtshan mchog gi dpung rgyan ⑦gyis so/ /sprin thams cad yang dag par bzung tshogezhing mi g.yo bar bya ba dang char chen po dbab pa dang rlung dang char pa dang glog dang ⑨ser ba bzlog pa dang dro ba dang grang ba bsal ba la rtso )ni/rdo rje gar gyi dbang po'i rdo rjes so/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya thams cad shin tu grub pa la ni/ rdo rje gar gyi 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis so/ /rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rjes su chags pa dang dgug pa dang dbang du bya ba dang rtse ba dang las thams cad la nges par sbyar ba la ni/ rdo rje gar gyi dngos grub thams cad kyis so/ /lha thams cad dbab pa dang klu hunyethams cad dbang du bya ba dang / gnod sbyin dang 'byung po dang ma mo thams cad las tshil nges par sbyar ba la ni/ rdo rje gar gyi rdo rje sku'i (snyemachog gis so/ /rnam thos sras mnan nas dpal drang ba dang / lha'i bu mo thams cad rab tu dbrog ④pa dang / lha dang lha ma yin gyi bud med thams cad dang martse ba dang 'jig rten gsum ma lus pa las rgyal ba dang 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thams cad las rgyal ba dang dbang phyug chen po thams cad dbrog 7pa la ni rdo rje gar gyi skyes bu byed pa chen pos so//mchod pa thams cad sgrub pa dang / thams cad rdo rjer pho bya ba dang bdud la sogs pa mthams cad rab tu gzhom pa dang / phyag rgya thams cad bcing ba dang 85—607

dngos grub kyi mchog la sogs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi las kyi rgyu 7myur du grub par bya ba la ni/ rdo rje gar gyi don yod cing /thogs pa med pa myur ba'i las sna tshogs kyi ②dngos grub dam pas ①so// //de nas phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub ④pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud ni⑤/ nyin re dang po lan cig ⑥ni/ /phyag rgya ④thams cad rab sgrub (nyebyed/ /snying mchog lan cig ⑨bzlas nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po rab grub ⑩bya/ / de yi 7rjes la ⑫nye snying po/ /las rnams kun la nges sbyar bas/ /don yod grub pas las rnams ni/ /kun la shin tu 'grub tsho/3par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya thams cad rab byin rlob / /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag bergya ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang ma mthong btso/ /ma bshad pa la'ang rab 'grub 16'gyur/ /rtog 'dir ⑩'jigs 8pa yod min te / /'khor lo med la brgya byin la/ /gang phyir bdag la byin rlob pas/ /rang sras rgyu ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang ⑩/ /bsam pa shes nas sbyin par bya/ /'di dag bcings tsam nyid dag byed/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po bde ba chen po'i rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig gi cho ga rgyas pa'i rtog pa'o// //de nas ston pa rdo rje du — )'dzin/ /'byin pa byed pa bde ba che/ /bde chen can du brtan ༅phyir dang / /sems can thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /khams kun dang mnyam zad pa med/ /kun gyi bdag nyid la zhugs te/ /mnyam pa'i dngos grub mchog spros nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs phyung ngo / /mtha' 85—608

yas pa yi zhing thams cad/ /'jig rten kun gyi khams bcas pas/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin myur gang / /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun mdun yang dag bzhugs/ /sems can thams cad ma dag pas①/ /rang rig las kyis dag ma ②'gyur / /de tshe sems can khams rnams ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni gso dka'i ④phyir/ /rang gi las ni sbyang ⑤don du/ /btang snyoms chen po mdzad pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /sems dpa' chen po bde ba che/ /byang chub chen por thugs brtan pas/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag bskul/ /sems can la phan bsod nams canayi/ /byang chub sems ni brtan pa dag /sems can khams ni rgyad ⑦'gyur bas/ /shin tu btang snyoms ma mdzad cig /de nas sangs rgyas kyis ②gsungs pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyi ⑨ thabs / /byang chub sems mchog khyod smros shig /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /de tshe kun nas byin gyis brlabs/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yin/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya khyon gyisam/ /'khor lo chen po gdod nas byung / / de yi nyunyekhams gsum gnas pa yis/ /sems can thams cad yang dag bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs 8dngos grub la/ /de tshe dag pa 'grub nyunyepar 'gyur/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad ni8/ /'dus nas gsol ba 'debs mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs chen pobla/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog bshad du gsol/ /de ni yisangs rgyas thams cad kyi'ome/ /sku gsung thugs la yang dag gnas/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje la/ /yang dag spros te 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ bhū 'kho/ de nas 'di ni gsungs the tsam gyis/ /85—609

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /bdud bcom la sogs mdzad nas ni/ /byang chub snying por byin gyis brlabs/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ①ni mchog gsungs pa/ /sems can kun la (babade don phyir/ /rtog pa kun gyi bde ba che/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol mchog /rdo rje 'khor lo yang dag bri / /'khor lo lte bar sangs rgyas nyid/ /'dzum pa'i tshems ni mi snang ba/ /su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ/ /oṃ sid dha māṃ zhes brjod dgod/ /mdun du bdud las rnam rgyal b.rapo —sku/ /mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas yang dag bri/ /g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /nor chen pos ni dbang bskur ba/ /rgyab tu byang chub sems dpa' dang / /mnyam du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /g.yon du log par rnam dregs pa/ /sdig pa bsdus pa kun ④'byin pa'o/ /de nas 'di rnams kyi snying po ni/ /badzra satwa/ badzra ratna/ badzra dharma/ badzra kurma/ de nas phyag rgya rnams te/ satwa bsgyu/ ratna brdzu/ padma badzī/ bi shwa brdzu/ mtshams snikyi char ni rdo rje dang / /rin chen sdong bu nor bu bri'o6)/ /mtshams ⑦rnams su yang (8)lha mo ste/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo rnams su'o99)/ /de bzhin snga ma ci lta bar / /'khor lo de ni brtag 41 )par bya/ /mchod pa'i thal mo snying gar bcing 31/ /g.yon du de bzhin bskor bar bya/ /me tog dang bcas phyag rgya 'di / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig rim/ /me tog bcas te snying gar rtso bcing la/ /bsam pa g.yos pas gdung bar bya/ /mgon la mgo bos phyag byas la / /bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ni/ /zhugs nas me tog 'dor 8bar bya/ /shin tu gsang ba yang dag dgug /de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes 85—610

par bya ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang dgug pa dang bsgrub par bya ba'i snying po ni 3)'di yin te/ oṃ a kā (miro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā aḥ.āṅgā nutpanda tadago/ de nas cho ga ji bzhin du/ /ston la me tog sil ma dor/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub (nyaphyir/ /'gro ba'i mgon la de nyid brjod/ /de yis kun nas sangs rgyas ni/ /thams cad 'dus pa nyid du 'gyur/ /thams cad mi dmigs sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol bar mdzadayi/ /dkyil 'khor der zhugs pa la ni/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dga' ba la sogs mtshan ma mchog /sna tshogs pa (peni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin cho ga ni/ /rgyas pas slob ma mchog tu gzhug(8) /mchod pa'i thal mos 'khor lo che/ /mchod pa byas nas slar dbyung ⑨bya/ /sgrub pa byas nas dngos grub kyang / /cho ga ci bzhin rab bshad bya/ /ras 57la bcom ldan bdud la sogs / /rnam par rgyal ba brnyes 37par bri/ /sgrub /nya'adi lan cig 8tsam gyis ni / /de 'dra'i sgrub pas 'grub 8par 'gyuranyuge/ /sku gzugs sogs tsamadun yang dag par/ /ye shes khu tshur yongs bzung la/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis 51 1cho ga bzhin / /bzlas brjod stong phrag brgya nyusnyebya'o/ /mdor na 'bum ni rdzogs pa na//ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad dang / /tshe mchog 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom nyu6med/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i sgrub pa chen po'i rgyud ni/ phyag rgya gang rung ri stagacig bcings nas/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas yin bsgoms na/ /phyag rgya chen po'i —rjedangos grub che/ / brtan pa na myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig sgrub ri ri pa'i rgyud ni/snying gar ( sterdo rje gzugs bzhag ste/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes brjod la/ /bzlas 85—611

brjod 'bum gyis bsgrubs ①nas ni/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya thams cad sgrub ②pa'i rgyud ni/ bdud las rgyal ba'i mchog bcings te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /mtshungs med sems can don byas nasal/ /las kyi phyag rgya rtag tu 'grub/ /ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi mchog sgrub ④pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do// //de nas ma bsgrubs dngos grub mchog /las rnams rab 'byam ⑤dam ⑥pa ste / /sdig pa kun sel sna tshogs pa/ /go rims ⑦bzhin du rab bshad bya/ /'di lta ste nad thams cad dang mya ngan dang gnod pa dang gnod byed dang dug thams cad ⑧dang sbyar ba'i dug dang gshed byed dang / g.yengs ⑨byed dang ro langs dang sngags dang sman dang bgegs dang log 'dren dang sdig pa dang rmi tu 'elam ngan pa dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang rims dang gdon dang mkha' 'gro ⑪ma dang nye bar 'tshe ba dang 'go ba'i nad dang nyes pa dang ⑩nyon mongs pa dang lus dang ngag dang sems kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par bshig pa la ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 32sdug bsngal 'phrog par byed 8pas so/ /tshe dang lang tsho dang gzugs dang kha dog dang gzi byin chen po dang mdangs dang stobs dang spro ba dang brtson 'grus dang dpal dang skal ba 8bzang po dang bsod nams dang ming dang snyan pa dang grags pa dang dran pa dang blo gros dang brtan pa dang rtogs 7pa dang stobs dang ting nge 'dzin dang phung po dang 'du byed dang sku dang gsung dang thugs 'phel ba la ⑩ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 85—612

thams cad kyi bde ba chen pos so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab dang ye shes dang stobs dang thabs dang rdo rje dang bsgrub ①pa dang gzungs dang sa dang spyod pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang chos dang las dang sna tshogs pa'i bya ba dang sems can gyi don dang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i don dang sku dang gsung dang thugs dang rdo rje chen po (migrub pa la ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thams cad kyis so / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①byang chub tu ④sems bskyed pa dang ⑤/ kun tu bzang po'i cho ga spyod ⑥pa rdzogs par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don dang 'pho ba dang skye ba'i sa dang gzhon nu'i rol pa ston pa dang mngon par byung ⑦ba dang dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang bdud thams cad 'dul ba dang / byang chub chen por mngon par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mu stegs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang / lha las babs pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i byin gyis brlab 'a)pa dang gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba dang 'dul ba la rab tu bzhag (9dpa dang / ngan 'gro thams cad las 'don pa dang mdo sde thams cad ston par mdzad pa dang rtog hu byepa thams cad byin gyis brlab (7pa dang dngos grub hu thams cad stsol ba hurtedang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la chadamigs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul bsgrub 7pa la ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sna tshogs kyi rdo rjes so/ /ci ltar phyag rgya 'di dag gis/ /byang chub sems la 85—613

mngon brten ②pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod sogs ②kyis/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /don yod bsod nams chadam pa yil/ /las kyi rab 'byam 2sgrub byed pa/ /cho ga ma grub pa rnams grub/ /sangs rgyas chos ni rab ster byed/ /rnam pa kun tu dang ldan pa'i/ /sems can kun la sbyin par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs pa/ /skad cig gis ni sbyor bar byed/ /dpal mchog dang po'i tsho6)rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po stilas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ byang chub rdo rje byin gyis brlabs tsho8)pa'i rdo rje'i stirtog pa rgyas pa'o// //de nas sna tshogs las chen po/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba'i mchog /sems can kun la rjes ston mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bskyed pas7/ /gang phyir nyes byas kyis gdug pa'i/lha / /rang gi rang sems spyod pa nyu3yis/ /zhi bas sems can kun gyi don/ /gdul ba 51lharab tu bsgrub 14mi nus/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsgrub bya ba'osnye/ / 'gro ba 'di dag 7thams cad yin/ /gang tshe bde gshegs sems can don/ /dam pa mdzad par mi spyod pa51 / /de tshe nyid kyi 32dngos po kun/ /gtso bos rdo rje gsol ba btab/ /sems can thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab/ /utiṣṭha /spus ma ya gro dha 3 )ni sum bha dzā /rmil badzra hūṃ/de nas sngags ( —rte'adi snyegasungs tsam gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje rang nyid gtso/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /slar byung nas ni mdun na gnas/ /khro chen rgyal po'i sku yis ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 3stelegs bzhugs/ /'bar ba'i 85—614

phreng 'od kyis gsal 0)ba/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa gzhan 'dra ba/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje bsnyems (0pa che/ /drag tu gsor bas bskyod (mimadzad cing / /'bar ba'i rdo rje cher 'bar ba/ /rnam par 'phro bas (bsreg pa 'dra(snye/ /'bar ba chen pos (6)gsod pa ni/ /bskal pa'i me yi tso)phung po 'dra/ /dang po'i rdo rje khro gnyer bcas / /rdo rje mchog nye'adzin pas gsungs pa/ de la rdo rje chen po (9)me dang nyi ma ltar 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i 7snying po 'di yin te hūṃ/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sdig pa kun gyi bud shing zad/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'jig rten gsum/ /thams cad g.yos shing 'gul nyi bar 'gyur/ /lha chen la sogs lha rnams ni/ /g.yo ba med cing rmongs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'khrugs pa kun/ /de bzhin 'jig pa lta bur 'gyuranyu2/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal rnams/ /mya ngan 'das par nye bar 'gro/ /lha la sogs pa'i srid gsum kun / /de tshe kun tu rmongs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yisahunye / /sangs rgyas byang chub yang bstan mdzad/ /sems dpa' kun gyi thabs chen po/ /dim pa yang ni thugs su chud/ /de nas rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchog /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje mche hu rib gtsigs pa'i zhal / /zhal ras khro dang bcas pa yin/ /g.yon brkyang skobs ni legs par bzhugasal/ /spyan 'bar 'jigs su rung ba ste/ /dbu 57spa gyen du brjes shing g.yo / /kun nas 'khyil cing 'bar ba che/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i rnal 'byor che/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi lus can rnams/ /phyung nas kun tu 'gro ba rnams/ /thams cad du ni 'bar ba 1 7'khrug /rlung bskyod bskal pa'i 12me lta bur/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba kun tu 'khrugs/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus na/ /85—615

sangs rgyas thams cad sras bcas pa/ /yang dag bzhugs ①pa legs bskul te//'jig rten thams cad yongs su bskor/ /bkug nas sems can kun don dang ske/ /bstan ②pa thams cad 'grub pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten gsum bdag ②de rnams dang / /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sems med byas/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos / /kun mchog sa ④yi dbang phyug (geni/ /de rnams la ni thugs rje yis/ /'chi ba slar gso brtan por gsungs(6)/ oṃ ustiṣṭha ⑦ma hā a budhi pa ti ⑨badzi ṇi'i / shī 0uta hu)shā 8pa ya hūṃ/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad bslang ba'o/ /de nas sa gsum bslang ba 8nithoge/ /thams cad du ni shi ba gso/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bos btul gyur cing / /rdo rje can gyis kyang rjes btul/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin khro bos7/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor byed cing / /nga yi dam tshig la gnas zhes/ /sna tshogs pa la bka' rab bsgo/ /de rnams kyis gsol ba/'di su zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das hu 〉ni zhi ba la/ /gnod sbyin gzugs can gang lags gsungs/ /khyed kyis (snyedam tshig ci 'dra ba/ /zhus pa bden pa'i tsa)tshig tu gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rnam grol ba/ /gdod skyes rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /dkon mchog gsum dang de bzhin du/ /nga ( )la skyabs su 'gro bar gyis/ /'jig rten gsum pos 9 spe'adi thos nas/ /tshogs bdag tshogs kyi dbang phyug bcas/ /bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu yi/ /'bar ba'i mtshon gyis 'thab par brtsams/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag gis ni sangs rgyas rigs/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin shes ma yin/ /bdag cag 'jig rten gsum po gcigasonye /gnod sbyin bsgo 2nyebs ci zhig 2stebya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin khros nas/ /khro gnyer dpral bar 85—616

bsdus te ①gnas/ /de nas khro gnyer thams cad ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rjes su spyod/ /g.yon pa bsnyems ②pa rgya bcas pas/ /smin zhum spyan bsdus pas dgod ④cing / /nam mkha' khyab pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /drag phya)du khros bcas pas smras so/ /de la khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i nye ba'i snying po sems can ma lus pa las rgyal ba ⑥ni 'di yin te/ hi/ de nas snying po 'di phyung bas/ / nges rgyal ⑦bcu gcig (8)bcings pa dang / /dam tshig brtan pa 'dzin du bcug /rdo rje ming gis ⑨dbang bskur nas/ /lag na rdo rje 'dzin mchog byas/ /rdo rje ming ni byin nas su/ /'jig rten gsum po'i ⑩ting 'dzin bzhag /de nas rdo rje chen po mchog /mgon po yis ni gsol ⑩btab pa/ /sems can kun la rjes ston pas/ /rtog pa 'di ni bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol tu/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo yang dag bri// de yi tsodabus su gzhag bya ba/ /sngon po 'bar ba'i tsogazugs bzang ba /zhal gyi mche ④ba cung zad gtsigs/ /zhal ni khro dang bcas pas bzhad/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis tsolegs bzhugs/ /bsnyems bcas shas cher 'bar ba la/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i 'od 'khrugs pa'i0/ /rdo rje gsol bar 'o snamadzad la brtson/ / de yi 8dngos 37ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi du )gzugs / /rdo rje mtshon cha mdung chen dang / /ral gri hunyezhags pa mtshon 'dzin pa me / /mtshams su mda' dang kha ṭī ga /'khor lo ba dan sna tshogs 'dzin/ /rdo rje'i 3rigs ni sna tshogs pa/ /'bar ba'i 'khor los zhusteyongs su bskor/ /dkyil 'khor dgod par bya ba ni/ /thig bdun gyis ni yang dag tu/ /dang po rdo rje phyag rgya bdag /gnyis pa sngags kyi lha mo ste/ /gsum par ༷ snyerdo rje rgyal po 85—617

ni / /rdo rje lha mos hu)yang dag bskor/ /rdo rje chen mo (bsgeg mo che/ /bzhi par klu mkhan ma la sogs/ /rgyal rigs gsol ka bran rnams kyil/ /khro bo rnams ni lnga pa lasnyi/ /drug par rdo rje pho nya mchog /gnod sbyin srin po skang ka ra / /dbang phyug dam pa drag po sogs(5na/ /gtum po chen po 'dul bar mdzad / /phyi yi (6)dkyil 'khor dbyibs rnams su/ /mdor na ming po gsum la sogs / /lha la sogs pa'i tshogs thams cad/ /legs par bri ba'am (7)gzhag par bya/ /mtshams 9na su lha mor 99cirab bshad pa/ /de rnams kyi ni sgo dbus su'amanyu )la/ / rdo rje 31lcags kyu sogs khro bcas/rta/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis ni/ /go rims 1snyedag ni ji bzhin dang 'i/ /cho ga rgyas pa ji bzhin bya/ /khros pas rdo rje rigegasor ba dang / /khro gnyer 'dzum dang bcas pas 'dudasko/ /de nas khro zhing slob dpon che/ /rdo rje can mchog rab zhugs la/ /rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad kyis sdigs nyu mdzub/ /ju mdzad rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /bsnyems 'osnyedang bcas pas rgyas gdab nyid/ /de bzhin khro bas 'dul 36ba la/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dgyes 3 )pa yis/ /gdug pa nyid la rab tu dgyes/ /de nas me tog blangs nas ni/ /khros pas bdag po che la gtor/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lcags kyu ches / /yang dag par ni 1dgug par bya/ /oṃ ma hā badzra dzā 3 la yā na lārka 22ya hi dzaḥ ri/ sarba badzra ku la pra be nagasha ya hūṃ/ sarba mu ṭwāṃ ga nā ban dha na tāṭa 5/sarba sa ma yaṃ na sā dha ya phaṭa/ sarba duhā 52na da ha pa tsa bhasmi 27ku ru ma hā kro dha a ka da ni badzre ṇa /rgyu phaṭa/ a a a a/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 2khro bo'i snye/ /rgyal po brtan pa che byon 'gyur/ /rdo rje rigs la sogs pa kun/ /dngos grub thams cad gsol bar mdzad/ /de nas rghaṃ la sogs pa'i sgra'iri ge/ /mtshan 85—618

ma rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gal te slob ma la sogs la/ /snying gar 0)dbab pa phra ba skye(gyi/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi(na / /phyag rgyas slob ma gzhug ( nipar bya/ /bcug nas dang po'i sems dpa' yi/ /rang gi snying po brjod par bya / hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra pra ha ra ṇi du༄phaṭa/ rtsu badzra shu la yā gri ṇi tri tiyo/ ma ta sa rghaṃ badzra konyu) ṣe tshirnya rta(2)/ oṃ badzra a ma la pā 7she ma ṭa/ rdo rje 'gugs pa dang rdo rje mdung dang rdo rje ral gri dang rdo rje zhags pa ste/ rdo rje khro bo'i srung 0ba'o/ /de nas 'di rnams kyi phyag rgya rdo rje don yod pa'i snamathogs pa hurtemed pa/ shin tu grub pa stobs dang pha rol gnon pa rnams sems can mngon par rgyas gdab par (rtenas pa rnams bskul bar bya'o/ / oṃ badzra gu hya 5shesid dha pa ra ma yo gī ⑫shwa ri hi/ rghaṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ho 19kha ṭwāṃ ga (1 tshom hā badzra ka pā cho1snyel ya ma ku te 3)ru lu ru lu ṇḍi hūṃ badzra nā rā ya ṇi 3 )dzi/ hūm̐ badzra pa ṭa ke dzi/ rdo rje khro bo'i mkha' 'gro ma lan cig bubazlas te dgod pa'am bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de kho na nyid kyi snying pos bzhugs tsho 2su gsol na/ /dngos rdo nyegrub thams cad la don yod pa'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig brjod par bya ste/sems can mang 28la bde phyir dang / /bstan pa thams cad 'grub pa'i phyir/ /gdug pa 'dul las tsho gebasod nams ni/ /'gyur zhes rdo rje 'dzin gyis gsungs//de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 9rgyu mdzad kyi 2 7phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mdzub rmo 8mo sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdug pa thams cad dang /bdud thams cad dang / 'jig rten gsum po thams cad yang dag par 'dul ba nyid du byin gyis rlob na par mdzad do/ /de nas dbang bskur ba rgyas pa la sogs pa de bzhin du byas la/ rdo rje khro bo'i )las bzhi pa la 1bslab par bya ste/85wa 619

phyag rgya rnams kyis sems can rnams rgyas gdab pa dang / phyag rgya gzhig pa dang gsad hu)pa dang slar 'tsho bar du bya'o/ /gang la phyag rgya sbyar ba ni 'chi bar 'gyur na (kyede ni gdug pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'tsho bar byed pa'i phyag rgyas 'tsho bar byas la/ shin tu bsrung ④ba rab tu sbyar ba byas na shin tu bsrung ⑤ba yin pa'i phyir/ /gdug pa rnams slar yang gnod par mi byed do/ /de nas brtsams te slob ma bzang / / rdo rje ⑥tshogs ni kun gyis kyang / /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod par/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas 'dir gasgrub bshad bya ste/ /ci bzhin sku ni dge 'dun du/ /rdo rje gsor zhing dang por ni/ /bzlas dukhubarjod stong phrag brgya bya'o/ /'bum tshang nas ni sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam mchog /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po mchog /rgas dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /gdug pa rnams ni rjes 'dul zhing / /sangs rgyas kun la rab mchod par/ /'jig rten gsum na 7legs snang zhing / /cis kyang 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /de nas de kho na nyid kyi snying po sgrub 7pa ni / 'greng ngam yang na 'dug pa 'am/ /'gro 'am 7nyal bar byed pa na8/ /ci lta 32de ltar 'bum bzlas na/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ④yis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug kun/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'gro 'ong lding / /dngos grub kun gyi tshedabang phyug grub/ /rga tsodang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /'gro ba rnams kyis 3 tshomachod pa dang / /rang gi nye du rnams kyis bsten8/ /gdug pa thams cad rjes 'dul zhing / /gang la 'jigs pa med par rgyu/ /zhes hu)bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dam pa sgrub pa nirdo sta/ ci bzhin dus su phyag rgya bcing / /bdag nyid nges ⑥85wa 620

par bsregs nas ni/ / ci srid nyid ①du khro chen po'i/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig sgrub ②pa ni/ /bdag ni thams cad gsad nibya zhes/ /brjod cing ⑤phyag na rdo rje yis/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /bzlas na rdo rje 'dzin 'grub 'gyur/ /de nas las rnams sgrub ⑤pa ni / /las rnams dam pa sgrub ⑥pa ni/ /rnam pa bzhir ni rab byed cing / /thams cad bde ba'i phyir zos na/ /rdo rje las nyid thob par 'gyur/ /sgrub stipa chen po ②cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do// //de nas dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ /rdo rje khro mchog rgyal po yi/ /las kyi rgyud ⑨ni dam pa rnams/ /go rims ⑩bzhin du bshad par bya/ /'di lta ste/ thams cad 0bsreg 8pa dang / bskrad pa dang / gzhig pa dang / rengs par bya ba (3dang ske/ gnyid log par bya ba dang / rgyas gdab pa dang / rmongs pa dang /gzhig pa dang / bcing ba ④dang / gzir ba dang / dral ba dang / brdeg skopa dang / 'bar ba dang / bsnyel ba dang / btso ⑩ba dang / gcad ⑩pa dang rka/ dbug 8pa dang / phye mar bya ba dang / gtor ba dang / rnam par gzhom 7pa dang / rims dang / dug dang / gdon gyis zin du gzhug pa dang ske/ smyo bar du bya ba dang / gsad ༅par bya ba la ni rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyis so/ /thams cad dgug ④par bya ba dang / nges par bkod na pa dang / / bskyod pa dang lge/ gar byed du gzhug pa dang / glu len du gzhug pa dang / brgyal du gzhug pa dang / rtser tsogazhug pa dang / ha ha zhes dgod mdu gzhug pa dang /'khor ba dang / drang ba dang / 'od du gzhug pa dang / bsgom pa dang /rmo tre 185—621

nub par bya ba dang / dbyung ba dang / 'phang ba dang / nye bar 'degs par ti bya ba dang / bskur tshogerab dang / nga ro 'don par bya ba dang / ngur gzhug pa (8)dang / rang nyid brdeg par bya ba dang / 'ching bar bya ba dang /skra 'bal (gebar bya ba dang / zhe 'gras par bya ba dang / gos bshu ba dang /khro ba 'bar bar bya ba la ni khro bo'i gdan gyi tshanaphyag rgyas so/ /thams cad dgug pa pormedang / gzhug pa dang / dbab pa dang / pra se na bsgrub 9)༄pa dang /bden par rdo smra bar bya 99ri ba dang / sgyu ma ston pa dang nya dī/ lan ston pa 7dang /dus tshigs kyi 'khor lo yongs su bzlog pa dang / dus ma yin par shing las me tog dang nyarte'abras bu smin par byed par ston pa dang / 'bru thams cad yang dag par ston par bya ba 1snyedang / rims dang / sbyar bidug dang / gdon dang ske/15 dug dang / mkha' 'gro ma las thar bar bya ba dang / g.yul 'gyed pa thams cad las thar bar bya ba dang / gzhan gyi dpung gzhom pa dang /phyogs dang / mtshams 17dang / dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / shin tu bsrung 1 ba dang / yongs su skyob par bya ba dang / thar bar bya ba dang / bslang ba dang ske/ dbang du bya ba la ni khro bo chen po sna tshogs grub pas so/ /lha la sogs pa 18thams cad ltung bar bya ba dang / klu gdon par bya ba 19dang / gnod sbyin rjes su 'brang bar bya ba 2 dang / srin po skrag pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad btul ba ri 1dang / bdud kyi dpung thams cad gzhom pa dang / ma mo rnams 'dul 22ba dang / gdug pa'i tshogs rnam par gtor ba dang / gdug pa rnams tshar gcad na pa dang / 'dum pa dang /'jigs pa med pa 4yang dag par bskyed pa dang / nor bu bzang po dbang du 85wa 622

bya ba dang ①/ nor sbyin las nor ②thams cad dbrog pa dang / rnam thos sras mnan nas dpal drang ba dang / lha'i bu mo gzhon nu ma thams cad dang rtse sa tsho'ajo bya ba dang / brgya byin mnan nas bde sogs ④/ma dbrog pa dang / skem tshibyed tshar gcad ⑥pa dang / tshangs pa lhung bar bya ba dang / khyab 'jug gdul 97༄ba dang / dbang phyug chen po las rnam par rgyal ba dang / 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mnan nas dga' ba mo dbrog pa dang / rdo rje bsgrub ༷8)pa dang / byang chub chen po (rshaci bsgrub bopa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya ba dang / dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / dam tshig gis tebacing ba dang /dbang du bya ba 8bsgrub 7nyepa la ni rdo rje khro bo chen po rgyal po dam pa'i dngos grub kyis so zhes kyang gsungs so/ /lan cig skobazlas pas mchog grub pa/ /thog ma'i rtsa snying bzang lan ciganyage / de yi tshe'og du khro gnyer gyis/ /bsgrub bya thams cad dgug nya tshopa yin/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje me dang nyi ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i rtog pa'i cho ga 32rgyas pa'o(// //de nas ting 'dzin thams cad ni/ /rnam dag mchog gi chos nyid las/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang chen po ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gtso 'chen yin/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul don du/ /rang rig ) rin po rimache bskyed na 2/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi khro bo che snye/ /thabs med pas ni ( khuthabs yin no/ /'dod chags la sogs kun bsags pas/ /ma dag sems can khams rnams lhani/ /de rnams la ni rab spyod par/ /skyes bu mchog ni rnam par mkhyen/ /mchog tu 85wa 623

mi 'dul ba nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni mnga' mi mdzad/ /'jig rten kun na 'jig rten mchog /rang nyid ①bzang po bul snyoms zhugs/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa ②zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te gang la gzigs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khams gsum pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug thams cad nyid ⑤thugs su chud par gyur pa'o/ /bsnyems ⑤pas padma g.yon ⑥pa ni/ /bzung ④ste 'dab ma 'byed mdzad pas/ /ci nus pa yi gting 'dzin gyisasti/ /rang bzhin gyis ni gzigs par mdzad/ /ci ltar padma dmar po 'di/ /tshon 0gyi nyes pas mi gos pa/ /gnas kyi nyes pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /khams gsum pa ni de bzhin dag /'di la gzigs pa la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams ni dbang por gyur⑩//de yis rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug gyur/ /de nas skosgom pa'i snying po 'di/ /dag par bsgoms pas sgom pa nam/ /rdo rje 'chang ba chen po ni/ /padma chen po 'chang bar 'gyur/ /gser sbyangs ri yi dbang po ni8/ /rgyal po che dang mdangs tsomanyam pa/ /bsnyems pa g.yon pa'i pad mchog gitshe/ / g.yas pa mchog la rnam par gzigs/ /de nas padma'i 'dab ma la/ /padma chen po mchog 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'byung ba yi / /'khor lo rnams ni 'dul ba'i mchog /'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul mdzad pa / /bzhugs pa rab tu bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis ni/ /de la padma dge ba der/ /'gro ba thams cad rnam sbyong ba'i/ /botshul gyis ⑫'dul bar lho/mdzad pa na sta/ /padma'i rigs mchog ston pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba ⑰85—624

rnams kyis gsol ba btab/ /de nas thams cad 'dul mdzad cing / /shin tu dkar ba'i chos 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje chos te ①rang rgyal po/ /'jig rten dbang pos bka' stsal pa/ /phyi ni dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ / de yi ②dbus su spyan 'dzum pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dgod par bya/ /gser sbyangs lta bu'i padma ni/ /g.yon bsnyems ②tshul gyis gzigs mdzad pa/ /rgyal mtshan kun gyis rnam par spras/ /sangs rgyas sku mchog spyi bor bzhugs/ /de yi ngos ④ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas sku ni brgyad po bri/ /rang gi ting (pe'adzin ⑥padma che'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la rnam par gzigs / /'jig rten dbang po'i gzugs logs su/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rigs kyi lha/ /zhi ba srid med bu tshangs pa/ /'dod pa'i gzugs ni padma can//spyi bor 'tsher 0zhing mgrin 'degs pa/ /rta mgrin lcags kyu bcings nas ni/ /chos kyi tshig gis spyan drang ⑧bya/ /de nas padma'i snying po ni/ /sarba ta thā ga ta padma dzaḥlas badzra padma/ he padma/ padma bam̐/ ho padma ni rā dza/ de nas mtshams ⑩rnams su ni/ rgyu padme tsaṇḍi shwa /sher hūm̐/ he ma hā bi shwa padma tsurje chasirta 'ogergyu / maṭa hrīḥ8padma padmo 8rgyu a ho padma a shwa/ kra ma kra ma hūṃ dzaḥskya/dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis ni/ /cho ga rgyas pa nyurtebyas nas ni/ /padma chen po me tog bcas/ /ma yengs nyu)yid kyis phyag bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor zhugs nas ting nge 'dzin/ /las byung gzungs tushe'adi brjod par bya/ /oṃ bi sho dha ya/ ma nu sa ni shurta ma hā satwa/ dhā (3 tu sa ma ya zhunyesatwa/ rā ga dri pañtsa ye/ tsitta 3me sarba (nyes meji badzre ṇi tsitta shusteme sarba du gedha me shya dzi ni/ gzungs kyi phyag rgya gsan nas ni/ /dgyes pas ( 9padma 'dzin pa 'grubadu — sna/ /de nas mdzub mo 85wa 625

lcags kyur ①bcing / /chos kyi tshig gis dugelegs spyan drang (gyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba (nga lo ki 95༄sha ra padma hastayi/ ya hi shī sgro ma me ④badzra mu drwa a gri ④bya sa be sa ma yer ba dha bi shi ko pa'imi/ dzaḥrtso )rtsu baṃ hoḥ.a sho dha ya sarba sā dha ya ba ma me32ske/ ma hā badzra dha ra sdi(snye/ de nas 'jig rten mgon po mchog(8 /'jig rten 'dzin pa rtsonyerang nyid byon/ /'jig rten kun mchog 'grub tso'agyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin cho ga nges par mdzad/ /de nas de bzhin slob ma rnams/ /gzhug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni51 / /dngos grub thams cad sbyin pa yi8/ /ye shes dag ni bslab par bya/ /ting 'dzin snying po 'di yi ni/ /sgrub rsha pa chen po gdod nas byung rmo — bye/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbang phyug nyid/ /go rims 0bzhin du bshad par bya/ /bud med rnams kyi nang zhugs pa'am/ /gdug pa rnams ( gekyi nang chud pa'amadu — / /gang yang rung bar 3 'dug nas ni/ /padma chen po yongs su bzung ske/ /dus dang stobs ni ji bzhin du/ / nyin re saci nus bsgrub par bya/ /cho ga 'di yis tshe 'di la/ /myur du mchog ni 'grub ༄ 5par 'gyur/ /'dod chags kun gyi 2 tshobade myur bar/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'gro 'ong lding / /'jig rten kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyid/ /phyag na rdo rje nyid dang ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi mtha' yas mchog /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya bsgrub 2shepa ni/ /phyag rgya bcings te ting 'dzin gnas/ /dngos grub chen po nyid thob bo / /dam :drog dam tshig mchog gis te —6/ /las ni tsho las mchog phyag rgyas so/ /sgrub da1pa chen po 2cho ga'i rgyud do// // 85wa 626

de nas dngos grub ma grub pa'i/ /ting 'dzin las ni 'dren ma 0)dag /dang por (miting 'dzin grub pa ni/ /go rims ( skabazhin du rab bshad bya/ /'di lta ste sgrib pa thams cad dang sdig pa ④dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa dang yams dang 'tshe ba dang nad 'go ba dang nyon mongs pa dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang 'jigs pa dang skrag pa dang rtsod (5)pa dang 'thab pa dang byis pa'i gdon dang dmu rgod dang nyon mongs pa dang ngal ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang dbul ba dang rgyags (6༄pa dang reg na mi bde ba dang skal ba 17)ngan pa dang nad med pa ma yin pa dang nor brlag (nyepa rnams la ni padma chen po zhi bas so/ /rlung dang mkhris ⑨pa dang khrag dang bad kun dang 'dus pa dang ma zhu ba bodang rims dang sbyar ba'i dug dang dug dang mdze dang 'brum bu phra mo dang g.yan pa dang rkang shu dang / skran dang chu'i dmu rdzing dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang sha bkra 11dang zad byed dang khrag zad pa dang khu ba zad pa dang / nad thams cad dang gnod pa dang gnod byed dang gdon dang phra hu men nyanyernams gso ba la ni/ padma chen po sman gyi phyag rgya ci'adzin pas so/ /thams cad rdo rjer byas pa dang chos dang go cha nyugadang / gtsug tor risadang gtsug phud dang mtshams 1 dang phyogs dang dkyil 'khor dang sa dang nam mkha' dang rdo rje'i gdan dang khang pa chen po dang rdo rje ra ba dang me 'bar ba dang thal ba'i ra ba dang rdo rje dang ri bo 18don yod pa la sogs pa dang srad bus yongs su bskor ba dang phur bus gdab pa dang zas dang btung 39ba dang gos dang rgyan dang phyag rgya dang bsrung rdu snab la ni padma chen po thams cad srung bas 2lhaso/ /tshe na thams cad dang stobs dang kha dog dang gzi brjid dang mdangs dang lang tsho dang brtson 'grus dang spro ba dang nad 85wa 627

med pa dang dpal dang skal ba bzang po dang nor dang 'bru dang dbang phyug dang 'byor pa dang dngos grub dang blo ①dang rnyed pa dang bkra shis pa dang ming dang grags pa dang snyan ②pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dam pa 'grub pa la ①ni padma chen po mchog grub pas so/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las/ chos thams cad sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje'i cho ga rgyas pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad mi 'gyur nam mkha' cheX/ /thams cad dbang bskur kun gyi don/ /kun dbang rin chen thams cad 'dzin//ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs⑤/ /drag ༅po chen po rab sad mdzad/ /chos rnams la ni rnam chagazigs pas/ /kun don dbang phyug gdod nas byung / /nyi zla dang ni gza' skar can/ /nam mkha' nyid du gyur ⑧pa yin/ /de nas rin chen ting 'dzin ni/ /nges par rdo rje can du brjod/ /de nas nam mkha' rdo rje nyid/ /ljang sngon bai ḍūrya tso)mnyam mdangs/ /rdo rje rin chen bsnams ⑩dge ba/ /nam mkha'i snying por 0yang dag gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan thog ma 'di'i / /mdzod spu kun gyi gnas na bzhugs/ /ting 'dzin la ni 0rnam gzigs pas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bdag po nyid/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sras bcas tsodang / /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /rdo rje rin chen de yis ni/ /kun rig 8kun gyis dbang bskur dang ⑩/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /kun mchog kun la dbang bskur nas/ /shis pa brjod pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba badzra sa twa a ti ༅pa ti st+waṃ a sgyi ṣiñtsa mi byur bhu ba 85—628

swaḥl / de nas bzang pos 'di gsungs shing / /legs par shis brjod dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje rin chen che de las/ /chos kyi gtso bor byung bar gyur/ /byung nas 'gro ba thams cad ni/ /ci rigs par ni kun dbang bskur/ /rdo rje kun gyis dbang bskur ②nas/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor tshul gyis bzhugs/ /bde gshegs kun gyis (0byin brlabs pas④/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /shin tu dbang phyug chen po'i mchog /dngos grub gsol ba'i rtog pa gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i du phyi rol ni/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo nam mkha'i mdog /nyi ma zla ba skar ma dang / /gza' rnams kyis ni brgyan ⑥pa bri/ /de dbus nam mkha'i 9)snying po ni/ /bdag nyid thams cad dgyes pa ⑧gzhag /dag pa'i bee ḍūrya ⑨mdog 'dra/ /'od zer 'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrug /g.yon pa rin chen thugs kur stodakyi/ /g.yas pas nor chen rab stsol ba/ / de yi hustengos su sems dpa' mchog /bzhi po gzungs nyunyebacas dam pa yin/ /dbang bskur ba dang gter nyid dang / /nor bu chen po bla med dang / /'byor pa dpal ni phun sum tshogs/ /rang gi 'osnyematshan mas mchod pas ④ni/ /de la de dag gi snying po 'di yin te/ badzra satwa dzaḥtsa/ badzra ratna rtsu/ badzra dharma tso / badzra kurma hoḥbi / de nas gzungs rnams kyi snying po bshad de/ oṃ pra ti badzi ṇi phaṭa/oṃ badzra sdi ti nyi hi/ oṃ tsinta ma ṇi 3༄hoḥhurte/ oṃ badzra ma hā ma he haṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis nidu 3 / /cho ga rgyas pa ci bzhin bya(2/ /nor bu'i khu tshur gyis bzhugs la(nye/ /mkha' skyes la ( nyeni mgos phyag bya/ /bzhugs dustenas nam mkha' mkhas pa yi/ /dam tshig dam pa brjod par bya/ /khyed ni nam mkha' las byung ba'i/ /thams cad kyi ( snyeni lnga pa yin/ /oṃ i shustesid dha bhur bhu 85wa 629
