brka/ sid dha 0)sid dha swaḥ0/ sid dha ma hā badzra(miratna/ ba ba tra ṭa /④/'di ni bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ /mkha' snying dngos grub thams cad dang / /phun tshogs kun la shin tu ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom (gemed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje (7rin chen bla na med pas gsungs so/ /de nas nor bu khu tshur can (7nagyi lcags kyus dgug par bya'o/ /oṃ khyu 'u)rā ya tī (9)dzā0/ bhu ba pra bi sha hūm̐ su/lha/ groṇḍa rtson ba ba ṭa ṭa sid dha ho rtanyurte/ de nas bcom ldan myur du ni / /byon nas dngos grub thams cad ni/ /'byor pa shin tu g.yo ba la/ /don ni rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas slob mas /tsho4phyag rgya ni/ /me tog bcas pa mchog gis gzhug /bcug nas de nyid mchog snying 8po/ /bden pa lan cig tshebarjod du gzhug /de nas 'byor pa'i mchog brtag pa/ /dpal gyi phun tshogs mchod pa che/ /'jig rten mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /bde bar gshegs pa de nya bzhin thobanyusnye/ /de nas de phyir sgrub 37pa bshad/ /rdo rje rin chen rgyal mchog gis/ /dpag med zlos pas bsgrub bya zhing / /'di yis 33 skyes mchog 'di nyid la/ /'dod chags 'gro dang 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rin chen kun gyi chadabang phyug rgyal/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /dngos grub kyi dam pa thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /phyag rgya bsgrub 32pa ni dga' ba nyid kyis so/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya bsgrub 2pa ni dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis so/ /de bzhin du las bsgrub 3 pa 25ni dngos grub bla na med pa yin no phyag rgya chen po bsgrub ri lhapa nyid de'i rgyud do// //de nas de phyir na las rnams kyi/ /rab 'byam ri rnyargyu ri (ni dam pa dang / /85wa 630

dngos grub chen po kun grub ①pa/ /go rims ②ci bzhin rab bshad (kyebya/ /'di lta ste 'byor pa thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang dbrog pa dang bsag (0pa dang len pa dang 'dren pa dang 'gugs pa dang gtod pa dang gzhig pa dang 'phen pa dang 'degs pa dang 'bebs pa dang brdeg rdo9pa dang sbyang ba dang rnyed pa dang nyo ba dang btsong ba dang kun tu 'gyed (6)pa dang nye bar dgod pa dang brtan par bya ba dang rdo rjer bya ba dang 'byor pa thams cad bsgrub (pepa dang 'byor pa 2thams cad kyi mchog bsgrub (7pa la ni 0rdo rje rin chen gyi tsho rnyedabang bskur bas so/ /dpal thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang hu3du bya ba dang dbrog pa dang bsag 'osnyepa dang len pa dang 'dren pa dang 'gugs pa dang gtod pa dang gzhig pa dang ④'phen pa dang 'degs pa dang 'bebs pa dang 8brdeg tshepa dang sbyang phyo tshob dang rnyed pa dang nyo ba dang btsong ba dang kun tu 'gyed tshepa dang nye bar dgod /7pa dang brtan par bya ba dang rdo rjer bya ba dang 'byor pa thams cad bsgrub zhu stapa dang 'byor pa thams cad kyi mchog bsgrub na/pa la ci ni rdo rje rin chen dpal gyis so/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang dbrog pa dang bsag pa dang len pa dang 'dren pa dang 'gugs ci pa dang gtod pa dang gzhig ④pa dang 'phen pa dang 'degs pa dang 'bebs pa dang brdeg 3pa dang sbyang ba dang rnyed pa dang nyo ba dang btsong ba dang kun tu 'gyed pa dang nye bar dgod 25pa dang brtan par bya ba dang rdo rjer bya ba dang 'byor pa thams cad bsgrub 2 pa dang 'byor pa thams cad kyi mchog bsgrub sbyo snyepa la ni rdo rje rin chen phun sum tshogs pas so/ /mchod pa thams cad dgug pa dang gzhug pa 85wa 631

dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang dbrog pa dang bsag ①pa dang len pa dang 'dren pa dang 'gugs ②pa dang gtod pa sridang gzhig pa dang 'phen pa dang /'degs pa dang 'bebs pa dang brdeg ④pa dang sbyang ba dang rnyed pa dang nyo ba dang btsong ba dang kun tu 'gyed ⑤pa dang nye bar dgod ⑥pa dang brtan par bya ba dang rdo rjer bya ba dang 'byor pa thams cad bsgrub rjo pa dang 'byor pa thams cad kyi mchog bsgrub ⑧pa la ni rdo rje rin chen gyi mchod pa sgrub ⑨pas so zhes kyang gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad bde don du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nor che ba/ /rang gi rgyal ⑩mchog lan cig 0bsgrub8/ /yi ge traṃ ni sbyar bar bya/ /dpal mchog dang po'i 0rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po las/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa rdo rje rin chen gyi rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o// //de nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten gsum po khams gsum pa/ /'jig rten gsum bdag thams cad la/ /'jig rten gsum mchog 'dul mdzad pa/ /cho ga bzhin du bsgoms gyur ④zhing ⑫/ /sems can don phyir cho gas bzhugs/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams/ /rtag tu rnam par gnas pa yin/ /mi mnyam pa yis bsten gyur natso/ /dug nyid du ni nye bar 'grol/ /bdud rtsi nyid kyis bsten 3 7gyur na/ /bdud rtsi nyid du'ang 'gyur ba yin / /'dod chags tshangs pa mchog 'byin 0pa/ /zhe snang drag po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gti mug khyab 'jug brtan mdzad nas/ /'jig rten gsum po byin gyis brlabs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /rtag tu gnas pas srid gsum gnas/ /chos kyis bsten hunyenas gsum mchog ste/ /chos min 85—632

bsten ①pas ngan song gsum/ /'dod chags sbrang rtsir byed par bshad/ /zhe snang rgyal bar byed par bshad/ /gti mug don ②ni sgrub byed ces/ /kun tu gsang ba'i ming yin no②/ /nga ni 'jig rten gcig pu nyid/ /'jig rten gsum du rab tu bshad/ /nga ni 'dod pa gcig pu nyid/ /tshangs pa drag po g.yung drung yin/ /de nas gsum po ④'di yi ⑤mchog /sbyang phyir rdo rje sbyang 'dzin pa/ /gzugs ni gsum po ⑥'di dag nyid/ /bdag nyid kho na byung ⑦ba yin / /gang phyir 'jig rten 'di dag ni/ /rtag tu yang ni 'di skad smra/ /tshangs sogs nikyis 'dul yang dag pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub snod ma yin/ /de rnams sbyang phyir bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rang nyid ni/ /gzugs ni gsum po 'di mdzad nas/ /phyis ni sangs rgyas nyid mi 'gyur/ /de nas tshangs pa lha sogs 0lha/ /'jig rten gsum mchog dbang phyug che/ /dkyil 'khor de 0ni gsang snying po(rnye/ /rang gi rang grub phyir rab phul/ /oṃ zlar bhu 8ba swaḥ8/ zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo srungs ④bzhis ni rab bsrungs pa8/ /kha khyer gyis ni legs bskor ba/ / phyi yi ⑩dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / de yi ⑩nang ma nyid dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs can la / /sbrang rtsir 8byed dang rgyal byed nyidam/ /bsgrub tsu )pa thams cad sgrub zhu〉pa ni / /go rims du)dag ni ji bzhin du/ /legs par bri 'am gzhag par bya/ /pus 0me gnyis kyis bzhugs rdzu stel der/ /rtse gsum dam tshig gis tsamatshan pas/ /zhugs te dam tshig bcings nas ni/ /yang dag par ni dgug bya9par bya/ /oṃ sgrur bhu 0ba swaḥdu nye/ swa ste nā ma swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa yis thams cad thams cad kyis bskor ba/ /thams cad grub phyir 'ongs pa la/ /de snyed 85—633

pa yi 3)gtor ma sbyin/ /slob dpon rab tu zhugs pa yis②/ /slob ma thams cad gzhug (kyepar bya/ /de nyid gsang ba brjod nas ni/ /dam tshig mchog ni sbyin par bya/ /gal te khyod ④kyis rtse gsum bcagaphyi /snying po snod min la smras ⑥sam / /ji skad smras pa'i chos rnams ni/ /gal te 'dir ni ma spyad dmacha/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa nyid/ /tshangs pa drag po g.yung drung ste/ /ming po gsum po 'di nyid ni/ /nam yang brnyas (kyepar mi bya'o/ /gang zhig 'di rnams sgom pa slob/ /yang dang yang du zhugs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod par bya ba 97dang / /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi ⑩phyag rgya bslabs nas ni/ /de la gar gyi mchod pa dang / /'dod yon dam pa lnga rnams kyis / /rtag tu dkyil 'khor mchod par 3|bya/ /'jig rten gsum 'byin pa'i rgyud do// //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can kun rje ston mdzad pa/ /'jig rten gsum phyung don grub tu/ /slar yang sring mo rnams 'byin mdzad/ /kun tu chags dang zhe sdang rmongs/ /brtan par byed pa'i rgyu yin no/ /dga' dang phrag 12dog bud med ni/ /rab tu grags pa'i dngos grub nyugester/ /gang zhig 'jig rten kun tu bshad/ /tshogs kun gyis mchod lha mo rnams/ /zhi dang 'jigs ma de bzhin gseramu/ /grub pa dang ni zhi bar bshad/ /phyi rol sems can phan phyir dang / /rtogs don khong du chud bya'i phyir/ /de rnams kyi nyunyeni snying po dang / /dkyil 'khor de bzhin dam tshig bshad/ / trī hūṃ shrī bhyo /dkyil 'khor bzang po sgo bzhi pa3 / /srad bu gsum gyis rtso)dkyil 'khor bya/ /85—634

mtshams nyukyi thig ni ka ba che/ /bzhi po dag ni ②rim (kyepa bzhin/ /de yi dbus su dkyil 'khor ni/ /bzhi po dag ni ④de bzhin bya/ /rang gi snying po bzhi po ni/ /rang gi sgor ni phyogs par gegazhag /skal (nyabazang lag na ral gri (7rimatshon / /sring mo phub can zhi ba mo/ /phag mo lag na gter nyid de/ /grub pa ④mo ni bsnyems (7dang bcas/ /de nas dang po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /kun nas de bzhin zhugs shinas ni/ /sring mo rnams kyi phonyerang gi rgyas/ /go rims nyurtedag ni ji bzhin du/ /zhugs nas de bzhin cho ga bzhinam/ /spos 0la sogs pas mchod par 8bya/ /de nyid gsang ba rab bsgrub tsogs/ /kun nas dgug pa dag tu bya/ /oṃ sum bha ga ra tiṣṭha ma ya hi byurahunya/ rakṣa sa mā (3tiṣṭha ma ya nyi khyur bhu 0ba/ ba rā hā a mirsā ta rngo )ma ya swā hā/ sid dhi ka sbyo rnyasid dhi sa ma ya hi khri māṃ ke mu drwa giḥdu 3/ hrīḥ ste/ shrī bhyo/ de nas lus ni thams cad kyis/ /de bzhin du ni legs bzhugs la/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings bstan sbyo 3te/ /gsang ba mchog 'di brjod par bya/ /gal te gsang nyid ma bsrungs na/ /gang zhig sems can don zhugs budang / /gang yang dkyil 'khor sgrub byed pa/ /de rnams khyed kyis bsad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan la bubadud rtsi nyid/ / mechos min pas ni dug pas lhagadu 3 /ci snyed pa dang dus ci bzhin/ /yul rnams nye bar bsten pa dang / /phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /ci bde bar ni rtag tu mchod/ sring mo bzhi'i rgyud do// //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ / sa yi 37dbang phyug kun gyi shu )mchog /'dod chags zhe snang shuglegati mug che/ /sgrub pa dang zhunyeni rab sgrub nyid/ /'dod 85wa 635

chags sogs ①dug gzhig phyir dang / /kun nas bdud rtsi nyid bya'i phyir/ /zhe sdang las byung klu yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la snying po ni (0'di yin te/ /phuḥ / zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /srad bu thams cad yang dag bri/ /sgo khyud klu yi gdengs ka mchog /mtshams kyi rtse mchog mjug ma mdud④/ / de yi (snyedabus su klu rgyal ni/ /mtha' yas gdengs ka bcas pa ni/ / klu yi ⑥rigs ni brgyad po dag /shes rab can gyis kun tu bri/ /de nas khros nas ༅zhugs nas ni/ /klu 'dzin pa yi ④shugs kyis ni/ /zhugs nas dkyil 'khor de nyid du/ /sbrul gyi ⑨gdengs gas dgug par bya/ /oṃ hrīḥ7a nī la dza 0ba be ga thra thi nyin da ṛ ṣe shā 8ya nyi phuḥ8/sarba 0nā ga ku lā tyā na ya 8phuḥhū/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya phuḥ0/ sablon sā 0dha ya phuḥpho'i / ta ta sa sarba so )nā ga pu tra ka phuḥpo nyu/ de ltar byas na legs par bzhugs shing dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dug med par bsam par bya'o / /de nas brtsams te dug thams cad zos ( 3kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur ro/ /nor rgyas dang rtse (3bar byed do/ /dug thams cad sbar ④ba dang / gzhig tsonus par 'gyur ④ro/ /de nas mna'i snying po sbyin par bya ste ⑦/ 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams/ /'jig rten na ni 'di gsum dug /gal te bden pa las 'das dge/ /de chadag gis ni rtag gsod 'gyur/ / khyod kyis ⑥ glog la brnyas mi bya/ /ser ba bzlog par mi bya zhing / /gal te dngos grub la dga' na/ /ci nas sbrul ni gsad 9mi bya/ /klu'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i mchog /85wa 636

sems can kun la bde ba'i phyir/ /gdon gyi dkyil 'khor phyung ①ba yin/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams/ /nyes byas kyis (kyeni dug nyid 'gyur/ /gdon dang rims dang sdig pa dang / /dmyal bar ②yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas gdug pa'i snying po ni/ /haṃ/ zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa④/ /gdon gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu bri/ /de ⑤dbus dang por gdon la sogs/ /cho ga rgyas pa gdon 6)par bya/ /de nas bshad pa bzhin zhugs nas/ /dgod ⑦cing myur bar ⑧dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhugs nas ni/ /khros pas rkang pa g.yon pas mnye/ /de nas gdon dang rims sdig pa0/ /dmyal ba thams cad rtag tu ni/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /rdo rjes rab tu 'jig ⑩par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /sdug bsngal thams cad las ⑩'don pa'i rgyud do// //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa yis/ /sems can kun don rab bsgrub 8phyir/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad gsungs pa nyusnyeyin / /de la snying po ni bo'adi yin te/ oṃ āḥ/ hrīḥdzā8/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa ni⑩/ /gzugs kun gyis 8ni kun mchog gitso/ /dbang phyug dam pa mdzad pa yin/ /gsang ba chen po lnga yis ni/ /gang tshe 'dul bar ma gyur pa/ /de tshe sna tshogs cher mdzad pa/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dam pa yin/ / de nas gang phyir dkyil 'khor che/ /yidam pa yang dag bshad bya ste/ /kun mchog sna tshogs rnam par rgyal/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bris nas ni/ / de yi du )dbus su 85—637

cho ga bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bzhag la/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs dkyil ①'khor / / de yi 90ngos ni thams cad du/ /kun mchog bdag po'i ②sku rnams sol/ /rdo rje mchog bcas mtshan ma ni/ /rang gi rigs kyis bskor ba gzhag /rgyal po rdo rje sred med bu'i/ /gzugs 'dzin 'khor lo bsnams pa ④byi/ /khyab bdag rdo rje can rdo rje/ /gtum dbang rdo rje mdung bsnams pa/ /rdo rje pad byung sa)padma can(3/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa tshangs (pegazugs ldan(she/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rdo rje dang bcas me tog mtshon/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtshams (9)rnams su/ /rigs kyi lha mo bri bar bya/ /rdo rje dpal mo dkar mo dang / /rdo rje sgrol ma mkha' rdo rje/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po 'di rnams kyi snying po 'di rngubashad par bya ste/ oṃ badzra nā rā ya ṇa tshinda 0pra ti ha na badzra tsakra te na nyu2ho/ bha ga bān nya badzra ta thā ④ga ta/ dzaḥ8rgyu baṃ hoḥhū/ badzra dhā 51 ra rta/ badzra ta thā ga ta hūm̐/ badzra kro dha ma hā yo gi ni pog ṇi shwa char/ ma hā 2 tshobadzra ku lo gra pa ne ho/ bha ga bān badzra tsaṇḍi 21shwa rā ya/ ha ha ha ha hrīḥ/badzra parbod 32bha ba ho/ bha ga bān du gebadzra lo ke bushā re/ ma hā pra me sid rgya/oṃ snar bhu (snyeb swaḥ/ swa ( cisti na maḥ2 tshog hā/ he badzra ku su mā yu dha/ sarba kā ⑫ma me sā dha ya hordo rkye/ bha ga bān sa snabadzra ā kā sa1sha garbha/ ba ba ṭa ṭa du rta/ badzra ā kā sha garbha nisnye.a she ṣi 8stemu dru ༷snye/ na mo ye na sā dhe na/ bha ga ba te sostemadzñā pā ra mi tā yu dha/ sbyin shuge badzra ṇi tsakre ṇa te na sa hye shusnyen pā pa kun/ oṃ dhīḥsna/ shrī shu 4 )ti smṛ 41ti bi dza ye swā hā/ badzra pa ra mi/ oṃ badzra gi 8ri ma hā bi rya tree lo kya 4nyebi dza ye shwa ri badzra kro dha a ga ni sa ma ye/ badzra dha ri na mo stu te( ste/ tad ya thā / oṃ hi li mi li le li tā 45li badzra ka 44mu ka ye swā hā/ badzra sa ma ya na mo sdo ye 85wa 638

na sā dme ①na bha ga ba til/ bunta bo dhi rbud dha dhā mer/ badzra dharma ④ma yo ge na/te na sa hye na si dha 'a⑤/ oṃ tā re tu'i yire tu re swā hā/ badzra dha mo ta/ oṃ kurma mebadzre ṇi sisgru sirgya bi shuddha sā ⑧rgya ba ha/ ga ga nod bha be/ yo ge na siddha māṃ pa ra ma ka re/ tabya thā/⑨ ga ga na 0bi shud dhe/ sarba ⑩ma ba pri 8ya pa ri pū tsor ni 8swā hā/ / phyi yi tsodakyil 'khor gnas rnams su/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang phyogs tsoganas/ /lha dbang dang ni ma mo nyid/ /'jig rten skyong rnams dgod par bya/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje yi/ /rol mo che bcu rdung 8byed pa// phyi yi pha/dkyil 'khor kha khyer dang / /sgo dang mtshams su'ang de bri'ohu)/ /sgo rnams kun tu 'jug pa ni/ /rang gi phyag rgya mmu rab tu gzhug /dkyil 'khor dam pa lnga par ni/ /dang po'i sbyor bas 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /dang po lcags kyu che de 6nyid/ /snying po 'di ni rjod sanyebyed cing ske/ /'gugs pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha tsho —nyebadzra satwa sirnyi ④rgyu / /sarba ata thā ga ta sdo ston/ sa ma ya ā 9 shekarṣa 3ya dzaḥhū/ badzra ku la dri paṃ/da ma ye twa 0 pra be sha ya hūm̐/ sarba tsho1lo ke shwa ro apra be sha ya sa ma ya ban dha na rba / sa ma ya sarba ratna dī 3 paṃ ma hā ma ṇi du:rā dzdza nī/ ba shī du sniku ru hoḥ(lha/ hūṃ āḥ0rgyu hrīḥrta(3/ de nas gsang ba chen po yi/ /snying po bzang po 'di brjod pas / /rdo rje 'chang chen rgyal po ni/ /'khor lo thams cad dang bcas par ge/ /bkug cing rab tu bcug pa dang / /bden pas bcings te dbang du byas/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog thams cad/ /dngos grub kun gyis 'grub ce nipar 'gyur / /de nas go rims ji (1bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub pa dang ske/ /dngos grub de rnams nyid kyang ni/ /thams cad kyang ni bsgrub par bya//85wa 639

bde ba thams cad mi 'gyur gnas/ /bde ba chen po zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje 'di ni bsgrub 0)la sogs/ /'di ni tshe 'dir 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar sna tshogs pa'i don sbyang ba'i ②don gyi ②cho ga 'gro ba dpag tu med pa 'dul ba/mtha' med cing sna tshogs pa ④mnyam pa med pa'i ⑤phul du byung ⑥ba de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rigs thams cad 'dzin pa'i bde ba'i mchog byed pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi ༅byin gyis brlabs pa srid pa'i bde ba ⑧mchog byed pa gsungs pa yin no/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rtog pa'i 0rgyal po las/ rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kun gyi mchog dbang phyug dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sgo7// // de nas gsang ba ras bris kyi cho ga gsungs pa ni/tshi sangs rgyas kun kyi gsang ba che/ /dam tshig mchog gi sgrub nyu pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /dngos grub kun gyis hunyelus byas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs mchog chen po yi/ /rin chen rgyal po 8sogs 8 kyis brgyan / /bde ba chen po ⑩chags pa 1༄yi/ /glu 37dang rol du )mo rjes chags pa/ /bla med dga' ba chen po yi / /mchod pa kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /dga' 0ba chen po dpal gyi gnas/ /rang gi ( gebazhugs gnas mchog de la/ /rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po mchog /mi 'gyur mchog ni du nyeyang dag bzhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /rab tu dga' ba mi 'gyur mchog /kun tu bzang po 'khor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /rdo rje bsnyems pa tsho — bdag po'i bdag /kun mchog chags pa chen po yi/ /dngos 85—640

grub dbang phyug rjes grub pa/ /glu dang rol mo thog mtha' med/ /mchog ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /hūṃ/ de nas 'di ni gsungs ①tsam gyis/ /rdo rje thams cad 'dzin pa ni/ /gsang ba lnga yi de nyid che/ /phyag rgya'i lha mo byung bar gyur/ /rtag tu chags dang dngos grub che/ /rnam rgyal dbang phyug lhag pa'i lha/ /phyag rgya dam pa bzhi pa ste/ /sems dpa' (gebyin gyis brlabs pa'i sku/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ②'di yin te/ kun mchog so sor rtog pa dang / /dngos grub kun gyi ④bde ba'i mchog /kun mchog rnam rgyal mthong ba 'am⑤/ /thams cad dbang phyug mchod pa che/ /dngos grub rnams dang phun tshogs dang / /dga' ba dag (6)dang bdag po rnams/ /rdo rje lha mo thog mtha' med / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku yi ⑦mchog /ces bya'o/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i mi rnams ni dga' ba chen po dpal rdo rje rjodon yod dga' ba'i dam tshig gi ⑨'dod pa'i rdo rje ma dang / dga' ba chen po dpal don yod la chags pa'i dam tshig gi rdo rje ki li ki ⑩li dang / dga' ba chen po dpal rdo rje don yod la chags pa'i dam tshig rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma dang / dga' ba chen po dpal rdo rje don yod la chags pa'i dam tshig rdo rje 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /'di rnams gsang ba'i mtshan dag ni/ /mkhas pas gang zhig dad pas brjod/ /de ni phyag rgya thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub hunyekun bdag bdag por 'gyur/ /zhes 'bacom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu gsang bas thagasungs yipa yin no0/ /de nas 'di sgrub bshad bya ba/ /dngos grub shin tu brtag ⑩pa ste/ /sdig pa che la ⑩dga' ba dang / /sgrub pa gang zhig ma grub kyang / /rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa bzhin/ /de dag kyang ni myur 'grub 'gyur8/ /nyin re 85—641

'am ni zla re 'am/ /de bzhin lo ni re re la/ /ci mngon mngon 'dod 'grub stipar bya/ /ci rnyed pa dang ci bde bas/ /ras la bcom ldan bri bar bya/ /kun bdag dam tshig dbang phyug ste/ /gang zhig bris par gyur na ni/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i thar pa thob/ /bzhad pa dang bcas zla ba'i 'od/ /sna tshogs padma'i 'od 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur sogs(gyi/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang na bza' dugeldan④/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis ⑤bzhugs/ /rdo rje bsnyems dunapa'i mchog 'chang ba/ /g.yon pa dril bu mchog bsnyems 3)pa rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu brtag / de yi ⑧logs na na)bzhugs pa rnams/ / de yi bo'od kyi rtsomadakyil 'khor brten/ /rab tu dga' dang 8bde ba'i sku/ /gsang ba chen po dgod par bya/ /dang po padma ltar dkar dmar/ /gzhan ni pa la sha ltar dkar/ /gzhan ni utpal 'dab ltar sngo/ /rdo rje bsnyems 0ma ser po 'dzin/ /dang po dang ni gnyis pa dag /g.yas kyi logs la brten pa ste / /gsum pa dang ni bzhi pa dag /g.yon gyi logs su bzhugs ④pa yin/ /rdo rje ki li ki rtsomili tshem/ /dbus kyi rang lha dgyes par spro/ / de yi (/ 1logs la rdo rje che'i1 )/ /mda' ni gsor ba la brtson pa/ /bsnyems 3)pa'i phyag gis yongs 'khyud pa'i/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan bsgreng ri ci )dang bcas/ / de yi sanyelogs na bzhad dang bcas/ /mchod pas bdag po la lta ba gye/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur mtshan/ /thams cad spyan gyi sa phyag rgya gzigs/ /rang la bdag ni 3stethugs gtad shusnyepa/ /zur du blta 39zhing bzhugs pa'o/ /ras ris 'di ni du mthong ba yis/ /rtag pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /mchod pa dang ni brtags 28pa yis/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i thar pa thob/ /ces ༷ )bya ba bcom 85wa 642

ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de ltar mchog tu dga' ba rab tu 'dod pa ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba dag pa ①dam pa'i dngos grub 'grub②/ /gsal zhing rnam par rgyal ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i ras ris chen po 'di/ /thams cad gzigs pa ④rnams mchod pa/ /chen po yis (snyeni yidapal 'dir ④rol/ /'khor lo de ni brtags (8)byas nas/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnam par dben pa'i khang par ram(pe/ /yang na skyed 7mos tshal sogs tsa)su/ /de bzhin gshegs mchog chen po yi/ /ras ris rgyal po sogs tshekyis brgyan33/ /dril bu dang bcas yid dga' ba'i/ /bla re ⑩phul bas mchog gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje glu yi mchod sogs chadang / /glu dang rol mo ⑩rnam 'phrul ba/ /me tog spos sogs tsherab sbyor ba/ /mar me'i sbyor bas yang dag mchod/ /khang pa sum 3nyebartsegs 7dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog gi gsang ba ku )bsgrub par bya/ /yang na bdag nyid kho na mchog /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgom zhu7bya/ /de nas 'khor lor ma zhugs kyang / /rang nyid kyis ni rtag zhugs nas/ /rdo rje kun 'chang slob dpon ni/ /dngos grub kun la 'grub ( 2par 'gyur/ /rang nyid khrus byas dri zhim bsgos/ /ji snyed zhu rgyan dang gos dang ldan/ /sna tshogs gos kyis yang dag bklubasari rige/ /phreng bcas kha ni dri zhim pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba dgeyis / /me tog spos dang dri snod bcas/ /rdo rje glu ni 'di dag gis/ /gar byed grong khyer 'jug par bya/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba'i dpal dam tshig gsum 'jug la mchog tu gsang ba'i glu'i (stemachod pa mchog tu grub pa 'di yin te / dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba'i/ /thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /dzaḥ( hūm̐ 85—643

baṃ hoḥ༅rab tu grub par mdzodage/ /rab tu zhugs te g.yon pa yis/ /rdo rje'i ①mig gis mgon la 'dud/ /g.yon pa bsnyems ④pa cung zad bzhad/ /bstod ducing mdzes pa'i mig ⑥btsums pa/ /de la mchog tu gsang ⑦ba dam pa dpal dam tshig gsum gyi phyag 'tshal ba'i me tog gi sil ma dor ba'i mchog tu gsang ba rdo rje glu'i mchod pa ⑧mchog tu grub pa 'di yin te/ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud⑨/ /dzaḥ7/ baṃ hoḥ nyi nyi hi nyi gyi7/ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /de nas me tog sil ma dor/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / /ldan pa'i don 8gsal sbyin par bya/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba'i mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i mchod pa mchog tu grub 8pa 'di yin te/ oṃ/sangs rgyas kun ldan rin chen mchog gis brgyanas/ / lha yi ②cod pan dang bcas khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang bdag rin chen dbang bskur bas/ / rdo rje ⑩sems dpa' sa ma ya st+waṃ 0rta/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje gzung tso/ /chos kyi dril bu dgrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gis ni phyag rgya cherahu)/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzlas/ /rdo rje la sogs thob bzung (3 bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis pa 'dra/ /rdo rje thams cad 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje can gyis byin 0brlabs 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum gyis bdag la byin gyis brlab ④pa'i sgrub pa gcig pu'i cho ga mchog tu grub pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas 'dir bsgrub tsobashad bya ba/ /dngos grub shin tu rtag ( nyepa yang / /gang gis sgrub po dam pa 85—644

dang ske/ /sdig chen byed pa rnams kyang ni/ /rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa bzhin / /ma grub ①rnams kyang grub par 'gyur/ /lugs ma 'am ni brdungs ma 'amadu / /'dus byas pa 'am bris pa 'am/ /dang po'i sems dpa' bzhugs gsol nas/ / de yi ①mdun du cho ga bzhin/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril 'chang zhing / /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /thams cad dgug dang mchod pa che/ /bdag byin rlabs sogs libasgrub ⑤rnams so/ /de la ji ltar mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad dgug pa'i rgyud ni 'di yin te/ rang lhag lha yi yisbyor ba las/ /thams cad dgug pa'i sbyor ba yis⑥ / /yan lag mchog gis ⑧rol bcas pas/ /gar bya zhing ni dgug par bya / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos grub mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi ⑨klu'i mchod pa ni 'di yin te/ dzaḥ7mchog dang po'i ⑩rdo rje 'chang ba rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba rab 0rtogs rab tu dga' ba khyod bdag sangs rgyas so sor rtogs/ /hūm̐ mchog rdo rje las ni mchog tu mi 'gyur hunyezad med srid pa hunye rab bsgrub tsunyebade dang yid bde dam tshig bdag la deng nyu9grub mdzod/ /baṃ mchog bdag gi sku 'dzin rnal 'byor thams cad rnam rgyal bsgreng nya ba rab mchog dag pa bde bar 'gyur ba'i padma'i rgyal po kye/ /hoḥ(12rab mchog huXni mchog gi dngos grub dam pa thams cad dbang phyug dam par bdag gyur cig /rtag par bdag 'phel nam mkha'i snying po khyod/ /hu lu hu lu'i sgrub pas dbab par mdzod/ /dam tshig chen pos yang dag dgug pa khyod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /rab tu dga' ba mchog bdag py-i )po/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam 6tshig gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad kyi mchod pa 85—645

chen po'i cho ga ci ltar yin/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor ji bzhin du/ /mchod pa kun mchog sku rnams kyi①/ / mchod de sngags pas glu rnams kyi/ /②rol mo'i rnam 'phrul gyis rjes mchod/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ②mchog gi dngos grub kyi mchod pa chen po'i cho ga'i mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi rdo rje'i glu'i mchod pa ni 'di yin te/ thams cad rjes su chags pa bde ba dam pa'i thugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni rab tu dga' ba yin/ /bde ba chen po gsal mthong bdag la brtan gyur cig /myur du so sor mkhyen nas rab tu 'dod ④pa bsgrubs/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal/ /dam tshig gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa'i ④sgrub pa chen po ci ltar yin / rang lha'i sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /phyag rgya kun gyis byin brlabs payi/ /de nyid chen po'i mchog gis ni/ /rang nyid bsgrubs te snying po bzla/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos grub byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang ba chen po (medam pa'i dam tshig gi/ rdo rje (8)glu'i mchod pa mchog tu grub pa 9'di yin te/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chabadag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod//nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kyis 3nyani rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi nyidamachog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po 12kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /85—646

dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha①/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pas/ /rdo rje bsnyems ②bdag bdag mdzod cig /dpal mchog dang po'i bcom ldan khyod/ /gang gis don dang glu yis bstod/ /de ni dngos grub kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po nyid grub 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba mchog gi de kho na nyid kyi (snyemachog tu gsang ④ba'i glu chen po mchog tu grub pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs so/ /dngos grub cho ga 'di yis (5rini / /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag rtogs/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po yi/ /dbang phyug nyid ni rab bsgrub (ge pa'o/ /kun nas 'od zer ston sogs dang / /so sor ston pa'i rmad byung rnams/ /rdo rje'i tsonatshig gis rang lha las/ /ngo mtshar gyur rnams mthong bar 'gyur(8na/ /rtog pa kun gyi (rsha)sna tshogs che/ /dngos grub dbang phyug bde rnams kyi(1 bye/ /myur du rang gis nyutebyin brlabs nyu2pas / /rdo rje slob dpon gyis thob bo/ /zhes 8bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi chadang pos gsungs so/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba'i spudapal dam tshig gsum gyi /9lha thams cad kyi hu bdag la byin gyis brlabs hu pa'i sgrub pa chen po'i rgyud ci ltar yin/ rang lha rnal 'byor ji bzhin du/ /lha kun bdag nyid sku rnams kyis/ /rang lha'i nyurternal 'byor bdag nyid kyis/ /rang lhag lha nyid bsgrub par bya/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum gyi kun mchog dngos grub chen po'i dbang phyug chen po'i bdag tsho tshonyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi las kyi tshogs mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dam pa bla na med pa'i dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang du stobade ba sridadang yid bde ba thams cad kyi dngos grub dam pa'i cho ga rgyas pa rjes su grub pa ni 85wa 647

'di yin te/ rang lha'i sbyor ba ①ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje kun mchog sku rnams kyis / /glu dang rol mo'i cho ga ni/ /rdo rje nyid kyis ②rjes chags 'gyur/ /rang lha'i sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /dbyangs kyi rtsa ba ①rnam dusad pas/ /glu dang rol mo'i ⑤cho ga ni/ /dril bu nyid kyis rjes su brjod/ /rang lha'i sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i bdag po mchog /glu dang rol mo'i cho ga ni/ /dam tshig gis ni rjes bsgrub bya/ / 'di yis rtog dupa thams cad la/ /rdo rje 'bebs pas ⑦rab sad pas/ /rang gi lha yi dudam tshig ni/ /thams cad bzhi 'gyur 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal/ /dam tshig gsum gyi glu chen po dang / rol mo'i cho ga mchog tu gsang ba mchog tu grub pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas de 0rjes gnas ci bzhin / /ji snyed pa dang ⑩ci bde bas/ /me tog spos kyis mchod nas ni/ /khang pa'am skyed 7mos tshal sogs 8su/ /bdag nyid ci 'dod rab bsgrubs nas / /ji snyed rgyan dang gos dang ldan/ /sna tshogs gos kyis yang dag bklubs0la/ /me tog phreng bcas kha dri zhim/ /lugs ma 'am ni brdungs ④pa 'am / /'dus pa 'am ni ri mor bris8/ /dang po'i 'khor lo de mdun du/ /cho ga bzhin du bzhugs gsol nas/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sad pas/ /thams cad dgug dang mchod pa che/ /bdag byin rlabs 7sogs 'grub 0par bya/ /sngon du lan cig 8bsgrub ⑩byas nas/ /de nas de rjes ci 'dod paradu / /ci 'dod pa dang 0ci smra ba ⑤/ /thams cad bza' zhing thams cad byed/ /langs pa 'am ni 'dug pa 'am/ /rab tu dgod tsodam smra ba 'am/ /ji bzhin de bzhin de dang der/ /ji 'dod par 85—648

ni de bzhin gzhag /gsang ba mchog gi 'khor lo ni/ /me tog sogs ①kyis mchod nas ni/ /ji bzhin du ni rjes bsgrub bya/ /'dis ②ni 'dod pa kun dbang phyug /'gro dang 'ong dang 'dod na phural/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug 'grub/ /rga shi med pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grub ༷chen po / /phyag rgya kun gyi dbang phyug bdag /rdo rje kun 'dzin rgyal po ⑤ni/ /rdo rje mtshon cha thams cad 'dzin/ /mi thub pa dang mi sod cing / /thams cad byed cing kun gyi rtenadu/ /sems can kun gyi rgyal po che/ /tshar gcod rjes su bzung ⑦bar nus/ /kun mchog rjes su chags pa che/ /'dod pa 'grub pa bde ba'i ⑧mchog /kun las rnam rgyal grub 'gyur te/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa yin/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i go 'phang gnas0/ /rgyal po rdo rje kun 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab 'grub 'gyur/ /de ltar mchog tu rjes chags dga' ba padma'i ra ba che/ /mchog tu gsang ba grub pa'i bla na med pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /mchog gi rgyal mtshan bsgreng 0bas gang zhig rjes su bsten pa ste/ /mchog gi dngos grub dbang phyug chen po nyid des nyams myong ba/ /zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po las gsang ba chen po dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum dang dngos grub thams cad dgug 7pa dang / mchod pa chen po dang ske/ bdag la byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa'i 8cho ga rgyas pa'o// //gsang ba mchog ni 8dgyes 0pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi 8rjes bstan 8pa / /rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu 85—649

bzhugs / /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid / /rdo rje bsnyems 0)tshul bdag po'i bdag /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gcig (kyephu nyid//ces bya ba 'grub (9par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mchog tu rjes chags dga' ba padma ra ba (4)che/ /mchog tu gsang ba kunabla na med pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /mchog gi rgyal mtshan bsgreng 96)ba gang zhig rjes su bsten pa ste/ /mchog gi dngos grub bde ba chen po nyid de 7)nyams myong ba/ /zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dpal ma chog dang po las/ dga' ba chen po'i dpal rdo rje don yod pa'i dga' ba'i dam tshig rnal 'byor thams cad kyi dbang phyug de bzhin 98)gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal rang gi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsang 79)ba yongs su rdzogs sobo// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyurtethams cad kyi (1snyedam tshig chen po'i slob ma'i cho ga rgyas pa rjes su gzung 512ba bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la dang po kho nar re zhig 6de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i sngags 'di lan cig 12brjod pas sems bskyed tshedu bcug ste/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsisto ud pā da yā hu tshomi/'di brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mi 'bral nyu)zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyag rgya 517byang chub sems dpa' tsho )sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du yang rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba yang gsungs so/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /mchog tu bskyed 85wa 650

par byas nas ni/ /snying gar 0)rdo rje rab bzhag nas/ /su ra ta sa ma ya st+waṃ ho(kye / snying pos rdo rje ci bder bsgrub / /'di yis rdo rje bskul ④ba na/ /'dod pa kun las 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid bskul ⑤bas myur du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bla ⑥med pa/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'i mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /gar byas spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /gos kyis gdong ni g.yogs pa rnams/ /ci 'dod dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /slob ma thams cad gzhug par bya/ /ci 'dod dngos grub sems dpa' yis/ /slob ma me tog 'dor ⑦du gzhug /phyag rgya gang la de babs (shepa'o/ /de de'i lha mo bsgrub par bya / /de nas gdong g.yogs dgrol ⑨byas la/ /rnam pa kun gyi yon blangs nas / /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur gyis/ /dam tshig gsum ni gsal bar sbyin/ /de la rdo rje chen po'i hu )mna'i chus dbang bskur te/rje/ /'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byedanyurte/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grubarka/ /rdo rje dril bu'i lhonyephyag rgya ni/ /gal te dkyil 'khor ma mthong smras/ /skye bo 'dus pa'i rshathunang na gnas/ /dad pa med pas bzhad gad sasmod/ / zhes bya bas tshemana' bsgag go/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi rin po che'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ /rdo rje chu yis dbang bskur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i mchog dbang bskur ba'i gnas rtse su bzhag ste/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sa ma ya a dhi /2pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa 37mi ma hā badzra dha ra zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis rdo rje lag tu sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas 85—651

thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ①rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje 'chang gi brtul zhugs che//khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems chen po/ /yongs su mi spang ②rtag tu bsgrubs / /shin tu gsang bde 'di yin te/ oṃ badzra kum 0bā dhi rnyi shrī badzra nā ⑤ma sid dhi dus ma ya sdig khyur bhu ba swaḥdu/ gang la rdo rje'i ming btags pa de la kye'i sgra dang por sbyar bar bya'o/ /de'i ming de yang ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug pa'i bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑨yang ming du 'gyur ro/ /de la mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dpal dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni 'di yin te/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems 0tshul bdag po'i bdag /zhes ⑩bya ba bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu mchog gi de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba lnga'i ⑫de kho na nyid bshad par byas nas rdo rje sbyin par bya'o/ /'di bcom ldan 'das srid pa'i bdag po dam pa kun gyi mchog dbang phyug gi dam pa de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid chos kyi mchog gi bka' yang dag par ⑫stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid pa marang bzhin nyid kyis dgatso /rang bzhin gyis ni srid bral byas rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa tsomachog ni mdzad pa yin/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid 'bebs pa ni dril bu'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod par hu 7bya ba'am lha sgrub pa'i tshe yidakrol bar bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rab tu sad pa'i phab pa rnams kyis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par byed pa yin no/ /rdo rje thams cad 'bebs par byed pa dang rab tu sgrub par byed pa dang / dbang du byed ⑩pa dang rab tu dang 85—652

bar ①byed pa ②zhes bya bar bsgrub ①par 'gyur ro/ /de nas srid pa dag pa'i thabs kyi bumachog rtog pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po dam tshig la rtag tu bsten 0par bya'o zhes bya'o0/ /de la 'di ni deng ༅khyod kyi/ /srid bde shin tu myur bar ⑧ni/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni brten ⑨bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi yisbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i theg pa chen po'i yang chen po dam tshig gi pho)sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi 8dam tshig go/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya'i tsodam tshig ces ④ni bsgrags/ /yid kyi sku ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes bya ba mchog tu gsang ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di brjod par bya ste/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i tshe ji srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang ba 8dam pa dam tshig thabs/ /bsod nams byin gyis brlabs bsgrubs tsopa / /rtag tu dngos grub kun dbang phyug /sems can don ni byed pa yin/ /dam tshig 'dis ni mchog 0sgrub cing / /ci bde bar ni sgrub byed pa/ /nyes pa spyad kyang sdig kun gyis/ /rnam pa kun tu gnod mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa chen po grub 8par 'gyur/ /kun bdag dam tshig dbang phyug dang / /thams cad rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa'o/ /las kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyis/ /ma lus bsgrubs pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan thams 85—653

cad rgyas btab pas/ /yang na bsgrub bya kun la yang / /don yod mchog tu grub pa dang hu)/ /rnal 'byor thams cad rjes sgrub (2)byed/ /dpal ldan sdug bsngal kun 'phrog byed/ /dam tshig (kye'ada' bar dka' ④ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ⑤mchog tu gsang ba bcom ldan 'das (6)rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rdo rje la sogs thob 'dzin pas/ /dngos grub 57)kun gyi bde ba kun/ /phab pas rdo rje slob ma yis/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nyams su myong / /de nas thams cad gzengs bstod rin pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid dngos/ /rdo rje'i ⑨ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /de bzhin gshegs ni lung bstan bya/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lung bstan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phyag rgya (7che/ /gzengs bstod pa yi hunyegang lung bstan / /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba'o / /oṃ 'di ni ngas khyod lung bstan te12/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod stonarmoge / /ho badzra na chamaḥta thā ga ta sid dhi nyanyes ma ya st+waṃ kur bhu ba swaḥ8/gang la gzengs bstod (1 pa 'di dang phyag rgya chen por 3)lung bstan pa naspumachog tu gsang ba'i cho gas byas pa de la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi )rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon rnams dang mgrin gcig 2nyetu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu —— lung bstan par mdzad do/ /'di lta ste gzengs bstod 0pa 'di nyid kyi phyag rgya chen po dang mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis du ri85wa 654

byin gyis 6)brlabs pa 'di dang sngags kyi stobs la chadad par ( —skubya'o/ /de nas ci lta ba bzhin du zhugs pa rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba sbyin par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa ci snyed pa byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad rang gi dam tshig la rjes su chags pas (pe'adir dgug pa dang rab tu gzhug ⑤pa dang dbang du bya ba dang bsgrub tsho6)pa dang rjes su bsgrub 3)pa rnams kyi ri3)rdo rje'i dbyings thams cad brtan (7par gyur pa nyid kyis/ 'di brtan 7par 'gyur ba chos kyi dbyings thams cad kun tu khyab pa nyid kyis kun tu zhugs pa/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi shirgya che ba nyid kyis 'dir rab tu bzhugs shing / legs par rab tu bzhugs pa gang yin pa de dang de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang gi dam tshig la rag las pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la lhag par dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di yin no zhes bya bas tu byin gyis brlabs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 3sterang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon gyis dam tshig gi comagrin gcig tu khyed rnams la tsodabugs dbyung ba mdzad pa yin te dad par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dbugs dbyung ba 'di yin te/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs pas kyang / /sdig pa kun las nges grol zhing / /khyed rnams der nyid 8legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg 3 7pa 'di las ni/ /slar 'chi ba ni yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs rol par gyis/ /srid pa'i sdug 85—655

bsngal ldog pa ni/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa khyod / /srid pa shin tu grub pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun ①par gsungs/ /dam pa rtag ②pa'i bka' yin no/ /gang zhig bskyed ②pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni gtang dumi bya/ /phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin padu/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi smod cing / /nam yang btang bar mi bya'o / /mi shes pa 'am yormongs pa yis/ /des ⑦ni smad ⑧par mi bya'o/ /rang gi ⑨bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' ( )thub rnams kyis gdung mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu /9nyephyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang yongs su spang mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yis0/ /slob dpon la ni gang smad pa/ /de 0ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas / /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te④/ /rims dang dug dang sbyar dug dang ske/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /gdon dang log 'dren gtum 8po yis/ /bsad tsonas sems can dmyal bar ltung / /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa / /nam yang smad ⑩par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis ⑩sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs hukyeganod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag (3 bsten bya 0na/ /longs spyod g.yo bas (2smos ci dgos/ /gang gis bskal pa bye bar ⑤ni/ /grangs med par 85—656

ni ⑨rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung ②/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul①/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de ④byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu sbyin 0pa nyid du 'gyur / /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas / /rang byung dam tshig lha dang mnyam/ /deng khyod 'gyur bar the com ⑥med / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pasatshu/ /kun gyi ⑧deng khyod dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni 0rgyal po che/ /rgyal po'i 0bdag por bstan pa yin/ /de ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyis 7ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng 8'dir thob par the tshom 0med/ /ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje 'chang dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu bden pas gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ④dpal rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon dang / slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis dbugs dbyung ba ni 'di yin te/ phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /byang chub sems dang lhan cig bskyed/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang rtogs 8bya ste/ /zhes bya'o⑩/ /de'i rgyu gang yin zhe na/ gang 0phyir khyed rnams kyi bdag nyid thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 4)kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa tsam gyi phonyemathu nyid kyis phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba yin no/ /phyir mi ldog pa nyid kyi phyir 85—657

nges pa'i phung po la rnam par gnas pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges pa nyid/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par ①sangs rgyas par rjes su rtogs par (kyebya'o/ /zhes bya'o / /de nas thams cad kyi dpal dam tshig gi slob dpon gyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dbugs dbyung ba 'di ①yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor kun dang rjes sbyor ldan/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rtogs bya ste/ /mkhas pas ④mchog tu brtag (snyepa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /de'i rgyu gang yin 4)zhe na/gang gi phyir khyed rnams kyi (7)bdag nyid thams cad 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang gi dam tshig yongs su bzung ⑧ba gdon mi za ba nyid kyi phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu (pemangon par sangs rgyas pa nyid du rtogs par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal rang gi dam tshig gi rjes su sgrub pas mchog gi dngos grub rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du de 7dag rtogs par bya'o/ /de'i phyir gnas skabs thams cad du yang ci nus pas sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba thams cad kyi skabs mi 'byed pa khyed rnams kyis rang gi bdag nyid thams cad kho na rjes su bsrung 37zhing gsad par nya mi bya'o/ /ci snyed nyunyepa'i longs spyod dang nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po'i dam tshig gi sbyor bas 0yang dag par mchod la bde bar gzung hu)ba dang yang dag par 'phel bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid la ci rtso4lta pho tshob bzhin du mngon par brtson pa de bzhin du gzhan rnams la na tshod bskyed 18pa yin no/ /lta ba log pa dang phyi rol nyu)mu stegs pa dang / nyan thos 85—658

pa ①thams cad dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung bas lus 'di shin tu gsang ba (2riyin no/ /ngag ni shin tu mi smra bas so/ /sems ni shin tu 'gog (kyepas so/ /gang gis kyang khyed ④kyi lus ngag yid kyi ⑤jo rje rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑥kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dpal rang gi medam tshig gi ⑧bla na med pa'i dngos grub mchog tu rtag par 'byung bar 'gyur 0zhes bya ba yang gsungs so / /'dod pa'i longs 7spyod thams cad (2kyis/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs rol par gyis/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'da' dka' ste/ /sdig pa med kyis ma 'jigs shig /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas tsomachog tu bden pas gsungs tem/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 8thugs la dgongs pa yin no/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bstan nyusnyepar gyis/ /de tshani 'gro la 7myur bde hu)rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam zhing rtag tu hu)nyid du rtogs par gyis( )/ /de nas ro dang bza' dang spyod pa gar dang sa1)glu/ /rol mo'i mchod sogs kyis ni mgon mchod pazhuge/ /rdo rje bla ma chen pos de ( /phul nas/ /rang dang gzhan dag ci 'dod mchod par byadu ste / /myos byed myos bral btung ba ni/ /ci 'dod par du snyeni bsten pa yis/ /glu dang rol mo'i cho ga sogs lha/ /ci bla bzhin rjes 'gro'i bzlas pa bya/ /rang gsang cho gas blangs pa yi/ /glu dang rol mo gar rnams kyisabla / /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i mchod pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rol mo sogs36/ /bud med sogs zhu )dang ldan pa 'am/ /rang gi slob ma dang bcas pa/ /ci 'dod pa yi longs spyod kyis lha/ /mchod pa byas pas myur du 'grub/ /zhes ni bya ba mchog tu 85wa 659

gsang ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la gsang ba'i cho ga'i glu'i lakhyad par ni 'di yin te/ hūṃ bcom ldan 'das mchog ②dang po'i rdo rje sems dpa'i 'o/ a de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi'o/ /hi dpal 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i'o①/ /oṃ padma'i snying po'i 'o/ /ha nam mkha'i snying po ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rgyal po nam mkha'i snying po yin no/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /rang gsang snying po'i glu dag ni/ /yi ge lnga pos bya ba ste/ /rang gsang cho gas blangs pa 'di/ /mchog tu gshegs pa kun gyi yin/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba rdo rje glu'i dumachod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu mnyam sogs bcas/ /rnam par dben par rol mo dkrol/ /rang gsang cho gas glu blangs pa/ /gsang ba'i rol mos 6)rab tu bsgrubadu/ /de nas mchog tu shin tu gsang ba'i rdo rje gar gyi mchod pa ni/ 'dzin pa dang bcas gzung ⑦ba che'idu / / gar ni ⑨rab tu byas nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor 'dra ⑩ba'i gar byas nas / /yongs su bskor ⑩bas rang 8mchod bya/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i phyag rgya sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam hunye'aphrul pa/ /gtam rgyud 8phyag mtshan phyag rgya yis/ /gang zhig gar de rol mo yin/ /gser ram 8yang na dngul dang ni/ /de bzhin shing las byas pa yi/ /rang gi lha yi tsogadong rnams kyis/ /grub pa'i phyag rgyas gar rnams bya/ /dkyil 'khor gang dang gang bsten ⑩pa/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs mchod pa yis/ /slob ma'i tshogs ni de dang de/ /bzla zhing thams cad mchog tu gzhug /sna tshogs cho ga 'di yis ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol 'gyur/ /bsod nams kun kyang 'phel 'gyur te/ /rtag tu srung bar gyur pa tsoyin/ /85—660

rims dang gdon dang dug dang nad/ /sbyar dug mkha' 'gro'i 'tshe ba dang /bdud dang gsod par byed pa rnams/ /'dis ①ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub dag ni phun tshogs 'gyur②/ /dga' ba de bzhin bdag po rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyil/ /rnal 'byor dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba shin tu gsang ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas phyag rgya sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa lhag pa'i lha thams cad re re'i mchog gsang ba ④'jug pa'i rdo rje glu'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa mngon par brjod nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis byas pa'am de las gzhan ci 'dod pa'i glu dang 0rol mo rnams kyis rtog pa thams cad kyi sna tshogs pa'i dam tshig chen po'i mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba ste/ de re zhig duthog ma kho nar bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi 'jug pa'i glu'i mchod pa ni/ thams cad rjes su chags pa bde ba dam pa'i thugs / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni rab dga' dam tshig ste/ /bde ba chen po brtan zhing mtho ba gsal gyur cig /so sor rtogs nas mngon du phyogs shing myur sgrubs ④shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (8)rigs kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi 'jug pa'i rdo rje glu'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na⑨/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glu ⑩blangs pas/ /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje rigs thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi 'jug pa'i rdo rje glu'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ rdo rje mda' gzhu dang bcas khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje chags pa'i dam tshig dpal khyod 'dud/ /kha ṭwāṃ 'jig dus rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje dril bu bskyod bla85—661

pa'i dpal khyod hu)'dud/ /de nas padma'i (kyerigs thams cad kyi semachog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi 'jug pa'i rdo rje glu'i mchod pa ni/ la lar skye bo ma rungs pa yi ④srog 'phrog byed pa shin tu drag po'i sku/ /la lar 'gro ba mtha' yas 'dul phyir shin tu rno ba'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i sku/ /la lar padma'i gdan gyi shin tu zhi ba'i sku ste 'gyur ba med pa ste/ /la lar shin tu 'bar ba'i 'dod pa'i dam tshig padma'i rgyal po bdag sgrubs (gyeshig /de nas nor bu'i rigs thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i ⑥klu'i mchod pa ni/ dbang bskur ④thams cad dbang phyug dam pa las/ /yang dag bsgrubs shing mi zad gter gyi (8)mchog /kun mchog rgyal mtshan rnam rgyal bsgreng 17ba las/ /rdo rje rin chen dpal bdag bolegs mchod gyur7/ /de nas ming po mirnyegasum gyi nyunyeni byur bhu ba swaḥhū/ de nas sring mo bzhi rnams kyi/gli 8rgyu shrī bhyo/ de nas klu'i rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ni/ phu phu/de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 975chen po phyag rtso tshon rdo rje'i sdig pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje 1 glu'i mchod pa ni/ sarba me 16ga maṇḍa 2 )la mi rda badzra dha rā lke 1kra ma bi mar da bi ki ra bhañdza ud sā da da ya/ nā sha ya/ ha na da ha/ pa tsa bhasmi caku ru kro dha hūm̐ kā rister marnyi ṇa dzwa/ de nas thams cad kyi mchog dbang phyug dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig gi rdo rje glu'i mchod pa ni/ la lar dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor stong gi 'od kyis —9sku ni rnam par mdzes/ /la lar 'jig sa dus nyi ma 'char ka bye ba'i ༷ —snye'od zer tshogs ni 'jigs cher dza'abar/ /la lar mdangs dang 'od zer dang ldan bde zhing zhi ba'i rgyal ba'i sno )sku 'dzin pa/ /la lar shin tu mdzes pa'i gzugs 'chang mchog 85wa 662

gi mda' dang bcas pa'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ /la lar gdul bya rnam par sbyang phyir brtson pa'i rdo rje sems khyod mkha' stibazhin bzhugs/ /ma lus 'dul ba mkhas pa'i bde ba dam pa nyid phyir bdag la grub rdo gyur cig /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i mchog bdam pa'i gsang ba'i mchog dpal dam tshig gsum gyi 'jug 4pa'i rdo rje glu'i mchod pa (ltemachog tu grub pa ni 'di yin te/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba'i/ /thar pa'i grong khyer bcom ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /dzaḥrdo(rtsu baṃ hoḥthorab tu grub par mdzod / /de nas shin tu mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga mchog tu gsang ba bla na med pa'i dam pa ⑧dpal dam tshig bla na med pa'i mchog tu ༷7shin tu gsang ba'i rdo rje tsoglu'i mchod pa mchog tu shin tu grub pa zhes bya ba mngon par brjod nas/ shin tu mchog gi de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje glu'i huXmachod pa'i glu dang gar gyi 32cho gas ci lta ba bzhin du rjes su bsgrubs nas/ so sor rjes su bsgrub nyunyepar bya'o zhes bya ba dang rka/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu shin tu gsang ba bla na med pa'i rtog pa thams cad kyi sna tshogs pa'i dam tshig chen po'i mchod pa mchog tu shin tu 0grub pa blayin no zhes bya ba rtso9yang gsungs so/ /sna tshogs cho ga 'di yis 7ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus (2pa yin/ /kun mchog sna tshogs chen po yi / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab tu grub/ /zhes 39bya ba shin tu gsang ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de ltar dpal mchog dang po'i rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas pa gtam rgyud 2 )sna tshogs can/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i rol mo bla na med pa'i dngos grub nyams dang ldan pa ste/ /gang gis sna tshogs pa yi 0rgyal mtshan mthon po dang ldan akun tu rjes ( debasten pa/ /mchog gi 85—663

dngos grub bde ba chen po nyid ni de yis yang dag nyams su myong / /don yod mchog tu bsod nams ldan/ /cho ga mchog tu rtag hu)pa ste/ /kun mchog gsang ba chen po ni/ /dngos grub thams cad myur sgrub (gyibyed/ /gang zhig grong khyer mchog riXdagyes par/ /zhugs te sgrub par byed rnams ④ni/ /shin tu mchog gi 'dod pa yihri/ /dngos grub dbang phyug bde des thob/ /gang gis dngos grub ma thob dang 6ste/ /bsod nams phun tshogs byed pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu rab zhugs na/ / sgrub po 'dir (7)ni rab grub 'gyur/ /gal te rdo rje sems dpa' mchog / snying po sogs kyis ma grub dang / /(8༄nye ba'i snying pos bsgrub ⑨byas kyang / /ma grub 'dir zhugs 'grub rtso )par 'gyur/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rtsa hu'irgyud du/ /de bzhin myur du grub pa yin/ /ji ltar phonyadang po'i khyim bzhugs 32nas/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor grub pa ltar/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad grub 14pa yis/ /de ltar thams cad grub pa min/ /ji ltar mchog tu gsang ba yi15/ /khang bzangs 35dam pa mthong ba yis/ /dam tshig rnams la hu tshonyams pa dang / /sgrib pa kun gyis bsgribs pa dang / /bdud sogs naltegadon gyis reg pa yang / /rtag pa'i thar pa thob par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs pa'am/ /yang na dkyil 'khor ma grub pa/ /slar yang mchog tu rab zhugs na/ /de dag myur du grub par 'gyur/ /grub 3)min yang 'dir ( )cung zad med/ /dngos grub las dang bde de bzhin/ /dngos grub thams cad bzhi du dzhai'agyur du/ /rtog pa kun las bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga shin tu gsang ba 85wa 664

cardogs cas①// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'jig rten gsum gyi dam tshig mchog gi gsang ba'i cho ga'i mchog ②ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dam tshig chen po gsum 'di yin(kye/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /ras la dkon mchog 3)gsum bri bya/ /go cha dang bcas rdo rje mchog /go cha sogs dusakyis legs par brgyan(6)/ /rdo rje mtshon cha brjod pa dang / /padma rin chen 'chang ba'o⑦/ /'khor lo de ni brtags dusanas su/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /ci rigs par ni bsgrub nyunyebyas na / /sum 'gyur du ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po zhes bya ba'i snying po mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa ster ba 'di yin te / oṃ zla (nyakho/ khyim mam nyu yang na nags tshal lam(nyi/ /snga ma bzhin du brgyan 8nas ni/ /mtshon cha mchog gi cho ga yisaris/ /thams cad byas nas nyunga'adi brjod bya/ /de nyid kyis ni rtso tshobacom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /lta ngan rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'di dag mya ngan 'das pa 8ston/ /ma lus 'dul ba la brtson pas/ /brtan zhing nges pa'i go cha bgosanyukye/ /shin tu srid pa la gnas mchog / go cha la sogs bgos 2 pa yin / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun zhes/ /dkon mchog gsum du gyur pa 21yin / /srid pa shin tu grub pa yishurnye/ /rnam par dag pa'i dpal 2)mdzad mchog /zhes du stebya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje'o/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid kyi dril bu ni/ thams cad 85wa 665

nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal①/ /zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig chen po gsum gyi sdom pa zhes bya ba ni/ longs spyod kun la longs spyod pa/ /rang lha bdag nyid kyis bsten (kyen/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i mchog /bdag gis bya zhes brjod cing mchod/ /ces ②bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgrub ④pa'ol/ /thabs kyi cho ga 'di yis ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyang / /bza' min pa yang (de bza' byas na/ /rtag pa'i dngos grub 'thob 6)par 'gyur//zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig chen po gsum mo/ /de ltar brjod nas snying po byin la ②phyag rgya bcing ba slob tu bcug menas ci ltar mngon par 'dod pa bsgrub ⑨par bya'o/ /de nas rdor 'dzin 8slob dpon gyis/ /rdo rje mchod pas mchod nas ni/ /ci 'dod pa yi hu)mchod pa yis/ /slob ma thams cad mchog tu gzhug /longs spyod kun la longs spyod kyang / /dkon mchog gsum po la phul ba/ /'dod pas bdag dang 33gzhan rnams la/ /mchod pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal mchog dang po las mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas rdo rje chen po khro bo'i rgyal po'i mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga ni/ ras la bcom ldan bri bya ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun bdag po ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar / /cho ga ji bzhin mchog tu'o/ / de yi lho pad 'dab gcig chabazhugs pa / / de yi 1lta'od kyis 'khor lor sten9lo/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje nyu 7rnal 'byor 85wa 666

che'i / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams logs la bri/ /dang por dmar dang dkar ba dzo)dang ske/ /gzhan ni thal ba ltar dkar ba/ /gsum po dkar dang lta ba ste ge/ /bzhi pa gser ltar dri med pa'o/ /rdo rje gtum po'i dbang phyug grub/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ bsgreng chadang bcas/ /rdo rje 'dod pa me ltar 'bar/ /de yi logs la mtshan ma gtodali/ /rdo rje khyab 'jug ma rdo rje'i/ /'khor lo gtod (5)pa de bzhin gzhan/ /rdo rje dril bu ba dan nam(pe/ / de yi 4)logs na g.yon bsnyems ⑧ma/ /cung zad mche (peb gtsigs pa yis/ /khro dang bcas pas zhal bzhad pa/ /rang bdag la ni thugs gtang cing / /sku ni zur gyi phyogs pa 1 snabazhugs / /de nas 'di yi nya7snying po ni/ /hūm̐/ de nas nye ba'i snying po ni/ /rdo rje dril sogs zhu lhan cig tu/ /rnam dben rol mo brdungs pa yis/ni/ /hi yi 14glu dang rol mo ni/ /brdung 8zhing zur bzhi rab tu bsgrub / /ces rtso tshobya ba ni 'dir bzlas pa'i cho ga'o/ /'khor lo der tsho/3ni bstan hu7byas nas/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mtshon cha mchog gi cho ga yis/ /cho ga thams cad rgyas pa'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid dang chos dang / dam tshig gi 3 )cho ga sbyin pa ni/ rtag tu chags pa las byung khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i byasku/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje khro bo che/ /rab 'bar ba yi du getshogs kyi sku/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor che/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kun tu 'bar/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'o/ /de nas chos ni/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad myur ba nyid du sgrub2snye/ /nam mkha' kun mchog sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad nam mkha' zhes brjod cing / /rdo rje'i chaphyag rgyas rgyas btab pas/ /'jig rten 85—667

gsum yang za bar byed/ /ces bya ba ni rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig go/ /cho ga 'di yis thams cad du/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bsgrub par bya/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po yis① las kyi tshogs rnams mi zad pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'o②/ /de nas ①ci lta ba bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho gas rang gi phyag rgya rnams kyis gar gyi mchod pa byas nas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dpal mchog dang po las rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas mchog tu phra ba dang / /shin tu bzang ba'i rdo rje yiX/ /grub chen dugasang ba'i rnal 'byor gyiyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor ⑦bshad/ /grong khyer skyed mos tshal sogs ⑧ni/ /ci lta ba ⑨bzhin rgyas byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin kun slob dpon gyis/ /ji bzhin du ni bsgrubs pa yisaX/ / /yid 'ong bzhi dang lhan cig tu/ /rang gi 'o/phyag rgyas me tog gtoratso/ /ci lta ba bzhin grong khyer 'jug /g.yon pa'i kha ni gyen du gtod8/ /rdo rje drag po bzhad ④chen po/ /sgra sgrogs mchog gi phyag rgya yis/ /'jug ste mgon tsol phyag 'tshal bya / /de la phyag ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ zhes bya ba brjod byas la/ /shin tu dga' ba'i dbugs 7rlung gis/ /ru lu ru lu slo drug ldan bar ma'i ru lu ru lu rlu ste/ 'di ni rdo rje drag po'i pho phyag 'tshal ba'i sgra sgrogs pa'i mchog 8ces bya ba 'dir rdo rje phyag gi 8phyag rgya ste/ phyag rgya thams cad dang gzhan rmongs pa dang thogs pa med pa'i dngos grub thams cad dang las thams cad la dgongs shing mchog tu grub pa ḍa )zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas 0mchog tu 85—668

shin tu ①gsang ba ②'di gsungs so/ /de nas yid 'ong dam bcas pas me tog sil ma dor nas ni/ /rdo rje padma'i dbang bskur gyis/ /dam tshig gsum ni gsal bar sbyin/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ padma'i thod pa las ①bya ste/ de stiyang rdo rje ⑤byin gyis brlabs pas na/ /rdo rje padma zhes bya ba'o⑨/ /de nas 'dir phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ sor mo thams cad phan tshun sbyar/ /kun mchog rtse mo dang bcas pa/ /mthe bo rdo rjes bkab bapa ni/ /rdo rje padma zhes 'grub 2po/ /rdo rje padma'i phyag rgya 'dis/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba'i sbyor ba dang / rdo rje padma'i rin po che'i cod pan gyis ⑨dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /'dis bodabang bskur ba tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis shin tu gdug pa dang drag po tsodang rab tu gtum pa dang ma rungs pa'i sems can thal bar brlag nas thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 3༄khams gsum ma lus pa'i stobs chen po dang ldan pa'i 'khor los sgyur hu ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ces bya bar byin gyis rlob ④par 'gyur ba dang / mchog tu rtag pa'i srung tsobar yang 'gyur ro zhes mchog tu shin tu 8gsang ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje bzung tu / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi lho)ni phyag rgya cheralhonge/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /rdo rje la sogs thob par tsho stegazung sgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis pa 'dra/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub/ /rdo rje can gyis byin rlabs me'agyur/ /bud med rnams kyang 'bebs gyur nas/ /ston pa'i rdo rje phab pa yis/ /rdo rje dang bcas phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rab tu 'gyur/ /de la thog mar re zhig gerdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba chen po 85—669

thal bar 3)rab tu rlog (snyepa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chen po'i khro bo'i rgyal po'i bdag po mchog dang po yang dag (gyi'abebs par byed pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i thabs kyis 'khon ༷bdu 'dzin pa'i khro bo'i me 'bar ba'i rdo rje rdo rje dang bcas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rgyal mtshan dang nges pa (5)sbyor ba ba dan (6)dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'chang ba rdo rje bsnyems nya pa'i bdag po shin tu khro ba 'bebs pas sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i smin mtshams ri kyikyi khro gnyer shin tu 'jigs shing (9ci 'jigs par byed pa'i spyan ser po dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 'jigs pa chen pos 'jigs par byed pa'i spyan gyi 3 )lta ba'i phyag rgya 'dis stong phrag brgya bzlas pas 'grub par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags pa dang dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang dbang du bya ba dang 'bebs par nus pa'o7/ /thams cad nam mkhar sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lan cig nyi brjod pa tsam gyis khams gsum ma lus pa'i rdo rje bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i bdud thams cad dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gdug 32pa dang drag po dang (1cherab tu gtum pa dang ma rungs pa'i sems can rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma drag po thams cad dang gang zhig nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams te/ de dag kyang thal bar rlog 15par 'gyur 10na/ dgra bo la sogs pa gzhan rnams nya 7lta smos nyurtekyang ci dgos/ don yod cing thogs pa med pa dang dngos grub thams cad dang las kyi tshogs rnams la dgongs shing mchog tu grub pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i thabs shin tu drag po 'di'i 37man ngag gi bzlas pa ni/sna'i dbugs phra ba nyid kyis bden pa'i rdo rje tshig gis rdo 7grub pa'i yid kyi 'dod 85—670

pa'i ①las thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi tshogs rnams la dam pa'i mchog 557tu grub pa'ol/ /rtsu de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma'i lha chen po durnams kyis ngabashad par bya ste/ de la thog mar re zhig zhu7rdo rje chen po 'dod pa'i me 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i lha mo chen mo rdo rje gzhu dang mda' stod 55pa'i spyan g.yon pa ste/ rdo rje spyan gyi ri lta ba'i phyag rgya 'dis thams cad sgrub ldepar mdzad pa dang sgeg pa dang bcas shing g.yo ba'i spyan gyi (1)zur gyis gzigs pa'i phyag rgyas btab pa tsam gyis thams cad la rgyas 'debs par mdzad pa dang /don yod pa hu )thogs pa med pa 37dngos po thams cad 8las kyi /lhatshogs rnams la dgongs shing mchog tu grub pa'o/ /de nas shesnyibacom ldan 'das yum 'di'i rdo rje phra mo'i 8g.yon pa'i khro bo'i bzlas pa ni yid kyis 'dod pas tsodangos grub thams cad dang / las kyi tshogs rnams la phortemachog tu grub pa'o/ /hrīḥ)snyeganyis pa ni rdo rje chen po 'dod pa'i me 'bar ba'i dam tshig gi lan zhes bya ba'i lha mo ste/dbus su rang gi lhag pa'i lha bstod 17pa'i zhal 'dzum pa'i spyan cung zhig 'dzums shing ske/ dga' ba chen po rdo rje'i spyan gyi ri )lta ba'i phyag rgya sdo lha'adis thams cad sgrub ni par mdzad pa dang tsum rin pa na sasnyedang / 'khyud zhugepa la sogs pa'i reg pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas gebatab pa tsam gyis thams cad la rgyas 'debs par mdzad pa dang ske/ phyag rgya thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa dang / thams cad kyis na gsod par mdzad pa dang / don yod cing thogs pa med par rin dngos grub thams cad dang / las kyi tshogs rnams la ༷ nyedagongs shing mchog tu grub pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yum 'di'i bya rog gi mgrin pa'i dbyangs kyis rdo rje ngag gi khro bo'i bzlas pa ni yid kyi 'dod pas ( dzha byedangos grub thams cad dang /85—671

las kyi 3)tshogs rnams la mchog tu grub pa'o/ /hūṃ/ gsum pa ni rdo rje chen po'i 'dod pa'i (geme 'bar ba thal bar rlog pa zhes bya ba'i lha mo chen mo ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje chen po dang kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rgyal mtshan 'chang ba nisgog pa dang bcas pa'i bzhad pas rtsismin mtshams ⑤kyi khro gnyer gyi ༅khro bo'i spyan te༅/rdo rje chen po'i khro bo ci'i 98)li ki la khro bo'i spyan gyi ②lta ba'i phyag rgya 'dis thams cad sgrub par mdzad 7pa'o/ /badzra zhes bya ba dang / ru lu ru lu ru lu ⑩sdi zhes bya ba tsam gyis bdud thams cad 'joms pa dang / don yod cing thogs pa med pa hunyedangos grub thams cad dang / las kyi tshogs rnams la dgongs shing mchog tu grub pa'o/ /hi/ bzhi pa ni rdo rje chen po 'dod pa'i me 'bar ba thal bar rlog pa 8'chi ba slong ba 12zhes bya ba g.yon bsnyems ④pa g.yas pas rang gi spyi bor rdo rje dril bu skyod rtsonapar mdzad pa sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i spyan ⑩shin tu gdangs pa ste/ rdo rje rgyal po drin gyi spyan gyi ⑩lta ba'i phyag rgyas thams cad sgrub par mdzad pa/ thal lcag la sogs nyushedang bzhad lho)gad dang rdeg nga )pa dang phyag rgyas rgyas btab pas 'chi na1ba thams cad slong bar mdzad pa/ don yod cing thogs pa med pa dngos grub thams cad dang / las kyi tshogs la dgongs shing mchog tu grub pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yum 'di'i dril bu'i dbyangs kyi rdo rje khro bo'i bzlas pa ni yid kyi tsho — 'dod pas ༷ snyedangos grub thams cad dang las tsokyi tshogs thams cad la mchog tu grub pa'o/ /ṣṭa/ de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i khams ltar grangs med cing / / rdo rje nyi ma las byung ba/ /tsonam mkha' kun gyi tsoganas skabs kyis / /dkyil 'khor 'di la rab zhugs pa/ /rdo rje mchog gi rnal 'byor gyi/ /85—672

dbang phyug ma lus kun nas 'bebs/ /de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor pa ston pa des rnal 'byor pa rang gi logs dag tu 'god ①pa yin te/ zla tshes ②dkyil 'khor rnam pa yis②/ /dkyil 'khor du ④ni dgod par bya/ /bkod dunarinas thams cad kun mchog gi/ /dngos grub dam pa bsgrub par bya/ /thams cad dgug dang mchod pa che/ /bdag byin brlab sogs grub ⑥pa yis/ /shin tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor de/ /brtag pa dang ni bsgrubs nas kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin kun slob dpon gyis/ /rdo rje slob ma rnams gzhug bya/ /de la re zhig lngarathog ma kho nar slob dpon gyis bcug ste tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dam tshig gsum gyi byin gyi rlabs ④kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams logs dag latu bzhag nas/skyes pa rnams kyang gzhug cing byang chub kyi sems kyis rdo rje chen po'i khro bo'i dam tshig dang dam tshig ②sdom pa dag len du gzhug par bya'o/ /khye'u dang bu mo rnams rab tu bzhag la tshogs dang bcas pa'i rang nyid kyis zhugs te/ bsrung rtsomab dang bskyab pa dang sba ba thams cad bya'o/ /de nas 'dir slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /mchog tu bskyed par 3)byas nas ni/ /gar byas spyi bor thal sbyar mchod/ /slob ma thams cad gzhug par bya / /ci 'dod pa yi 8dngos grub bskyedas/ /slob ma 8me tog dor du gzhug /rnal 'byor ma ni gang la babs/ /de dang de yi ⑩lha mo 'grub/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bgrol bonas ni/ /rnam pa kun tu yon blangs nas/ /rdo rje padma'i dbang bskur gyis/ /dam tshig gsum ni gsal bar sbyin/ /'dir mna' bsgag 8pa dang dbang bskur ba ni de nyid do/ /de la 'dir dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni 'di yin te/ mi byed nyushepa dang so sor rtogadu kye /gdug pa thams cad 85—673

gnon pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems ni che zhing brtanazhi la/ /mtshon cha de ni rgyal kun gyis/ /kun tu bzang po'i lag tu sbyin/ /bstan pa thams cad grub pa'i phyir/ /de phyir phyag na rdo rje yin/ /de nas rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba'i mchog tu gsang ba ni/ rtag tu chags pa las byung khrol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gdul bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar/ /mchog tu 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gsang ba mchog gi de kho na nyid ②ni/ rdo rje nyi ma 'char las ༷༷byung / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i grib ma 'di/ /sprul te ma lus bdud la sogs/ /gdug pa'i khrag ni gsol bar spyod/ /ces bya ba ni gsang ba mchog gi de kho na nyid do/ /de nas 'dir mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid 'bebs pa'i dril bu ni / shin tu gdug cing drag pa (snyedang / /bdag po drag po'i 96dbu rnams dang / /shin tu gnyid ni log pa medag /rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pas gsungs/ /zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid 'bebs (2)pa'i rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rgyal mtshan dang ⑨ba dan gyis 7dril bu thams cad 'bebs pa dang / rab tu grub tunyepar byed pa dang —/ thams cad ltung bar byed pa dang / slong bar byed pa'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor mchog gi dam tshig ni/ khrag chen ga bur dang bcas pa/ /tsandan ⑫dmar dang sbyar ba ni/ /tshogs kyi nang du nyisarab zhugs nas/ /rdo rje dang bcas rdo rje 'dzin/ /srin lag mthe bo 8rtse mo yis/ /nam mkha' thams cad sbyor mchog ldan/ /zla ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na'i/ /rtag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /ci 'dod pa ni bsten tso85—674

bzhin du/ /nam mkha' kun mchog sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' kun mchog sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' thams cad ces brjod cing / /rdo rje'i 3)phyag rgyas btab pa yi(ge/ /'jig rten gsum yang bza' bar bya/ /dngos grub las dang de bzhin bde/ /'di la cung zad mi 'grub ③med/ /las kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyis/ / dngos grub rtso)ma lus sgrub par 'gyur/ /don yod mchog tu grub pa dang / /gdug pa thams cad gnon 75)par byed/ /sdug bsngal kun 'phrog (yedapal dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni las kun byed/ /ces bya ba mchog tu gsang ba ⑦bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas ro dang bza' dang (0spyod pa gar dang 3)glu/ /rol mo'i mchod pa sogs ⑩kyis mgon la mchod/rnye/ /phul ba de yis hu rdo rje bla ma che/ / dad pas hu)bdag dang gzhan rnams mchod par bya/ /myos bcas 8myos byed btung ba ni/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten lhonyepa yis/ /rdo rje nyi ma me 'bar sogs0 / /ji bzhin rjes 'gro'i bzlas pa bzla/ /rang gsang cho gas blangs nyu tshopa yi/ /glu dang rol mo gar rnams dang / /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i mchod pa dang ske/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa/ /bud med tshogs dang bcas pa yi / /mchod pa rgya chen thams cad dang / /ci 'dod pa yi longs spyod kyis/ /mchod pa byas nas /sterab tu bsgrubasku16/ /ces bya ba mchog tu gsang ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ / de nas du )de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa so)la sogs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba sbyin par bya ste/ 'gro ba kun gyi khams rnams kyi/ /phra rab rdul dang mnyam pa nyid/ /rtog pa'i rgyal po grub pa ste/ /sangs rgyas la sogs mchog grub pa'o/ /gang zhig blo ni dpag med 85—675

pa'i / /khyad par du ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bde ba ①ni / /dam pa thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /zad pa thams cad zad 'gyur dang / /'phel ba thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang zhing (snyemathong bas mi snang 'gyur//gang nas kyang (kyeni 'jigs ④med byed/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang zla/ /nyi ma mkha' 'gro tshogs dkyil 'khor/ /khros nas yi ge hūm̐ tsam gyis/ /ma lus pa ni thal bar byed/ /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /mchog tu zhugs te tshogemathong nas ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol te/ /khyed rnams dang ni rab tu gnas/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /khyad par du ni ngan 'gro med/ /gzhan gyis mi thub mi sod cing / /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis⑥/ /shin tu srid pa'i dngos grub rnams/ /ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /rtag tso)tu yang ni bsrung (8)bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun (she)par gsungs/ /dam pa brtag 7pa'i bka' yin no/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam chos de bzhin dam tshig dang / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin kun de/ /sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /theg pa thams cad 'grub nyunyapa'i phyir/ /gdug pa 'dul ba snyidag pa zhesakyis/ /rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pas gsungs/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa dang ske/ /bdag po'i / grogs po bu rnams kyang / /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor mngon spyod kyis/ /shin tu gnyid ni log tu gzhug /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung nyami/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul / /de la phul na 'bras bu che/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin 7te/ /tshogs 85wa 676

las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la rab tu gnas/ /dam tshig rgyal po dang mnyam par/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin kun tsho17gyis/ /de ring khyed ②la dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum gyi (ri ni rgyal srid chego/ /stobs dpal 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba yin/ /rdo rje dam pa'i gsang mchog rnal 'byor ma'i / /mchog gi dam tshig gsang ba mthong nas ni/ /bdud la sogs pa'i sha yang zos nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs sbyor thob nas khyod grub yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po las mchog tu gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi ⑥mkha' 'gro ma'i 7dkyil 'khor gyi 85cho ga mchog yoX )tu grub pa'o// //de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rshadabang phyug gi mchog tu gsang ba 'gro ba 'dul ba'i cho ga ni/nye/ ras la bcom ldan bri bar bya/ /padma gar gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /glog gi 'khor lo yongs 'gyur nyurteba'i/ /'khor ba'i rnam 'phrul gar rnams kyis/ /padma la sogs phyag mtshan bri/ /phyag rgya 'khor lo ltar mdzad pa/ / de yi (2logs ni thams cad la/ /khro gnyer ma sogs sabri bar bya//drag mo nyugel sogs phyag mtshan gzugs/ /padma'i lha mo padmar 10bcas/ /dkyil 'khor der coni brtag byas na18/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mtshon cha mchog gi gang gang gis/bee/ /thams cad byas nas 'di brjod bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug ste/ /'dul ba'i thabs kyis dag pa yis sku/ /rol pa'i gar ni nyemadzad pa yin lha/ /85—677

zhes bya ba ni mchog gi rdo rje ste/ ci ltar padma dmar po ni0)/ /gnas kyi nyes pa sna tshogs kyi/ /tshon (gyigyi nyes pas mi gos pa/ /de bzhin khams gsum dag pa'ol/ /zhes bya ba ni mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid kyi (kyedril bu'o/ /cho ga gang dang gang dag gis/ /'gro ba rnams ni ④'dul 'gyur ba/ /padma dag mchog rnal 'byor bdag /de dang de yis dag (depar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig go/ /de nas ci lta ba (7bzhin du padma gar gyi mchod pas mchod la cho ga thams cad rjes su spyad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying po don thams cad grub ④pa'i cho ga ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /ras ris de ni blo gros che/ /ljang gu bee ḍūrya dang ⑧mtshungs / /nam mkha'i snying po bri bar bya/ / de yi padma gcig la gnas/ /du de yi lnga'od kyi 'khor lor brten/ /dbang bskur ma dang gter ma dang / /rgyal mchog mnga' bdag pho/mchod chen ponarte/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa de'i / /'khor lo brtag par byas nas ni/ /mtshon cha mchog gi sbyor ba 0yis/ /cho ga rgyas pa ji bzhin pa'o/ /de nas 1/rdo rje mchog gi 8ni/ /nyi ma 'di ni dam pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong / /nam mkha'i snying po bcom ldan 'das/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /de nas chos kyi rin po che'i dril bu ni/ bsam pa grub pa thams cad kyi/ /nor gyi bsam pa grub pa mchog /de yang 'dod par rab grub tshephyir/ /'dod las thar pa bde ba che/ /zhes bya ba'o( tsho/ /sbyin 38min rnams ni sbyin bya'o/ /'dod pa kun gyi bde ba rnams/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan rnams lalho'i/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs phyir ro/ /zhes bya ba ni dam tshig gi mchog go/ /dam tshig 'di yis 85—678

mchog tu ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /myur du yang dag dam pa mchog /mi 'gyur mchog ni grub par mdzod/ /de ltar gsang ba 3)mchog gi tshon tshul dag ni/ /ji bzhin cho ga mchog tu rgyas pa ste/ /mchog chen de ni rtog pa thams cad kyi/ / snying po nikhyad par dngos grub li'agrub par 'gyur/ /dpal mchog dang po las rtog pa thams cad kyi bsgrub ⑤pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas grub chen thams cad kyi/ /sgrub yipa'i mchog ni bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya cheli/ /rtog pa kun mchog grub pa'i phyir/ /snod ma yin pa'i sems can ni⑤/ /sdig pa thams cad byed rnams la/ /mthong ba la sogs sems can don/ /sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa yin/ /mthong med long ba de rnams ni/ /bsod nams med sogs klu)rtags ldan la/ /rdo rje sems sogs 51 nosems dpa' mchog /mthong ba'i thabs kyi rgyu rnams ni/ / rdo rje nyunyesems sogs sems mchog gis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcing ba ste/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' /geba'o/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' yi/ /gang phyir sku rnams brtan pa ni/ / de yi 7phyag rgyar thegegags pa ste//dngos grub kun phyir de dag sprul/ /gang dag bzung 35ba tsam gyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs mchog /mthong zhing mngon par mthong ba nyid/ /mchog tu bsdus par tu gyur pa yin/ /phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /gang phyir bsdus par 'gyur ba phorteste/ /rdo rje sems sogs nyu7sems dpa' rnams/ /nyams pas 'jigs pas grub par 3 )'gyur/ /ci ltar rgyal po rnams kyi bka'i(1//rtags kyi phyag rgya 'da' dka' ba/ /phyag rgya gsal tsho rteb kun gyis kyang / /85—679
