g.yon pa'i khu tshur gsang bar reg na ①thams cad bsgrub ②pa'o/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje chen po'i lta bas thams cad grub pa'o/ /smin ma gyen du bteg ②pas ltung ba slong ba'o/ /rang gi ma (snyemachu nang du myang bas (5ciskal ba bzang po chen po bsgrub ⑥pa'o/ /rang gi lce bskyod pas rang nyid kyi 57 bden pa thams cad dang de kho na nyid gsal zhing mi slu bar smra ba'o/ /rang gi lus la 'bebs ⑧pas gzugs thams cad yongs su bsgyur ba ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'am sangs rgyas su yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /rang gi bdag nyid rdo rje bsgoms pas nam mkha' la 'gro ba'o/ /de nas dang po las thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcu ni rdo rje thal mo kha ṭwāṃ gis 7so/ /dngos grub thams cad rdo rje khu tshur dag gis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur dag gis dngos grub thams cad do / /thams cad gsod pa ni khro bo'i ⑩khu tshur dag gis so/ /thams cad sbyar ba ni 7padma'i khu tshur dag gis so/ /nor thams cad 'brog 12pa ni nor bu'i khu tshur gyis so/ /thams cad 'bebs pa ni thams cad 'bebs pa'i khu tshur gyis so / /thams cad gar byed du gzhug pa ni kha ṭwāṃ ga gtor ba'i khu tshur dag gis so / /thams cad smrar 8gzhug pa ni mdzub mo mnyam pa'i lce'i khu tshur dag gis so / /thams cad bskyod pa ni brtan pa'i khu tshur dag gis so/ /thams cad gzhug cing don yod par bsgrub 8pa lini rdo rje lcags kyu'i khu tshur gyis so/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis ci 'dod pa'i lag pa'i sor mo'i phyag rgya bcu ste/don yod cing thogs pa med par skad cig mas myur du grub par byed pa /lha'adi lta ste / pi bang ⑩dang / gling bu dang / rdza rnga dang / mu kuṇḍa dang / cha lang dang ske/ rnga bo 'o)che dang / rnga skum dang / rnga pa ṭa ha nyunyadang / guñdza 5 )dang /85—729

ti mi li stiste/ 'di rnams kyis rgyas btab na thams cad du rjes su chags pa dang ske/ dbang du byed pa dang / 'bebs pa dang / rims dang / dug dang /sbyar dug dang / gdon las grol ba dang / gsod pa dang / 'thab mo las rnam par rgyal ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob pa yin no zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /'dod chags chen po (gernam dag phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chen po yin/ /phyag rgya'i rtog — pa rab tu brtags/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma mchog /de nyid dad pa'i rjes 'brangs ④la/ /rtogs pa tsam gyis skad cig gis / /don yod kun grub bde bar gsol/ /zhes bya'o/ /dpal mchog dang po las mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyud rdzogs sgo(zhen// //de nas mchog tu mkhas shing mtha' las 'das pa tshad med cing gzhal du med pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i mchog gi dngos grub chen po'i bdag nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi tsho6)las kyi tshogs mchog tu dam pa grub pa zhes bya ba rdo rje gar las byung ba'i tshogs thams cad kyi phyag rgya stong bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /phyag rgya chen po mnyam gzhag nas/ /sgeg bcas 'dzum 97 sogs bkrol ba yis las kyi phyag rgya chen po brgya98/ /thams cad gar gyis bsgrub par bya/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje gsang ba'i lcags kyus khyad par du las kyi phyag rgya 99)bcing ba ste brgya 7phyag dang po mchog tu bsgrubs te rdo rje dam tshig lha mo rnams kyi 91stephyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings nas ni/ /kha sbyor nang du gsal ba ste/ /mchog dang po yi zhunagasang chen gyinyu / /las kyi phyag rgya rgya gzhan yin/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje lha mo 85—730

gsang ba thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje las kyi 3)mchod pa che'i/ /thal mos spyi bor bzung nas ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya grub pas na/ /dbang po rnams dang sbyar bar bya/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje thams cad kyi mchod pa chen po'i lha mo rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsnyems (2mas gar bya zhing / /sgeg bcas mthe'u (ri)chung sogs bkrol bas/ /de nyid bcings nas gar bya zhing / /phyi ma 'di ni 'byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje thams cad kyi las don yod ④pa'i dam tshig grub pa'i (shedabang phyug chen po'i mchog gi phyag rgya brgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam gzhag nas//thams cad kyis (yeni bsgrub par bya/ /mchog dang po'i (3)las chen po'i phyag rgya mchog ⑧gzhan yin no zhes bya ba rgyal mo thams cad kyi phyag rgya/ mda' lnga bsdus pa bcings nas ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya bde ba brgya(9ste/ /rab tu dga' mchog ma 0bkrol bar/ /bde ba nyid du mngon par sbyar/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i 'dod pa ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /ji bzhin phyag rgya mchog sbyor bas/ /las kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs brgyal/ /mchog dang po ni rab tu brtaganyu1 /ces 51 dbya ba rdo rje thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje lha mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje lha mo'i kha ṭwāṃ ga /lus kun gyis 12ni gar bya zhing / /rdo rje gar mchog glu blang zhing / /dang po'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'o/ /ci ltar gong du rgyas 14gsungs pa/ /rol mo mchog gi phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /rol mo brdung nyunyezhing glu len pa/ /phyag rgya kun gyi 15gsal ba brgyas rme/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje thams cad kyi lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya 78ste phyag rgya stong mchog tu grub pa'o/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' rtso ltar grangs med pa'i/ /85—731

phyag rgya'i rgyal mo grub mchog ster/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po yi/ /dbang phyug chen po'i mchog grub phyir/ /nam mkha' kun gyi go skabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni rab tu zhugs/ /①dam pa mchog tu grub par byed/ /mchog gi dam pa rgyud chen po/ /dam pa mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma mchog /de nyid dad pa'i rjes 'brangs la②/ /phyag rgya kun gyi tshul 'di ni/ /bstan par bya ste gzhan la min/ /de ltar mchog tu mi 'gyur dam pa'i dngos grub bde ba yi/ /mchog tu rnam dag rdo rje bde grub mtha' yas 'bras bur ldan/ /dpal mchog dang po'i gsang ②ba'i de nyid mchog gi sku'i tshul lo/ /mchog tu rtag gepa'i rtog pa'i ②tshul 'di yongs su mthar thug pa'o/ /dpal mchog dang po las dam pa mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyud rdzogs sto༅// //de nas sems dpa' chen po kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang bcas pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'chang chen gtso bo ni/ /mgon la bde gshegs rnams kyis gsol/ /kun mchog nam mkha' chen po yi/ /dngos grub dbang phyug rab grub phyir/ /rtog pa thams cad kun bsdus pa'i/ /de nyid sems dpa' chen pos gsungs/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /rtog pa'i don 'di gang brjod pa/ /gang gis rgyud 'di phyi ma la/ /dang po'i gnas mchog ci ltar lags/ /de bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /rab dga' nyid dang bzang ba nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems 97bdag ji ltar lags/ /sems dang sems dpa' (geting 'dzin dang //de bzhin rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'chang chen nyid dang ni/ /byang chub spyod 85—732

pa ji ltar lags/ /bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba nyid/ /byang chub sangs rgyas ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje gtum po mthar ①byed nyid/ /phyag na rdo rje ji ltar lags/ /ji ltar dang po'i rigs byung dang / /'dod pa thar pa ji ltar lagasal/ /ji ltar mgon po rnam gsum dang / /khyod ni ji ltar thams cad nyid / /dang po'i snying po ji ltar byung ②/ /de ci nye snying ji ltar lags/ /bde chen rdo rje chen po yis/ /don yod dam tshig ji ltar lags/ /dkyil 'khor zhes bya ji skad gsungs/ /de yi rnam smin ji lta bu/ /thig gdab pa dang brtag pa yis/ /dngos grub ji ltar gsungs pa lags/ /gsang ba lnga yi de bde ba/ /ji ltar gyur pa ji lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnams dang ni / /rigs rnams gsal ba ji ltar lags/ /thams cad dbang bskur de nyid dang / /phyag mtshan tshogs kyi de nyid dang / /thams cad dgug gzhug mchod pa che/ /bdag byin brlabs ④sogs sgrub pa chel/ /de ni de nyid gsang ba dang / /don yod pa ni mchog nyid de/ /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub (6dpa'i phyir//thams cad bdag cag rnams la gsungs/ /zhes ④bya ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (gemachog gi mdo gsungs so/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /rtog pa kun gyi bdag po ni/ /the tsom latshogs rnams gsan nas su/ / 'di yi 7lan ni gsungs pa yin/ /de la rtog pa'i don gyi rgyud ci ltar yin zhe na/ rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams las/ /sems can don ni yongs brtags 3nyepas/ / des ni rtog nyurtepar gsungs pa ste/ /rtog pa yongs su dag phyir ro/ /de nas rgyud phyi ma ji ltar yin zhe na/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya bar bshad/ /phyi ma sngar dang yang dag byung / /de nyid gsang ba'i gsang ba 85—733

dang ske/ /phyi ma dang bcas rgyud du 'dod/ /de la dang po gnas zhes ①bya ba'i rgyud ji ltar yin zhe na/ nam mkha' kun la rab tu gnas/ /rdo rje kun mchog rang ②bzhin mchog /bde ba chen po dga' ba che'idu/ /grong khyer der ni mi 'gyur mchog /ces bya ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' ④rtog pa thams cad kyi rtog pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /de la thog ma tha ma med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ji ltar yin zhe na/ nam mkha' ⑤skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin / /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de gang yin zhe na/ kun (snyomachog dngos grub chen po yi/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /rab tu dga' ba mi 'gyur mchog /de la bcom ldan 'das dga' ba chen po nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ nyes pa med cing shin tu rtag /'dod chags kun gyi 0rjes chags pa/ /de nyid 'di yis gsang ba 'di/ /'dod chags chen po spridaga' ba che/ /de la ci kun tu bzang po nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i cho ga mchog /de la rdo rje bsnyems pa'i lconyebadag po bcom ldan 'das ji ltar yin zhe na/ kun mchog dngos grub chen po yi/ /dbang phyug chen po'i 0phyag rgya'i mchog /rdo rje dbang phyug cher 7bstod pas/ /rdo rje bsnyems 32pa'i bdag po'i 1lhabadag /ces bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /mchog dang po yi 8de nyid 'di/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gang gang nyiltabarjod/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'byor pa rnams/ /de la thams cad 'grub tso85—734

par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba mchog gi de kho na nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas de'i 'og tu las kyi bya bas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi mchog nyid du bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba 0)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi (gyisems can ji ltar yin zhe na/ bsam gyis mi khyab rgya che ba/ /zab dudangos kun bde lnga/mi 'gyur ba/ /thams cad khyab cing dri ma med/ /byang chub sems ni bdag brtan pa/ /de nas 'di'i (5)las kyi khyad par ni/ sems nyid brtan pa nyid sems pas/ /ting 'dzin de la mnyam par gzhag /rnam shes las ni rdo rje kun / /rdo rje las ni 'dzin 'gyur (6)te/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin ji ltar yin zhe na/ sems dpa'i byin rlabs 9) sbyor ba ni/ /bdag la byin rlabs 'byemachog bsgrub ⑨pa/ /nyin re sgrub par byed na des/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid thob 'gyur/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po'i rtso )spyod pa rtso1ji ltar yin zhe na/ snying stobs rdul dang mun pas kyang / /gang phyir sems can don gyur 8pas/ /de phyir nga 512ni kun tu bzang / /byang chub spyod pa'i rjes 'jug pa'o / /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bdud nyid dang 'dul bas rgyal ba ji ltar yin zhe na/ sems nyid kho na bdud nyid de/ /sems nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rang sems gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag ni bdud nyid gyur pa yin/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang sangs rgyas yin zhe na/ rang sems so sor rtog pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems mchog rdo rje nyid/ /de phyir de nyid sangs rgyas nyid/ /bdag byin rlabs skemachog grub phyir ro/ /de la 'ji ltar bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 85—735

yin zhe na/ mi phyed so sor rtogs pa dang / gdug pa thams cad nges par gnonashe)ske/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems ni brtan pa bdag /kun tu bzang po'i lag tu ni/ /mtshon cha de ni rgyal bas byin/ /brtan (3)pa thams cad grub pa'i phyir/ /des na phyag na rdo rje des/ de la ②ji ltar dang po'i rigs las byung ba ④shis pa'i ⑤rgyud yin zhe na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa yum/ /yab ni thabs la mkhas pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gdul bya'i (6)phyir/ /rig (7 rnams rab tu byung ba'o/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das 'dod dang ༷ thar pa yin zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das ni chags pa che/ /dngos grub thams cad rjes chags phyir/ /dngos grub thams cad mi 'gyur bde//bde ba chen po zhes brjod pa'o/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam pa gsum yin zhe na/ bdag ni dus gsum mtha' yas phyir/ /nga (7ni srid gsum gdul bya'i phyir/ /gsum mchog 'jig rten gsum kun phyir/ /'jig rten gsum nga khams gsum nga / /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad nyid yin nyu )zhe na/ nga 3)nyid brtan pa thams cad bde/ /bsod nams kun mchog che ba'i phyir/ /g.yo ba sems kyis 'dus byas phyir/ /sgyu ma thams cad nga yin rnam/ /zhes bya ba rang gi las kyi bya ba'i de kho na nyid rdo rje sems dpas gsungs sol/ /de la ji ltar dang po'i glu riṅgā byung ba shes pa yin zhe na/ srid pa shin tu grub pa yi/ /dbang phyug chen po mchog grub phyir/ /gzi can sems can don mdzad phyir/ /bskal pa thog mar bcom ldan 32gsungs/ /de nas de 8gang yin zhe na/ 'dod chags chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /rab tu dga' ba mi 'gyur mchog /gsang ba'i phyir ni snying por 35brjod/ /yi ge rghaṃ ni mi 'gyur 85—736

mchog /de nas nye ba'i ①snying po yi/ /de kho na nyid shes pa ni/ /de nyid gsang zhing gsang ba dang / /snying po rab tu brjod par bya/ /snying po'i ②rjes su sgrub ①par 'grub④/ /nye ba'i snying po nyid du brjod/ /de la ji ltar gebade ba chen po'i rdo rje don yod pa dam tshig gi bshad pa'i rgyud yin zhe na/ dngos grub kun gyi mi 'gyur bde/ /bde ba chen po zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje de nyid (6stedon yod grub/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' meba'o/ /zhes bya ba'i mchog gi dam pa'i glu bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar dkyil 'khor gyi don shes pa yin zhe na/ ji ltar gnas dang 'khor lo dang / /ji ltar dgod par du'agro ba dang / /'khor dang bcas pa dgod pa gang / /de 'dra'i 'khor lo mchog gis sprulatshi/ /de nas rnam par shes pa ni/ /rdo rje sems sogs ⑩lha rnams kyim/ /'khor lo mngon sum 'osnyemathong ba yis/ /rtag pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba/ /phyir na bris na'ang de bzhin no/ /de nas thig gdab pa'i 0cho ga ni/ shes rab can gyis dkyil 'khor bris/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs la/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lhor/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ / zordo rje thig gis yongs bskor bar8/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nyer mdzes shing / /sgo bzhi rta babs kha khyer dang / /dra ba dra phyed la sogs brgyanas/ /der bdag po'i ⑩don shes pa 3nyeni rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bu zhe na/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog / rdo rje sems dpa' mche rang bzhin/ /dpal mchog dang po zhes byar brjod / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de gang zhe na/ kun mchog dngos grub chen po yi/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /rab 85—737

gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar thams cad dgug pa'i rgyud yin zhe na/ / rtog pa thams cad tshigasang chen gyi(2ri/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dril bcas pas/ /bkug ste ②de nas rjes bsgrub ④pa/ /dril bu nyid kyis (pebya ba yin/ /ji ltar mchod pa thams cad kyi cho ga yin zhe na/ rtog pa kun gyi gsang chen gyis6/ /rab tu dga' bas mchod nas ni/ /glu dang rol mo (medarnam 'phrul bas/ /mchod de slar yang rnal 'byor mchod/ /de la ji ltar dngos grub thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs ⑧pa'i dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid yin zhe na/ rtog pa kun gyi gsang chen gyis99)/ /phyag rgya kun gyis malegs byin brlabasam/ /dam tshig chen po 'di nyid kyis/ /rang nyid bsgrubs nas snying po bzlas/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems 32pa'i bdag po'i nyunyebadag /ces bya ba rmo rimachog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /de la ci'aji ltar rang lhag pa'i lha thams cad kyi sgrub 37pa chen po'i rgyud yin zhe na/ brtan 1 tshopa dang ni g.yo ba dang / /rtog pā kun las bsgrub bya gang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /de dag thams cad tsho1 ri bsgrub par bya/ /de nas thams cad rjes su sgrub 39pa'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin gyur nas/ /rdo rje dril bu skurab sad cing / /rtog pa thams cad rjes bsgrubs ( rjepas/ /mchog dang las nasogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la ji ltar 'bad pa med pa thams cad sgrub du — pa'i rgyud yin zhe na/ bsgrub bya ci 'dod bsgrubs nas ni/ /phyi nas ji ltar 'dod pa yisari sku/ /ci 'dod spyod pa la spyod cing ske/ /thams cad byed cing thams cad bza'/ /langs pa 'am ni 'dug pa 'am / /gang dang de ru 'chag pa 'am/ /dgod pa dang ni smra ba 'am/ /gang 85—739

der ji bzhin de bzhin no/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam gyur①/ /de dang de yi ngo bor bya/ /mnyam par bzhag nas rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bya/ /de nyid rnal 'byor 'di yis ni②/ /thams cad nyid ni bsgrub par bya / /sangs rgyas kun dngos thams cad ni/ /rtag tu mthong zhing grub par 'gyur / /dam tshig chen po de nyid ni/ /mkhas pa gang zhig dad pas klog /de ni sdig kun dang bral bas/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid do/ /de ltar dpal mchog dang po'i cho ga ma nyams mchog gi bla ma gsal/ /mchog tu gsang ba sgrub (kyepa'i cho ga bde mchog myur du grub phyir gsol/ /rdo rje mchog 'dzin dang bcas bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyis byin brlabs ④pa/ /bde chen dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dga' chen mchog gis de gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po las mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkha' ltar thug ⑤med kun tu 'gro/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bstod 56)nas ni/ /rtog pa'i mthar thug don gsungs so/ /bdag gi snying po dang 'di 4)mchog chen po'o/ /bde chen mchog gi mchog dang rjes su chags pa che/ /kun mchog sems dpa' rnams kyi rtag tu 'byung gnas ni/ /kun mchog 'byor pa'i dbang phyug 'di ni dugaso ba yin/ /mtha' yas pa dang thog med mthar thug med pa ni/ /mchod bya chen po thams cad rnams kyi tshul chen po/ /nam mkha' dang mtshungs mchog gi dngos 'phel gsol / /de ni sus kyang mthar thug byed par nus pa min/ /sems can rnams ni dman la zhen cing nyung la dga'/ /dad pa med cing slu 6)ba byed la ma sbyangs pa/ /rtag tu rjes su chags shing mchags bral la chags pa/ /de rnams 85—740

la ni phan phyir 'di ni mthar thug pa'o/ /gang gi khyim na (11'di gnas gang gis rab tu bsgrub ②pa 'am/ /yang na ji bzhin gsungs pa rtag tu 'dir sgrub nabyed / /so sor nyams su myong ba'i mthu yis thams cad du/ /bdud kyi las tshogs ④rnams kyis de ni gnod mi nus/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs (5)sku ni gang gis sgrub byed pa/ /gzugs brnyan la (6sogs thams cad 'dir ni ji bzhin gsungs / /des ni thams cad so sor nyams myong nus par ldan/ /bdud kyi las tshogs ⑦rnams kyis de ni gnod 785mi nus/ /gang zhig rdo rje la 94)sogs gzugs brnyan la sogs pa/ /ji ltar 'dod pa 'di dag thams cad sgrub 1 ci par byed/ /rab tu 'dod pas yi ge hūm̐ las bris nas ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub de yis ster zhing thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po rnams kyis rnam par sbyang bar 31mdzad pa ni/ /gang la don kun dag phyir mdzad par mi 'gyur min/ /'di 1 ni bgegs byed bdud rnams kyang ni yod ma yin/ /rtogs pas dngos grub 'phel zhing byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /nga ni bdud nyid mi 'gyur brtan med nyid mi 'gyur / /brtan pa nyid phyir nga ni brtan par mdzad pa yin/ /rtag pa 'di ni mchog chen gang gis sgrub byed pa/ /de la nga 3lhani dngos grub myur du sgrub par byed/ /dngos grub chen po la 1 thams cad 15rjes su chags shing shin tu mnyes pa dang / shin tu brtan pa dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / rtag tu rgya che bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /gang zhig mchog gi rgyal po 19snying po sgrub nyu tshobyed pa/ /rgyal ba thams cad dgyes shing rgyal ba dgyes par mdzad/ /de dag grags pa chen po thob nas bde ba'ang thob/ /de phyir 'di la dad cing gus par bya ba yin / /de nas rgyal ba rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes bya ba byin 85—741

༄gi /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya pradzñā pā ra mi tā ②na ya sha ta pas sha ti kāl / bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya ⑤lnga bcu pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i ⑤dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (nyamakhyen pa'i bye brag rnam pa ④tha dad pa dang ldan pa/de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che (0thams cad kyi 〈cod pan gyis khams gsum du dbang bcu rdzogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi makye/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor can chen po'i dbang phyug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgyas mchos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa/ sna tshogs kyi / bya ba mdzad de/ ma lus pa na sems can gyi khams lus pa med pa thams cad kyi /stere ba thams cad yongs su bskang ba'i phrin bla85—801

dag par 'gyur ro/ /shes pa thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje su la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / sgom pa de 'dod chags dang / dri ma thams cad kyi nang na 'dug kyang padma lta bur 'dod chags kyi nyes pa rnams dang / dri ma rnams dang / glo ①bur gyi nyon mongs pa rnams kyis gos par mi 'gyur te/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang ge'agyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ③chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don gyi ④gnas 'di nyid rgya cher ston cing bzhin rab tu 'dzum dmul te/ padma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i ⑤dri mas mi gos pa la lta zhing 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyir (7padma gzugs sna tshogs zhes ⑥bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /hrīḥphu)/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa khams gsum thams cad kyi dbang pos yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑨dbang bskur ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul ⑩'di bshad de/ dbang bskur ba sbyin pa ni khams gsum thams cad kyi rgyal srid thob par 'gyur ro/ /nor sbyin pa ni re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos sbyin pa ni chos thams cad kyi nyunyemanyam pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /zang zing 7sbyin pa ni lus dang ngag dang sems kyi bde ba thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 32chen po nam mkha'i snying po bzhin rab tu 'dzum ste3byu/rang gi mgo la rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur ba'i phreng ba 'ching zhing don 'di 85—807

nyid rgya cher ston te/ dbang bskur ①ba thams cad kyi dam tshig rin po che zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /ṭwāṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya thob pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur 'dzin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag (kyepas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du 'gyur rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa ni chos thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa ni ting nge 'dzin du rathams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ④thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa ni (5)lus dang ske/ ngag dang / sems bethams cad rdo rjer ( sku rdo rje'i bdangos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /su la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan pa dang ske/ 'chang ba 7—dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bogs 7pa dang / sgom pa des dngos grub thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / shes pa thams cad dang / dgos pa thams cad dang / lus dang / ngag dang /sems 11thams cad rdo rjer rdo rje'i dngos grub dam pa thob nas/ myur du 8bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i (snyekhu tshur dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pas don gnas 'di rgya cher bstan 7te/ de bzhin rab tu 'dzum zhing rdo rje sra ba'i phyag rgya skedangos 85wa 808

grub thams cad kyi dam tshig ①ces bya ba'i snying po 'di smras rdo riso/ /aḥ'o ci de nas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas yang 'khor lo ltar yi ge bskor ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad de/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid do0//mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis ⑤chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa'o/ /smon pa med pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad smon pa med pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa don 'di nyid rgya cher ston te/ bzhin rab tu 96)'dzum bzhin du bdag gi rtso)ral gri des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'debs (kyeshing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i tho)mchog 'di smras 0so/ /ahunye/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor der nyu2'dus pa'i tu de bzhin gshegs pas hu9'khor lo chen po la 'jug pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /don gyi mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor lo la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad kyi comanyam pa nyid la 'jug pa ni dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo la 'jug par 'gyur ro'i/ /thams cad kyi ngamanyam pa nyid la 'jug pa ni 'khor lo thams cad la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' skyo sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba chos 3)nyid kyi don 'di 5 rirgya cher ston cing 'dzum dmul ri nyanas rdo rje'i du rte'akhor lo bskor ri gezhing rdo rje'i 4'khor lo 85wa 809

thams cad la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /hūṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa thams cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i snod kyis ①mchod pa thams cad kyi mchog ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /byang chub kyi sems bskyed snyipa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o(ba/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su skyob pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o / /dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ger 'dri ba dang /yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / brjod pa dang ske/ ston pa dang / nyan pa dang / sems pa ④dang / sgom pa dang /mchod pa byed pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i ⑤mdzod don de nyid rgya cher ston te/ bzhin rab tu 'dzum zhing las thams cad don yod pa'i dam tshig ces 96)bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /oṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 97)sems can thams cad (8)'dul nus pa ⑨yang ye shes kyi khu tshur yongs su 'dzin pa sems can thams cad 'dul ba shes pa'i snying po zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas khro ba bomanyam pa nyid do/ /sems can thams cad 'dul ba nyid pas khro ba (kā'adul ba nyid do/ /sems can thams cad chos nyid pas khro ba 3 chos nyid do/ /sems can thams cad rdo rje nyid pas khro ba 8rdo rje nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad 85—810

'dul ba ni byang chub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa don de nyid rgya cher ston te/ bzhin rab tu 'dzum zhing rdo rje ①mche ba'i phyag rgya dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi gzugs kyis rdo rje ①khro bo'i gad mo zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /ha/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la gnas pas yang chos thams cad kyi (kyemachog ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /thams cad don nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don nyid do/ /thams cad chos nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos nyid do/ /thams cad las nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las nyid du rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi don yod pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ don yod pa thams cad kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ /hūm̐/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis yang sems can thams cad byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ④kun tu bzang po thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems can thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no/ /thams cad rdo (5)rje'i snying pos dbang bskur ba nyid pas sems can thams cad ni rdo rje'i snying po (yecan no/ /ngag 57nathams cad rab tu 'byung (kyebs sems can thams cad ni chos kyi snying po can no//85—811

sems can thams cad kyi bya ba byed pa la sbyor bas sems can thams cad ni las kyi snying po can no/ /de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i ①rigs rnams kyis ca co'i sgra phyung ②nas/ chos nyid kyi don rgya cher ston cing snying po phul te/ de nas rdo rje'i dbang phyug chen pos rang gi de kho na'i snying po 'di phul lo/ /dri②/ de nas ma mo thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te tshig mthun par ④thams cad dgug pa dang / gzung ba dang / gzhig pa dang / sgrub pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba rang gi de kho na'i snying po 'di phul lo/ /bhyoḥdu/ de nas sbrang rtsir chudabyed pa tsonol sogs pa ming po gsum gyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te / tshig mthun par 7sherang gi de kho na'i snying po 'di phul lo0/ /gtso/ de nas sring mo bzhis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ rang gi de kho na'i snying po 'di phul lo/ /hā/spe/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas mu med bel mthar thug cing mu med pa'i chos dang ldan pas yang chos 8'di mthar thug par byin gyis brlab pa'i liphyir chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi mthar thug pas byin gyis brlabs nyusnyepa rdo rje cizhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad dotsha/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa nyid pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mtha' yas pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid pas rdo rje thams cad mu med pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu 3 7phyin pa du ma nyid pas chos thams cad du ma nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa mthar thug pa med pa nyid pas chos thams cad mthar thug pa med pa nyid yin no/ /su la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang 3 / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa 85—812

dang ske/ rjod ①pa dang / sgom ②pa des gsangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thug pa med pa'i mthar phyin te/ sgrib pa thams cad zad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ rdo rje 'dzin par 0myur du 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di don yod pa dang ske/ thogs pa med par myur du 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /sems can chen po legs so legs/ /bde ba chen po legs so legs/ /theg pa chen po legs so legs/ /blo gros chen po legs so legs/ /cho ga 'di ni legs par smras/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin kun gyis/ /'bras bu yod pa 'dul ba'i mchog /rdo rje mdo sde byin gyis brlabs / /cho ga'i rgyal po bla na med/ /gang rnams 'di dag 'dzin pa ni/ /bdud la sogs pa thams cad kyis/ /de dag mi sod mi tshugs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dngos grub dam pa thams cad kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /ring por mi thogs thob par 'gyur/ /de skad gsungs nas gsang ( grub phyir/ /rdo rje can gyis bshad pa la/ /kun mchog sangs rgyas mkhas bcas pa/ /thams cad kyis (6nani mngon par bstod5)ri/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i chos nyid brnyes pa chos thams cad spros pa med pas yang bde ba chen po rdo rje'i (2)don yod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba rdo rje don yod pa'i 7chos mnyam pa nyid kyi nyu )shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo mchog dang po thog ma dang / tha ma dang / dbus med pa'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi /nye'adod chags chen po dngos grub dam pa 85—813

ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po dngos grub dam ①par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ②bde ba chen po dngos grub dam pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen po dngos grub ③dam par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen po dngos grub dam pa ni bdud chen po'i stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dngos grub dam par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bdud chen po'i stobs thams cad ④rab tu 'joms pa dngos grub dam pa ni khams gsum pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug chen po dngos grub dam par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi khams gsum pa rdzu'uthams cad kyi dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub dam pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams (bem lus pa na sems can gyi khams lus pa med pa yongs su sbyong bar 'dod pa'i rgyu'i phyir 'khor ba la (7)yang chags shing brtson 'grus che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams (8)ma lus pa na sems can gyi khams lus pa med pa yongs su bskyab khyapa dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba dang / mchog tu 7shin tu bde ba chen po'i 7dngos grub dam par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas tshimachog 'dug par 'gyur ba'i 8tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don / /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /shes rab pha rol phyin thabs dang / /ye shes gnas su bsgrubs pas ni/ /chos kun rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba yongs su dag par 'gyur7/ /chags la sogs pas 'dul na ni/ /'khor ba'i bar du rtag par yang / /'jig rten sdig byed de sbyang phyir/ / 85—814

'khor ba'i ⑨srid du bdag nyid 'dulas/ /ji ltar padma rab dmar rdokyeyang / / tshon gyi ④nyes pas mi gos pa/ /de bzhin gnas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /'gro phan rnams la mi gos so/ /'dod chags chen po rnam par dag /bde ba che zhing nor che la/ /khams gsum dbang phyug thob pas na/ /sems can don rnams brtan par byed/ /lag na rdo rje su la la nang par langs nas mchog dang po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyin re zhing 'don pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / sgom pa de yid bde ba dang / bde ba thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ / bde ba chen po ⑤rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig dngos grub kyi mchog kyang tshe 'di la thob par 'gyur ro / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba mchog kyang 'grub yiste/tsordo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi chen po'am de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/gsang ba'i spribadag po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i sngags kyi tshig nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di rnams so/ /oṃ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ oṃ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ oṃ yid bzhin gyi klananor bu/ oṃ 'gog pa med pa/ oṃ skye ba bzlog 0pa/ oṃ rnam par shes pa thams cad/ oṃ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos nyid chen po/ oṃ brtson 'grus kyi go cha'o)/ oṃ kun tu 'gro ba/ oṃ rdo rje sra ba'i sems hūṃ phaṭahu / oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ oṃ ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa/ oṃ chos nyid shes pa rnam par dag pa/ oṃ de bzhin / las tshernam par sbyong ba'i/ rghaṃ oṃ nges par gnod mdzes rdo rje can ci'aphaṭa/ oṃ 'dod pa la 'dod chags patsho / oṃ spong ba'i rdo rje can/ oṃ hūṃ thams cad 'dul ba/85—815

oṃ hrīḥhu)/ oṃ a zhes bya ba'i sgo/ oṃ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ st+waṃ ② hūṃ arka/ ma(mi/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i mchog /oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rnam par dag pa/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje aḥhri/ oṃ a/ sdig pa'i bcings pa ⑤thams cad choms (6)shig /ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las thar bar ⑦gyis ④shig /oṃ dam tshig thams cad kyi rdo rje/ hūṃ traṭakha/ sdig pa gzhom pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ⑩dngos grub dam pa rdo rje 'dzin 7chen po dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje 'di ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa rnams kyi rna lam du thos par mi 'gyur ronyurte / /'di ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa rnams kyis mnyan pa'am/yi ger 'dri 32ba 'am/ yi ger 'drir tsogazhug snyipa 'am/ bklag ⑩pa 'am/'chang ba'am/ bsgom rmo tshopa 'am/ bste hunyestang du bya ba 'am/ ri mor bya ba 'am/mchod par mi nus so/ /gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na yi ge 'bru gcig tsam thos na yang sems can de dag ni gzhan na sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin na mtha' dag rdzogs pa lta ci smos/ lag na rdo rje gang la la dag sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang gā'i klung 3ltabargyad cu'i tsho tshobye ma snyed 31la bkur ste ma byas pa dang / bla mar ma byas pa dang / bste 32stang ma byas pa dang / mchod pa 3 ma byas pa de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi bla )rnam grangs 'di thos par mi nus so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang na 3 spyod pa'i sa phyogs de mchod rten du 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang gi lus la thogs sam/85—816

glegs bam la bris te spyod pa'i tshigang zag de phyag bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /de bskal pa ②bye ba mang por skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de la bdud sdig to can bar chad byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha gzhan rnams kyang de la bsrung chub dang / bskyab 7༄pa dang / sba ba'i phyir rtag tu phyi 6bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /ya nga ba ma spangs par ⑦'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du 'dod pa de dang der skye'o/ /de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di phan yon mang mod kyi ngas phyogs tsam zhig brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad 2bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' ⑨de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 8rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i /mtshul brgya nyunyelnga bcu pa rdzogs sto41snyel// // maṅga lo// pā85—817
